title: People Services Manager
description:
Overview   People Services Manager    Lead People Services in a newly built People and Culture function — services, policy and a new cloud People system.    Location: Flexible, with a preference for the successful candidate to be based at one of our MAF International entities.    MAF International is a Christian not-for-profit organisation that uses aviation to deliver essential services — medical evacuations, supplies, disaster relief and education — to remote communities across Africa and Asia Pacific.    With an 80-year history, MAF International is undergoing a major transformation — integrating a historically federated structure into a single global organisation, with the goal of reaching more than 5,000 remote communities by 2045. Its new People Operations and Strategic Projects function is being built now, and this role helps shape it from the start.   Why this role matters  Every contract issued on time, every record accurate, every colleague able to self-serve in seconds rather than days — that is what strong People Services delivers, and it lets the wider organisation focus on its work.  As People Services Manager you lead a core department in the new function, delivering three sub-functions — employee lifecycle management, policy management, and the People and Culture Management System (PCMS) — to around 850 staff across 31 units and 3 support offices, including some 120 internationally mobile staff.  The timing could hardly be better. We’re implementing a brand-new cloud People system from the ground up, and you’ll be its business owner — shaping service priorities, data quality, self-service and automation from day one, working with Digital/IT and implementation partners.   Please note:  Candidates must hold existing legal working rights for their proposed location of employment.    Salary : Competitive and flexible, with remuneration aligned to the successful candidate’s location, experience, and local employment context.  Responsibilities  💡 What You'll Be Doing  
 Lead and develop a team of People professionals across three sub-functions, including the PCMS Specialist, building a customer-centric, high-performance culture. 
 Own People Services requirements for the PCMS — service priorities, data quality and access controls — working with Digital/IT, the vendor and implementation partners through go-live and  
 Run employee lifecycle services — contracts, onboarding, transitions, offboarding and records — across all 31 units and 3 support offices, to clear service standards. 
 Coordinate the People policy lifecycle — from specialist review and approval to publication and implementation: standardise wherever it helps, localise where it matters. 
 Champion digital self-service and automation so our people spend their time on impact, not administration. 
 Turn clean data into insight: your reporting feeds the analytics that drive organisation-wide decisions. 
  Click here for the full job description   Closing date :  Closing date :  Applications close on the 27th November    We reserve the right to close this vacancy before the advertised closing date if we receive a sufficient number of applications. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible   Qualifications, Skills & Experience  🌏 What You'll Bring  We're looking for an experienced People Services or HR service-delivery leader who can combine  strategic thinking with practical delivery .  You'll bring:  
 Evidence of building and leading high-performance People service-delivery teams across multiple countries. 
 A track record managing a People-services or shared-services function, including service standards, SLAs and continuous improvement. 
 Strong knowledge of modern cloud HR systems and experience as business owner of an PCMS, including data quality and vendor management. 
 Proven experience implementing global People policy frameworks and managing compliance across multiple jurisdictions. 
 A process designer’s mind with a customer’s heart — efficiency that never loses sight of the person behind the ticket. 
 Sharp attention to detail, sound knowledge of employment-law principles across jurisdictions, and the ability to balance global consistency with local realities. 
 You share our vision, mission and values. 
  What we offer  
 A rare chance to build, not just run — you join as the function takes shape, with genuine influence on its design. 
 Work from anywhere: this role is globally remote, because talent matters more than time zone. 
 A small, expert team with real influence, in an organisation whose work has measurable impact. 
  Join us  Want to find out more about the role?   Click “Enquire Now” and register your details  to learn how you could help shape MAF’s People Services and support colleagues serving remote communities across Africa and Asia Pacific.  Originally posted on  Himalayas

The successful candidate will design and implement a focused sales plan that expands Expleo’s client base, strengthens its brand and grows both new logos and the accounts Expleo already holds.

They will bring strong knowledge of the London insurance market, its key decision-makers and the business and technology priorities shaping the sector, including market modernisation initiatives following Blueprint Two, digital placement and claims transformation, core platform replacement, quality engineering and managed testing, data governance and AI assurance, regulatory change and operational resilience.

Expleo already has a footing in this market. The role builds on this base rather than starting from nothing.

The individual must be a self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, strong commercial judgement and the credibility to engage senior stakeholders. They will bring a credible senior network across the London Market and specialty insurance ecosystem, and the ability to translate access into qualified opportunities and long-term client relationships.

For the right person, the role offers the opportunity to shape Expleo’s insurance proposition, bring together the full breadth of its relevant services and influence the growth strategy for London Market and insurance clients

Responsibilities

• Own and deliver the sales strategy for the London Market and insurance portfolio.
• Identify, pursue and win high-value new clients, alongside growth of the accounts Expleo already holds.
• Grow existing London Market accounts by converting delivery relationships into broader consulting, quality engineering and transformation engagements.
• Build a qualified pipeline and create clear pursuit, stakeholder and closure plans for priority opportunities.
• Achieve personal sales targets and contribute to team performance through disciplined forecasting, coaching and continuous performance monitoring.
• Develop long-term relationships with senior decision-makers, including C-suite, business, operations, technology and transformation leaders.
• Position Expleo as a strategic insurance partner by connecting client challenges to relevant consulting, quality engineering and managed testing, digital delivery, data and AI assurance, and transformation capabilities.
• Work collaboratively across business development, delivery, solutions and insurance teams to extend the existing UK insurance go-to-market plan, propositions and service lines for London Market and
• specialty insurance clients.
• Coordinate with relevant regions and business units where appropriate to expand Expleo’s presence within international insurance groups and market-wide insurance accounts.
• Represent Expleo externally as a credible industry voice through the Lloyd’s, LMA, LIIBA, IUA and ACORD communities, market events and published thought leadership.
• Lead, coach and develop sales colleagues, creating clear objectives and a high-performance culture.

Essential Skills

• Exceptional communication, negotiation and executive-level presentation skills.
• Credibility and gravitas to engage effectively with C-suite, business, operations, technology and transformation stakeholders.
• Strong commercial acumen, with a value-led approach focused on client outcomes, benefits, pain points and value creation.
• Proven ability to influence complex stakeholder groups and build internal and external sponsorship for major opportunities.
• Strong new-business hunting capability, with the discipline to qualify, pursue and close priority opportunities.
• Ability to shape and close complex, high-value, multi-stakeholder deals.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and highly motivated, with the resilience to operate through lengthy sales cycles.
• Strong coaching and performance-management capability in a player-coach sales environment.
• A collaborative mindset and the ability to mobilise multidisciplinary teams around client opportunities.
• New-logo and existing-account revenue generated across London Market and specialty insurance accounts.
• Qualified pipeline built and progressed against priority target accounts.
• Pipeline coverage against target, with qualified opportunities in each priority segment (managing agents, brokers, market service providers).
• Strategic client relationships opened, developed and converted into live opportunities.
• Sector propositions translated into credible pursuits, proposals and closed business.
• Contribution to Expleo’s London Market and insurance growth plan and sales leadership agenda.
• A recognised relationship-builder who can open doors and convert access into substantive opportunities.
• A credible ambassador for Expleo who can strengthen its profile across the London insurance community.

Experience

• Successful senior sales experience within the London Market, commercial insurance, specialty insurance, reinsurance, broking, insurance technology, insurance consulting or a closely related insurance-focused professional-services environment.
• A strong network and demonstrable credibility with senior stakeholders across Lloyd’s managing agents, company-market carriers, reinsurers, MGAs, specialty brokers or market service providers.
• Proven success in securing new accounts and expanding strategic clients at senior-management and executive level.
• Experience selling complex consulting, transformation, technology or professional-services solutions specifically into insurance organisations.
• A track record of exceeding personal and team sales goals and managing a high-quality pipeline and forecast.
• Experience navigating complex and lengthy decision-making, procurement and sales processes.
• Experience leading sales professionals and creating a high-performance environment.
• Evidence of successfully managing and closing multi-million-pound or equivalent strategic deals.
• Strong working knowledge of insurance operations, technology and transformation priorities, with the ability to engage credibly with business and technical leaders.
• Strong understanding of the London Market's strategic business and technology priorities, including market modernisation, digital placement and underwriting transformation, core platform modernisation, data and AI governance, operational resilience, regulatory change and the evolving carrier and broker operating model.
• Experience selling professional services (consulting, quality engineering, managed services)
• London-based or available to be in London, with the working week largely spent in the market (EC3) and with clients.

Benefits

• Collaborative working environment – we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges
• We empower all passionate technology loving professionals by allowing them to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects
• Expleo Academy - enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses
• Competitive company benefits
• Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo

• Ensure our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible
• Communicating and promoting vacancies
• Offering an interview to disabled people who meet the minimum criteria for the job
• Anticipating and providing reasonable adjustments as required
• Supporting any existing employee who acquires a disability or long term health condition, enabling them to stay in work at least one activity that will make a difference for disabled people

title: Data Solution Engineer | Python, Snowflake, dbt & AWS
description:
We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to join our growing team at Meso Systems.

We're a small technology and data consultancy helping organisations make better use of their data, technology and digital platforms.

We work across transport, mobility, retail and membership sectors, building data platforms, integrations, analytics and managed data services.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving real problems, building reliable solutions and getting things done.

The role

You'll work across a range of client projects, building and improving data pipelines, integrations and analytics solutions using Python, SQL, Snowflake, dbt and AWS.

You'll also have opportunities to work with Snowflake Cortex, Amazon QuickSight and emerging AI-driven data capabilities.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You won't need to be a senior architect, but you will be confident taking ownership of technical tasks, investigating problems and delivering well-built, maintainable solutions.

What you'll be doing

• Building and maintaining data pipelines using Python, SQL, dbt and Snowflake.
• Developing data models, transformations and integrations.
• Working with AWS cloud services and external APIs.
• Improving data quality, automation and processing reliability.
• Investigating and resolving technical issues.
• Supporting dashboards and analytics solutions, including Amazon QuickSight.
• Exploring AI-enabled data capabilities using Snowflake Cortex.
• Writing clean, tested and maintainable code.
• Working alongside our Data Architect, developers and wider delivery team.

What we're looking for

Essential

• Strong Python and SQL skills.
• Practical experience building ETL/ELT data pipelines.
• Experience with cloud-based data platforms.
• Good understanding of data modelling, integration and transformation.
• Confidence troubleshooting technical problems.
• Familiarity with Git, testing and good engineering practices.
• Ability to work independently, collaborate and take ownership.

Ideally, you'll also have experience with:

• Snowflake
• dbt
• AWS
• Amazon QuickSight
• Snowflake Cortex or other AI/ML data capabilities

You don't need experience with every technology. Strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity and a willingness to learn are just as important.

What makes someone a good fit?

You'll enjoy working in a small team where you can make a real contribution.

You're practical, proactive and comfortable figuring things out. You ask questions when needed, share ideas and care about building solutions that work reliably.

You're happy working across different projects rather than being limited to one system or technology.

Why join Meso Systems?

• Work on interesting, real-world data challenges across different industries.
• Use modern cloud data technologies and develop experience with emerging AI capabilities.
• Work directly with experienced engineers and technology specialists.
• Enjoy autonomy, variety and opportunities to develop your skills.
• Be part of a friendly, collaborative, remote-first team.

Location: Remote within the UK, with occasional team and client meetings.

Employment: Permanent, full-time.

Interested?

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV.

We'd particularly love to hear about something you've built, automated or improved using Python, Snowflake or other data technologies.

• Find out more about us at www.meso.systems.

Recruiting Coordinator (12 Month FTC)

Dublin, Ireland

Apply

Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

Recruiting is a key driver to Fin’s success. As a Recruiting Coordinator at Fin, you’ll act as a first impression for the company and partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver an optimal candidate interview experience. This position will support our global team to efficiently navigate complex scheduling requests and last-minute changes. Along with scheduling interviews, our Recruiting Coordinators are responsible for supporting recruiting related initiatives and overall system maintenance. We currently operate in a hybrid working model and have offices in San Francisco, Chicago, Dublin, London, Berlin and Sydney. You will be expected to be in the office in Dublin at least 3 days a week. This is a 12 month FTC.

What will I be doing?

• Manage the end-to-end interview scheduling process, including candidate communication, interview panel coordination, and room booking. Ensure a smooth interview experience for candidates and interviewers.
• Support recruiters and hiring panels by opening, organising, and maintaining recruitment data in our ATS. Generate reports and provide data insights as required.
• Serve as the main point of contact for candidates throughout the hiring process. Continuously seek ways to improve the candidate experience.
• Facilitate in-person / on-site interviews, including greeting candidates, preparing interview spaces, and ensuring a welcoming office experience.
• Assist with posting job openings on various job boards and Fin's careers page. Ensure job descriptions are up-to-date and attractive to potential candidates.
• Assist with maintaining recruitment-related documents, templates, prep guides, and processes. Help streamline and optimise recruitment operations, including organising recruitment events, managing recruitment campaigns, and coordinating with external vendors.
• Represent Fin’s mission, vision, and values with integrity, and help us attract AI-enthusiasts who are excited to shape the future of customer service.

What skills do I need?

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in a recruiting coordinator or similar role
• Strong attention to detail, high sense of urgency, and prioritisation and multi-tasking skills
• Excellent communication skills
• Affinity for improving and caring for the candidate experience
• Proficiency in multiple tools and systems: GSuite, Microsoft office and applicant tracking systems

Bonus skills & attributes

• Familiarity with our scheduling, recruiting and HR Systems (Greenhouse, Workday, Candidate FYI, Slack, Claude)

#LI-Hybrid

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Mobile Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

 - Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

 - Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (Swift UI or Kotlin Jetpack Compose), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

 - Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

 - Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Senior Events Executive

Company Description

We're ASOS, the online retailer for fashion lovers all around the world.

We exist to give our customers the confidence to be whoever they want to be, and that goes for our people too. At ASOS, you're free to be your true self without judgement, and channel your creativity into a platform used by millions.

Everyone needs some help showing up as their best self. We're Disability Confident Committed - let our Talent team know if you need any reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

Job Description

YOUR ROLE

You’ll support the planning and delivery of ASOS’ events, helping us create brilliantly organised, engaging experiences that bring ASOS to life and support our business priorities.

Reporting to the Senior Events Manager, you’ll take day-to-day ownership of agreed events and workstreams, coordinating plans, suppliers and logistics to keep everything moving. You’ll work closely with teams across Brand, Comms and the wider business to turn event briefs into memorable experiences.

This is a hands-on opportunity to bring fresh ideas, build your experience and help shape how ASOS shows up IRL, with guidance and support from the Senior Events Manager.

What you'll be doing...

• Supporting the delivery of ASOS’ events programme, taking day-to-day ownership of agreed smaller events and defined workstreams within larger projects.
• Coordinating event logistics, including agencies, supplier schedules, materials and on-site arrangements.
• Working with agencies and suppliers against agreed briefs, obtaining quotes, tracking deliverables and escalating any changes or concerns.
• Maintaining budget trackers, coordinating purchase orders and invoices, and flagging potential overspend. You’ll seek approval from the Senior Events Manager before committing spend or changing scope.
• Coordinating input and approvals from teams across ASOS, keeping event plans aligned with wider campaigns and priorities.
• Providing hands-on support during event set-up, delivery and breakdown, resolving day-to-day issues and escalating risks where needed.
• Bringing together attendance data, feedback and costs for post-event reporting, and identifying practical ways to make the next event even better.
• Supporting our culture by championing Diversity, Equity & Inclusion strategies.

Qualifications

Who we'd like to meet...

• Experience coordinating and delivering events, with ownership of projects or defined workstreams.
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience working with agencies, suppliers and production partners, as well as supporting budgets and event administration.
• Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with people across different teams.
• Creative thinking, a practical and delivery-focused mindset, and a genuine interest in fashion, culture and brand experiences.
• The confidence to work independently on agreed priorities, alongside the judgement to know when to ask for guidance or raise an issue.

What success looks like

• You’re highly organised, have a sharp eye for detail and can be relied on to deliver.
• You keep plans on track, communicate clearly with stakeholders and suppliers, and deliver agreed activity to a high standard, on time and within budget.
• You also bring fresh thinking, anticipate practical challenges and raise risks early, helping the team find solutions before they become problems.

Additional Information

BeneFITS’

• Employee discount (hello ASOS discount!)
• Employee sample sales
• 25 days paid annual leave + an extra celebration day for a special moment
• Performance related bonus
• Private medical care scheme
• Opportunity for personalised learning and in-the-moment experiences that enable you to thrive and excel in your role.

HR Process Coordinator

• Full-time

Company Description

Software Mind develops solutions that make an impact for companies around the globe. Tech giants & unicorns, transformative projects, emerging technologies and limitless opportunities – these are a few words that describe an average day for us. Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. Our culture embraces openness, acts with respect, shows grit & guts and combines cooperation with enjoyment.

Job Description

Project – the aim you’ll have

We are looking for someone who will support the HR and payroll team in the day-to-day administration of HR and, at the same time, help us organize and improve HR processes in a multi-company organization. This role is for someone who knows “hard” HR inside out, yet enjoys organizing, standardizing, reporting and bringing together the perspectives of different departments. It is a role in a dynamic environment: it requires running several topics in parallel, setting priorities independently and working efficiently with a large number of tasks.

Role – how you’ll contribute

• Supporting the team in comprehensive HR administration across the full lifecycle of employees, individuals engaged under civil-law contracts and B2B contractors (including electronic personnel files).
• Standardizing and supporting HR processes within the team and at the interface with other company departments, including defining the rules of cooperation with those departments.
• Identifying areas for improvement and automation of HR processes, and initiating and leading changes in this area, including through the use of new technologies and AI-based tools – in cooperation with the company’s operational improvement team.
• Cooperating with the external partner supporting us with the HR and payroll system: reporting needs, testing changes and rolling out new functionalities.
• Co-creating and updating the internal policies, procedures and instructions of the HR and payroll team.
• Participating in the preparation, updating and implementation of company regulations in cooperation with the Legal department.
• Preparing HR reports and summaries.
• Running ad hoc HR projects and initiatives (e.g., mass contract amendments and documentation, changes in legislation, organizational changes).
• Tracking changes in labor law and implementing them in HR processes, and participating in HR inspections and audits.

Qualifications

• Min. 5 years of experience in an independent HR position in an international company (including 2 years of experience coordinating project work)
• Knowledge of labor law and GDPR, and of the practical rules for maintaining employee records.
• Experience in organizing and documenting processes, instructions and internal policies.

title: Delivery Engineer, ML, EMEA
description:
About Hilbert

Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies.

The Mission: Turn Ground Truth Into Growth

Hilbert has two parts: a data foundation that gives our AI agents a high-fidelity view of each business, and an agentic web app where growth teams find and act on insights. The scores and audiences you build feed both: our agents reason with them, and our activation sends them into paid media and CRM.

The hard problem

Every customer's data is different, their compute may be ClickHouse, Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery, and their teams want proof, not promises. Your models have to work in that environment and show measured uplift. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. You focus on delivery; our sales engineers handle pre-sales. Your work centers on customers in your own region: supporting customers elsewhere is a rare exception, and your global work is mainly staying aligned with Hilbert colleagues in other regions.

What You'll Do

• Feature stores: build customer-specific, point-in-time correct features on the data foundation.
• Models: train, tune and validate propensity, churn, lifetime value, uplift and custom models, starting from our ML templates and building custom models when a customer needs something the templates don't cover. New model types that many customers will need are built first by our product engineering team, and you roll them out to later customers.
• Model analysis: go beyond aggregate metrics to verify what each model has learned, what drives its scores, and how it behaves across segments and on edge cases.
• Deployment: models run in the customer's own environment or on our managed stack. In either case, understand the constraints, pin down the requirements, design the ML system to fit, and write the scores and audiences our agents and activation use.
• Measurement: own the statistical design inside our growth team's measurement plan, from power and holdout setup to uplift analysis.
• Trust: document models for the customer's data science and risk teams, then monitor and retrain them in production.
• Productization: turn repeated features and model patterns into product with our product engineering team.

What Success Looks Like

• Audiences built from your models lift the agreed growth metric, such as conversion or retention, against a holdout group, and that result decides whether the customer takes them to production.

Who You Are

• The translator: you explain a model to a customer's data science team and earn their trust.
• The experimenter: you'd rather prove uplift in a holdout test than show off an offline metric.
• The pilot: you get the most out of AI agents across model iterations, from feature ideas and experiment runs to error analysis, and help build them into how the team works.
• The systems thinker: you build reusable features, pipelines and automation instead of one-off models, so a small team can deliver across very different environments.
• Extensive applied ML experience on tabular customer data, with strong Python and ML libraries.
• Extensive hands-on deep learning experience, from designing architectures and loss functions to training and shipping models in production, with PyTorch or a similar framework.
• Feature engineering in SQL warehouses such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery.
• Working data engineering experience: building and debugging pipelines, data orchestration, data modeling and data quality checks, enough to own your feature pipelines end to end with our data engineers.
• Production ML with tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases or Vertex AI.
• Solid experiment design and uplift measurement.
• Comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones.
• Fluent Spanish for roles based in Latin America.

Nice to have

• DevOps, software architecture and security knowledge
• Growth-focused data projects experience
• Industry experience such as e-commerce, retail, fintech, telco and media
• Model governance in regulated industries such as banking and telco: model documentation, explainability and PII handling
• Able to travel to the US when necessary

Reporting and location

You report to your pod's Lead Delivery Engineer and work alongside our data delivery engineers and product engineering team. The role is based in EMEA. Delivery runs remotely, with occasional visits to our largest customers.

Why join us

At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go.

Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Sous Chef
description:
Sous Chef, Prezzo Italian

The Head Chef's right hand, and the steady pair of hands every kitchen needs.

You can't miss Prezzo Italian right now. Our refurbished restaurants look stunning, with more on the way, and the food has never been better. Guests are noticing and the momentum is real. Now we need Sous Chefs who lead by example and are ready to grow into Head Chefs.

Who We Are

Brava Hospitality Group is the home of great restaurant brands. We're the group behind Prezzo Italian, in towns and cities right across the UK, and a collection of much-loved central London restaurants: Jamie's Italian, Riding House Café, Nessa, Yasmin, Mortimer House Kitchen and, most recently, Bolo by Gennaro. And we're growing the footprint of every one of our brands. We're restaurant people at heart, and we believe every guest deserves brilliant food and exceptional hospitality from teams who love what they do.

Prezzo Italian has been bringing the Italian classics to towns and cities across the UK since 2000. For our 25th birthday we gave it a fresh start: a brand-new look, beautifully redesigned restaurants, and a menu built around the dishes people love, made fresh and cooked properly. Prezzo Italian is the home of the Italian classics.

We're a business on the way up, and the people who join us now will shape where it goes next.

The role

As Sous Chef at Prezzo Italian, you're your Head Chef's right hand. You run shifts in the kitchen, keep standards high on every section, and take charge when your Head Chef isn't there.

At Prezzo Italian, it all comes down to two things: the impression we make and the connections we build. Every guest should leave feeling genuinely looked after, not just served. That starts with how we treat each other. Teams who look out for one another, have fun together and take pride in what they do create the moments guests remember and come back for. As Sous Chef, you help set that tone on every shift.

Food is one of our key pillars, so you'll have the right tools to get it right every time. Our dedicated chefs website shows exactly what every dish should look like and the right ingredients that go into it, and some of our restaurants use QSR kitchen technology to keep every order flowing.

With your Head Chef and our central team of chefs behind you, this is the place to learn what it takes to run your own kitchen.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Leading the kitchen

• Run the pass and lead shifts with confidence.
• Train and coach the team, helping develop the chefs of tomorrow.
• Step up and run the kitchen in your Head Chef's absence.

Cooking the Italian classics properly

• Make sure every dish is made fresh, cooked properly and plated to spec.
• Jump on any section when it's needed.
• Work closely with front of house so every guest gets the same great impression.

Keeping standards high

• Help manage ordering, stock and waste.
• Lead on food safety, allergens and health and safety, every shift.
• Keep the kitchen clean, organised and audit-ready.

What We're Looking For

Are you a Prezzo person? You're warm, genuine and generous with your time. You love great food and you love people even more. You make every guest feel welcome from the moment they walk in, you lift the team around you, and you take pride in getting the little things right. You bring energy, a sense of fun, and the confidence to make the call.

You're a Sous Chef already, or an experienced chef who is ready for the next step.

• Experience in a busy, high-volume kitchen, including leading shifts.
• Pride in food and consistency, on every plate.
• Calm under pressure, with a people-first approach.
• Good knowledge of food safety, allergens and health and safety.
• Ambition to run your own kitchen one day.

What's In It For You

You'll give a lot to this role. Here's what we give back.

Reward

• Tronc, so you share in the success of a busy restaurant
• Company pension scheme, if you're eligible
• Life assurance at 2x your annual pay
• Paid holiday allowance
• Refer a friend and earn up to £1,000

Time and wellbeing

• Your birthday off, every year
• Free or heavily subsidised meals on shift
• 24/7 GP helpline and Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
• Stream (formerly Wagestream), our financial wellbeing app: access pay you've already earned, save straight from your pay, and get tools and guidance to manage your money
• Free regulated mortgage advice

Perks

• 50% off at Prezzo Italian
• 25% off at every other Brava restaurant
• Share 25% off with up to 5 friends and family, even when you're not there
• Free Tastecard and the Hospitality Rewards app for retail discounts
• Electric car scheme after one year's service

Your future

• Ongoing development and coaching
• A clear path to Head Chef
• Opportunities across our other brands

Ready for the next step?

This is an exciting time for Prezzo Italian, and where we go next will be shaped by the people who join us now.

If you want to lead, learn and grow with a kitchen team that's proud of every plate, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today. It takes a few minutes to start a conversation that could change your next five years.

Brava Hospitality Group is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone, and we'll make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Python Engineer with expertise in Cloud technologies to contribute to a strategic project for one of our key clients.

As a Senior Engineer, you will create, enhance, and implement scalable, secure solutions utilizing Python and modern cloud platforms. Collaboration with cross-functional teams will be essential to deliver innovative software systems addressing complex business challenges and driving digital transformation.

Stanowisko łączy pracę biurową z zadaniami realizowanymi w terenie, w tym bezpośrednia obsługa Zleceniodawców oraz organizacja i realizacja odbiorów materiałów do badań.

Poszukujemy osób, które dobrze odnajdują się zarówno w zadaniach organizacyjnych, jak i w bezpośrednim kontakcie z klientami. Proporcje obowiązków biurowych i terenowych mogą być zróżnicowane w zależności od potrzeb organizacyjnych laboratorium oraz kompetencji i predyspozycji pracownika.

Zakres obowiązków:

• Realizacja bieżących zadań administracyjno-finansowych.
• Bezpośrednia, telefoniczna i mailowa obsługa Zleceniodawców.
• Obsługa zamówień w sklepie internetowym genetico.pl.
• Bieżąca obsługa zleceń, weryfikacja poprawności ich realizacji oraz wyjaśnianie niezgodności.
• Budowanie i utrzymywanie dobrych relacji z obecnymi oraz potencjalnymi Zleceniodawcami.
• Organizacja i realizacja odbioru/zwrotu materiału do badań.
• Planowanie tras kierowców oraz koordynowanie ich realizacji.
• Bezpośrednie wizyty u Zleceniodawców, w tym instytucji i podmiotów współpracujących z laboratorium.
• Przedstawianie oferty oraz przekazywanie informacji dotyczących usług świadczonych przez laboratorium.
• Współpraca z firmami kurierskimi oraz koordynowanie transportu przesyłek.
• Prowadzenie dokumentacji związanej z obsługą zleceń i realizacją działań logistycznych.
• Dbanie o sprawny przepływ informacji oraz prawidłowy obieg spraw i dokumentów.
• Ścisła współpraca z laboratorium i wsparcie jego bieżącej działalności organizacyjnej.
• Wsparcie działań marketingowych, w tym przygotowywanie i publikowanie treści informacyjnych.

Nasze wymagania:

• Bardzo dobra organizacja pracy własnej, samodzielność i odpowiedzialność.
• Terminowość, dokładność oraz umiejętność ustalania priorytetów.
• Komunikatywność, wysoka kultura osobista i umiejętność budowania pozytywnych relacji z klientami.
• Umiejętność pracy zespołowej oraz samodzielnej realizacji powierzonych zadań.
• Umiejętność planowania i organizacji pracy oraz szybkiego reagowania na zmieniające się sytuacje.
• Umiejętność efektywnego działania pod presją czasu i rozwiązywania nietypowych sytuacji.
• Dobra znajomość pakietu Microsoft Office oraz obsługi komputera i urządzeń biurowych.
• Prawo jazdy kat. B oraz praktyczna umiejętność prowadzenia samochodu.
• Gotowość do wykonywania obowiązków zarówno w biurze, jak i w terenie.
• Rzetelność oraz przestrzeganie zasad poufności informacji i dokumentacji.
• Zaświadczenie o niekaralności (przy zatrudnieniu).

Mile widziane:

• Wykształcenie wyższe, szczególnie na kierunkach: administracja, marketing, biologia, biotechnologia lub pokrewnych.
• Doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta, administracji, logistyce lub pracy terenowej.
• Doświadczenie w bezpośrednich kontaktach z klientami oraz budowaniu relacji biznesowych.
• Znajomość języka angielskiego.
• Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu profili w mediach społecznościowych (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn), tworzeniu i publikowaniu treści.
• Umiejętności w zakresie tworzenia prostych materiałów graficznych i promocyjnych (np. Canva), edycji krótkich materiałów wideo (np. CapCut).

Oferujemy:

• Możliwość pracy w nowocześnie zarządzanym laboratorium, w zaangażowanym, doświadczonym zespole.
• Ciekawą i odpowiedzialną pracę pełną wyzwań.
• Udział w szkoleniach wewnętrznych i zewnętrznych, podnoszenie kwalifikacji.
• Możliwość stałego zatrudnienia po odbyciu okresu próbnego.
• Ubezpieczenie na życie.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Position: Data Scientist

Department: AI Growth

Reporting to: Data Science Manager

Location: London or Amsterdam

Hybrid role: 3 days a week from our office & 2 days working from home

Full time / Part time role: Full time

Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it's a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About This Role

Join our AI Growth team and help build the intelligence behind Just Eat's marketplace, powering personalised experiences for tens of millions of customers across 14 countries. This is your opportunity to deliver end-to-end machine learning solutions that directly impact customer engagement and order growth.

We're building JET's foundation model platform, developing embedding models for search and recommendations, and creating intelligent targeting systems for personalised offers and notifications. We're looking for someone who can live our behaviours of lead, deliver and care while bringing technical excellence and innovation.

This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real-world business impact. You'll work on everything from fine-tuning large language models to designing sophisticated recommender systems, all while collaborating with ML engineers, product teams, and commercial stakeholders.

We need someone who can challenge assumptions, translate ambiguous business problems into elegant technical solutions, and ship production-quality ML systems that make a measurable difference to our customers and partners.

These are some of the key components to the position:

• Lead the development and deployment of ML/AI solutions including embedding models, fine-tuned LLMs, and ranking systems that drive engagement and orders while raising the bar for technical excellence.
• Apply generative AI and LLM techniques to personalisation challenges, generating customer and partner representations that improve search relevance and app experiences.
• Own your results by designing, running and interpreting A/B experiments with statistical rigour, measuring real impact on business metrics and holding yourself accountable.
• Collaborate with ML engineers to productionise models, implementing MLOps best practices and maintaining monitored pipelines that deliver consistent value.
• Break down silos by translating complex business questions into clear modelling approaches and communicating results effectively to product and commercial stakeholders.
• Be determined to take end-to-end ownership of well-scoped workstreams, independently framing problems, choosing approaches, running experiments and presenting findings.
• Move fast by writing production-quality Python code and efficient SQL for data pipelines and analyses that can scale across our marketplace.
• Contribute to JET's foundation model platform and personalised targeting systems, pushing boundaries to create lasting impact across millions of customer interactions.
• Set clear goals by designing experiments that influence commercial decisions while ensuring statistical validity and actionable insights.
• Aim higher by staying current with advances in search, retrieval, recommendations and LLM applications, bringing fresh ideas to drive the AI Growth vision forward.

What will you bring to the team?

• Proven track record delivering end-to-end ML solutions from problem framing through data exploration to production deployment and experiment measurement, demonstrating your commitment to achieving goals.
• Hands-on expertise in search, retrieval and recommendation techniques including embedding-based approaches, learning-to-rank, and vector similarity search with measurable business impact.
• Practical experience applying LLMs in production environments, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, structured output validation and assessing generative output quality.
• Strong experimentation skills with ability to design and interpret A/B tests, reason about statistical significance, and understand the gap between offline and online performance.
• Production-grade Python coding abilities that go beyond notebooks, writing clean, testable code suitable for engineering workflows and collaboration with technical teams.
• Proficient SQL
• skills across complex data warehouses, including partitioning, window functions, and large-table joins, with focus on query efficiency and data quality.
• Excellent problem-framing and communication skills to translate ambiguous business questions into modelling approaches and explain technical results to non-technical stakeholders based on respect and mutual support.
• Self-starter attitude comfortable with autonomy and ambiguity, thriving in fast-paced environments where you can build rapidly, test rigorously and roll out successes at scale.
• Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with senior data scientists, ML engineers, product partners and commercial teams across different levels and functions.
• Results-driven mindset with attention to detail, able to balance speed of execution with technical rigour while making data-informed decisions that create lasting impact.

Bonus Skills That Will Help You Excel

• Experience with causal inference or uplift modelling relevant to promotions and growth initiatives.
• Knowledge of sequential or session-based recommendation modelling techniques.
• Familiarity with real-time data pipelines and streaming infrastructure.
• Experience working across multiple languages or markets in a data science context.

At JET, This Is How We Play

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Being the best at what we do isn't just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers' loyalty, again and again.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we're building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We're committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else are we delivering?

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys.

Are you ready to join the team? Apply now!

Have you ever wondered what it takes to keep tens of thousands of delivery vans moving across Europe, every single day? We work across multiple European countries, partnering with Delivery Service Providers (DSPs), Fleet Management Companies (FMCs), and internal teams across Last Mile operations.

We're looking for an Insights Manager to own how we use data to find and drive fleet cost savings. You'll build the pipelines, dashboards, and analyses that help leadership understand where the money goes and where the opportunities are. Think of it as being the team's data engine: you surface the insights, quantify the impact, and help turn numbers into action.

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be comfortable working independently, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, and solving problems where the path isn't always obvious. Please note that this a 12 months Fixed-term contract.

Key job responsibilities

• Experience with one or more analytics visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI)
• Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

• Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
• Experience analysing and interpreting large-scale datasets using SQL and a cloud data warehouse (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar)

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with financial or business analysis
• Experience with database, data warehouse or data lake solutions
• Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities
• Experience in fleet management, logistics, transportation, or last mile operations
• Track record of building reporting or data products from scratch

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
Our client is a successful consumer-focussed tech scale‑up, a cash‑generative SME currently at c.£12m turnover and c.80 staff, looking to double in size in the next five years under the guidance of its experienced, highly charismatic and driven owner, supported by a first‑class senior leadership team.

Find out more about this role by reading the information below, then apply to be considered.

Its CFO is looking to strengthen the company’s close-knit, growing finance department to best manage the increasing volume and complexity of business generated by c.120,000 product and service customers, increasing presence and advertising spend, plus a constantly developing product range, by appointing to an exciting, new Senior FP&A Analyst role.

Working closely with CFO and Financial Controller, building the commercial models, pulling data, finding the insight and explaining it in plain English, you'll support the company in scaling from a subscription business into a multi-product, regulated one.

Your Key Responsibilities As Senior FP&A Analyst Will Include

Subscription and growth

• Own subscription metrics: new customers, MRR, churn and retention by cohort, ARPU, LTV:CAC and payback
• Work hand-in-hand with marketing on paid social, creators, influencers, affiliates and other channels: CAC, ROAS and payback by channel, including where the next pound should go
• Model pricing, offers, upgrades and add-ons before launch, tracking them after
• Track affiliate programmes — marketing affiliates and partners who sell products: sales, commission accruals and payouts, margin after commission and return by affiliate

Products, inventory and raw materials

• Build the P&L, margin and cash models for physical products and services, including new partners
• Own inventory and raw-material budgets: forecast usage from sales plans, set purchase plans and track actual use against budget
• Build product costings (bill of materials, packaging, fulfilment) to show true unit margin
• Track stock levels, stock days, wastage, write-offs and slow-moving lines; run regular stock reconciliations with Ops
• Join up Sales, Marketing and Stock plans so campaigns don't outrun supply or leave cash tied up in stock
• Model supplier, fulfilment and partner costs, terms and settlements

Planning and reporting

• Build and run a lean budget and rolling 12–18 month forecast, plus a 13-week cash flow
• Produce a weekly flash and a monthly KPI pack with clear, short commentary
• Prepare board numbers with the CFO

Governance and compliance

• Put in place strong controls, reconciliations and documentation that fit a fast-moving business
• Support governance of supplier and affiliate partnerships: clear contracts, settlements, audit trails and reporting, so responsibilities stay with the right party and partner's regulatory requirements are met
• Get revenue recognition and VAT right across subscriptions, bundles and physical products, working with the CFO and advisers

Systems and data

• Pull reliable data from the company’s proprietary app, payments (e.g. Stripe), ad platforms and accounting system
• Automate reporting with Excel, Power BI or similar so the numbers update themselves

As Senior FP&A Analyst, You’ll Need

• Strong, hands-on commercial experience gained in a similar Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Commercial Finance or Management Accounting role - you build models and dashboards yourself and enjoy being hands-on every day
• Strong understanding of subscription or SaaS economics (MRR, churn, cohorts, LTV:CAC), ideally gained in a scaling, marketing-led, social-first or D2C businesses, including physical products, inventory, raw-material costing, e-commerce or affiliate programmes
• Exposure to health or other regulated consumer products also beneficial
• Qualified (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) or qualified by experience
• Proven knowledge of Power BI, SQL and/or similar data, analytics and tech tools
• High emotional intelligence: you read the room, build trust quickly and can challenge founders and marketers without friction
• Strong grip on governance, controls and compliance
• Advanced Excel and financial modelling; comfortable with messy data

Rewards And Benefits

• Basic salary between £60,000 and £80,000, plus benefits including pension and health/wellbeing programme
• Maximum pay/rewards, dependent on possessing all outlined experience, skills, knowledge and qualifications
• Full‑time, permanent, office-based in Gateshead
• Free parking
• On‑site health facilities, staff events and discounts, training/development and more
• Casual dress
• Pet friendly

title: Compounder and Blender
description:
Job title: Compounder and Blender

Reporting to: Shift Lead

Location: Bury St. Edmunds, Suffolk

Shift Options:

Rotating day shift: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday on a rotating weekly shift pattern: early shift: 06:00 – 14:00 or late shift: 13:45 – 21:45

Night shift: 38 hours per week (Monday to Thursday, 20:45–06:15)

Weekend shift: 36.75 hours per week, Friday to Sunday on a rotating weekly shift pattern: 6:00 – 18:15 or 18:00 – 6:15.

The Opportunity

As a Compounder and Blender you will be playing a pivotal role. processing orders and operating and maintaining and ensuring the smooth and efficient running of machinery.

What It’s Like To Work Here

We’ve been making the world taste better since 1886 and sell over 3000 products in more than 90 countries, but we’re only just getting started. We’re on an exciting journey and have ambitious plans to become the indispensable partner of choice for the world’s leading flavour and fragrance houses, beverage and consumer brands. You can find out more about our exciting organisation here: TREATT | About Treatt the trusted global ingredients manufacturer

On joining Treatt, you’ll become one of over 400 international experts, working together to collectively surprise and delight our customers. Nothing is more important to us than the happiness of our people as without them, we’d never succeed.

We think Treatt’s a great place to work, but don’t just take our word for it:

“Everyone wants your feedback and opinion; it feels like a place of study where nurturing and encouragement are the standard. It is very clear the hard work that goes into providing excellence for customers, but it is also very apparent that managers have the same goals for helping us all to progress.”

“Joining my close and supportive team was the most enjoyable way to gain more skills and increase my knowledge”

“Treatt creates an environment to help you be the best you can, with no two days the same and opportunities always available to help you learn and develop. The people and the culture create a fantastic company to be part of”

What You’ll Be Doing

The responsibilities of this role include but are not limited to:

• Operating all Distillation process units according to operating and safety procedures.
• Operating all ancillary equipment, including chillers, compressors, tank farm Thermal Oil Burners, Vacuum pumps and the tank farm control system
• Assisting in the safe start-up and shutdown of all plants and ancillary equipment
• Carrying out weekly checks, including housekeeping and ensure they are suitably actioned
• Ensuring that hourly checks, including close monitoring of process units are carried out
• Contributing to a ‘right first time’ policy and help to ensure that all orders are met on time and within specification.
• Carrying out basic maintenance tasks such as replacing valves, seals, checking filters etc. Report more complex maintenance problems to Shift Supervisor.
• Operating and carrying out checks on Pilot plant if required
• Carrying out laboratory tasks and analytical work as required to maintain efficient use of process equipment
• Loading and unloading tankers, ensuring paperwork, analysis and transfer is carried out in an efficient and timely manner
• Ensuring high standards of housekeeping and 5S are always maintained within the department
• Carrying out bulking of manufactured and purchased materials and fulfilling orders in an efficient and timely manner
• Operating the safe use of forklift trucks and ensure checks are completed on relevant vehicles and carrying out basic maintenance tasks such as replacing valves, seals, checking filters etc.
• Cycle Counts
• Ensuring that Standard Operating Procedures and Cleaning Processes are always followed
• Coordinating stock that requires melting & Filtering in preparation for orders
• Supporting the delivery and deployment of a lean culture and behaviour in the organisation.
• Contribute to a ‘Continuous Improvement’ process to improve, optimise and make safer processes and operations. Lead a ‘Continuous Improvement’ process within shift to improve, optimise and make safer processes and operations
• Maintaining high standards of GMP & BRC compliance in all aspects of production
• Exhibiting a good awareness of COSHH, risk assessment, HAZOP and general process safety and ensure this is communicated to all staff. Take the lead in introducing an excellent safety culture in general and specifically with regard to manual handling, Vehicle / Pedestrian safety, PPE and Accident / incident reporting

What we’re looking for

If you have a genuine passion for what you do and want to work in an environment that celebrates progress, teamwork and dedication, you’re what we’re after.

What We’ll Do For You

We offer an excellent package which includes a competitive salary; a generous holiday entitlement as well as the opportunity to purchase additional holiday, we also offer a discretionary annual bonus, BUPA medical and dental schemes, pension scheme with 9% employer contribution, life assurance, group income protection, SAYE schemes and free shares.

With the encouragement and development you need, we help you to become your ultimate you. Beyond building a successful career, we also support the wishes and ambitions of our staff outside of the office in achieving a health work/life balance - the wellbeing of our staff is paramount to us, which we actively promote and support by regularly delivering a variety of wellbeing initiatives and offering responsibility based flexibility. There will also be opportunities to be actively involved in community and charity projects and to take part in numerous subsidized social events.

Polite Notice

We politely request that we are not contacted by any recruitment agencies. We have a preferred supplier list and high volumes of speculative calls from agencies negatively impact upon the efficiency of our business. Please help us to maintain the highest levels of customer service by respecting our wishes.

title: Junior Journalist Apprenticeship - SCQF 7 - BBC Radio Orkney - Kirkwall
description:
Contract Type: Fixed-Term Apprenticeship, Full-time for 24 months

Department: BBC Radio Orkney

Location: Kirkwall - Radio Orkney

Salary: £24,650

COULD A BBC APPRENTICESHIP BE THE NEXT ROLE FOR YOU?

Join us as an apprentice at the BBC to give yourself the opportunity to kick-start your career in a job you'll love. We’re committed to your skills and talent development. You’ll learn on-the-job, developing your knowledge and skills in an area that interests you, whilst working towards your apprenticeship qualification with one of our learning providers.

WHY JOIN THIS SCHEME?

The Junior Journalist Apprenticeship (JRA27) is perfect for curious and creative individuals with a passion for storytelling. Whether you're finishing school, college, or exploring an alternative to university, this programme offers an exciting opportunity to kick-start your journalism career with the world's leading public service media organisation.

You'll gain hands-on experience covering stories that matter to audiences, learning from experienced journalists and developing the skills needed to create trusted journalism.

Alongside this, you’ll work towards a SCQF7 apprenticeship qualification.

Want to find out more? Watch recordings from our webinar series on our Life at the BBC YouTube playlist to learn more about this scheme and other opportunities we offer, and hear from current apprentices about their experiences.

Your Key Responsibilities And Impact

As a Junior Journalist apprentice, this is a brilliant opportunity to learn, grow and contribute. On this team you can expect to:

• Work alongside experienced journalists developing your skills while creating high-quality content.
• Get hands on experience including researching stories, booking guests and writing briefs.
• Discover and develop compelling stories, assisting with interviews that bring important issues to life for diverse audiences.
• Learn from industry experts at the world's largest public service broadcaster.

You’ll study for your industry-recognised apprenticeship qualification, learning both on and off the job.

This involves weekly in-person classes at Glasgow Clyde College. For apprentices who aren’t based in Glasgow these sessions will be virtual.

You’ll Cover a Range Of Modules Including

• Media Law
• Essential Journalism
• Broadcast Journalism
• Journalism for a Digital Audience
• Video Journalism

Modules will be assessed through exams, coursework and a portfolio of work.

For more information on what you will study during the scheme, please see the SCQF 7 Standard.

Your Skills And Eligibility

We’re interested in your passion for working at the BBC and your enthusiasm for delivering world-class content and operational excellence to our audiences. We’re not focused on your qualifications; instead, we look for potential and offer you the opportunity to apply your transferable strengths and experience to work in different ways.

Skills

If you can bring some of these skills and experiences, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply:

• You're naturally curious about people and what’s happening in the world around you, with a keen interest in news.
• You’re full of creative ideas and enjoy finding innovative ways to tell engaging stories.
• You love finding things out, asking questions and getting to the heart of a story.
• You have a real enthusiasm for writing and enjoy communicating complex ideas in a clear, compelling way.
• You thrive in a fast-paced environment, bringing flexibility, motivation and a willingness to adapt as priorities change.

This scheme is aimed at non-graduates. If you have a degree and you’re interested in similar roles at the BBC, we recommend applying for jobs at the BBC careers site or having a look at our other apprenticeship schemes.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

To be eligible for an apprenticeship at the BBC, you must:

• Be 18 years old or over by the time the apprenticeship begins in September 2027.
• Have lived in the UK continuously for the last three years prior to the start of the apprenticeship.
• Be legally eligible to work full-time in the UK for the entire duration of the apprenticeship.
• Not currently be enrolled in another apprenticeship programme, whether with the BBC or another organisation.
• Not already hold a qualification in the same subject area at the same or a higher level than this apprenticeship.

To Apply For This Scheme, You Must Also

• Not have completed or be studying for the NCTJ diploma or a journalism qualification at the same level or higher.
• Have achieved English GCSE at Grade 4/C or above, or National 5 (Scotland) at C or Functional Skills Level 2 or equivalent qualification.

For candidates under the age of 19 years at the start of the apprenticeship: To complete the apprenticeship, you must have achieved Maths and English GCSE at Grade 4/C or above or National 5 (Scotland) at C or Functional Skills Level 2 or equivalent qualification to pass the apprenticeship.

READY TO APPLY?

Don’t leave yourself wondering “what if?” This could be your chance to be part of something exciting. See yourself thriving in this role? Just click ‘Apply Now’!

You’ll create a candidate profile and answer a few questions - no CV or cover letter needed.

If you're eligible, we’ll guide you through the next steps of the process and what to expect.

You’ll need to live within a commutable distance of where this role is based. Interested in a different location? Check out our other adverts - but please only apply to one.

The BBC recognises that you may need to relocate to a new location to take up a BBC Apprenticeship scheme. The cost of relocating can be a barrier for some applicants and where that is a barrier to participation, we want to help where we can. To help ensure our apprenticeship opportunities are accessible to people from a wide range of backgrounds, a limited number of relocation support awards are available each year for those who meet our financial eligibility criteria. Relocation financial support is available for this role, subject to meeting the financial eligibility criteria. Further information will be shared with applicants during the recruitment process. Details on the wider support, initiatives and networks available at the BBC can be found on our careers site.

This is a fixed-term apprenticeship - your contract lasts for the duration of the scheme. Once you have completed your apprenticeship, you will be able to apply for any suitable open vacancies at the BBC or outside in the wider creative industry. You’ll be supported with career development, employability training, and networking opportunities to help you take your next step.

For apprenticeship opportunities, disabled applicants who choose to apply under the Disability Confident Scheme and who meet the minimum criteria for the role will normally be progressed to the next stage of the recruitment process. For most of our campaigns, this would be an online assessment designed to assess your skills, motivations and suitability for the role. Further details can be found in the FAQs section of our careers site.

Disclaimer

This job description is a written statement of the essential characteristics of the job, with its principal accountabilities, incorporating a note of the skills, knowledge and experience required for a satisfactory level of performance. This is not intended to be a complete, detailed account of all aspects of the duties involved.

Our apprenticeship roles are also subject to you having the require qualifications that we have deemed to be necessary for your role and the requirement of the training provider for your scheme. The offer would be subject to you undergoing and meeting the requirements of a skill scan process with the BBC nominated training provider to determine your eligibility.

Please note: If you were to be offered this role, the BBC will conduct Employment screening checks which include Reference checks; Eligibility to work checks; and if applicable to the role, Safeguarding and Adverse media/Social media checks. Any offer made is conditional on these checks being satisfactory.

Before your start date, you may need to disclose any unspent convictions or police charges, in line with our Recruitment policy. This allows us to discuss any support you may need and assess any risks. Failure to disclose may result in the withdrawal of your offer.

We are unable to accept applications via CV and only applications made online will be considered. Please click on the APPLY NOW button to proceed with your application.
