Description & Requirements

Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock - from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes.

Our Team

The Portfolios Account Management Team sits within the Managed Investments & Benchmark division of the Data Department. As a team, we are responsible for sourcing proprietary portfolio holdings information, normalizing it and making it available within the Bloomberg Terminal and Enterprise products.

We source this information through establishing and maintaining strong relationships with fund houses globally, and other content partners in the funds industry. Within the Portfolios Account Management Team, we help our clients make quicker and more informed decisions by empowering them with the right tools to analyze portfolios and provide them with visibility over the underlying investment of funds.

What’s the role?

Bloomberg’s Portfolios Account Management Team is looking for a Technical Account Manager to join its growing team. As part of the team, you will be responsible for building strong relationships with fund houses, engaging with them regularly, and sourcing their portfolio holdings. Your focus will be on EMEA, where you will be responsible for a list of accounts, covering all fund types from Mutual Funds to ETPs.

You will engage with fund houses, regulators and various other parties to ensure high visibility over their portfolio holdings. You will also work closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering departments to support the development of new/enhanced holdings-based terminal functionality, assess the different quality dimensions of the product, and make Bloomberg the platform of choice for data dissemination.

We'll Trust You To

• Establish and manage relationships with major fund houses to work closely with them in disclosing their proprietary portfolio holdings
• Acquire, update & maintain high-quality holdings data
• Work with other data and core business groups, such as Product, Sales, News and Engineering to help develop and improve the holdings product and portfolios functionality across the terminal
• Come up with innovative ideas and project proposals on Portfolio Holdings functionality
• Create and lead on roundtables and seminars around the themes of Funds and Portfolio Holdings Analytics to engage with your accounts in their respective markets
• Participate actively in new projects that drive departmental initiatives and goals
• Attend industry events and conferences around Funds and Holdings

You'll Need To Have

• A bachelor's degree or higher in relevant data technology or financial field, or equivalent professional work experience
• Minimum of 5+ years of experience* working as a data analyst or in the asset management and/or finance industry
• Strong understanding of the Funds Market and the Buy Side
• Proficiency in Spanish
• Excellent written communication and presentation skills
• Ability to build strong relationships
• Ability to think critically in improving and developing products
• Strong organization skills with ability to balance multiple projects simultaneously
• A curiosity about data management and the asset management industry
• Please note we use years of experience as a guide, but we certainly will consider applications from all candidates who are able to demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

We'd Love To See

• Experience with the Funds Market
• Proficiency in additional languages (German, French)
• Understanding of fund investment strategies and an understanding of different fund types
• Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation or working towards it
• Good knowledge of Python or a desire to learn

Does this sound like you?

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are!

If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an AI‑first Lead AI Engineer to define, architect, and deliver enterprise‑scale AI solutions for Investment, Corporate, and Commercial Banking.

This role combines deep hands‑on technical leadership with architectural ownership, driving the adoption of LLMs, agentic workflows, and generative AI platforms to improve efficiency, automation, simplification, and risk reduction. The Lead AI Engineer will shape both technical delivery and AI-first engineering culture, partnering closely with multiple technology and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

• End‑to‑End AI Leadership: Lead the design, hands‑on implementation, and deployment of scalable agentic AI and generative AI solutions for high‑impact business use cases.
• Agentic Architecture: Architect advanced agent‑based systems (perception, reasoning, planning, execution), integrating multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google).
• Full‑Stack AI Engineering: Build and deliver production‑grade, full‑stack AI applications using modern ML/LLM platforms and AI coding tools (e.g., Devin, GitHub Copilot).
• Rapid Value Delivery: Champion MVP‑driven delivery, rapid iteration, hypothesis testing, and experimentation (A/B testing) to achieve fast time‑to‑value.
• Evaluation & Optimization: Define rigorous evaluation frameworks and metrics for AI and agent performance, ensuring continuous optimization and alignment with business goals.
• Technology Foresight: Proactively evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, particularly in agent‑based and autonomous AI systems, while acting as a thought leader and coach.
• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Provide front‑line technical leadership, guide architectural decisions, and mentor engineers across AI, data, and application teams to build an AI‑first engineering culture.
• Strategic Domain Alignment: Ensure all AI solutions are grounded in deep banking domain understanding and clearly articulate business and risk impact beyond pure technical implementation.

Qualifications

• Programming: Expert‑level proficiency in Python and/or Java (Spring Boot); solid experience with JavaScript/TypeScript (Angular, Node.js).
• AI/ML Expertise:
• Deep knowledge of AI fundamentals (knowledge representation, automated planning, decision‑making under uncertainty, multi‑agent systems).
• Extensive hands‑on experience with LLM platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), RAG pipelines, MCPs, and agent frameworks (Google ADK).
• Demonstrated effectiveness with AI coding tools (Devin, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity).
• Strong experience with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and data science libraries.
• Proven ability to design and expose robust, scalable APIs for AI services.
• Engineering Excellence: Deep expertise in software engineering best practices, including system design, CI/CD, testing strategies, resiliency, security, and operational stability for AI‑driven platforms.
• Architecture & Data: Strong experience designing API‑first, microservices‑based, and event‑driven systems, including AI‑focused data pipelines and lifecycle management.
• Platforms: Hands‑on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
• Leadership & Communication: Exceptional ability to articulate complex technical concepts, influence senior stakeholders, and lead high‑impact technical discussions.
• Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of banking and regulated financial environments, with the ability to connect AI capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

Nice to Have

• Advanced data science expertise (statistical modeling, experimentation).
• Demonstrated experience mentoring and scaling AI‑first engineering talent in rapidly evolving toolchains.

Experience:

• Progressive software engineering experience with sustained hands‑on contributions.
• Advanced level of expertise in Python language
• Dedicated experience in AI, LLM‑based systems, and agentic architectures.
• Proven success architecting and delivering multiple enterprise‑scale AI solutions into production.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Robotics, or a related quantitative discipline.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Company Description

We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future.

As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity.

Our teams of interdisciplinary experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results.

And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defence and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport.

Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands.

PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life.

Job Description

We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. We challenge where it matters and own the outcome. We combine strategic thinking, customer-centric service design, and agile engineering practices to accelerate innovation in a tech-driven world.

Why consider joining our Digital & Data community? 🤔

• Join our Digital & Data team working alongside product, design and a wide range of other experts and cross-disciplinary teams to bring ideas to life through innovative software solutions.
• Grow a flexible and unique career within a trust-based, inclusive environment that values excellence, innovation, and curiosity. You have the option to progress with us on a technical career track. No need to go onto the Partner career track if this doesn’t align with what you want to do.
• Hybrid working - our approach is to be in the office or on client site a minimum of 2 days per week.
• Work on a broad variety of projects and tech stacks for clients across seven sectors - no project is ever the same
• Join other experts within our supportive and collaborative tech community through knowledge-sharing and peer-level support, coaching and mentoring
• Deepen your expertise through our culture of learning and growth – you’ll have budget to take courses (technical and non-technical training), plus gain certifications

Our tech stack 🚀

While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, you can expect to work with the following technologies to ensure scalable, high-performance applications:

• Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
• Building and implementing CI/CD Pipelines, experience working with repos, build automation tools, build orchestration and environment automation is very interesting E.g. Jenkins, GIT, SVN, CVS, Cloud-Formation, Terraform, Chef, Ansible, Puppet, Code Pipeline, Azure Stack
• Implementing microservices and containers E.g. Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift
• Implementing tools for logging, monitoring and alerting. E.g. TICK Stack, ELK Stack, Splunk, CloudWatch
• Creating and automating virtual machines in the cloud deployed on compute instances
• Implementing other cloud infrastructure and networking required to host a digital service, including storage, firewall and network configuration
• High availability, business continuity and disaster recovery solutions in the cloud
• Deploying serverless functions E.g. AWS Lambda, GCP Cloud Functions, Azure Cloud Functions

What You Can Expect 🌱

• Work to agile best practices and cross-functionally with multiple teams and stakeholders. You’ll be using your technical skills to problem solve with our clients, as well as working on internal projects
• Live in-person whiteboarding sessions to problem solve as a team, alongside asynchronous communication on Teams
• Hybrid working with the team on client site or in our office a minimum of two days per week. However, the actual time you spend and where you spend it will vary by role or assignment, including up to 5 days per week on a client site.
• An environment that deeply cares about its values Values | PA Consulting

Qualifications

Essential requirements ✅

Even if you don’t meet every requirement below, feel free to still apply as we are often hiring for similar roles which your background might be better suited to.

• 8-10 years + of experience in DevOps
• You thrive in problem-solving and analytical thinking
• You enjoy collaborating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
• Expertise in architecture
• Knowledge of the development process, perhaps being responsible for the overall process across a pod, or multiple pods, creating strong values and putting robust methods and patterns in place
• Maintaining communication with the client regularly, being one of the key points of engagement between the client and the project
• Coaching and mentoring the team
• Help shaping and contributing to bids, working with a bid team on the approach or proposal and perhaps even presenting to clients in a formal selection process
• Playing a role in account management and strong consulting skills

Please be aware that some of our UK roles at PA Consulting require a UK security clearance.

All PA people are required to undergo background checks and to achieve the Baseline Personnel Security Standard however, some UK roles also require higher levels of National Security Vetting, where applicants must have at least 5 years of continuous residency in the UK.

We therefore ask that you only apply if you meet the residency requirements (i.e. you are a British citizen or have been resident in the UK for the past 5 years), as this is the prerequisite for a security clearance. If you're unsure about your eligibility, we encourage you to review the UK Government’s guidance on security vetting before applying.

Additional Information

Assessment process ⚖️

Please note that the interview stages may be subject to change based on the specific requirements of the role.

• Quick call with one of our Tech Recruiters – to discuss your application, the role and PA
• Round 1: Either a competency or technical interview (60 mins)
• Round 2: Either a competency or technical interview, whichever you didn’t do at first round (60 mins)
• Final round 🎉: Meeting with a PA leader - a mini case study and discussion around your client-centricity (60 mins)

Life At PA encompasses our peoples' experience at PA. It's about how we enrich peoples’ working lives by giving them access to unique people and growth opportunities and purpose led meaningful work.

Our purpose guides how we work with our clients and our teams, and support our communities, to deliver insight and impact, solving the world’s most complex challenges. We're focused on building a workplace that values human difference and diverse mindsets, and a culture of inclusion and equality that unlocks the potential in our people so everyone can be their best self.

Find out more about Life at PA here.

We are dedicated to supporting the physical, emotional, social and financial well-being of our people. Check out some of our extensive benefits:

• Health and lifestyle perks accompanying private healthcare for you and your family
• 25 days annual leave (plus a bonus half day on Christmas Eve) with the opportunity to buy 5 additional days
• Generous company pension scheme
• Opportunity to get involved with community and charity-based initiatives
• Annual performance-based bonus
• PA share ownership
• Tax efficient benefits (cycle to work, give as you earn)

We’re committed to advancing equality. We recruit, retain, reward and develop our people based solely on their abilities and contributions and without reference to their age, background, disability, genetic information, parental or family status, religion or belief, race, ethnicity, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity (or expression), political belief, veteran status, any other range of human difference brought about by identity and experience. title: Principal Engineer - Retail
description:
In Short

As Principal Engineer - Retail, you will chart the architectural vision and technical strategy for On’s global physical and omnichannel retail systems. Reporting to the Senior Director of Commercial Technology, you will lead the evolution of high-scale, resilient platforms across Point of Sale (POS), digital payments, fiscalization, and omnichannel store operations. You will champion modern software engineering principles, moving beyond off-the-shelf configurations to engineer scalable, distributed systems that power seamless athlete and runner experiences worldwide across our expanding footprint.

Your Mission

• Architect Global Retail Systems – Define and drive the multi-year architecture north star for On's global retail ecosystem, designing decoupled, event-driven architectures that span next-generation POS, payment gateways, omnichannel services, and store operational platforms.
• Master Core Domain Capabilities – Act as On's foremost authority in retail engineering, establishing resilient technical solutions for real-time payments, international fiscalization compliance, offline-first reliability, inventory replenishment, and clienteling touchpoints.
• Elevate Software Engineering Excellence – Set high standards for distributed systems design, data consistency, and code quality across teams, prioritizing bespoke, cloud-native engineering and decoupled services over monolithic or configuration-only enterprise tools.
• Ensure Operational Resilience – Champion an operational excellence mindset across global retail infrastructure, defining robust SLOs, observability standards (distributed tracing, telemetry), disaster recovery, and peak-trading launch preparedness.
• Drive Cross-Domain Strategic Alignment – Partner with senior engineering leadership, Product Managers, and Retail Operations to translate commercial roadmaps into modular, scalable technical milestones that minimize future technical debt.
• Mentor & Foster Technical Culture – Guide and mentor Senior and Staff Engineers across multiple squads, leading consequential technical decision-making and building an open, high-velocity engineering culture across the Oniverse.

Your Story

• Extensive Technical Leadership Experience – 10+ years of software engineering experience designing, scaling, and operating distributed systems, with significant tenure operating as a Principal Engineer or Staff+ technical leader in modern retail tech environments.
• Deep Retail Domain Mastery – Proven track record architecting core retail domain platforms, specifically high-throughput POS solutions, global payment processor integrations, multi-country fiscalization frameworks, and store replenishment flows.
• Software Engineering & Architectural Craft – Mastery of modern cloud-native architectures (microservices, event-driven designs with Kafka or similar, REST/GraphQL APIs, distributed storage) and strong proficiency in modern languages, emphasizing resilient system design over vendor package configuration.
• Decoupled Integration & Composable Commerce – Demonstrated success integrating distributed retail touchpoints with enterprise backbones (ERP, OMS, CRM) via resilient asynchronous integration layers, deprecating legacy monoliths without business disruption.
• Pragmatic, High-Impact Decision Making – Demonstrated ability to drive complex, consequential architectural trade-offs across multiple cross-functional teams, balancing long-term technical vision with immediate business outcomes.
• Inspiring Mentorship & Influence – Strong communicator who articulates complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, with a passionate track record of mentoring senior engineers and raising the hiring bar.

Your Team

We power the in-store experience. The Technology team supports On’s stores with cutting-edge digital tools. For us, a personalized shopping experience goes hand-in-hand with efficiency. Tech makes it happen. So, we’re after innovative solutions — from point-of-sale systems to customer engagement platforms — all for the wow.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

title: Events Operations Manager
description:
Company Description

Raffles Hotels & Resorts

The Birthplace of stories and legends since 1887, Raffles is a legendary brand, steeped in history and loved by generations past, present and future. Raffles, at distinguished landmark addresses around the world, is the vibrant heart of its destination, curating experiences that are culturally enriching, intellectually stimulating and always respectful of local communities, heritage and the environment.

About Raffles London

Raffles London at The OWO on London’s Whitehall, unites the allure and heritage of Raffles with one of the world’s most historic addresses with a name is synonymous with luxury, glamour, and extraordinary adventure.

This fine Grade II* listed Edwardian building has been transformed with 120 rooms and suites along with a collection of 85 exceptional branded residences. Within The OWO destination there are a total of nine restaurants and three bars, including one by our signature chef Mauro Colagreco. The Guerlain spa and Pillar Wellness offer the latest in wellbeing, and a 600 seated-capacity grand ballroom, The Whitehall, is perfect for all kinds of special occasions and events.

Within these much-storied walls, where legendary statesmen and women once shaped the modern world, guests are now invited to discover new and inspiring emotions and connections.

At Raffles, you arrive as a guest, leave as a friend and return as family.

Job Description

Scope Of Position

Working in the role of Meeting and Events Operations Manager, this position has full responsibility for the day to day running of the operations during each service period. To co-ordinate events taking place within the meeting rooms, ensuring that guests expectations are exceeded and that any issues that may arise are dealt with swiftly and efficiently. Ensuring event set up and service is delivered to guest expectations at the Raffles London OWO. Leading preservice team briefings, working closely with events planners, sales teams and clients to manage changes and special requests whilst ensuring time sensitive service targets are met. Maintaining exceptional levels of guest communication, preparation, and delivery of all events and meetings across the events department. The role involves the ability to pre-empt guest expectations.

You will work in close contact with the planning, kitchen, bar and events teams to ensure guests expectations are met and surpassed. The role will report into our Director of Events Operations.

Responsibilities

Operation

• Ensure all operating equipment is in good working order.
• Actively monitoring staffing levels ensuring levels are sufficient to enable the desired guest experience whilst adhering to company guidelines.
• Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
• Cross liaising with relevant departments such as Planning and Sales regarding floor plans and Banquet Event Orders.
• To positively promote sales awareness within the department and maximise sales opportunities.
• When necessary is the first point of contact to the client adhering to any questions or queries and liaising back with the client during the day to ensure everything is satisfactory for them.
• Lead pre service team briefings ensuring good communication channels with all areas and department.
• Additional responsibilities in absence of line manager or senior employee.
• Performs other duties as required or assigned including working in a different department or restaurant, than usually assigned.

Leadership

• Ensuring composure under pressure and providing leadership and guidance to the Team when required.
• Actively encouraging and promoting employees to be creative and innovative, whilst recognising them for their contributions to the success of the operation.

Health and Safety

• Ensure that all potential and real hazards are reported immediately and rectified.
• Be fully conversant with all departmental Fire, Emergency and Bomb procedures.
• Ensure the safety of the persons and the property of all within the premises, by strict adherence to existing laws, statues and applicable ordinances, and by anticipating possible and probable hazards and conditions and either correcting them or pre-planning a defence against them.
• Stimulate and encourage a general awareness of Health and Safety in relation to all tasks and activities undertaken in the department.

Qualifications

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

Essential

• The ability to assist in the creation and management of a department with a positive culture resulting in guest satisfaction and a high team member retention rate.
• A full understanding of event function sheets and to be able to plan team member tasks in line with client requirements.
• Fully conversant with Microsoft Office.
• A proven track record and ability to provide high levels of service under pressure.
• Exceptional communication and customer service skills, both written and spoken.
• Strong time management skills with the ability to multi-task while maintaining an immaculate and professional appearance.
• An understanding and willingness to contribute to a 24h operational schedule when required.

Desirable

• Previous experience within a luxury hotel environment working with LQA, Forbes 5* or equivalent standards.

Additional Information

Why join our Raffles team?

Not only will you be joining one of the world’s best hotels you will also receive great benefits including:

• 28 days holiday including bank holidays plus a day extra for every year of your service up to 5 years (35 Days).
• Staff meals whist on duty.
• Free dry cleaning for uniform.
• Employer pension contribution of 3%
• Enhanced sick pay.
• Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.
• Life Assurance 1x salary
• Employee assistance program, including virtual GP and financial advice.
• Season ticket loans and cycle to work scheme.
• Colleague gifting to celebrate special occasions.
• Paid days off to move house or give back time to a charity of your choice.
• Internal learning and development programmes tailored to you.
• Fun-filled events, whether that’s a pub quiz, team run or festive party.
• Employee benefit card offering discounted rates of up to 30% at Accor worldwide and Raffles London F&B outlets.
• Worldwide development opportunities across Accor’s extensive brand portfolio.

What are the Raffles Values?

Respect: We value the needs ideas and individuality of others; we treat everyone with fairness and dignity.

Belonging: We celebrate our differences. We support each other and we always stand together.

Integrity: We build trust through mutual respect and being authentic.

Empowerment: We have the authority to take initiative and anticipate moments to create unforgettable experiences.

Excellence: We make genuine connections and we cherish every opportunity to make the people around us feel special.

Diversity & Inclusion

Raffles is committed to creating an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team.

About the Application Process:

At Raffles, we want to bring out your highest potential. Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire. This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence.

The project focuses on establishing and supporting a reliable, scalable voice network that enables global voice and digital traffic for contact center and back-office operations.

The successful candidate will play a key technical role in implementing the company's cloud strategy, contributing to the design, planning, integration, maintenance, and optimization of cloud-based voice solutions.

You will collaborate closely with architecture teams and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions, ensuring seamless communication across voice and digital channels. • REST API
• API
• SIP
• SDP
• IVR
• Communication skills
• Degree

• DNS

• Strong knowledge of network architecture, design, configuration, operations, and administration

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at different organizational levels
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
• Excellent organizational, teamwork, and time management skills

• Experience working in large-scale, global contact center environments

Nice to have:

• AWS

• Microsoft Teams

group: wifinity|business development manager - public sector - south & south west
title: Business Development Manager - Public Sector - South & South West
description:
Your patch: You'll take ownership of a broad territory spanning Sussex, Hampshire, Berkshire and the Thames Valley, through the South West to Cornwall, as well as South Wales.

The Opportunity:
Wifinity seek a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Manager to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for helping us to expand our proposition into the Public Sector including Central Government and Arms Length Bodies.

This is a hunter role and you will be expected to identify, target, develop and close business within the agreed sector. You will work closely with the management team to identify opportunities for expansion and establish new partnerships to support our growing managed service business.

About us:
We're a UK-based managed internet provider delivering B2C & B2B connectivity solutions for organisations and their customers.

At Wifinity, we're passionate about providing the most reliable, high-speed broadband and site-wide WiFi networks for modern living. We focus on delivering secure, ultra-fast connectivity that meets the demands of today's digital lifestyles. Whether in military accommodation, student housing, holiday parks, multi-tenant properties, or retirement communities.

We believe in delivering that experience sustainably. As a responsible broadband provider, we're committed to reducing our environmental footprint through energy-efficient infrastructure, smart power management, and ongoing improvements.

Key Areas of Focus:
Your day to day role will consist of the following responsibilities, you may be required to carry out further responsibilities at the company's discretion.

• Use your network to uncover opportunities for growth across the Local/Central and wider Public Sector markets
• Develop and execute business strategies to drive growth and profitability
• Developing successful, sustainable and profitable long-term relationships with the largest and most complex customers. Drawing on multiple sources of information and insight (customer, competitors, market insight/trends, group insight, trading/economic environment) in order to formulate win strategies with customers.
• Build and maintain a solid and robustly qualified pipeline of sales opportunities within assigned industry verticals growing to a level of 3x target coverage.
• Identify new opportunities for expansion and establish partnerships with key vendors
• Build and maintain strong relationships at Senior level within the target customer base.
• Develop and deliver compelling proposals and presentations to potential clients.
• Collaborate with the leadership & management team to help identify strategic growth opportunities within our existing customer base.

About you:
We are looking for someone that brings:

• A full UK Driving License.
• Substantial experience in business development, sales, or related field
• Proven track record of successfully developing and implementing business strategies.
• Experience in complex deal leadership within the Public Sector marketSolid understanding of Public Sector procurement, bidding and frameworks
• Strong understanding of market trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs
• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, including an enhanced annual leave scheme starting at 25 days, with additional holiday entitlement awarded through length of service, alongside a remote-first working environment that gives our employees greater flexibility and supports a healthy work-life balance. At Wifinity we are committed to providing a positive environment in which individuals do not encounter bullying or harassment on the basis of protected characteristics which are identified by law (including sexual harassment).We are committed to treating candidates and employees with courtesy, dignity and respect.

title: Commercial Director - Insurance
description:
Commercial Director – London (Commercial Insurance Advisory, French, German, Italian, Spanish or Polish Speaker)

Our client is a fast-growing advisory firm in a very mature industry. It works with a broad range of corporate clients on every stage of the insurance process, from analysing risk and drafting contracts and policies to managing and resolving complex, high-stakes claims. The firm is known for a thorough, forensic approach and exceptionally high-quality work. It is not afraid to uncover uncomfortable truths or challenge accepted wisdom.

Alongside this, it remains a hands-on leadership role. You'll run your own portfolio of client accounts while overseeing, coaching and developing junior Project Managers and Associates. A central part of the job is taking end-to-end ownership of written-lines tenders and complex renewal exercises, and you'll act as a trusted point of contact for senior client stakeholders.

• Drive the office's growth by building the client base, raising the firm's profile, and spotting new business opportunities across Europe.
• Manage a portfolio of client engagements from project set-up through delivery, renewal and close-out, including complex and strategically important accounts.
• Lead insurance tenders and renewals: set the strategy, build and run the timetable, brief brokers, and hold brokers and insurers to account on quality and deadlines.
• Review and compare broker and insurer proposals on structure, pricing, security, service and value, and turn complex market information into clear recommendations for clients.
• Lead or support broker and insurer meetings and negotiations, challenging constructively where needed.
• Keep tight control of project scope, resourcing, budgets, timelines, reporting and records, and flag risks early with clear recommendations.
• Work closely with technical specialists so that coverage requirements and wording improvements are reflected in market activity.
• Build strong client relationships, manage expectations on demanding projects, and expand the services you provide.
• Oversee, quality-assure and coach junior colleagues, helping them take on more ownership of client and broker work.
• Build a strong network of broker and insurer contacts in Europe

What you'll bring

• Substantial experience managing insurance tenders, renewals and broker relationships, ideally in commercial insurance, broking or risk advisory.
• Fluency in English and at least one other European language (French, German, Italian, Spanish or Polish).
• The entrepreneurial drive and resilience to help build a new office from the ground up.
• The confidence and judgement to engage with senior client stakeholders on complex accounts.
• Strong project-management skills and a disciplined approach to budgets, timelines and compliance.
• The ability to analyse complex proposals and present clear, decision-useful advice.
• Experience of supervising, reviewing and developing junior team members.
• A commercial mindset and a drive to raise standards.
• Knowledge of the Luxembourg or wider European insurance market would be a strong advantage.

Why apply?

You'll join a business that is actively changing how commercial insurance is done, at the moment it expands into Luxembourg. You'll have real ownership of high-profile client work and a genuine say in how a new office is built. That gives you the chance to shape its team, culture and growth from the very start.

group: accenture uk & ireland|oracle cloud procure-to-pay manager
title: Oracle Cloud Procure-to-Pay Manager
description:
Career level: Manager (CL7) | Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh | Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (Oracle)

Why this role

This role owns the Procure-to-Pay workstream end to end on large-scale Oracle Cloud finance transformation programmes, in front of the client — the full cycle from sourcing and requisitioning through to how suppliers are paid. It's a role to become the finance design authority clients rely on across P2P, and to grow into the practice's go-to for getting procurement and payables design right on Oracle Cloud.

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.

"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What You'll Bring

Procure-to-Pay expertise. Deep command of the Procure-to-Pay cycle in Oracle Cloud, from the finance lens: Oracle Cloud Procurement, Sourcing and Payables — requisition-to-receipt and invoice-to-pay, sourcing and procurement contracts, supplier and spend management, three-way match, and payables through to payment run. You know how P2P design flows through to accruals, working capital, cash and the close, and where the controls have to sit.

Procurement and payables process design. You design the P2P process end to end — how requisitions, purchase orders, receipts and invoices move, how exceptions and holds are handled, and how approvals and controls are set so finance can stand behind the numbers. You bring a clear view of procurement and sourcing processes and the challenges they throw up in a large organisation.

Procurement data structures. A strong grasp of the data underneath P2P — supplier and item master, spend categories and classification, and how those structures shape reporting and control. You've handled data migration and integration into Oracle Cloud, and the functional data conversion, transformation and reconciliation that make a cutover hold together.

Finance process context. A clear view of how P2P connects to financial close and controls — accruals, reconciliations, working capital — and to the adjacent finance processes it depends on.

Leading delivery. You lead the P2P workstream end to end — fit-to-standard, business process design, testing and deployment — as the primary finance design authority for the domain. You bring a clear view of the functional, application and technical implementation elements of an Oracle Cloud ERP programme, manage dependencies with adjacent finance processes, and work closely with Oracle delivery and integration teams while keeping ownership of the finance outcome. You lead functional teams across onshore and offshore delivery, facilitate design forums with senior procurement, finance and operational stakeholders, and keep programme leadership clear through structured status, issue management and decision recommendations.

Growing the practice. You contribute to how the practice grows — supporting proposals and bids, shaping P2P and procurement-transformation approaches, and building reusable assets and points of view.

Ways of working. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team — bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, analyse and deliver, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. An understanding of Oracle Cloud's own AI capabilities and agents, and of persona- and journey-led design, is a real plus.

Who You Are

You take ownership and lead from the front. You build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and coordinate procurement, finance and operational perspectives with confidence. You bring a collaborative leadership style and a value-led mindset — you can link P2P changes to better cash and working capital, fewer invoice exceptions and stronger spend control — and you develop the people around you. Running workshops, managing stakeholders and expectations, good judgement, critical thinking and clear decisions under pressure are second nature.

Things that set strong candidates apart: a track record (typically 7+ years) delivering Oracle Cloud P2P and procurement transformation on large-scale programmes; experience across complex, multi-entity or multi-country work; the confidence to lead senior client design discussions; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).

If you have most of this and the drive to build the rest, we want to hear from you — tell us what you'd bring.

About Finance RP

Within Accenture, the Finance Reinvention Partner helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.

You'd join our Platforms transformation offering within the practice: a growing team delivering large-scale, business-led finance transformations on Oracle Cloud, and building AI into how we deliver. It's a place to go deep on Procure-to-Pay and procurement transformation while staying close to the CFO agenda the work serves.

What's In It For You

Alongside a competitive salary and package (dependent on experience), you'll have an extensive benefits package including 30 days' holiday a year, private medical insurance, and 3 additional days' leave a year for charitable work of your choice.

Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society. Accenture reserves the right to close the role earlier should a suitable applicant be found.

title: Digital Commerce Delivery Lead
description:
Role- Digital Commerce Delivery Lead

Location- London

Level- Manager

Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients by combining creativity, technology, and data-driven intelligence. Within Song, our Digital Commerce delivery practice helps organisations design, build, and scale modern digital commerce ecosystems — embedding Generative AI and Agentic AI into commerce to enable real-time personalisation, autonomous merchandising, and intelligent customer engagement at scale.

We are entering an exciting era of agentic commerce — where AI agents, conversational interfaces, and intelligent systems are reshaping how people discover, evaluate, and buy online. We are looking for experienced delivery leaders who are energised by this shift and want to lead the programmes that make it real for our clients.

You are an experienced commerce delivery manager with a track record of leading end-to-end implementation programmes — from platform selection and architecture through to go-live and value realisation. You have hands-on experience delivering major commerce platform programmes (e.g. Commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce) and are building a growing capability in agentic AI — whether through delivering agentic features on top of commerce platforms, or through implementing AI-native capabilities on cloud platforms such as Google Cloud or AWS.

You are as comfortable owning a delivery programme as you are shaping the approach with a client. You lead multi-disciplinary teams, manage risk and pace, and hold yourself accountable for quality outcomes. You bring strong client relationships and the credibility to operate at senior stakeholder level — and you are excited about what the next era of commerce will demand of you and your clients.

Key Responsibilities

• Owning end-to-end delivery of commerce transformation programmes — from discovery and architecture through build, testing, and go-live — ensuring programmes are on time, on budget, and delivering against agreed outcomes

• Leading the technical and functional delivery of major commerce platform implementations, including composable and headless architectures built on platforms such as Commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, or MACH-aligned stacks

• Defining delivery approaches, programme structures, and workstream plans that are executable, well-governed, and appropriately resourced across engineering, solution architecture, QA, and integration

• Leading multi-disciplinary delivery teams — including engineers, architects, QA, and third-party partners — creating the conditions for high performance and clear accountability

• Managing client relationships at programme and senior stakeholder level, providing transparency on progress, risks, and decisions, and building trust through consistent delivery

• Overseeing the integration of commerce platforms with surrounding enterprise systems — including CRM, CDP, OMS, payments, PIM, and search — and ensuring architecture decisions are sound, scalable, and fit for purpose

• Leading the delivery of agentic commerce capabilities — including AI-powered personalisation, conversational commerce, intelligent search, and autonomous merchandising — integrated into commerce platforms or built on cloud AI services (e.g. Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI)

• Driving build vs. buy decisions across commerce platforms, AI orchestration frameworks, and supporting infrastructure, bringing a point of view grounded in delivery experience

• Embedding responsible AI and governance principles into agentic delivery programmes — including auditability, explainability, and human-in-the-loop mechanisms

• Contributing to Accenture Song's commerce delivery capability — including shaping accelerators, reusable assets, delivery standards, and points of view that advance our market position

• Supporting the growth and development of delivery talent within the team, providing hands-on coaching and creating development opportunities for consultants and engineers

Required Experience

• :8 years of professional experience in technology delivery, with a track record of leading end-to-end implementation programmes at pace and scale

• Deep, hands-on experience delivering at least one major enterprise commerce platform — such as Commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, SAP Commerce, or a composable / MACH-aligned architecture

• Strong understanding of commerce platform architecture — including API-led and microservices-based design, headless and composable patterns, and integration with enterprise systems

• Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary delivery teams — including engineers, architects, QA, and third-party partners — across complex, multi-workstream programmes

• Experience managing senior client stakeholders — able to build trust, communicate delivery status with clarity, and navigate competing priorities and risks

• Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) as deployment and infrastructure environments for commerce and AI systems

• Demonstrable interest in agentic commerce and AI — through delivery of AI-powered features, proof of concepts, or a developed understanding of how agentic capabilities integrate with commerce platforms

• Strong communication and leadership skills — able to set direction, hold teams accountable, and represent delivery credibly at C-suite level

Preferred Experience

• Hands-on experience delivering agentic AI capabilities on cloud platforms — such as Google Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI

• Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and tooling — such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI — and how they are applied

• Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, vector databases, and LLM-powered applications as part of a commerce or customer technology programme

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerisation, and cloud-native deployment practices for production commerce and AI systems

What’s in it for you:

Our Total Rewards consist of a competitive basic salary, annual performance bonus, opportunities to acquire equity and a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits. These include perks such as:

• Up to 30 days of leave to spend each year plus 3 extra volunteering days per year for charitable work of choice.

• Family-friendly and flexible work policies.

• Attractive pension plan with financial wellbeing support and resources.

• Private healthcare insurance plan and Mental Wellbeing support.

• Employee Assistance Programme, Career Development and Counselling.

• A range of generous Parental Leave offerings.

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the outstanding services we are known for.

Please note that with all our roles, you should expect some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building rapport with clients, peers, leaders and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

description:
Job Application for Senior Marketing Manager, Commercial Marketing (Grocery & Retail) at Deliveroo

tags.new

Senior Marketing Manager, Commercial Marketing (Grocery & Retail)

London, United Kingdom - Deliveroo

Apply

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

Deliveroo connects millions of consumers with the restaurants and brands they love. Our Integrated Marketing team sits at the heart of how we bring those relationships to life — combining customer insight, commercial opportunity and creativity to drive growth for Deliveroo and our partners.

Within Central Integrated Marketing, the Merchant & Ads team sets the global strategy for how we partner with merchants to help them grow on our marketplace and create compelling reasons for consumers to choose Deliveroo. This is an opportunity to shape Deliveroo’s global approach to merchant partnerships, building high-impact collaborations with some of the world’s most recognised and loved brands. This will be a hybrid role - working 3 days a week from our London HQ.

• Owns the New Verticals merchant and ads marketing strategy end to end, reporting into the Merchant & Ads Integrated Marketing Director.
• Responsible for the creation and deployment of New Verticals merchant marketing playbooks across co marketing, promotions, and ads.
• Responsible for the creation and deployment of the New Verticals sell in strategy and associated sell in materials for adoption by local teams.

Ads & Monetization Strategy

• Own the New Verticals specific ads and monetization strategy across owned and external surfaces, feeding into the global monetization strategy.
• Lead pricing, packaging, and investment decisions for merchant advertising in your category, in partnership with Commercial and Finance.

Category Playbook: New Verticals

• Own and evolve the New Verticals merchant marketing playbook, setting how co marketing, promotions, and advertising work for grocery and retail merchants globally.

Key Merchant Relationship Management

Cross Functional Stakeholder Management

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production.

🧠 Your day-to-day

• Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance
• Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback
• Own requirements, release readiness, and in-field performance and issue triage
• Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles
• Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements
• Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features (Ownership through the full lifecycle)
• Define and track quality metrics (e.g., comfort, tracking error, and safety margin KPIs, and regressions against them)
• Contribute to safety artefacts: provide evidence for safety cases, work with the safety team to ensure compliance with required standards

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV). You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches, implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology.

🙌 You should apply if you have:

Required Skills/Experience

• Strong fundamentals in control theory, with applied experience in one or more of optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems
• Practical experience developing, tuning and validating motion control on complex real world physical systems (e.g., direct experience with mobile robotics and/or autonomous vehicles)
• Experience with test and validation discipline: unit and integration tests, simulation regression suites, closed-loop metrics.
• Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++
• Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software
• Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour in complex robotic systems across software and hardware

Desired Skills/Experience

• Applied machine learning experience, or experience developing systems that integrate with ML components
• Vehicle dynamics and actuation. Steering, braking and powertrain interfaces, actuator delay models, and CAN or similar vehicle bus experience
• Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls
• Experience with safety-critical systems, validation, and relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262)
• Experience with monitoring and diagnostics: Logging, fault detection, and on-platform debugging tools, ideally with experience investigating field issues
• Experience across multiple platforms or vehicles. The team supports vehicle-to-vehicle variation, such as accounting for parameter identification, calibration, and keeping one software stack across hardware variants

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

• Initial call / recruiter screen: general background, current situation, interests and Wayve company information & hiring context.
• Competency Interviews: programming and code review.
• Deep-dive technical interviews: domain knowledge & system design.
• Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Oracle Cloud ERP Finance Technical Consultant
description:
Career level: Consultant / Associate Manager (CL9–CL8) | Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh | Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (Oracle)

Why this role

This role builds the Oracle Cloud finance solutions our clients run their books on. You'll take a finance design and turn it into a working, tested, migrated system that stands up at go-live and holds together afterwards. That means the configuration, the build specifications, the integrations and the data conversion behind them, and the evidence that it all works. You'll do it on large-scale Oracle Cloud ERP finance transformations, with real ownership of your own scope: a workstream lead sets the direction and owns the design authority, while you own the build within it and the technical decisions that come with it.

You'll do that work from inside the client's finance function, in their design sessions, alongside their controllers and their IT team. You'll explain why the system behaves the way it does to people who will never open a configuration screen, hold a design decision when it is challenged, and become the person a client comes back to when the answer has to be right. We're hiring for both halves of that: the technical depth, and the judgement to carry it in front of a client.

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.

"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What You'll Bring

Oracle Cloud configuration depth. Hands-on configuration of Oracle Cloud ERP Financials (Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials) across the core finance modules: General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, Tax and Intercompany, plus the enterprise and ledger structures underneath them. You configure it, you test it, and you can stand behind why it is set up the way it is. That extends into Oracle Subledger Accounting, where you understand how transactions are accounted and how to configure the rules that decide it; consolidation and close in FCCS; and enterprise data and chart-of-accounts structures in EDMCS. You stay on standard, extending Oracle the way it is designed to be extended rather than modifying it, and you can explain to a client why that boundary is worth holding. Experience across the wider Oracle finance estate, including the EPM suite and planning in EPBCS, broadens where you can work. The platform matters less than the rigour you bring, so comparable cloud finance platforms are worth talking to us about.

Design, build and integration. You translate finance requirements into functional designs and into build specifications a developer can work from, covering reports, interfaces, data conversions, extensions, workflow and integrations. You build the reporting yourself in BI Publisher, OTBI and Smart View, and you have worked hands-on with Oracle's integration patterns across Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and REST and SOAP web services. Data migration and conversion sits with you, using FBDI and ADFdi, so a cutover holds. Where the standard product doesn't reach, you extend it properly, in a sandbox and through Visual Builder. You take the solution through testing and into deployment, and you know what evidence a client needs before they will sign it off.

Finance process knowledge. Genuine Record-to-Report depth, with a feel for how your configuration choices show up for the CFO: a faster close, numbers people trust, stronger control. You understand enterprise structures and chart-of-accounts design and the finance master data underneath them, how finance controls are built into the configuration rather than bolted on afterwards, and how those choices shape reporting downstream. Exposure to a second finance process area broadens your range.

Delivery and client skills. You own your scope and see it through. You make the configuration and design calls within it, document them, and explain them to the client and to the workstream lead without either needing to check your working line by line. You're at ease in front of a client: running a working session with finance and IT stakeholders, walking them through what you've built, taking the questions it raises, and turning a technical constraint into what it means for their close, their controls and their reporting. You are straight with people about what the system will and won't do, and you say so early, not late. You bring structured, analytical problem-solving and communicate clearly under pressure, and you support the people around you by reviewing a colleague's configuration, bringing someone newer through a build, and passing on what is worth reusing on the next programme.

Ways of working. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team, bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, build, test and validate, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. An appreciation of Oracle's own embedded Fusion AI and agents, and how they augment a finance solution, is a real plus, and we're keen to hear from people bringing that experience.

Who You Are

You take ownership and follow through without being chased. You work well in a delivery team and build straightforward, trusted working relationships with client counterparts. You can explain a technical decision to someone who isn't technical: plainly, without talking down and without hiding behind the detail. You bring good judgement to ambiguous problems and you're careful and clear in how you make and explain technical decisions. You know which calls are yours and which belong to the workstream lead, and you raise the second kind early. You're precise about detail and thorough about proof. You test your own configuration and satisfy yourself it holds before you report it as complete.

Things that set strong candidates apart: Oracle certification; hands-on configuration experience on end-to-end Oracle Cloud ERP finance implementations, from early design through to go-live; depth in the Oracle finance suite, whether subledger accounting, consolidation (FCCS) or enterprise data (EDMCS); reporting build in BI Publisher or OTBI; integration and data-conversion experience on Oracle Cloud across Oracle Integration Cloud, REST and SOAP services and FBDI; an awareness of how controls, master data and staying on standard shape a finance solution; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).

If you have most of this and the drive to build the rest, we want to hear from you — tell us what you'd bring.

About Finance RP

Within Accenture, the Finance Reinvention Partner helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.

You'd join our Platforms transformation offering within the practice: a growing team delivering Oracle Cloud finance transformations for finance functions, and building AI into how we deliver. It's a place to go deep on the Oracle build while staying close to the CFO agenda the work serves. We're a close team that enjoys working together and keeps asking whether there's a better way to do the work than last time. We deliberately put platform, process, data, AI and advisory backgrounds on the same team, because the mix gives a client a better-informed answer than any one of them does alone.

Alongside our consultant development programmes, we also work directly with organisations to deliver tailored Data, Analytics and AI training, as well as broader consulting and capability-building projects.

Founded by industry experts with decades of global Data & Analytics experience, we help both individuals and organisations build practical, relevant data skills.

Rockborne sits within the Harnham Group, one of the world’s leading Data & AI recruitment specialists, with offices in London, New York, Phoenix and Amsterdam.

title: Engineering Manager, Applied AI & Data Science
description:
Who We Are

Since 1843, The Economist Group has championed independence, excellence and openness, helping people understand and tackle the critical challenges shaping the world. Today, we are building on that legacy as a global media and information-services company powered by digital innovation, analytical rigour and evidence-based insight.

Across our three businesses -The Economist, Economist Enterprise and Economist Education - we deliver trusted analysis and insights to individuals and organisations in more than 170 countries. United by a shared purpose to drive progress, we empower decision-makers to make sense of change and chart a course through an increasingly complex world.

As a colleague, you will be part of a culture that values ideas, encourages ownership and holds itself to high standards. We invest in people who are curious, thoughtful and adaptable, whether they are launching new products, reporting on global events or harnessing emerging technologies such as AI to improve how we work. Here, fresh thinking is taken seriously, ambition is matched by integrity, and great work is recognised. Working across disciplines, geographies and perspectives, we are united by a commitment to innovation, excellence and creating meaningful impact.

Want to discover more about life at The Economist Group? Follow @EconomistCareers on Instagram to discover the people, stories and opportunities that make TEG unique.

Technology, Product & Data

Our team of 450 colleagues across Technology, Product and Data is at the heart of The Economist Group’s digital-first agenda. Together, we design, build and optimise the digital products, platforms and data capabilities that power our business and reach millions of people around the world. Whether you're an engineer, product manager, designer, data scientist or analyst, you'll work on products that have real-world impact. From enhancing economist.com and developing new products for Economist Intelligence to creating personalised experiences and applying AI to solve complex challenges, you'll help shape how consumers, businesses and government leaders access trusted insights. Working in cross-functional teams, we combine engineering excellence, product thinking and data expertise to solve meaningful problems, experiment with new technologies and continuously improve the experiences we create. It's an opportunity to do challenging, purposeful work alongside curious, collaborative colleagues, while helping drive sustainable growth for one of the world's most trusted brands.

The Role

Our AI Platform team builds the technology that powers AI-enabled products and services, for internal users and external customers. We design, build and operate the infrastructure, patterns and reusable capabilities that enable generative and agentic AI, natural language processing, predictive analytics and machine learning across the Group, from customer-facing features in our digital products to the internal tools used by colleagues across our four businesses.

Scope

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead our Applied AI and Data Science team: a multidisciplinary group of AI Engineers, ML Engineers, NLP Engineers and Data Scientists. This is a player-coach role. You will own the health, delivery and growth of the team while remaining a hands-on contributor to its work, writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture and stepping into implementation when it matters.

The team’s work spans generative and agentic AI systems built on large language models, alongside the NLP and predictive models that sit behind our products and internal tools. You will turn the Group’s AI ambitions into well-architected, production-grade systems, working in close partnership with the Head of AI and Data Engineering, product managers, data engineers and business stakeholders to decide what we build, why we build it, and how we know it is working. You will also champion the team’s move to AI-native engineering, with coding agents used across the whole software development lifecycle.

Accountabilities

• Lead and manage the team. Provide day-to-day management, mentorship and career development, and build one team across engineering and data science disciplines.
• Own delivery. Own planning, resourcing, prioritisation and delivery with product management, balancing exploratory work against production commitments.
• Communicate progress. Keep leadership and stakeholders informed on progress, risks and trade-offs, and set realistic expectations of what AI can deliver.
• Stay hands on. Contribute directly to the team’s deliverables: build, prototype, review code and models, and step into implementation when it matters.
• Contribute to technical and architectural decisions. Shape the architecture of our agentic AI, RAG, NLP and ML systems, covering agent design, model selection and build-versus-buy.
• Oversee the development of safe and reliable agents. Ensure our agents have well-scoped tool permissions, guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls, and are evaluated end to end before and after release.
• Ensure quality, security and compliance. Set standards for code quality, testing, evaluation, observability and cost, and keep AI systems secure, well-architected and compliant.
• Champion AI-native engineering. Embed AI coding agents across the SDLC of the team, from specification and design to code, tests and review, with clear standards for AI-generated code.
• Partner with others. Work with Product, Data Engineering, Security, Legal and the business units, challenging requirements and using metrics to define what “done” looks like.
• Hire and grow the team. Recruit, interview and onboard engineers and data scientists, shaping the team’s skills mix to match the AI roadmap.
• Drive best practices and ways of working. Improve CI/CD, experiment tracking and the path to production, and promote the team’s capabilities across the Group.

Selection criteria

Essential

• A track record as an engineering manager or tech lead with direct people-management responsibility for AI/ML engineers, NLP engineers and/or data scientists.
• Experience balancing hands-on technical contribution with people leadership and delivery ownership.
• Strong hands-on AI/ML engineering background, with extensive Python experience and confidence reviewing code across LLM, agentic, NLP and classical ML systems.
• Hands-on experience with modern agent frameworks such as Strands Agents, LangGraph or the Claude Agent SDK, and with interoperability standards such as MCP and A2A.
• Strong cloud-native expertise on AWS, especially Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore, alongside SageMaker, Lambda and Step Functions, with CDK or equivalent IaC.
• Hands-on LLMOps and MLOps experience, including agent and trajectory evaluation, tracing (e.g. OpenTelemetry), guardrails, cost monitoring and automated model pipelines.
• A clear understanding of agent security risks, such as prompt injection, data leakage and over-permissioned tools, and how to mitigate them.
• Day-to-day experience of AI-native software delivery, using coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot across planning, coding, testing and review.
• Able to set team standards for AI-assisted development, including context engineering for coding agents, review of AI-generated code and measuring its impact on delivery.
• A solid grounding in applied data science, enough to lead data scientists and constructively challenge their work.
• Excellent communication skills, able to work closely with product, design and engineering, and explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong product sense: comfortable interrogating and refining requirements rather than taking them as given, and able to spot when one doesn’t hold up.

Desirable

• Direct experience applying AI within a media, publishing, entertainment or other content-led industry.
• Proven experience building and operating agentic AI systems in production, including multi-agent orchestration, tool use via MCP, agent memory and agentic RAG.Depth in NLP, such as information extraction, classification, summarisation and semantic search, or fine-tuning LLMs.
• Experience building shared AI platforms or reusable capabilities consumed by multiple product teams, such as internal MCP servers or agent tooling.
• Experience with vector search at scale, using tools such as OpenSearch, Amazon S3 Vectors or pgvector.
• Familiarity with AI governance and regulation, and with putting responsible AI practices into day-to-day engineering.
• An advanced degree in computer science, data science, linguistics or a related quantitative field, or equivalent work experience.

Please note: this role is open to internal applicants only until Tuesday, 13 October 2026, after which it may be advertised externally.

As part of this AI Transformation Programme, we are hiring an AI Transformation Lead for Editorial to help turn that ambition into measurable results in The Economist’s newsroom. This is a hands-on transformation role for people who combine strong stakeholder skills with practical fluency in building with AI.

You will work closely with our editorial teams to understand how work is done today, identify where AI can make a meaningful difference, shape the right solution and lead it through implementation and adoption.
