title: Project Manager
description:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste.

Our app connects businesses with consumers to save unsold food. Since 2016, we’ve grown to become the largest food-saving marketplace in Europe, with over 120 million users and more than 453 million meals saved.

We’re now looking for a Project Manager to support a large-scale technical transformation programme across our global Commercial organisation, including the implementation of VOIP technology and operational tools across multiple markets.

Working closely with the Senior Programme Manager, Commercial teams, Tech, Product, Operations and external vendors, you’ll take ownership of defined workstreams and drive them from planning through to implementation and adoption.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong project delivery skills, technical understanding and a proactive, independent approach.

Please note: This is a 12 month fixed term contract.

Your Mission

You’ll turn programme objectives into clear delivery plans, coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure implementations are delivered successfully.

The Senior Programme Manager will set the overall programme direction. You’ll independently drive your workstreams forward, bring structure to ambiguity, solve problems proactively and escalate decisions when needed.

Your Role

Project Delivery

• Own workstreams from planning through to implementation and adoption, managing milestones, timelines, dependencies and risks.
• Bring structure to complex or ambiguous situations, proactively identifying solutions and driving decisions and actions.
• Maintain delivery momentum, adapting plans as priorities and requirements evolve.

Technology Implementation

• Work with Tech, Product and external vendors to understand system requirements, integrations, dependencies and technical constraints.
• Coordinate testing, UAT, issue resolution and go-live readiness.
• Translate between technical and commercial stakeholders, ensuring solutions support business needs and operational processes.

Stakeholder Management & Adoption

• Build strong relationships across Commercial, Tech, Product, Operations and external partners.
• Lead working sessions, align stakeholders and communicate progress, risks and decisions clearly.
• Coordinate rollouts across markets, ensuring processes, training and ways of working are ready for implementation.

What We're Looking For

• Project delivery experience: A track record of independently managing projects, workstreams or implementations, ideally involving technology or operational transformation.
• Technical understanding: Confidence working with technical teams and vendors, understanding systems, integrations and dependencies, and learning new platforms quickly. You don’t need to be a developer, but you must be comfortable engaging with technical detail.
• Stakeholder management: Ability to bring business and technical teams together, manage competing priorities and drive decisions.
• Ownership and problem-solving: A proactive, structured and pragmatic approach, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, anticipate risks and drive outcomes independently.
• Relevant experience: Experience with commercial or customer-facing teams is beneficial. Familiarity with VOIP, telephony, CRM or contact centre platforms is a plus.

We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates confidently, adapts quickly and follows through to ensure things get delivered.

Our values:

• We Win Together
• We Raise the Bar
• We Keep It Simple
• We Build A Legacy
• We Care

What we offer:

• A rare opportunity to work in a social impact company where you can use your commercial skills to drive positive change
• An open company culture where you have the independence and room to unleash your creativity
• A strong team culture where learning together is encouraged and successes are celebrated together
• Inclusive benefits with flexible working hours and generous vacation and wellness policies
• The experience of being part of an international company with over 1350 enthusiastic and highly talented teammates across 20 countries – always ready to share knowledge and support!
• Strong personal as well as professional development in a thriving, high-growth scale-up environment.
• UK Remote with monthly visits to our London office.

How to apply

• We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.
• Submit your CV in English.
• Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

title: Manager – Insurance Architect
description:
Role: Manager – Insurance Architect

Location: Bath, Bristol, London, Hybrid

Mobility: Up to 100%

Career Level: Manager (CL7)

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge.

We are recruiting for talented technologists to join the Insurance Architecture team within Accenture’s UK Insurance & Financial Services Industry and Enterprise practice, helping us shape and deliver digital change for our clients.

“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” – Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO

As a team:

Insurance Architecture is the dedicated digital architecture and technology team within Accenture’s UK Insurance & Financial Services Industry and Enterprise practice. We are a small, high-impact team of senior architects and technologists who shape and assure complex digital change for some of the UK’s leading insurers, life offices, wealth managers and platform providers, and advising CIOs, CTOs and Chief Architects on major investment plans and technology and platform decisions.

Our work spans General Insurance, Life, Pensions & Investments, London Markets, Capital Markets and the wider Financial Services market, supporting clients in areas such as journey to cloud, digital transformation in underwriting and claims, applications of AI and GenAI, and large-scale platform re-platforming.

Our operating model is built around six functional pillars – Solution Architecture; Enterprise Architecture & System Design; ML, AI & GenAI; Data Architecture; Cyber Security; and Cloud & Infrastructure. Each team member develops deep expertise in one or more pillars and helps us build capability across the team, enabling us to deploy rapidly onto client engagements with both depth and resilience.

We were recently recognised by the Financial Times as one of the UK’s leading Management Consultants in Insurance.

In our team you will have the opportunity to:

• Invent and provide solutions to real-world problems across our Insurance and Financial Services clients, including solutions leveraging the latest technologies including GenAI and agentic AI.

• Build on and develop your understanding of the Financial Services sector using our industry-proven models and reference architectures.

• Act as the communication bridge between business and technology teams, helping ensure that solutions are aligned to true business needs.

• Build trusted advisor relationships with CIO, CTO, Chief Architect and senior business stakeholders.

• Collaborate with colleagues from across the wider Accenture business – including Industry and Enterprise, Technology, Song, Operations – to create differentiated offerings and enable the best outcomes for our clients.

• Deliver tangible, transformational change for clients, helping to shape the insurance and financial services industries of the future.

As an Enterprise & Solution Architect Manager within Insurance Architecture, you will:

• Contribute across all six of our functional pillars on client engagements – with a particular focus on Applications, Integration and Data as well as AI, Cloud and Cyber Security – and developing your skills as an SME in one or more areas.

• Lead technology advisory engagements and architecture workstreams within larger programmes, shaping technology solutions for our clients, leading and working on client engagements that range from architecture assessments and product selections through to major business and technology transformation programmes.

• Define, shape and deliver enterprise and solution architecture artefacts (current-state, target-state, roadmaps and transition states, integration patterns, capability maps) for clients across Insurance and Financial Services.

• Become familiar with and help to enhance our industry specific reference architecture frameworks, which form a core part of our proposition to our clients.

• Shape and lead client engagements – from cloud strategy and solution architecture designs for major programmes to IT strategy roadmaps for an entire business – and lead teams in the delivery of quality outputs and client outcomes.

• Partner with and demonstrate credibility to CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects and other senior client stakeholders through clear, well-structured and insightful analysis and evidence-based advice, acting as a trusted technology adviser and helping to shape clients’ investment decisions and strategic thinking.

• Support sales, proposals and business development activities, including client presentations, solution shaping, effort estimation and commercial input.

• Build and maintain relationships across client organisations and Accenture account teams and contribute to account growth by identifying follow-on opportunities and helping clients develop investment cases and transformation strategies.

• Contribute to and lead thought leadership on the application of technology in financial services, developing distinctive points of view on emerging technologies and trends and representing Accenture at industry forums, conferences and client events.

• Actively contribute to growing and diversifying the Insurance Architecture team, managing, mentoring and coaching colleagues and helping us continuously raise the bar and to develop consulting, architecture and industry/domain skills.

We are looking for candidates with experience and skills such as:

• 7+ years of experience in technology roles – ideally with exposure to Financial Services, Insurance or another regulated industry – covering some combination of data, application, cloud, integration and security.

• A strong working knowledge of architecture concepts particularly with regard to the Application and Data Domains.

• Experience of integrating multiple systems within an enterprise estate and a broad familiarity with Enterprise Application Integration patterns.

• An appreciation of how technology can solve complex business problems, and comfortable operating at the intersection of business and technology.

• Excelled written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to engage and influence senior business and technology stakeholders and to present complex technology concepts clearly to executive and non-technical audiences

• Familiarity with at least one major industry platform (e.g. FNZ, SS&C, Pershing, Guidewire, Sapiens, Duck Creek, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics) is highly desirable.

• A genuine desire to improve outcomes for clients and consumers, and willingness to travel within the UK and occasionally internationally.

Set yourself apart:

• Experience leading technology consulting architecture or transformation engagements within Financial Services or other regulated industries, including supporting business development, proposals and client relationship management activities.

• Experience shaping technology strategies, architecture roadmaps or large-scale transformation programmes, and of leading teams and managing workstreams within complex client environments.

• Passion and enthusiasm for innovating in the insurance and financial services industries, especially through automation, AI/GenAI and modern data platforms.

• Curiosity about the wider Insurance Architecture pillars – Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture & System Design, Cyber Security – and a desire to develop your existing expertise in one or more.

• Experience of how AI/GenAI can be used within architecture and the wider change process to improve delivery quality and efficiency, as well as where it could fit within our clients’ propositions.

• Ability to engage with stakeholders across business, technology and delivery teams, suppliers and clients, explaining the business rationale for architectural and technology choices as well as the delivery impacts.

• A distinctive emerging point of view that you can bring to internal forums and external events.

Successful candidates will demonstrate a consulting mindset, combining deep technology expertise with commercial awareness, client relationship management and a passion for helping organisations navigate complex transformation challenges. They will be comfortable operating as trusted advisors to senior stakeholders while leading teams and contributing to the growth of both client accounts and the wider Insurance Architecture practice.

What’s In It For You

At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days’ leave per year for charitable work of your choice.

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the services we are known for.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Title: Data Engineer

Salary: £65,000 - £85,000 DOE

The Opportunity

I'm currently working with an established financial services business in Manchester that is looking to hire a Data Engineer to join its growing data and technology team.

The organisation operates within the financial services sector, working with complex financial datasets and business-critical information to support its operations, reporting and wider commercial objectives. As the business continues to invest in its technology and data capabilities, it's looking to strengthen its data infrastructure and improve how information is collected, processed, managed and utilised across the organisation.

This is a hands-on Data Engineering opportunity where you'll play an important role in designing, building and maintaining data pipelines, developing scalable data solutions and ensuring the quality, accuracy and reliability of business-critical data.

You'll work closely with Data Analysts, BI Developers, software engineers and wider business stakeholders, helping transform complex datasets into accessible, reliable information that supports financial reporting, operational efficiency and better business decision-making.

The role will involve working with modern cloud technologies, improving existing data processes and contributing to the development of a robust data platform. You'll also have the opportunity to influence engineering standards, improve data architecture and support the organisation's longer-term data strategy.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL and Python skills, experience building production-grade data pipelines and a good understanding of modern cloud data platforms and data warehousing. Experience within financial services, banking, insurance, investment management or another regulated environment would be particularly valuable.

If you're a Data Engineer looking for an opportunity to work with complex financial datasets, modernise data infrastructure and make a tangible impact within an established financial services organisation, this could be an excellent opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, transform and process large volumes of financial and operational data.
• Develop and optimise ETL/ELT processes, ensuring data is accurate, consistent and readily accessible.
• Build and maintain data models and warehouse solutions to support financial reporting, business intelligence and wider analytical requirements.
• Work with cloud-based data platforms and infrastructure to improve scalability, performance and cost efficiency.
• Develop data integration solutions, connecting internal financial systems, databases, APIs and third-party data providers.
• Implement data quality checks, validation processes and monitoring to maintain the integrity of critical financial datasets.
• Optimise SQL queries, data transformations and pipeline performance.
• Collaborate with Data Analysts, BI Developers, Software Engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
• Ensure data pipelines and infrastructure meet relevant security, governance and regulatory requirements.
• Contribute to data architecture decisions, engineering standards and best practices.
• Implement automated testing, version control, CI/CD and deployment processes across data workflows.
• Identify opportunities to improve existing data infrastructure, automate manual processes and increase engineering efficiency.
• Support the development of a scalable data platform as the organisation's data requirements evolve.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Proven experience working as a Data Engineer or in a closely related data engineering role.
• Strong SQL skills, including query optimisation, complex transformations and working with large datasets.
• Strong Python development skills for data processing, automation and pipeline development.
• Experience designing, building and maintaining production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines.
• Experience with cloud data platforms, ideally Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
• Knowledge of data warehousing principles, dimensional modelling and database design.
• Experience integrating data from multiple sources, including APIs, databases and third-party systems.
• Understanding of data quality, validation, monitoring and pipeline reliability.
• Experience using Git and version control, alongside collaborative development practices.
• Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD and deployment best practices.
• Understanding of data security, governance and access management.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate complex data issues.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• Experience working within financial services, banking, insurance, investment management, fintech or another regulated industry.
• Familiarity with financial datasets, including transaction data, customer information, investment data or financial reporting.
• Experience working with modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks or Microsoft Fabric.
• Experience with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Dagster or Azure Data Factory.
• Familiarity with transformation frameworks such as dbt.
• Experience with cloud services including Azure Data Lake, AWS S3, Azure Functions or equivalent technologies.
• Knowledge of Spark, distributed processing or other big data technologies.
• Experience working with streaming data, event-driven architectures or near-real-time processing.
• Understanding of regulatory data requirements, auditability, data lineage and data governance.
• Familiarity with financial services regulations and reporting requirements.
• Experience building data infrastructure to support business intelligence, advanced analytics or AI-driven applications.

Package and Benefits

• Salary of £65,000 - £85,000, depending on experience.
• Hybrid working, with 2-3 days per week in the Manchester office.
• Opportunity to join an established financial services organisation investing in its data capabilities.
• Hands-on involvement in developing and improving modern data infrastructure.
• Exposure to complex financial datasets and business-critical data projects.
• Opportunity to influence technical decisions and contribute to the evolution of the data platform.
• Close collaboration with Data, Technology and wider business teams.
• A role offering technical ownership, ongoing development and the chance to make a measurable business impact.

title: Hospitality and Events Manager
description:

Relevent Football Partners is a wholly owned subsidiary of Relevent, purpose-built to commercialise the UEFA men’s club competitions globally. Following the UC3 tender process, Relevent Football Partners was awarded the commercial rights to the UEFA men’s club competitions (Champions League, Europa League and Conference League) on a global basis for the 2027 to 2033 cycle.

Key Responsibilities

General

Financial

Free weekly wage advances and emergency cash.

Up to 50% off when dining at Dishoom with friends and family.

title: Network Planning Technical Project Manager
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

#LI-IV1

The role

We are seeking a highly technical and experienced Network Planning Technical Project Manager to join our infrastructure team. In this pivotal role, you will be the bridge between internal data center development teams and external telecommunications partners.

You will own the connectivity lifecycle—from initial site opportunity assessment through to the final Outside Plant infrastructure delivery—ensuring our facilities are seamlessly integrated into the global network.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of fiber optics, ISP commercial structures, and geospatial data management, coupled with the project management discipline to drive complex, multi-stakeholder builds across the region.

You’re welcome to work in our Amsterdam office or remotely from Europe.

Your responsibilities will include:

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

• Integrated Project Delivery: Work in lock-step with other Network TPMs, DWDM engineers, ITDC (Infrastructure Technical Data Center) teams, Network Procurement, and Construction departments to ensure cohesive project execution.
• Datacenters PoP Selection: Partner with the site selection team to evaluate connectivity feasibility. Lead the technical validation of long-haul wave proposals and dark fiber options to inform Datacenter and PoP selections.
• Infrastructure Design: Act as the technical lead for fiber pathway architecture from the "0 manhole" to the internal access panels. Oversee the design of manhole placements, conduit systems, and site entry points to ensure optimal route diversity.
• MMR/POE Integration: Collaborate with engineering teams on the layout of Point of Entry (POE) and Meet-Me Rooms (MMR), ensuring space, power, and structural readiness for high-capacity, multi-carrier fiber and MOFN (Managed Optical Fiber Network) arrivals.

Carrier Relations & Commercial Management

• Strategic Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with regional/ Continental ISPs, private dark fiber owners, and utility providers.
• Procurement & Negotiation: Collaborate with Network Procurement on RFx process for last-mile, middle-mile, and long-haul capacity. Lead negotiations for IRU (Indefeasible Right of Use) agreements, long-term leases, and MOFN service structures.
• Colocation: Coordinate with fiber owners to secure necessary rack space, power, and environmental resources within ILA (Inline Amplification) sites.

Network Data & Geospatial Management

• Documentation: Maintain internal databases of fiber/connectivity routes, including rigorous management of KMZ/KML files.
• AutoCAD: Utilize AutoCAD to review, modify, and create site infrastructure and conduit design plans, ensuring accurate documentation of physical plant deployments.

We expect you to have:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
• Industry Expertise: 5+ years of experience in network infrastructure, OSP planning, or data center connectivity project management.
• Technical Proficiency:
AutoCAD: Proficiency in creating and reviewing site infrastructure/conduit designs.
• GIS: Advanced ability to work with geospatial tools and KMZ/KML files.
• Optical Networking: Strong grasp of DWDM technology, ILA requirements, and the technical lifecycle of MOFN deployments.
• Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated success in negotiating complex fiber leases, IRUs, and construction contracts.
• Relationship Management: Proven ability to influence stakeholders and external vendors to meet aggressive regional deployment timelines.

Preferred technical stack:

• Deep knowledge of the regional fiber landscape, including utility right-of-way and regional infrastructure challenges.
• Experience with large-scale 100Tbps+ capacity planning and deployment.
• Ability to read and create code in Python or Go that is relevant to the position.
• Knowledge of service provider or datacenter IP Networking is preferred.

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation
• Career growth and learning opportunities
• Flexibility and ownership
• Collaborative and innovative culture
• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Software Engineer II - Frontend
description:
Description

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join a team of passionate engineers that are tasked with the unique opportunity to build next-generation platforms that will pave the path for many other teams at Ookla to follow. This team manages Ookla’s flagship enterprise products, the most prominent of which provides a whole new way to combine data from different sources to visualize, analyze, and inspire real-world action to improve connectivity, and is a centerpiece in Ookla’s strategy to bring connectivity insights to a wide array of industries and geographies. The modern era has made telecommunications essential to daily life. While our target markets are government entities that are striving to invest and improve broadband access and performance in their jurisdictions along with network operators that are seeking to maximize their revenue opportunities through thoughtful investments in their network, there are many potential customers that could benefit from our products and services.

To be successful in this mission, we use mapping technologies and high performance database systems to produce highly interactive and performant means of understanding large quantities of data at a glance. To do this we work in informal cross-functional “squads” that include more backend focused engineers or data engineers depending on the project. We use each of these skill sets to problem-solve across the software stack, and you’re welcome to contribute to multiple codebases.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain robust and scalable web applications using React, Redux (RTK Toolkit), and Vite
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop and implement new features and functionalities for our data visualization platforms and portals
• Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code and adhere to best practices in software development
• Conduct code reviews, debugging, and troubleshooting to ensure the quality of the codebase
• Help develop, maintain and test RESTful APIs for data processing and handling
• Participate in agile development methodologies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex software issues, identifying and implementing solutions in a timely manner
• Eye for detail and knack for noticing and perfecting subtle interactions and fine points that impact user experience
• Harness AI tooling for speeding up development while still emphasizing human oversight
• Stay up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies in full-stack web development and apply them to our stack

• Proficient in React, Redux (preferably Redux Toolkit), and Vite with hands-on experience building complex web applications

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment

Nice to have:

• Experience with various mapping libraries like MapboxGL (preferred), Leaflet.js, or OpenLayers
• Much preferred to have experience with TypeScript
• Experience with Material UI (MUI)
• Basic understanding of monorepos and the infrastructure required to support them
• Understanding of Accessible user experiences in web applications (WCAG 2.2)
• Experience using AWS or similar cloud computing environments to build and scale a web application
• Familiarity with storing data in relational databases and writing SQL
• Experience writing APIs or other code in Go, Python, or Ruby
• Comfort with collaborating with a design team, providing suggestions and feedback while iterating on UX designs

About

Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights.

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected.

About Accenture

Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

title: Legal Director
description:

Our founding belief is It Only Works If It All Works. That’s why we bring specialists from every discipline - strategy, AI, data, media, digital, experience, branding, creativity, production, PR, CX, CRM, employee engagement and beyond - into one fully integrated challenger network.

VCCP has topped the AAR’s annual new business ranking in 13 of the last 14 years and holds multiple Agency of the Year titles. Across every company and every capability, we share the same ambition: to challenge ourselves, challenge our clients and challenge the industry for the better.

THE ROLE

Our team is made up of five people: General Counsel, Head of Legal, Senior Legal Counsel, Legal Counsel and Paralegal with a separate UK and US Business Affairs team. The role reports directly to the General Counsel.

We are looking for a commercially-minded 5+ PQE lawyer, preferably already with some great in-house experience or a secondment, ready to throw themselves into this busy but fun team. Previous experience in advertising law - whether obtained in private practice, in an agency or within an in-house team supporting a marketing department - is essential, as is a strong background in commercial contracts and IP. • Embracing of new technology - particularly the use of AI and legal tech.

• Pragmatic and commercially minded.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
This role is based at our head office at NETPark in Sedgefield TS21 3FR. Skilled Worker Visa support and Relocation assistance is available, if required.

About Us

Filtronic is looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team to work on a range of exciting RF and microwave products from concept through to volume production.

With experienced engineers, advanced design tools and in-house RF/mmWave manufacturing capability, you will be able to develop your skills and experience designing high-frequency products as part of the Filtronic team.

Our products range from low volume niche opportunity devices to high volume telecommunications, aerospace, defence and space-related applications.

Purpose of Role

To provide end-to-end mechanical engineering support and leadership for advanced high-frequency RF systems, modules and amplifiers, ensuring that mechanical performance, thermal efficiency, reliability, manufacturability, quality and cost requirements are achieved.

The role will involve the design of mechanically robust, lightweight and thermally efficient assemblies for demanding industrial, payload and high-reliability environments, including space-related applications.

Summary Of Responsibilities

Mechanical Design and Development

• Design precision mechanical components and assemblies for RF modules and systems, including lightweight structural enclosures, heatsinks, liquid cooling solutions and waveguide-based architectures.
• Develop modular mechanical architectures suitable for integration into larger payload or system-level assemblies, considering mass, volume, mounting interfaces and serviceability.
• Ensure designs meet RF, thermal, mechanical and environmental requirements, including EMI shielding, structural stiffness, tolerance control, CTE compatibility, vibration, shock and ingress protection.
• Create detailed 3D CAD models and engineering drawings using SolidWorks.
• Select appropriate materials, finishes and manufacturing processes to support product performance, reliability and manufacturability.

Thermal and Structural Analysis

• Perform thermal analysis and simulation, including CFD and conjugate heat transfer, to validate cooling strategies for high-power RF amplifiers and electronic assemblies.
• Conduct structural and dynamic analysis using FEA for vibration, shock, fatigue and other load-case conditions typical of high-reliability payload deployment.
• Review mechanical properties of parts and assemblies, including thermal performance, mechanical stress and environmental robustness.
• Validate simulation models through physical testing and correlation with measured data.

RF-Aware Mechanical Engineering

• Work closely with RF, electronics and systems engineers to optimise mechanical features that influence RF performance, including cavity geometry, surface finish, plating, tolerances and material selection.
• Design mechanical solutions with consideration for waveguide structures, micro-machined geometry, PCB integration and precision alignment.
• Support electromechanical product concept design in collaboration with RF, electronics and PCB design teams.

Manufacturing Support

• Develop designs for manufacturability, assembly and cost reduction using processes including CNC machining, die-casting, additive manufacturing and sheet metal manufacture.
• Generate manufacturing documentation including bills of materials, GD&T drawings and assembly instructions.
• Manage and control engineering drawings and documentation in accordance with Drawing Office standards and company processes.
• Support suppliers and production teams during prototype build, first article approval and continuous improvement activity.
• Contribute to design reviews as part of the company's ISO and NPI processes.
• Support engineering change activity through ECN/ECO processes.

Prototyping and Testing

• Support the build and test of mechanical prototypes and development hardware.
• Support environmental and reliability testing including thermal cycling, humidity, vibration, thermal shock and drop testing.
• Work with test and process engineering to develop production hardware, jigs and fixtures to optimise build and test efficiency.
• Provide technical support to internal stakeholders, customers and external partners throughout the product lifecycle.

Requirements

Skills, Experience and Qualifications

• Degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering.
• Strong 2D and 3D CAD skills, with SolidWorks preferred.
• Experience designing high-precision mechanical assemblies, ideally for constrained, high-reliability or technically demanding environments.
• Understanding of PCB integration, RF shielding and EMI/EMC considerations.
• Strong understanding of materials and manufacturing processes, preferably including CNC machining of aluminium alloys and lightweight structures.
• Excellent understanding of GD&T and engineering drawing standards.
• Experience developing drawings for machined, cast, moulded, punched or sheet metal parts.
• Ability to work effectively within cross-functional engineering teams.
• Experience with PDM/PLM systems and engineering change processes.
• Must be a highly motivated individual able to interface effectively with internal and external customers.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• Experience with payload systems or deployment environments such as space, aerospace, defence or telecoms infrastructure.
• Experience with industrial system design.
• Hands-on experience with FEA and thermal simulation tools, preferably SolidWorks Simulation or SolidWorks Flow.
• Familiarity with RF/mmWave product development, including waveguides, filters, amplifiers and high-frequency assemblies.
• Knowledge of lightweighting techniques and structural optimisation for mass-constrained designs.
• Experience with high-reliability and qualification-driven design standards, such as MIL-STD or ECSS.
• Familiarity with environmental testing such as thermal vacuum or vibration qualification.
• Knowledge of RoHS and WEEE compliance.
• Experience supporting supplier development, first article inspection or production readiness activity.

Personal Attributes

• Strong problem-solving ability with excellent attention to detail.
• Positive, proactive and hands-on approach.
• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in parallel.
• Clear and effective communicator across multidisciplinary teams, suppliers and customers.
• Self-motivated, adaptable and eager to learn new tools, processes and technologies.
• Team player with a strong customer focus.

The successful candidate must meet the criteria for UK Government Security Clearance vetting.

Benefits

• 37.5 hour working week
• 25 days' holiday plus public holidays, with the option to buy up to 5 additional days
• Contributory pension scheme with up to 8% company contribution
• Life Assurance
• Income Protection Insurance

Want to Know More?

This advert provides an overview of the role and its key responsibilities. If you would like details of the salary and benefits package on offer - please note that some benefits become available following successful completion of your probationary period - before investing your time in applying, or would simply like to have an informal conversation about the opportunity, we would be delighted to hear from you. Please contact our Talent Team on 01740 618828.

title: Senior Study Delivery Lead
description:
Global Project Manager

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.

As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.

We are currently seeking a Project Manager to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Project Manager at ICON, you will be responsible for leading and coordinating project activities. Your role will involve overseeing all aspects of project execution, from planning and resource management to stakeholder communication and risk mitigation.

What You Will Do

Ideally, you will be a Project Manager or experienced Senior Clinical Trial Manager with retrospective and prospective designs, post authorization safety studies, real world evidence, and epidemiology experience. This is a leadership role, and you need to demonstrate global clinical study management experience in leading and driving cross-functional teams.

• This position combines end-to-end design, execution, and reporting of clinical studies and trials including:
• Non-interventional studies using primary data collection, including prospective studies enrolling patients and / or HCPs, de novo registries, discrete choice experiments, creation of new datasets with secondary data (e.g. with EMRs / chart abstraction), patient reported outcomes development and validation.
• Global clinical study management experience across different countries and regions is essential to succeed in the role.
• Non-interventional comparative and descriptive studies using secondary data sources, including retrospective studies, burden of illness and drug utilisation studies, prevalence / incidence studies of exposure, risk factors and outcomes.
• Studies utilizing a mixture of existing medical data and the collection of new data via sites or directly via patients.
• Economic modelling studies and supplemental analyses of clinical trials / meta-analyses.
• Interventional and low-interventional studies.

This Includes Responsibility And / Or Accountability For The Set-up, Coordination, Execution And Delivery Of Studies In Partnership With The Science Lead

• Planning and leading the delivery of NIS to time, quality, budget, company standards and scientific requirements from concept protocol to final study report.
• Accountable for coordination and delivery of a fully feasible Study Protocol, Informed Consent Forms, operationally robust study documents and Clinical Study Reports.
• Accountable for the study delivery strategy (e.g. country selection, diversity, patient identification and engagement strategy, recruitment plan, digital platforms / tools etc).
• With the majority of NIS fully outsourced this role includes responsibility and/or accountability to drive assessment, selection, engagement, and management of appropriate vendors.
• Ensure compliance with ICH / GCP & ENCePP guidelines and/or applicable guidelines for studies
• Make decisions which balance risk / benefit. Mitigate risk where appropriate.
• Work with matrix partners, Study Delivery Director and/or manager to develop and manage study level budget within project budget allocation.
• Requires active partnership building for their portfolios and collaboration with therapy aligned staff in other functions. Interact effectively across boundaries with other global functions using influencing and relationship-building skills.

The Position May Include

• Leadership of a study team with single point accountability for delivery of the study
• Have primary responsibility and be a focal point of contact for interactions with key stakeholder groups including lead scientists (epidemiologists, health economists, health outcomes, etc.) data management, biostatistics, legal, compliance and project management.

Your Profile

• Proven expertise in the proactive identification of issues which may impact clinical programmes coupled with the ability to contribute to solutions affecting cross-functional matrix teams.
• Advanced degree (e.g. MS, PhD, PharmD) or equivalent experience.
• Demonstrated experience leading in matrix environment to deliver projects, develop clinical plans, and manage change.
• Ability to work independently and proactively and to take on leadership roles on cross-functional study teams.
• Excellent leadership, influencing and negotiation skills.
• Ability to lead and drive change, continuous improvement and learning, effectiveness at building networks of partners and stakeholders. A track record of applying experience and judgement towards project decision-making, effective peer review, and shared learning is essential.

Required Qualifications And Experience

• A minimum ideally of 6+ years of experience in a Clinical Trial Management position at a CRO or Pharmaceutical Organization.
• Bachelor's degree in health, life sciences, or Advanced degree (e.g. MS, PhD, PharmD)
• Ideally, at least 10+ years of relevant experience in clinical trial management.
• Experience in managing complex or global trials is advantageous.
• Preferred: Experience in managing all trial components from start-up to database lock.
• Preferred: Experience in leading and driving cross-functional teams including oversight of external CROs, etc.
• Proven expertise in the proactive identification of issues which may impact clinical programmes coupled with the ability to contribute to solutions affecting cross-functional matrix teams.

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

description:
Location

London

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg's Engineering AI department has 400+ AI practitioners building highly sought after products and features that often require novel innovations. We are investing in AI to build better search, discovery, and workflow solutions using technologies such as transformers, gradient boosted decision trees, large language models, and dense vector databases. We are expanding our group and seeking highly skilled individuals who will be responsible for contributing to the team (or teams) of Machine Learning (ML) and Software Engineers that are bringing innovative solutions to AI-driven customer-facing products. At Bloomberg, we believe in fostering a transparent and efficient financial marketplace. Our business is built on technology that makes news, research, financial data, and analytics on over 35 million financial instruments searchable, discoverable, and actionable across the global capital markets.

Bloomberg has been building Artificial Intelligence applications that offer solutions to these problems with high accuracy and low latency since 2009. We build AI systems to help process and organize the ever-increasing volume of structured and unstructured information needed to make informed decisions.

Our use of AI uncovers signals, helps us produce analytics about financial instruments in all asset classes, and delivers clarity when our clients need it most. As an ML Research Engineer on the AI Sustainable Finance team, you will be working on exciting initiatives such as real-time controversies detection from news, greenhouse gas emissions estimation for global equities, financial materiality assessment of corporate conduct, and ML explainability for our sustainability solutions.

Bloomberg's sustainable finance solutions are built on comprehensive, reliable, and contextualized environmental, social, and governance data, helping investors see clearly and act with confidence. Our team powers the ML systems behind these solutions, enabling clients to surface opportunities in a shifting landscape, integrate sustainability signals into their models, manage risk exposure, and measure the impact of their strategies.

Join us as a Senior ML Research Engineer and you will have the opportunity to:

• Collaborate with sustainable finance domain experts to develop systems that identify, categorize, and assess sustainability risks
• Own cross-team projects end-to-end, from research and experimentation through production deployment
• Research and train ML models that help investors assess and manage sustainability risks
• Design and build real-time NLP pipelines using large language models
• Develop evaluation frameworks and annotation tooling that drives continuous model improvement
• Stay current with the latest research in NLP, LLMs, and estimation techniques, and incorporate new findings into our models and methodologies
• Represent Bloomberg at scientific and industry conferences and in open-source communities
• Publish product and research findings in documentation, whitepapers or publications to leading academic venues

We are looking for a Senior ML Research Engineer with the following experience:

• Experience building production ML systems, with exposure to sustainability and responsible investment problems
• Practical experience with Machine Learning problems and Large Language Models
• Ph.D. in ML, NLP or a relevant field or MSc in CS, ML, Math, Statistics, Engineering, or related fields and previous relevant work experience
• Proficiency in software engineering with Python, including experience with production ML infrastructure (model serving, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks)
• Familiarity with LLM-based systems for structured information extraction from unstructured text
• An understanding of Computer Science fundamentals such as data structures and algorithms and a data oriented approach to problem-solving
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with engineering peers as well as non-engineering stakeholders such as sustainable finance analysts, product managers, and domain experts
• Interest in sustainability or climate finance is a strong plus
• A track record of authoring publications in top conferences and journals is a strong plus

If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

title: Supply Chain Director
description:
LeMieux is the UK’s fastest-growing equestrian and lifestyle brand, with a global community and big ambitions. Our success is driven by talented people who share our passion for innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We’re seeking a Supply Chain Director to join our team and help shape the future of our brand.

What You’ll Do

This role is currently being filled by an interim Operations Director who has improved our own UK warehouse processes and efficiency, opened a US 3PL, and onboarded a new freight forwarder that has stock consolidation hubs for more efficient shipping to distribution warehouses. We want to bring in a permanent replacement, with a broader remit than the current role, particularly incorporating supply chain planning and inventory management to build on these foundations that have been established. This will involve a realignment in responsibilities across the business.

The Supply Chain Director will report into the Chief Financial Officer (CFO). The role will be part of the Senior Leadership Team (SLT) with regular engagement and interaction with the CEO.

As the business has grown, we now have a large range (c13,000 SKU’s) mainly being sourced from many suppliers across Asia that is being consolidated into Asian hubs before being shipped to our own warehouse in the UK, and 3PL’s in the USA & EU. From these warehouses we then service wholesale customers and our D2C channels (owned e-comm site and Amazon). The business has seasonal ranges that create a large volume and value of orders for wholesale customers and then separately has a peak sales period in Q4 via D2C.

With the strength and depth of our consumer proposition, we have an ambitious growth plan. At the heart of this role will be drive OTIF for key product launches and a ‘never out of stock’ programme whilst also reducing the cost-to-serve from the supplier through to the customer.

The Supply Chain Director will be responsible for the design, planning, and execution of our global supply chain owning the integrated demand & supply plan, translating these forecasts into executable purchasing (with merchandising & buying), freight, warehousing, fulfilment, and capacity plans to ensure that we have the right inventory, in the right place, at the right time, and at the best cost, to ensure our customers (and our employees and suppliers) have a great experience. A big part of the role will be balancing availability / cost-to-serve / resilience / working capital requirements - this must always be through the lens of supporting the customer proposition, profitably.

There are c65 people across the supply chain team, of which c55 are warehouse operatives. Determining the right capabilities and structure across the team, and in particular ensuring that key roles are filled by great talent, will be fundamental.

The principal responsibilities of the role are:

Build & lead a capable supply-chain team

• Assess, build, and lead the supply-chain team, with the capabilities required to support growing the business, profitably, whilst driving a culture of continuous improvement.
• Create an environment of data-led decision making anchored in customer service and profitability, ensuring the team understand the commercial & financial impact of decisions.
• Work collaboratively with other teams across the business to drive the right outcomes.
• Promote health & safety across our operations.

Develop the supply chain strategy and operating model aligned to the regional growth plans

• Design the optimum global network for purchasing, consolidation, freight, inventory management, warehousing, and fulfilment.
• Develop policies in relation to; where inventory is held (regional v regional v central); inbound and intra-warehouse freight; warehouse capacity and utilisation.
• Develop a business continuity programme for the supply chain, with a documented supply-chain risk register and clear responses to material risks.
• Develop a clear plan for inventory & supply response should there be a material change in demand

Own the S&OP process & plan

• Develop the demand forecast process, including the rolling 12-month demand forecast (owned by the regional commercial leads) and the mechanism by which it translates into a supply plan and hence a financial forecast (in conjunction with the finance team).
• Convert the demand plan into a supply & inventory plan i.e. the intake plan from factories; despatch plan from the freight forwarder warehouses to receiving warehouses; stock cover required for different classification of products; deals with the variability in the forecast & shipping times; ensures cost efficiency v working capital requirement and storage costs.
• Identify supply constraints with recommendations to resolve challenges

Drive the inventory management plan

• Recommend the inventory management plan to the CFO & CEO, based on achieving OTIF targets and reduced cost-to-serve.
• Actively participate in the product lifecycle management process (new ranges / SKU’s; seasonal collections; dealing with slow moving, obsolete, or discontinued stock) and drive stock health and efficiency.

Manage key supplier chain partnerships to achieve our objectives

• Own the strategic relationship with the freight forwarder, negotiating and validating rates (including surcharges) & service levels and ensuring sufficient capacity at the necessary times.
• Set the warehouse operating strategy for wholesale & D2C fulfilment across the UK owned warehouse and the US & EU 3PL’s. For the UK, ensure clear accountability for safety, service, productivity, accuracy & cost. For the 3PL’s, ensure we have the right partners and contracts in place to drive high standards and performance, at the right cost.
• Ensure that we have the right logistics providers in place for deliveries (service & cost) and that they have the capacity to scale during peak & seasonal spikes.
• Establish, with the customer service team, an efficient and effective process for dealing with shortages, delivery failures, returns, and refunds.

Drive effectiveness and efficiency through systems and data

• Own the supply-chain systems road map, in partnership with IT & finance, and ensure effective use of systems such as; ERP; forecasting and planning; WMS; freight management systems; 3PL interfaces; etc.
• Establish a single view of inventory (from orders through to projected availability).
• Ensure ownership of master data across the supply chain.
• Take accountability for and drive financial performance across the supply chain
• Own and prepare budgets & forecasts and understand variances to a flexed plan (supported by finance).
• Identify how to drive productivity and cost-saving programmes without compromising service.
• Ensure accurate landed cost information per SKU and an understanding of cost-to-serve.
• Put in place controls for airfreight; overtime; exceptional distribution charges; and any other material costs.
• Work with the CFO to understand and manage working capital requirements

Measures of success:

• High customer service levels (OTIF), particularly during seasonal peaks and for the ‘never out of stock’ products whilst managing working capital requirements.
• Clear understanding of landed costs to enable better decision making, and the development and execution of a plan to improve cost-to-serve.
• Credible strategic and operational plans agreed and executed with merchandising, buying, commercial, supply chain, and finance.
• A resilient supply chain with practical contingency plans

What You’ll Bring

• Proven experience building and running a consumer goods supply chain, ideally in an apparel business, from purchasing inventory in Asia through to selling in multiple regions and multiple channels, ideally wholesale and digital B2C. This would ideally include running a warehouse and fulfilment operations.
• Customer first mindset – experience, quality, service.
• Demonstrable ability to lead and develop a supply chain team
• Continuous improvement / kaizen mindset and experience, driving down the cost-to-serve.
• Experience of running S&OP, driving forecasting & supply chain planning and working cross-functionally with buying, merchandising, supply chain and finance.
• Experience of designing & develop new processes and ways-of-working and confident challenging existing practice
• Strong strategic and analytical skills
• Commercially astute, driving better financial outcomes

Why Join LeMieux?

Founded in 2006, LeMieux is the UK’s fastest-growing equestrian and lifestyle brand with a global presence. Driven by innovation and passion for horses and riders, we’re expanding our team based in our Romsey HQ and looking for exceptional people to join us on our journey.

We’re on a mission to be the most exciting equestrian brand on the planet. To get there, we need exceptional people who thrive in a fast-paced, creative environment and a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and problem-solving. Whether you ride or not, you’ll share our energy, determination, and obsession with delivering excellence for our community.

From financial security to time with your loved ones (on two legs or four), we continually invest in our employees.

We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that varied perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our team. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities - including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, and neurodiversity. We are an equal opportunity employer and actively promote an environment of respect, support, and opportunity for all. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments throughout the application process.

title: Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is on a mission to power the connected operations that keep the world moving. As our Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter in EMEA, you will lead Engineering Early Talent (New Grads and Interns) and G&A hiring across multiple businesses. You will partner with regional and global leaders, build sourcing strategies that work, and give every candidate a standout experience.

You should apply if these excite you:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work helps keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores and workers home safely, as we digitize large sectors of the global economy.
• High-Impact Role: Direct visibility and influence with regional and global business leaders in a fast-growing organisation.
• You are the architect of your own career: Put in the work and this role won’t be your last at Samsara, with countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft.
• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together and support each other, surrounded by a high-calibre team that pushes you to do your best.
• Cutting-Edge Tools: Work with best-in-class, AI-forward recruiting technologies and data-driven strategies.

In this role, you will:

• Lead G&A hiring across EMEA: partner with a very diverse group of business leaders, plan hiring by function (Finance, People, Legal, IT), and switch context fast to keep every business moving.
• Build our Early Talent programs in EMEA: lead local New Grad and Intern hiring, grow university relations and campus pipelines, and work with HQ on planning and execution and with local engineering leaders to hire early-career talent who meet our high bar.
• Build creative sourcing strategies across LinkedIn, referrals and other channels, tailored to each function and market and backed by EMEA market intelligence.
• Manage the pipeline from sourcing to onboarding, with an exceptional candidate experience.
• Use data to refine recruiting strategy and influence hiring decisions.
• Champion diversity, equity and inclusion through impactful hiring programs.
• Work with People, Legal, Finance and Mobility to streamline hiring, including country-specific requirements.
• Mentor peers and foster a culture of learning in the recruitment team.
• Embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• You have 6+ years of proven full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in a tech organisation with a very high hiring bar.
• You have proven experience building Early Talent programs, hiring for Engineering New Grads and Interns in UK (mandatory) and G&A roles (e.g. Finance, People, Legal, IT) in EMEA.
• You communicate with key partners in a concise, professional and pro-active way.
• You have exceptional stakeholder management abilities and executive presence, experienced working with a very diverse population of business leaders and switching context rapidly and comfortably.
• Innovation mindset: you’re comfortable implementing new tools, technologies, and methodologies.
• AI - forward: we would like to see strong analytical skills when looking into hiring data and forecasting hiring needs.
• Optimising the use of the AI tools available to create a better candidate experience and efficient workflows. No AI slop.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Deep understanding of EMEA talent market trends, turned into actionable strategies for each function.
• Proven outbound sourcing for technical and specialist talent in a competitive market.

What's in it for you?

• The chance to shape and build Samsara’s teams across EMEA.
• A high-visibility role: build connections and influence with Samsara’s regional & global business leaders.
• A passionate, innovative & AI-Forward team committed to excellence

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Marine Mechanical Engineer II
description:
Description

Marine Mechanical Engineer Level 2

Position summary: Leidos Gibbs & Cox is seeking a Marine Mechanical Engineer Level 2 to support the design, analysis, and integration of marine mechanical systems for naval and maritime platforms. This mid-level role is suited for an engineer with experience applying technical knowledge, strong analytical skills, and interest in supporting ship design, system development, and lifecycle engineering efforts.

Primary responsibilities:

• Works independently (with moderate supervision), or on project teams
• Performs calculations applying mechanical engineering principles, procedures, and criteria.
• Develops analyses and prepares technical reports and other engineering documentation.
• Develops ship propulsion and auxiliary system calculations and designs and prepares technical purchase specifications for major equipment.
• Supports engineering activities for systems that may include main and auxiliary propulsion, fuel systems, lubrication systems, seawater and freshwater systems, and heating, ventilating, and air conditioning systems

Basic qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent education in Marine Engineering or Mechanical Engineering and 2+ years of relevant experience.
• Functional understanding of mechanical systems, thermodynamics, fluid systems, or shipboard systems
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work effectively in a team environment
• Proficiency with CAD and Microsoft Office applications
• Must be able to obtain a security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

• Career experience in marine, naval, or defense engineering
• +3 Years of experience with ship design, piping, HVAC, propulsion support, or auxiliary mechanical systems
• Professional Engineering or Engineer in Training certification in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another applicable discipline.
• Proficiency in using industry-standard computer aided design, engineering analysis software tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
• Exposure to U.S. Navy, shipbuilding, or maritime industry standards

Work environment: This role supports Leidos Gibbs & Cox engineering work in a collaborative environment focused on maritime and defense solutions.

Some travel to support specific customers and contracts should be expected, approximately 10%. Local to one of the main offices is desirable, however not required. Main offices are located in New York, Philadelphia, Arlington, Newport News, and New Orleans. Open to flexible working arrangements after experience.

Company description: Leidos Gibbs & Cox delivers engineering, design, and maritime solutions in support of critical customer missions. As part of Leidos, Gibbs & Cox combines deep domain knowledge with broader enterprise capabilities to support innovation across defense and national security programs

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo - because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. November 2, 2026

Pay Range $69,550.00 - $125,725.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

About Leidos

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Pay and Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos' name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). title: Head of Retail

• Run retail launches and activation with Brand & Marketing

About you

• A track record of growing rate of sale within UK retailers
• Has launched or managed a brand in at least one international market, distributor-led or direct
• Commercially sharp: confident with forecasting, margin and trading analysis across currencies
• Sets the strategy and still enjoys doing the work
• Happy to travel internationally

description:
About The Role And Team

Account Management at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don’t come with a script. In this role, you will own the growth and success of a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, acting as their primary advisor to unlock the full potential of the Uber Eats platform. It is a high-stakes environment where your ability to build long-term partnerships directly impacts the livelihood of local businesses and Uber’s mission to move the real world.

The work is fast-paced and requires a grit-based mindset; you will deal with shifting priorities, handle tough negotiations, and build lasting partnerships. We are looking for resourceful owners who are energised by the complex reality of Account Management and can stay resilient through the inevitable "no" to find creative solutions for our partners. If you thrive on autonomy and are motivated by seeing the tangible impact of your work on the community, this is where you will grow.

What You’ll Do

• Build and grow long-term partnerships by understanding what matters most to your restaurant partners - doing the right thing long term.
• Manage partner portfolios with urgency and discipline, using data-driven insights to track KPIs and identify opportunities for optimization.
• Navigate ambiguity and complexity to resolve merchant issues, unblock growth, and ensure high-levels of partner satisfaction.
• Adapt your approach based on market dynamics and partner needs to influence the adoption of new features, marketing products, and services.
• Collaborate across operations, marketing, and product teams to share local market knowledge and shape regional strategies that scale.

• 3+ years of experience in account management, operations, sales or customer-facing functions.
• Ability to negotiate with external partners and overcoming objections to gain commitment.
• Ability to handle high-ambiguity environments and pivot quickly based on shifting business priorities.
• Demonstrated ability to build and leverage data-driven insights for portfolio sales lifecycle-management.
• Fluency in the local language of the market, and professional proficiency in English.
• High school diploma or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

• Proficiency in Salesforce and Google Sheets/Excel for data-driven decision making.
• Demonstrated problem-solving ability to solve gaps in merchant processes.
• Stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without authority.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
