group: yoto|strategic finance business partner, group functions (12 month ftc)
title: Strategic Finance Business Partner, Group Functions (12 month FTC)
description:
Our Strategic Finance Business Partner will run financial forecasting, budgeting and in-year reforecasting for Yoto’s central group functions, manage their investment cases, and be the Finance business partner for our S&OP process. This is a great opportunity for someone who loves turning numbers into clear insight for non-finance colleagues, and who wants to shape how a fast-scaling business plans and makes decisions.

About Yoto

Yoto is a screen-free interactive audio platform for kids. We make carefully connected audio players that kids control, with no microphones, cameras or ads. We have a catalogue of audio that inspires creative play and learning with 1,000+ titles in our card store from top creators, publishers and labels - think Disney, Marvel, Roald Dahl and Universal Music. We also create Yoto Originals like BrainBots.

• Voted the 14th fastest-growing private software technology company in Britain in The Sunday Times 100 Tech 2025; and named the 94th fastest-growing company in Europe in the prestigious FT1000.
• Ranked 9th in Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2024; and featured in the Sifted 100 fastest-growing startups across the UK&I by revenue growth.
• Featured in Bloomberg’s 25 UK startups to watch in 2023; and ranked second fastest growing tech company in the UK in the Deloitte Fast50.
• Named one of TIME Magazine’s Top 100 Inventions of 2020.
• We’re over 200 employees spread across the world... and growing!

We’re on a mission to be the soundtrack of childhood, and help families on their own unique adventures. By creating products that inspire independent play, we help families discover and grow with an inspiring world of audio - and we would like you to help us achieve it!

What you’ll be doing:

Financial Forecasting and Budgeting

• Run forecasting, budgeting and in-year reforecasting for our central group functions, working closely with department leads to build plans that link to Yoto’s strategy and KPIs
• Deliver continuous improvements in our forecasting process and financial governance, leveraging our EPM (Pigment), ERP (NetSuite) and support from our Data team to increase accuracy through better data integrity, systemisation and AI
• Build and model hands-on in Pigment to unlock better reporting and forecasting for group functions.

Investment Cases

• Manage investment cases for our central group functions, from framing the problem and building the business case to testing the ROI and supporting prioritisation and sign-off
• Partner our Content, Product and Operations teams on CAPEX spend to ensure it’s supported by a healthy ROI and prioritised accordingly.

Group Business Partnering

• Be the Finance business partner for our S&OP process, using commercial thinking to balance demand vs. supply side risk, maximising revenue and limiting overstocks
• Partner on non-staff overheads, leveraging Pigment to promote self-service for department leads so that this is more variance management than report generation
• Support cash planning and working capital optimisation across the business.

What you’ll bring:

• Experience presenting forecasts and variance analysis to non-finance colleagues, including senior leaders, in writing and in person, in a way that supports business decisions
• A track record of improving finance processes, for example by automating manual reporting or planning steps with Excel, planning tools, data tools or AI tools
• 2+ years’ post-qualification experience (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or equivalent practical experience, in FP&A, Strategic Finance or Commercial Finance
• Experience running budgeting and forecasting cycles and building financial models in Excel or a financial planning tool
• Experience building investment or business cases, and testing the assumptions behind them with budget holders.

Nice to have

• Experience in a subscription business, working with metrics such as LTV, churn and retention.
• Hands-on experience with a financial planning or EPM tool such as Pigment, including helping to configure or improve it to reduce manual planning work.

Salary: £60,000 - £70,000 based on experience

How we use AI at Yoto

We think using AI to work smarter is part of the job.

At Yoto, we use AI to help us move faster and reduce manual work so we can focus our time on creativity, problem-solving and impact. We don’t want to use AI to cut corners - it’s about smart usage that makes space for the work that really matters. Our intention is to be thoughtful about how we use AI. We treat its outputs as a starting point, not the final answer, and we take care to use it responsibly - especially given the trust families place in Yoto.

We don’t expect everyone to be an AI expert, but we do expect people to be curious, to experiment, and to keep improving how they work. If you prefer to do everything manually, you might find our pace and expectations challenging.

The magic at Yoto comes from people working here, not their prompts. AI should help us move faster, not change what makes working here great.

What you can expect from Yoto:

• Flexibility: Hybrid working - At least 1 day a week on average in our central London office. You are welcome and encouraged to come in more than this. How you meet the minimum expectation is up to you, to ensure you're happy and productive in your role whilst also getting that vital face time with your colleagues. Take advantage of our ‘work from anywhere’ policy to work from a different location for up to 6 weeks every year. Summer Hours policy to use between the months of June and August.
• Financial: Receive Income Protection, covering long term sickness for up to 2 years and company sick pay that increases with length of service. Life Assurance cover from day one of your service. Workplace Pension offering up to to 4% employer contributions, following probation. Generous employee referral bonus scheme.
• Health & Wellness: Private Medical Insurance via Aviva, or a Wellbeing Allowance to be used for memberships, subscriptions, treatment or therapy. Access to 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) through WeCare. Bike to work scheme to promote healthier lifestyles.
• Time Off: 25 days of holiday per year, plus bank holidays. On top of this, you also receive your birthday off, plus 1 extra day of holiday for every year worked after you hit your 2 year anniversary, up to 5 extra days. After 4 years of service, you are also eligible for our sabbatical policy offering up to 3 months' of unpaid sabbatical.
• Helping Families: Variety of family-friendly leave, including enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption, fertility, pregnancy loss and carers leave. Unlock savings with our workplace nursery scheme, designed to support parents of preschool-aged children.
• People & Planet: Up to 2 volunteer days a year. A Book Allowance of up to £50 a year to contribute to your professional development.
• Fun Perks: You receive your very own Yoto player and starter pack of cards! Regular company socials and celebrations, including our annual YotoFest!

Equity and Diversity

At Yoto, we love creating a world where childhood is rich with discovery and joy. We’re also passionate about building a workplace where everyone can thrive - both professionally and personally. We value flexibility and give our team the freedom to balance life and work in ways that suit them.

We're committed to fostering a safe, diverse, and inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of their background, feel valued and supported. Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion group holds bi-monthly forums to elevate diverse voices and perspectives, ensuring everyone at Yoto feels heard, respected, and appreciated.

We don’t just embrace differences - we celebrate them. We share audio content from a vibrant and diverse community of creators (check out our DEI selection), and we are building a team that reflects that same diversity. We invite candidates from all walks of life to explore opportunities with us and join a company that champions flexibility, equity, and inclusion. Take a look at our website for more information on our approach to People and Planet.

Please only apply or engage with Yoto jobs posted on our careers page (careers.yotoplay.com or careers.yotoplay.com/en). All correspondence from our Talent team will only come through Teamtailor, our application tracking system.

The Senior Director, Global Medical Director ensures a deep understanding of customer, patient, and healthcare system needs are represented consistently across cross-functional discussions and decision-making forums.

This role will provide strategic leadership and contributions directly or through team members in support of the clinical development team to determine and align on future treatment landscape scenarios for assets in early development through commercialization for all Neuro-Oncology assets. The Senior Medical Director will inform and influence clinical development strategy, evidence plans and the target product profile for such products, with a bias toward the United States therapeutic landscape as the driver of strategic planning.

The role serves as a critical interface between Medical Affairs and global R&D, Early/Clinical Development, Global Product Development and Commercialization functions, to ensure regional insights and priorities are understood, communicated, and appropriately considered within the Global Product Team (GPT), Commercial Development Team (CDT), Medical Functional Matrix Team (FMT), and governance forums including the Portfolio Governance Committee (PGC) and Development Project Review Committee (DPRC). This role leads the US medical affairs team with responsibility to deliver strategy and execution in support of the US indications in Neuro-Oncology in alignment with Neuro-Oncology commercial leadership and partners in the US market.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

• Lead the global and US Medical Affairs Neuro-Oncology team to deliver all aspects of medical affairs strategy in support of pipeline and marketed products
• Lead the global medical Neuro-Oncology FMT
• Provide strategic and executional leadership and guidance to team members to deliver US medical plan in support of all indications and launch planning
• Lead and develop team members in high performing team culture
• Lead the development, maintenance, and execution of the Integrated Evidence Generation Plan Neuro-Oncology including investigator-sponsored studies, real-world evidence initiatives, health outcomes research, and Phase IV interventional studies, where appropriate

• Represent and advocate for medical perspectives within global cross-functional teams and governance forums, including GPT, CDT, PGC, and DPRC
• Contribute Medical Affairs expertise to inform early development activities for early pipeline assets, including Target Product Profile (TPP) development, clinical trial design and lifecycle planning based on regional insights and aligned future therapeutic landscape scenarios
• Ensure regional needs and insights are appropriately considered in early/clinical development discussions, evidence-generation activities, and lifecycle planning
• Ensures awareness and Medical Affairs functional alignment on early/clinical development programs
• Maintain and apply a deep understanding of the competitive landscape to inform evidence generation strategy and internal development decisions
• Partner effectively across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Market Access, HEOR, RWE, Commercial, and other cross-functional teams to support evidence generation and scientific exchange
• Lead development and execution of publication strategy and publication plans in alignment with regional evidence needs and scientific priorities
• Support scientific communications, congress planning, advisory boards, and external engagement activities as required

Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

• A minimum of 10 years of Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, or related pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience is required
• A minimum of 5 years of experience leading US strategy and in-line execution is required
• Experience in people management strongly preferred
• Experience in Neuro-Oncology is strongly preferred
• Demonstrated experience developing and executing evidence-generation strategies, publication plans, and external scientific engagement activities
• Strong understanding of clinical research, evidence generation, and drug development
• Proven ability to influence without authority and operate effectively within complex matrix organizations
• Strong strategic thinking coupled with excellent operational execution skills
• Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
• Ability to build productive partnerships across regions and functions and effectively represent diverse stakeholder perspectives

• Evidence of success in matrix organizations and track record of high performing behaviors, including independent critical thinking, initiative, and execution under time pressure with competing priorities

Required/Preferred Education And Licenses

• Advanced scientific or healthcare degree required (PharmD, PhD, MD, MBBS, Nurse Practitioner, PA, or equivalent)
• Experience in the delivery of oncology care preferred

title: Design engineer (UK)
description:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com.

📐 About the role

Design engineers sit at the intersection of design and engineering. As a design engineer at WRITER, you'll own the Writer Design System (WDS) — how it's built, how it's maintained, and how both humans and AI agents use it to ship product.

This role matters more now than ever. AI coding agents write more of our production code, and they ship whatever they find. A design system that's incomplete or inconsistent doesn't just slow designers down; it gets compounded at scale by every agent that builds against it. You'll make sure WRITER's core UI library is complete and trustworthy enough to build on, working closely with the designers, PMs, and engineers who rely on it every day. You'll help shape the surfaces that define how our product feels to use, and help set the standard and process for how the EPD org ships product.

This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, New York City, Seattle, or London hubs. This role will be reporting to the Director of product design.

We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do

• Own the Writer Design System (WDS) as your primary domain — agentify and maintain it, ensuring it's optimized for both humans and AI agents building with it
• Design and build production-quality UI components and features, owning surfaces from sketch to ship
• Ship design-led work that wouldn't survive an engineering backlog — polish passes, micro-interactions, and brand moments that make the product feel alive
• Architect new primitives and extend the system's core components, shaping its technical direction while keeping documentation, examples, and libraries in sync across Figma, .md skills, and Storybook
• Uphold the bar for front-end craft across accessibility, motion feel, consistency, and quality, ensuring accessibility is baked into every design system component
• Help shape the design-to-code workflow, researching the latest tools and practices to unlock org-wide productivity and democratize workflows across the EPD organization
• Partner with designers, PMs, and engineering leads to measure WDS adoption, close gaps, and make sure shipped features meet design system standards

⭐️ What you need

• 4–8+ years building production frontends with TypeScript and React, with a track record of owning a system, platform, or surface end-to-end rather than individual features
• Solid instincts for animation principles including easing curves, choreography, anticipation, follow-through, interruptibility, and perceived performance
• Fluency in Figma at expert level — auto-layout, variants, variables, and code connect — and proficiency with design engineering technologies like framer-motion, gsap, and lottie for web-based animation
• A demonstrable obsession with craft, backed by a portfolio, side projects, GitHub, or production work that includes systems-level work and not just feature work
• Experience driving adoption of a design system or shared platform across an engineering org, with a track record of influencing technical or design direction beyond your immediate team
• Experience with AI product surfaces — tool-call UIs, streaming responses, agent state, and dynamic UI rendering — and comfort navigating ambiguous, cross-team problems with good judgment about when to loop others in
• A genuine commitment to WRITER's values of Connect, Challenge, and Own

🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees):

• Comprehensive medical and dental insurance
• Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)
• Fertility and family planning support
• Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri

title: Technical Project Manager, Commercial Integrations
description:
Company Description

At QIMA, we are on a mission to help our clients make products consumers can trust. We have developed compliance solutions for testing, inspection and certification (TIC) that enable supply chain agility, sustainability and product innovation. Our services are used by 30,000 businesses globally in the consumer products, agri-food and life sciences industries. Backed by 6,000+ dedicated Qimates worldwide, we bring local expertise and tailored support to every client. Our passion for service has made QIMA an industry leader for customer satisfaction, as highlighted by our exceptional Net Promoter Score (NPS).

What truly sets us apart is our unique culture of relentless care for our clients, and a commitment to offering intuitive solutions that blend deep tech and human intelligence; this is how QIMA continues to disrupt the testing, inspection and certification industry. Qima is driven by client passion and thrives by focusing on agility, integrity, and growing together. After rapid strategic acquisitions, we're at an inflection point as we transition from start-up velocity to scale-up sophistication. We're building the processes, systems, and team to support our next phase of growth while maintaining the entrepreneurial spirit that got us here.

Job Description

QIMA’s rapid growth has added complexity in data, systems, processes, and management structures. Successful integration requires close collaboration between technical, commercial, and core business teams. This role is responsible for driving that collaboration.

The Technical Project Manager, Commercial Integrations is an individual contributor responsible for the end-to-end integration of data, systems, and operational processes from acquired companies into QIMA's core infrastructure. You will own workstreams from initial data discovery and process mapping, through to production-ready pipelines and process handover, coordinating across legal, finance, commercial, and technical stakeholders. This is a mid-level role requiring engineering rigour and commercial fluency in equal measure: genuinely at home with data, and equally able to explain what you are doing and why it matters to people who will never open a database.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Project Management

• Own project plans, timelines, risk registers, and status reporting for all active integration workstreams; escalate blockers and business decisions proactively.
• Maintain integration documentation, decision logs, and handover notes that enable teams to own the output once integration is complete.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

• Coordinate across Legal, IT, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to gather requirements, identify dependencies and handoffs, secure milestone sign-off, and manage competing priorities.
• Translate complex data processes into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders at all seniority levels.

M&A Data Integration

• Lead post-acquisition data integration workstreams: discovery, profiling, schema mapping, matching, cleansing, and migration from acquired entities into QIMA systems.
• Define integration plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria; identify data quality or process issues early and drive well communicated remediations.
• Validate data integrity across source and target systems at each stage; facilitate knowledge-extraction with acquired company experts before systems are decommissioned.

Data Engineering & Automation

• Build or coordinate data pipelines and ETL processes; apply AI and machine learning tooling to accelerate data ingestion, deduplication, and anomaly detection.
• Design automated quality checks that reduce manual validation effort without compromising accuracy.

Master Data Management & Governance

• Apply MDM principles to align acquired data with QIMA master data standards; define ownership, stewardship rules, and lineage documentation for integrated datasets.
• Navigate data protection and privacy requirements throughout integration, ensuring GDPR compliance while preserving data usability for analytics and AI applications.

Qualifications

Required Experience

• 5-7 years in technical project management, including data integration or data engineering, with proven track record delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
• Hands-on experience with schema mapping, data matching and deduplication, ETL design, and data quality validation.
• Working knowledge of SQL; Python or comparable scripting for data processing and automation.
• Understanding of MDM concepts (data domains, golden records, ownership, lineage) and PII regulations (GDPR and equivalent), including the practical balance between compliance and AI usability.
• Experience managing project workstreams across multiple concurrent stakeholder groups spanning commercial and technical functions.
• Exceptional English-language communication skills with proven ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences in writing and in meetings.
• Bonus: post-merger integration experience, including direct exposure to CRM, marketing automation, or ERP systems in a data integration capacity
• Bonus: project management certification (PMP, Prince2, or Agile/Scrum).

Desired Characteristics

• Clear Communicator: You can make a data mapping discussion accessible to a CFO and credible to a data engineer, and you know which version to use in which room.
• Disciplined with Detail: Integration work lives and dies in the detail. You catch discrepancies before they reach production and document decisions so they are not repeated.
• Technically Grounded, Commercially Aware: You understand data architecture and frame technical work in terms of the outcomes it enables.
• Comfortable with Ambiguity: Acquired data is rarely clean and processes are rarely documented. You impose structure and clarity without being rigid.
• Collaborative by Default: You coordinate large, cross-functional groups without a reporting line through preparation, clarity, and trust.

Additional Information

Does this describe you? Then we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Apply now with your CV in English and we can write the next chapter of the QIMA story together!

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Department: Finance

Location: Bristol, UK

Compensation: £30,000 - £40,000 / year

Description

We're building the UK's next generation engineering powerhouse, providing critical technology that strengthens national security and resilience.

We specialise in turning advances in sensing, AI, and communications into operational capability for the edge, where connectivity may be degraded or denied. Our work focuses on accelerating the deployment of technology, improving decision-making for frontline teams, and protecting people and critical assets in demanding environments.

Headquartered in Bristol, Rowden employs around 200 people and operates over 20,000 square feet of engineering and manufacturing facilities. We have a growing international footprint and are one of Europe's fastest-growing engineering businesses.

The role

We have an exciting opportunity for a Finance Assistant to join our team. In this role, you will support the finance team with day-to-day financial operations and transactions, including processing invoices, managing expenses, reconciling accounts, and assisting with payroll. You will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, preparing reports, and supporting a broad range of finance activities across the team.

The ideal candidate for this role will be hands-on, adaptable, detail-oriented and proactive in improving our financial processes. This is a fast-paced role in an ambitious, growing engineering business – there will be a huge amount of opportunity for growth and development for the right person.

As a Finance Assistant, you will have the chance to:

• Progress Your Career: This role is designed to offer a clear pathway for advancement within the finance team. As you develop your skills and demonstrate your impact, you’ll have opportunities to take on more responsibility and progress to more senior finance roles.
• Learn and Upskill: You’ll gain hands-on experience with a wide range of finance processes, systems (such as SAP Public Cloud (S4/HANA), SAP Concur and more), and projects. We provide study support for professional qualifications (AAT, ACCA, CIMA, or similar) and encourage continuous learning through internal and external training.
• Exposure to Projects: You’ll be involved in process improvement initiatives, system migrations, and automation projects as the company scales. This exposure will help you build a broad skill set and prepare for future roles in finance or operations.
• Mentoring and Support: You’ll work closely with experienced finance professionals who are committed to supporting your growth. Regular feedback and coaching will help you identify strengths and areas for development.
• Dynamic Environment: As part of an ambitious, growing engineering business, you’ll be challenged and supported to reach your full potential in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Candidates must be eligible for SC clearance.

More information about security clearance is available here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels

Key areas of responsibility

Mission: To support the day-to-day financial operations of the business, and ensure accurate, efficient, and compliant financial processes that enable business scalability.

Outcomes:

1. Transactional Finance (Day-to-Day Operations)

• Accounts Payable: Processing supplier invoices, reviewing and matching POs, handling payment runs and resolving discrepancies.
• Accounts Receivable: Raising sales invoices, chasing overdue payments, and assisting with credit control.
• Bank Reconciliation: Ensuring transactions are recorded accurately and reconciling multiple bank accounts.

2. Month-End & Reporting Support

• Assisting with month-end close processes (e.g., preparing journal entries, reconciling ledgers, and supporting accruals & prepayments).
• Supporting the preparation of management accounts by providing accurate financial data.
• Helping to maintain the fixed asset register and tracking capital expenditures.

3. Compliance & Process Improvement

• Ensuring all transactions comply with accounting policies and financial regulations.
• Assisting with VAT returns, tax filings, and audit preparations.
• Identifying and suggesting improvements to finance processes and automation to enhance efficiency.
• Comfortable with the application of AI tools to automate workflows and speed up financial operations.

4. Business Support & Collaboration

• Management of finance email inbox.
• Processing staff expenses (chasing for missing receipts & other required information)
• Collation of financial information required for monthly project review meetings.
• Partnering with wider teams (e.g., operations, sales, HR) to ensure accurate financial reporting.
• Assisting with a range of ad hoc finance duties as required.

5. Systems & Tools Management

• Using accounting software and other financial applications (e.g. SAP Public Cloud (S4/HANA) and SAP Concur) for data entry and reporting.
• Helping with ERP system implementation or automation projects as the company scales.

Competencies:

• Proactive: solutions-focused finance professional who consistently anticipates needs and takes initiative to improve processes and outcomes (e.g. embedding the use of AI tools, automating workflows and streamlining processes).
• Meticulous attention to detail: You have an exceptional eye for detail and take pride in delivering accurate work.
• Analytical: You are an analytical thinker and able to confidently solve problems. You consider new ways of working and different ways to tackle challenges.
• Strong interpersonal skills: You can confidently communicate with all members of the Rowden team.
• Eagerness to learn: You have a hands-on approach and a strong desire to learn new things, adapting quickly to changing demands.
• Dynamic and adaptable: You are energetic, determined and prepared to face, and adapt to, any challenge with a positive attitude.
• Organisational skills: You have excellent time management skills – you’re organised and able to prioritise a busy workload in a fast-paced environment.
• Self-motivated: You can work independently and seek advice when needed but also work well within a small team environment.

Key skills, experience and behaviours

• Previous experience in a Finance Assistant (or similar bookkeeping) role with a willingness to learn and develop.
• Experienced processing staff expenses and managing reimbursements.
• Experienced in transaction processing and monthly account reconciliations.
• Experience of straight forward month-end tasks, such as prepayments and accruals.
• Advanced Excel and strong Microsoft Office skills.
• Experience in using accounting software and other cloud-based applications e.g. SAP Public Cloud (S4/HANA) and SAP Concur.
• AAT qualified or part-qualified ACA, ACCA, CIMA (or other relevant qualification) – training support available.

Working at Rowden

We are committed to building a flexible, inclusive, and enabling company. Our aim is to create a diverse team of talented people with unique skills, experience, and backgrounds, so please apply and come as you are!

We also recognise the importance of flexible working and support this wherever we can. We typically operate a flexible, hybrid-working model, with an average 3 days in the office each week (dependent on the role). We welcome the opportunity to discuss flexibility, part-time working requirements and/or workplace adjustments with all our applicants.

Rowden is a Disability Confident Committed company, and we actively encourage people with disabilities and health conditions to apply for our roles. Please let us know your requirements early on so that we can make sure you have everything you need up front to help make the recruitment process and experience as easy as possible.

Finally, if you feel that you don’t meet all the criteria included above but have transferable skills and relevant experience, we’d still love to hear from you!

group: hellofresh|associate director, corporate strategy & development (all genders)
title: Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development (all genders)
description:
The role

As an Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development, you will be a senior member of a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This is a high-exposure role, acting as the strategic and analytical engine for our most important decisions in a team that reports directly to the Group CEO.

This role balances corporate development / M&A with corporate strategy. You lead projects across both areas as the day-to-day owner and guide a small number of more junior colleagues and internal functional experts. You operate with minimal direction and take projects from a vague problem statement to a CEO-ready recommendation. You also stay hands-on, personally building the models and analysis and preparing the executive-level outputs that drive investment and strategy decisions.

What You’ll Do

• M&A Strategy: Lead M&A projects end to end (owning small and mid-sized transactions independently and partnering with the Director on the largest, transformational deals), from target screening and valuation through due diligence, negotiation preparation, and post-deal integration. Run deal teams day to day, coordinate external advisors and act as the lead with target management teams or their advisors. You are not just a process manager but can form and defend a point of view on whether and why a deal makes strategic sense and present it directly to senior leadership.
• Portfolio Optimization: Lead the strategic analysis and recommendations for key portfolio decisions, including potential geo-expansions, new vertical or brand launches or divestments.
• Corporate Strategy: Contribute to the development of the Group's mid-term strategy by driving the process, owning the underlying analysis, strategic synthesis, and preparation of strategic documents.
• Capital Allocation: Own and develop analytical frameworks and models to support strategic budget allocation and ROI analysis.
• Business Unit Strategy: Act as a senior internal consultant, supporting our key business units across geographies on a project-by-project basis to develop their mid-term strategies and solve their most complex challenges.

What You’ll Bring

• Experience: 6+ years of high-performance experience from a top-tier Management Consulting firm, Investment Banking, or a comparable in-house Strategy / Corporate Development team. This includes leading projects or deal teams with minimal supervision.
• Process and deal leadership: You have led complex, multi-stakeholder processes to a deadline, coordinating internal functions and external advisors and managing senior counterparties such as target or client management teams. This can come from running M&A transactions (in-house corporate development or advisory) or from leading strategy projects with transaction exposure, such as due diligence, carve-outs, partnerships or market entries. Direct M&A process experience is a strong plus; the ability to learn it quickly is essential.
• Leadership and Influence: You have guided and developed more junior colleagues and influenced senior stakeholders, including through negotiation and building rapport with counterparties.
• Toolkit: Exceptional qualitative and analytical problem-solving skills. You are hypothesis-driven and can own and structure complex analytical problems from end-to-end. You structure ambiguous problems and set direction for others, not just solve them yourself. You are utilizing AI tools to meaningfully improve your productivity. Ability to build applications with AI coding tools is a plus.
• Financial Acumen: Expert-level financial modeling skills are required: you have built and defended complex models used for high-stakes investment or strategic decisions. Valuation experience is a plus. You are just as comfortable building analysis and models from scratch as you are managing processes and presenting recommendations to leadership.
• DTC economics: You are comfortable working with typical DTC KPIs like CAC, AOR, AOV, CLV, retention and understand how cohort economics build a P&L over time. DTC marketing analytics experience is a plus but not required.
• Communication: Proactive 360° communication and excellent ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear, concise storylines, presentations and memos for an executive audience.
• How you work: You take ownership of outcomes and pressure-test your own conclusions before presenting them. You go deep into the analysis to get to the right answer, and know when it is good enough to decide.

What You Will Get In Return

• 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes
• Company pension scheme
• Gym membership
• Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)
• Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme
• Nursery support scheme
• Cycle to work scheme
• Group Life Assurance

Location: The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, London

Hybrid Working Policy

We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.

Next steps: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.

To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company.

title: Head of Financial Planning
description:
Commercially focussed, Head of FP&A required (Spanish Speaking) for large Consumer Group undergoing a significant period of sustained growth.

This is an opportunity for a driven Finance leader to join a highly successful Group, working as part of, and supporting the senior leadership team.

• The Head of FP&A will take ownership for plans, forecasts and financial performance and will oversee the treasury function.
• Acting as the key finance business partner to the leadership team on every major investment, you will play a significant role in the future growth of the business.
• You will build the forecasting, reporting and business-partnering capability that lets the company grow with confidence: Ensuring a budget that leadership trusts, a rolling forecast that moves with the business, and clear answers to “what happens if”.
• This is a senior leadership role and a mandate to raise the bar on financial rigour across the company.

Reporting into the CFO and leading the FP&&A Team - Key Accountabilities include:

Planning and forecasting

• Own the annual budget process and the long-range (5 year) plan, from first assumptions to board approval
• Run a rolling monthly forecast covering P&L, cash flow and balance sheet, with clear variance analysis against budget and prior forecast
• Build and maintain the driver-based financial model, including scenario and sensitivity analysis

Reporting and insight

• Deliver the monthly management pack and board reporting: results, KPIs, drivers and the story behind the numbers
• Define and track the KPIs that matter, and make sure the business measures what it manages
• Turn analysis into recommendations: pricing, investment cases, cost reviews, capacity decisions

Business partnering

• Act as finance partner to the CEO, CFO and functional heads, challenging plans and spend constructively
• Partner with sponsors to shape investment proposals before they reach the committee
• Support fundraising, M&A, debt or investor reporting as the business needs
• Work with the Corporate Financial Controller to keep actuals, forecast and reporting on one consistent data model

Investment and business cases

• Own the end-to-end investment and business case process: templates, appraisal standards, approval thresholds and governance
• Review and challenge every case before submission, testing assumptions, returns (NPV, IRR, payback) and risks
• Assist with preparing and presenting the investment papers and the portfolio view to the Business Development Committee, with a clear recommendation on each
• Control approved investments against plan: track spend, milestones and benefits, and escalate variances
• Run post-investment reviews and feed the lessons back into future cases and the forecast

Treasury

• Oversee the Treasury Manager, and own cash management, liquidity planning and shorter term cash flow forecasts

The perfect candidate will have come from a Corporate Finance background and have a good working understanding Capital Allocation and discounted cash-flow.

Exposure to Power BI, AI or similar would be highly desirable.

Benefits include: Bonus 20-25% (excellent run rate in recent years), Hybrid working and core benefits.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Great executive support means being able to turn a brief conversation into a clear plan, anticipate what’s needed and handle sensitive matters with sound judgement.

At Person Centred Software, we’re looking for an Executive Assistant who can build a trusted partnership with our CEO, while supporting the wider C-suite. You’ll bring structure to busy schedules, keep important actions moving and help our leaders focus their time where it matters most.

We’re a growing technology business helping care professionals deliver better care through software. Working closely with our leadership team, you’ll gain exposure to business priorities, strategic projects and decisions that shape our future.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll need to be comfortable working from a short brief or limited information. The CEO won’t always have time to explain every detail, so you’ll use the context available, ask focused questions and take ownership of the next steps.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing complex diaries, protecting time for key priorities and resolving competing demands.
• Turning brief requests and conversations into clear actions, coordinating input and following through.
• Preparing reports, presentations, board papers and briefing packs, bringing together information from across the business.
• Coordinating domestic and international travel, including detailed itineraries and last-minute changes.
• Organising leadership meetings, events and offsites.
• Tracking decisions, actions and deadlines, keeping people accountable and flagging issues early.
• Supporting cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives.
• Handling confidential business and people matters with care, discretion and professionalism.

What you’ll bring

You’ll be someone the CEO can rely on to get things moving without needing detailed instructions at every stage. You’ll know when you have enough information to act, when to clarify and when a decision needs to come back to them.

Discretion is central to this role. You’ll have access to sensitive conversations and information, and we’ll trust you to exercise good judgement about what is shared, with whom and when.

You’ll also bring the confidence to build relationships across the business, chase outstanding actions and challenge respectfully when priorities or deadlines are at risk.

We’re looking for:

• Significant experience supporting a CEO or other C-suite leaders.
• Strong judgement and the ability to work independently from limited direction.
• A proven ability to handle confidential and commercially sensitive information.
• Exceptional organisation, prioritisation and attention to detail.
• Experience managing complex diaries and international travel.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn information into clear, concise briefings.
• Strong analytical skills and commercial awareness.
• Confidence using Microsoft Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel and Teams.
• A calm, flexible approach when plans change or urgent requests arise.
• The ability to work from Central London or Guildford, with flexibility to travel between both locations.

Experience in a growing or changing organisation, board-level support, project coordination or business integration would also be valuable.

Why join us?

You’ll work closely with our CEO and senior leaders, with the opportunity to make a tangible difference to how the leadership team operates.

There’s scope to take ownership, improve how things are done and become a trusted partner in a business whose software supports care professionals and the people in their care.

If you enjoy bringing clarity to complexity and take pride in being someone others can depend on, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Mid/Senior Java Backend Engineer - Insurance
description:

Our systems manage the full policy lifecycle and claims settlement processes end to end, handling millions of operations per month - including financial settlement, accounting, investment fund, and claims modules (FIN/FUN/CLAIMS).

AI on our team is an everyday engineering tool, not a marketing buzzword - we work in a Spec Driven Development paradigm: we use AI agents for technical documentation, task specification, building technical plans, and verifying and testing work.

• Practical knowledge of document databases (e.g. MongoDB) and relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, Oracle)
• Architectural thinking - SOLID, Clean Code

• Openness to AI-assisted programming in the Spec Driven Development model

Nice to Have

• Understanding of insurance product specifics, claims settlement processes, or market regulations

title: Campaign Manager, CPG (EU / UK)
description:

Remote across Europe, or hybrid from our London office | Permanent, full time

And we're not talking about the occasional influencer campaign. This is creator marketing at scale. Multiple products, new launches every few weeks and hundreds of creators producing content across different markets.

If you love discovering great creators, know what makes content perform and get excited about turning a brief into a successful campaign, we'd love to meet you.

At Kyra, we're building a different kind of creator marketing company. We combine great people, technology and AI to make creator marketing smarter, faster and more effective. You'll have access to our own platform, with over 29 million creator profiles, and tools to manage everything from casting and outreach to contracts, payments and reporting.

You'll own campaigns in your local market, work directly with the client and collaborate with a team that genuinely loves what it does.

This is a permanent, full-time role.

🚀 What You'll Be Doing

Bring Campaigns to Life

• Manage multiple creator campaigns, from the initial brief through to launch, delivery and reporting.
• Keep timelines, budgets, content approvals and deliverables moving.
• Work closely with creators, clients and our internal teams to make great campaigns happen.
• Spot potential issues early and find solutions before they become problems.

Make the Numbers Work

• Build creator pricing around CPV targets and expected performance.
• Negotiate creator fees and manage budgets with confidence.
• Balance creative ambition with commercial performance.
• Use data to make smarter decisions throughout each campaign.

Build Great Client Relationships

• Be the day-to-day contact for the client's local marketing team.
• Lead weekly calls, share campaign updates and keep everyone aligned.
• Bring ideas, recommendations and solutions to the table.
• Build trust through great communication and consistent delivery.

Find and Work With Amazing Creators

• Discover and cast creators who are the right fit for each product, audience and brief.
• Build creator shortlists at scale across different campaigns.
• Manage outreach, briefing, negotiations, contracting and content delivery.
• Oversee usage rights, disclosures and creator approvals.
• Use feedback and campaign results to make your next casting list even better.

Get Creative With Technology

• Use Kyra's platform to manage the full campaign journey.
• Monitor CPV, reach, engagement and conversion while campaigns are live.
• Use AI tools to make creator discovery, research, analysis and campaign management more efficient.
• Keep campaign information organised and up to date so the whole team has visibility.

⚡ How We Work

We move quickly, work collaboratively and care about doing great work.

With lots of campaigns running at once, staying organised and communicating clearly makes a huge difference.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

• New briefs are picked up within 24 hours, with creator discovery and outreach underway.
• Blockers are escalated within 3 hours so we can resolve them quickly.
• Campaign risks and performance concerns are raised early, ideally with a suggested solution.
• Clients and teammates receive regular updates without needing to chase.
• Campaign information is kept accurate and up to date in our platform.

We don't expect everything to go perfectly. We do expect people to take ownership, communicate openly and work together to find solutions.

🙌 Who We're Looking For

First and foremost, we want someone who really understands creator marketing.

Someone who knows the difference between a creator with a big following and one who can actually deliver results. Someone who enjoys both the creative and commercial sides of the job.

The Essentials

• 3 to 5 years of experience in influencer or creator marketing.
• Experience running high-volume creator campaigns, ideally for consumer brands.
• Native or fluent proficiency in your local market's language, plus English.
• Strong knowledge of the creator landscape in your market.
• Experience managing campaign budgets, negotiating creator fees and handling contracts.
• A solid understanding of CPV and creator performance metrics.
• Strong Excel and data skills.
• Experience working directly with clients, ideally large consumer brands.
• Confidence using AI tools such as Claude in your everyday work.
• Based in Europe or the UK, working your local market's business hours.

Even Better If You Have

• A second European language.
• Experience with influencer marketing platforms.

You'll Probably Love This Role If You...

• Spend more time than you'd like to admit discovering new creators.
• Can spot a great creator-brand fit almost immediately.

🎁 What We Offer

• Competitive salary.
• Share options.
• Remote across Europe, or hybrid from our London office.
• A fast-growing account and the progression that comes with it. Several of our senior campaign managers came up through this team.

Benefits
🌎 Remote-first, so you can work from wherever you do your best work
🌴 25 days PTO + bank holidays, 4 company-wide days off (Kyra Days), 3 wellness days and paid sick leave

📚 Annual Learning and Development budget

💰 Annual bonus scheme to recognise great work
🩺 Healthcare coverage for US-based team members

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

📩 Sound like you?

We’d love to hear from campaign managers who are ready to step up and deliver impactful creator marketing at scale.

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. As a Senior Account Executive, you will drive new business growth by owning and developing your territory. • Collaborative, low-ego approach and ability to work across teams to win priority opportunities and improve execution

What You’ll Bring With You

• 2+ years of experience as a full-cycle / 360 B2B SaaS Account Executive, with a strong track record of self-sourcing pipeline.
• Track record of consistently closing new business through self-directed sales activity
• Experience selling to mid-market and enterprise customers with complex needs
• Strong commercial judgment and ability to manage your own territory as a business
• Excellent discovery, communication, and negotiation skills
• Comfortable running technical product demos and adapting them to customer use cases
• Comfortable operating with autonomy, structure, and accountability
• Curious, resilient, and motivated by building something rather than inheriting it

Success looks like

• Consistent delivery against new business targets
• Healthy, self-generated pipeline with strong conversion
• Accurate forecasting and disciplined deal management
• Clear ownership of outcomes and continuous improvement in execution

This position description is intended merely as a guideline of the responsibilities involved in the position. The employee is expected to perform any other duties as reasonably required by their Manager.

At Planday, we offer you

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan
• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us
• Flexible remote work
• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture, and we highly value the strength that diverse backgrounds offer.

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all our candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process.

title: Warehouse Section Leader - Nights
description:

From our distribution centres to our transport operations and support functions, we connect people, technology and expertise to ensure the right products reach the right stores at the right time.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

Why Apply?

An opportunity for a hands-on Data Analyst to play a key role in supporting business decision-making through detailed analysis, reporting and insight.

You'll dig into the detail, identify trends and anomalies, and turn complex data into clear, meaningful outputs that help the business better understand its performance and make informed decisions.

You'll also support the ongoing development of the data function, working alongside the Data Lead as they build a new data platform using Microsoft Fabric.

title: Laboratory Technician
description:
Location: Plymouth, UK (On-site – Candidates must be located in or close to Plymouth)

Position Type: Full-time

About Pulsiv

Pulsiv is disrupting the global power electronics industry. Our patented power conversion technology fundamentally changes how energy is converted—eliminating waste, boosting efficiency, and shrinking system footprints.

We are preparing for a massive phase of growth. With our flagship USB-C fast-charging platform launching in 2027, we will rapidly scale that technology across multiple power levels and variants. From there, we are expanding into high-power, high-growth markets including TVs/displays, LED lighting drivers, industrial power supplies, and hyper-scale data centers, among others. If you want to work on hardware that directly impacts global energy consumption across next-generation tech, this is where it happens.

The Role & Your Future at Pulsiv

We are looking for an ambitious, hands-on Laboratory Technician based in or within easy commuting distance of our engineering hub in Plymouth. This isn’t a passive bench job—you will be right at the heart of our R&D engine, building, tweaking, and stress-testing the prototype hardware that powers our technology roadmaps.

Because we operate as a lean, agile engineering team, this role requires a true "all-hands-on-deck" attitude. You will take full ownership of the laboratory space, handling everything from high-precision electronic assembly down to general lab upkeep, waste management, and day-to-day facilities tasks.

Where can this take you?

Pulsiv is scaling quickly, and we believe in growing our talent from within. As you master our lab systems and gain deep exposure to cutting-edge AC-to-DC conversion, this role offers a clear pathway to transition into Applications Engineering, Test & Validation, or Design Engineering. You won't just keep the lab running; you will build the technical foundation to launch a high-impact career in power electronics.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Build & Modify Next-Gen Hardware: Hands-on prototyping, fine-pitch SMD/TH soldering, complex PCB rework, and custom cable assembly for cutting-edge power electronics modules.
• Drive Bench Testing & Validation: Set up thermal, efficiency, and environmental stress tests under engineering guidance, logging critical data for upcoming USB-C platforms, display power supplies, lighting drivers, and data center reference designs.
• Rapid Prototyping & 3D Printing: Own the lab’s 3D printers to fabricate custom test jigs, thermal fixtures, and mechanical prototype enclosures.
• Lab Ownership & General Housekeeping: Maintain a clean, safe, and professional laboratory environment. This includes routine facility support tasks such as emptying bins, managing recycling/waste clearance, organizing benches, and keeping walkways clear and hazard-free.
• Stock & Inventory Management: Oversee component stock levels, unpack shipments, track lab consumables, organize hand tools, and coordinate component re-ordering.
• Support Engineering Sprint Execution: Assist senior engineers with teardowns, equipment calibration tracking, schematics checks, and test automation setup.

What We’re Looking For:

Essential:

• Location: Based in or located close to Plymouth, UK (this is a fully on-site laboratory role).
• Degree Qualified: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
• Bench & Soldering Craft: Solid hands-on assembly experience, fine-pitch SMD rework, wire harness fabrication, and mechanical assembly skills.
• Test Tool Mastery: Familiarity with standard electronics lab equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, power analyzers, DC electronic loads).
• Schematic Literacy: Ability to confidently read electronic schematics, assembly diagrams, and technical datasheets.
• Software Competency: Comfortable using Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Teams) for logging data, tracking stock, and daily collaboration.
• Attitude: Flexible, proactive, and willing to get stuck into any task—big or small—to keep the engineering environment running smoothly.

Desirable (Bonus Points):

• Experience or familiarity with Altium Designer (schematic capture, PCB layout viewing, component placement).
• Hands-on exposure to thermal imaging cameras and 3D CAD/slicing software (Cura, PrusaSlicer, SolidWorks).
• Familiarity with high-voltage laboratory safety practices and ESD control environments.

Description & Requirements

People Management

• Adaptability/Agility: Tolerates uncertainty and ambiguity and can change priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Decision Making: Uses logic and reasoning to evaluate alternatives and make effective, timely decisions

Availability

Other Willingness Requirements

• Willing to work as part of a team and also complete work independently
• Willing to move through a store for most of a shift to help guests and accomplish work
• Willing to move boxes weighing up to 30 lbs (13.6 kg)
• Willing to work in an environment with bright lights and loud music

Experience

Job Assets (i.e., nice to have; not required)

In your email, please include the position title, the location of the position and the nature of your question or request.

Beyond The Paycheck (Benefits & Perks)

At lululemon, we care for and invest in the whole person – body, mind, spirit. Our total rewards program is designed to support you in achieving your goals and focus on the things you love. How to apply

If you wish to have a confidential conversation about the role, please contact Executive Support Manager, Shila Panchani (shila.panchani@brent.gov.uk)

Interested in applying? Click "Apply Now" to begin your application.

You will need to submit a supporting statement demonstrating how you meet the essential criteria in the job description. This is a key part of the selection process, and applications without a supporting statement may not be considered. You may also upload a CV to support your application, but it cannot replace the supporting statement.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive a high volume of applications. If you are interested, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Applications from candidates who have applied for this role in the last 6 months will not be considered.

Brent Council values the diversity of its community and aims to have a workforce that reflects the people we serve. We welcome all applications from all sections of the community and encourage applicants to complete the diversity survey section of the application.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with dignity, respect and fairness. We expect all employees to demonstrate a commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and to promote inclusive, non-discriminatory practices in their work. This commitment forms part of our recruitment process, and candidates may be assessed on their understanding of and ability to contribute to an inclusive working environment.

The information we collect from you will be shared with Cifas, who will use it to help prevent fraud and other unlawful or dishonest conduct, malpractice, and other seriously improper conduct. Further details on how your information will be used by Brent and Cifas, and your data protection rights can be found here.

As a Disability Confident employer, we guarantee an interview to disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role. This includes people with hidden disabilities, long term health conditions, diagnosis, and mental health conditions. We also guarantee an interview to care-experienced applicants who meet the essential criteria. Information shared for this purpose will be treated fairly and used only to confirm eligibility under these schemes.

If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact recruitment@brent.gov.uk

Brent has a positive approach to flexible working.

title: Specialist Biomedical Scientist - Clinical Biochemistry INTERNAL
description:
Job Overview

PLEASE NOTE THAT WE WILL ONLY ACCEPT APPLICATIONS FROM STAFF CURRENTLY EMPLOYED BY BETSI CADWALADR UNIVERSITY HEALTH BOARD

Please note appointment will be made at Band 6 Annex 21 or Band 6 dependant on qualifications and experience.

As a Biomedical Scientist, the post holder will be required to work within professional standards expected as a registrant of the Health Professions Council (HCPC) and maintain a portfolio of evidence supporting Continuing Professional development (CPD). Duties as a BMS will include performing a range of scientific procedures involving the processing of specimens to contribute to the diagnosis, treatment and monitoring of diseases and investigation of pathological processes.

The post holder will be required to conform to agreed standard operational procedures, policies and good laboratory practice and also within their work duties, comply with the standards as required of UKAS and other relevant professional and Legislative Bodies (e.g. HTA, BSQR).

To demonstrate commitment and dedication to our staff we have a flexible recruitment and progression plan that consists of:

Band 6 candidates:

• Band 6 Annex 21 for candidates with HCPC registration and evidence of core competencies with automatic progression on completion of out of hours (24/7 working) competencies’ and successful completion of IBMS Specialist Portfolio.

Main duties of the job

The post holder will be required to work on a rotational basis through the different sections of the department, and may be required to work on any site within the Betsi Cadwaladr University Local Health Board (BCULHB) area to enable continuity of service.

On completion of the necessary competence requirements, Band 6 post holders will be required to cover 24/7 out of hours service working as a registered scientist to deliver safe and effective specialist emergency and core testing services requiring the post holder to :

• Support and advise laboratory support worker colleagues.
• Prioritise investigations in accordance to clinical need, ensuring optimum turnaround for urgent requests.
• Manage emergency requests, single or multiple.
• Liaise with IT and specialist equipment suppliers to resolve system or equipment failures.
• To respond to Major incident procedures should the need arise.

The ability to speak Welsh is desirable for this post; Welsh and/or English speakers are equally welcome to apply.

Working for our organisation

If you relish a challenge, have a passion to help others or simply fancy a fresh start, then Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board (BCUHB) North Wales, has all the right ingredients. The largest health organisation in Wales, providing a full range of primary, community, mental health, acute and elective hospital services for a population of around 700,000, across North Wales . Join our team and get the support you need, in line with our Organisational Values and ‘Proud to Lead’ competence framework.

Enjoy being part of working with engaged leadership at all levels, and be assured we are committed to promoting equality and diversity, and are proud to welcome applicants under the “Disability Confident Employer” scheme.

Please check your email account regularly. Successful applicants will receive all recruitment related correspondence via the email account registered on the application form.

Applications may be submitted in Welsh. Applications submitted in Welsh will not be treated less favourably than an application submitted in English.

Detailed Job Description And Main Responsibilities

You will be able to find a full Job description and Person Specification attached within the supporting documents or please click “Apply now” to view in Trac.

Person specification

Qualifications

Essential criteria

• IBMS accredited Biomedical Sciences Degree or other qualification acceptable for future HCPC registration.
• State registered with HCPC as a Biomedical Scientist
• Specialist Portfolio BMS relevant to the service/s being covered – or equivalent

Desirable criteria

• Able to provide evidence of ongoing personal development

Experience

Essential criteria

• Experience of automated and manual laboratory investigations and procedures (sufficient post registration training).

Desirable criteria

• General familiarity with common computer software (Microsoft Office)
• Experience of working alone in out of hours service
• Experience of leading a team

Skills

Essential criteria

• Ability to supervise others
• Ability to pick up techniques quickly following a training program.
• Computer literate
• Good verbal and written communication skills
• Good interpersonal skills
• Good organisational skills

Desirable criteria

• Welsh speaking

Personal Qualities

Essential Criteria

• Ability to work without supervision and as part of a team
• Ability to work under pressure and Ability to assess & prioritise work in a pressured environment
• Ability to make specialist scientific decisions when working alone / as lone scientist in response to clinical situation and using specialist scientific knowledge & experience

Knowledge

Essential Criteria

• Specialist knowledge across the range of work procedures as evidenced by attaining IBMS specialist portfolio
• Knowledge of quality control and assurance
• Knowledge of managing emergency requests

Desirable criteria

• Knowledge of Clinical Laboratory Accreditation requirements
• Knowledge of Laboratory Information management systems

group: hoare lea|2027 building services design engineer - degree apprentice - oxford
title: 2027 Building Services Design Engineer - Degree Apprentice - Oxford
description:
2027 Building Services Design Engineer – Degree Apprentice

Oxford

About Us

Hoare Lea is a human-centric and planet-conscious engineering consultancy. We offer intelligent and sustainable solutions to complex design challenges for the built environment throughout the UK and further afield.

We provide a wide range of engineering and consultancy services, including acoustics, air quality, building services (MEP), fire, lighting, security and sustainability to name but a few. Together, our highly skilled teams use technical expertise and problem-solving skills to bring buildings to life. We ensure that whatever the building, its design is outstanding, and its operations meet the needs of the communities it serves.

Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.

Why Join Us?

• You’ll collaborate with the industry’s best, working with a wide range of built-environment specialists.
• You’ll be part of progressive and exciting projects from day one, able to experience innovative schemes across all sectors.
• You’ll advance your career, your way, thanks to our structured Career Paths framework.
• You’ll be encouraged through our accredited training and development scheme with a dedicated mentor and supervisor, supporting you to Chartership, if you wish.

Joining us is the chance to play your part in the future of engineering design. Our projects span scales, styles, and geographies. We’re committed to sustainable design, innovation, and collaboration with forward-thinking clients. Straight away you’ll experience working on live projects.

The Role

Being part of one of the UK’s largest building engineering consultancies, we benefit from collaborating with some of the best engineers in the business, with access to state-of-the-art technical support, and have the opportunity to work on some of the largest and most high-profile projects as part of a multi-disciplinary team.

Bispebjerg Hospital in Denmark, Canolfan Pentre Awel in Carmarthen, Multi-Megawatt Data Centre Campus , Oxford North in Oxford, One Piccadilly Gardens in Manchester, Gwynfaen in Swansea, and the nature-based net-zero neighbourhood of Earls Court in London, are examples of some of the amazing projects where we have led the design with other Hoare Lea disciplines.

As an Apprentice, your day-to-day tasks will vary, as we’ll expose you to all aspects of our work so you can discover what suits you. You could be;

• Working on live projects from day one – our exciting projects
• In a variety of sectors from healthcare to hotels, retail to residential
• Producing detailed designs and drawings
• Using the latest computer modelling software
• Undertaking site surveys
• Researching ground-breaking technologies
• Having regular meetings with project teams, clients or end users
• Preparing engineering system designs on computers
• Writing specifications
• Monitoring progress on construction sites.

There could be opportunities to specialise in electrical, mechanical or digital engineering design.

Communicating will span all of these, as we regularly liaise with project teams, meet clients or end users, and attend collaborative meetings.

Training

Apprenticeship - Building services engineer / Skills England

Provider – Building Services Design Engineering Apprenticeship BEng (Hons) | London South Bank University

You will develop and enhance your technical and management skills in a variety of applications and job roles, including design and project management. Additional learning support is provided in-house, and you will receive mentoring and supervision throughout your Apprenticeship.

You will receive one day study leave during term times to attend university to work towards your BSc or BEng Building Services Engineering degree providing a route to gain Incorporated Engineer (IEng) status.

The typical duration for this apprenticeship is 60 months, but this will depend on the previous experience of the apprentice and opportunities to gain the full range of competence.

About You

To be successful in this role, you’ll need…

• To meet the University’s entry requirements either;

• Three A levels at BBC including Mathematics and preferably a Science in either Chemistry or Physics; or
• T-Level at Merit or above in Construction: Design, Surveying and Planning, or similar; or
• BTEC Level 3 Extended Diploma DDM in an Engineering subject or above, with a minimum of Merit in Mathematics and Further Mathematics; or
• BTEC Level 3 National Diploma D*D* in an Engineering subject or above, with a minimum of Merit in Mathematics and Further Mathematics; or
• Level 3 or Level 4 Building Services Design Technician Apprenticeship; or
• A career on the tools e.g. an Electrician or a Mechanic, who wants to move into an office setting.

• Genuine interest in developing a career within the sector
• Excellent communication, analytical and organisational skills
• Ability to work in a team environment and independently
• A friendly, ambitious and confident individual with a flexible and resilient approach

Our Benefits

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer both core and flexible benefits, a competitive salary and industry leading training and development to support you throughout your career. We are as committed to providing an environment where everyone can realise their unique potential. So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality.

You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes. We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.

How To Apply

To apply simply complete a CV profile, answer a couple questions, and submit your application. For hints and tips in applying click here .

Please only apply for one location for your discipline, if you are flexible with location, great! – you will have the chance to select your other location preferences, and this will be confirmed again with you at telephone interview. If you apply for multiple locations, you will only be considered for the location you have applied for.

Please note: We do not offer visa sponsorship for this apprenticeship role. Only candidates already authorised to work in the UK – e.g. British/Irish citizens, EU Settled/Pre-Settled, ILR holders – will be considered.

Recruitment Process

Our Projects Are Human-centric, And So Is Our Recruitment Process. Once You’ve Applied, You’ll Speak To a Person Every Step Of The Way. Here’s Our Planned Timeline

• Applications close – 6 th November 2026
• Telephone Interviews – November/December 2026
• Selection Event – January/February 2027
• Start Date – September 2027

Adjustments and accommodations

If there are adjustments or accommodations that we can put in place to ensure you can participate and give your best at any stage of the recruitment process (whether relating to disability, neurodivergence, or anything else) please let us know.

Flexible working

We are committed to enabling a healthy work-life balance for all employees. So, we welcome applications from candidates seeking flexible working arrangements to suit their particular needs and lifestyle, including part-time, term-time-only, and remote working.

Data privacy

We have updated our terms and conditions for candidates, click here to find out more.
