• Keep our project management tool (monday.com) up to date, so everyone always knows where things stand.
• Provide general support to the wider team as priorities shift.

What you'll bring

• 1+ years of experience in marketing, brand, communications agency or in-house role. Recent graduates with a relevant placement or internship are also welcome to apply.
• Exceptional communication and coordination skills, with real attention to detail and a clear, concise writing style.
• Ambition and high energy, with a genuine enthusiasm to learn.
• Curiosity and drive to master a skill and make it your own.
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities at once.
• Experience with project management tools such as monday.com is a bonus, not a requirement.
• A proactive approach, with a commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion in the workplace.

What we offer

• Dedicated support and mentoring from our Managers and Directors, with a clear path to progress into an Account Manager role.

• A culture that values collaboration, creativity and the wellbeing of our people.

• Competitive pension contribution.

We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established and highly regarded high street law firm close to Romford, Essex, seeking an experienced Residential Conveyancing Solicitor to take on the position of Head of Conveyancing.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a solicitor with approximately 5 years' PQE or more who is looking to progress their career, take on additional responsibility and play an influential role within an established conveyancing department.

The successful candidate will join a friendly and supportive firm with an established residential property team, including fee earners, a paralegal and dedicated administrative support.

This position offers an excellent balance of hands-on conveyancing work, team leadership and departmental development, providing the opportunity to make a genuine impact on the firm's continued success.

The Role

As Head of Residential Conveyancing, you will take responsibility for the effective day-to-day management of the department, ensuring high standards of service, compliance and productivity.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing and overseeing the daily operations of the residential conveyancing department.
• Supervising, mentoring and supporting fee earners and administrative colleagues.
• Providing technical guidance on residential property transactions, including complex matters.
• Overseeing a range of freehold and leasehold sales and purchases.

• Ensuring compliance with SRA requirements, AML regulations and relevant conveyancing procedures.
• Supporting file reviews, risk management and quality control.
• Managing a personal caseload where appropriate, alongside departmental responsibilities.
• Developing relationships with estate agents, mortgage brokers and other professional contacts.
• Working closely with the firm's Directors to identify opportunities for business development, improved efficiency and departmental growth.

About You

We are looking for a commercially aware and motivated Residential Conveyancing Solicitor who is ready to take the next step in their career.

The ideal candidate will have:

• Approximately 5 years' PQE or more in residential conveyancing.
• Extensive experience handling freehold and leasehold sales and purchases.
• Strong technical knowledge of residential property law and conveyancing procedures.
• A good understanding of SRA regulations, AML requirements and risk management.
• Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Strong communication, interpersonal and client relationship skills.
• The confidence to provide support, guidance and supervision to other team members.
• A proactive, solutions-focused approach and a commitment to delivering excellent client service.
• An interest in business development and contributing to the long-term success of the department.

Management experience would be advantageous but is not a requirement. Applications are welcomed from senior residential conveyancing solicitors who have experience mentoring junior colleagues, supervising files or taking on additional responsibilities and are now ready to progress.

What's on Offer?

Our client offers a supportive working environment and the chance to develop your career within an established and respected law firm.

Benefits include:

• Competitive salary of £55,000 – £60,000, depending on experience.
• 25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays.
• An additional 3–4 days' leave during the Christmas closure.
• Company pension scheme.
• A well-established team with dedicated administrative support.
• Opportunities for continued professional development and career progression.
• A friendly, collaborative and supportive working environment.
• The opportunity to lead and develop an established conveyancing department.
• A genuine opportunity to influence departmental performance and future growth.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This position would particularly suit an experienced Residential Conveyancing Solicitor who enjoys the technical aspects of conveyancing but is looking for a role offering greater variety, responsibility and long-term career prospects.

Rather than requiring an established Head of Department, our client is looking for someone with the right experience, attitude and ambition to grow into the position.

You will have the opportunity to lead an existing team, contribute to business decisions and help shape the future of the residential property department.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Residential Conveyancing Solicitor based in or around Romford and are considering the next step in your career, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Whether you are already managing a team or are looking to move into your first departmental leadership position, this could be an excellent opportunity.

Apply today with your CV or get in touch for a confidential discussion about the role.

title: Home Dialysis Specialist Nurse
description:
Job Overview

This is an exciting opportunity to join the Home Dialysis Team at Glan Clwyd Hospital. The team provides specialist care and support for patients receiving home haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis across the region. You will become part of a highly motivated and supportive nursing team, working closely with a multidisciplinary renal team to deliver high-quality, patient-centred care. The role involves the training, education and ongoing supervision of patients undertaking home haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, both within the Renal Unit and in their own homes. As a Home Therapies Specialist Nurse, you will manage a caseload of home dialysis patients, providing specialist assessment, clinical monitoring and support. Patients are reviewed regularly within their home environment and through joint consultant nephrologist and nurse-led clinics, ensuring safe and effective treatment delivery. Key responsibilities include:

• Assessing and monitoring patients' fluid status and overall clinical condition.
• Evaluating dialysis adequacy and treatment effectiveness.
• Monitoring dialysis access, dialysis techniques and adherence to treatment plans.
• Supporting patients' physical, emotional and psychological wellbeing while adapting to dialysis at home.
• Overseeing dialysis equipment and treatment
• Monitoring blood results and haemodialysis water quality.

title: Supply Chain Risk Management Specialist
description:
Description

Leidos is seeking a Supply Chain Risk Management Analyst to provide technical and analytical support to the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Counterintelligence (CI) Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) program. The program is responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating foreign intelligence, nation-state, and cybersecurity threats to the FAA's supply chain, critical infrastructure, and enterprise networks. Embedded within a 3-person team, this position focuses on enterprise risk assessments and procurement execution support. Providing risk analysis aligned with the FAA Acquisition Management System (AMS) framework, the analyst evaluates the actual security posture of software suppliers, cloud providers, Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools, telecommunications, and Operational Technology / Industrial Control Systems (OT/ICS) environments. This role translates threat data into technical risk scoring, conducts criticality analysis, and drafts custom contract security language to protect and mitigate threats against FAA supply chain.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Conduct enterprise-level vendor risk assessments and technical security reviews for software suppliers, cloud providers (SaaS/PaaS/IaaS), AI tools, telecommunications, and OT/ICS (Operational Technology/Industrial Control Systems).
• Conduct technical and non-technical risk scoring to compile comprehensive Vendor Risk Reports that map systemic vulnerabilities.
• Provide specialized SCRM subject matter expertise throughout the procurement lifecycle, including early-stage acquisition planning and source selections.
• Author Acquisition Security Reviews and evaluation matrices that integrate directly into the FAA Acquisition Management System (AMS) pipeline.
• Draft specific contract security language, technical security requirements, and risk acceptance recommendations to mitigate identified supply chain risks prior to contract award.
• Translate highly technical and complex risk assessment data into clear, Executive Decision Packages for a non-technical audience to enable FAA senior leadership to make rapid, fully informed decisions.
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of FAA SCRM policies, governance documentation, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
• Formulate performance metrics and program reports for executive leadership.
• Maintain critical operational and collaborative relationships with external stakeholders, including the FAA Chief Information Officer (CIO), Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and the broader Intelligence Community (IC).
• Coordinate and facilitate SCRM training and awareness campaigns for acquisition personnel and program offices.

Basic Qualifications:

Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship required

Clearance: Active Top Secret/SCI clearance is required

Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Risk Management, Intelligence Studies, National Security, Logistics, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science/Engineering, or a related discipline. (Equivalent professional experience or specialized training may be substituted).

Experience: 8+ years of professional experience as an Intelligence Analyst (All-Source, Cyber, Counterintelligence, or OSINT) or professional experience in third-party risk management (TPRM), Cyber Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM), technical risk assessments, cybersecurity risk management, or infrastructure defense.

Framework Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and risk management frameworks, specifically NIST SP 800-161 (Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices) and NIST SP 800-53.

Technical Skills: Hands-on experience evaluating the security posture, software supply chains, and configurations of at least three of the following technology profiles:

• Cloud infrastructure and service providers (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS)
• Commercial software packages and open-source dependencies
• Artificial Intelligence (AI) platforms or Machine Learning tools
• Telecommunications hardware or infrastructure frameworks
• Operational Technology (OT) or Industrial Control Systems (ICS)
• Communication Skills: Proven capability to translate complex technical vulnerabilities, software flaws, and architectural risks into clear, well-structured, non-technical written reports and executive summaries.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Completion of formal military or federal intelligence training courses focusing on threat network analysis or open-source collection.
• Possession of one or more of the following industry-recognized certifications:

• Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
• Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)
• Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
• Specialized federal SCRM or Counterintelligence training certifications (e.g., CDSE, ODNI, or defense-sponsored SCRM courses).
• Proficiency with advanced OSINT search techniques, corporate filing retrieval systems, or international trade/shipping databases.
• Demonstrated experience reviewing federal procurement mechanisms, source selection processes, or drafting contract security language.

Remote Interview / Identification Notice

**** Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you.

title: Core Enterprise Account Executive TOLA
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Core AE, you will be helping our largest and most strategic enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US in the following states: Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, and Arkansas.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
• Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
• You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

• Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
• Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
• Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
• Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $100k+ ARR transactions
• Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships
• Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting
• Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast paced environment
• Willing and comfortable traveling to meet customers on a monthly basis

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)
• Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
• Passion for the world of operations!

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary

$222,400—$278,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

We’re moving fast, reinventing playbooks, and actively embracing the new era of AI and modern organizational dynamics. We operate with a creative, problem-solving mindset that prioritizes common-sense solutions and business-focused metrics. If you thrive on building trusted leader relationships, tackling complex talent challenges, and driving measurable impact, this is the team for you.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US or Canada.

You should apply if:

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

• Collaborate Across the People Function: Partner seamlessly with Regional People Partners, Program Managers, and COEs to build, scale, and seamlessly deliver strategic people solutions.
• Champion Samsara's Culture: Role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
• Connect in Person: Travel roughly once per quarter for leadership offsites, business strategy meetings, and key team gatherings.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 6+ years of People Partnering.
• Experience partnering with go-to-market teams (sales, CS or similar), or broader People experience (programs, talent, etc.) alongside business partnering.
• Learning oriented with demonstrated experience leveraging AI to automate routine tasks.
• Ability to work well in a fast-paced, iterative environment, open to changes in focus and direction.
• Excellent analytical capability, attention to detail, and problem-solving acumen.
• Experience using data to identify insights and influence leadership decision-making.
• Effective communication, consulting, coaching and facilitation skills.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$163,200—$192,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

The Acquisition Account Executive, DSO role is a quota-carrying, outbound-focused sales hunter responsible for generating net-new Dentrix Ascend revenue within the Dental Support Organization (DSO) and emerging group practice market. This role owns the full new-logo sales cycle - from self-sourced prospecting through executive-level negotiation and close - and is measured primarily on net-new logos acquired and net-new ARR booked, not on managed-account growth or renewals.
This is a hunter role. The Acquisition AE is an expert at competitive displacement, proactively identifying DSOs and emerging dental groups running on legacy or competitor practice management platforms and building the business case for migration to Dentrix Ascend. Success requires comfort navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees (CEO, COO, CFO, CCO, IT/Operations leadership) at the DSO support-organization level, as well as sustained discipline through long, multi-stage sales cycles (typically 6-12+ months) involving competitive RFPs, security and IT review, and multi-location implementation planning.

This position is Remote within the United States with up to 35% travel as needed

This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. To be considered, candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for Henry Schein One without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

What you will do:

• Maintain a self-sourced outbound pipeline generation target, consistently building new-logo opportunities through cold outreach, conference and event prospecting, referral partner development, and account-based targeting
• Build and maintain a prioritized target account list of DSOs and emerging dental groups (8+ locations) not currently on Henry Schein One platforms, ranked by location count, growth trajectory, funding/PE backing, and competitive displacement opportunity
• Partner with Marketing and the Acquisition/Growth team to develop and execute account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns targeting net-new DSO prospects
• Expertly lead, teach, and take control of complex DSO sales cycles incorporating the Henry Schein One portfolio, practice technology, change management, and growth/acquisition strategy consulting
• Lead competitive displacement strategy, including conducting win/loss analysis and incorporating market and competitor intelligence into sales messaging and positioning
• Create detailed, account-specific business plans and mutual close plans to facilitate attainment of net-new logo and net-new ARR targets
• Deliver value-based insights through discovery and demos tailored to multi-stakeholder DSO buying committees, connecting practice/organization needs to Henry Schein One solutions
• Negotiate multifaceted, enterprise-level customer agreements, including pricing, implementation scope, and multi-location rollout terms
• Maintain accurate, current leads and opportunities in Salesforce, including sales stage, next steps, and close-date discipline appropriate for long enterprise sales cycles
• Forecast monthly and quarterly net-new bookings to leadership with a high degree of accuracy
• Develop and maintain a working relationship with Henry Schein Dental field sales representatives as a key lead-source and early-signal channel for in-market DSO prospects
• Partner with Sales Engineering, Implementation, and Customer Success to ensure a smooth handoff from close to onboarding for newly acquired DSO accounts
• In addition to the responsibilities listed above, this role is responsible for meeting company standards pertaining to quantity and quality of work performed on an ongoing basis, performing all work-related tasks in compliance with Company policies and procedures including Worldwide Business Standards, and adhering to Company policies, procedures, and directives regarding standards of workplace behavior

What we are looking for:

• 5 plus years of proven experience in a net-new, hunter-focused B2B SaaS or enterprise technology sales role, with a demonstrated track record of net-new logo acquisition in complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles (6+ months)
• High School Diploma or GED
• Demonstrated track record of net-new logo acquisition and quota over-achievement in a dedicated hunter/new-business role (not primarily account management or renewals)
• Expert-level consultative and value-based selling skills suited to complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise software sales and change management
• Strong knowledge of competitive displacement selling - identifying, messaging against, and winning deals from incumbent practice management or DSO software vendors
• High proficiency in relationship management and strategic partnership development at the executive level (C-suite and VP-level DSO stakeholders)
• Proficiency with Salesforce CRM required; strong working knowledge of MS Office
• Excellent communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility quickly with senior healthcare operators
• Versed and practiced negotiation skills suited to enterprise, multi-location contract structures
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the discipline to manage a long-cycle (6-12+ month), multi-threaded enterprise pipeline
• Sharp business acumen with the ability to execute business-level and financial conversations with DSO executive leadership
• Self-motivated, resilient, and energized by proactive, outbound new-business development

What will set you apart:

• Bachelor Degree in business administration, sales, marketing, or a related field
• Experience selling into Dental Support Organizations, multi-site healthcare groups, or private equity-backed group practices strongly preferred
• Dental market expertise
• Enterprise new-business sales experience

Travel / Physical Demands

• Typically less than 35%. No special physical demands required
• This position will be working in an office or remote environment, utilizing typical office equipment, with travel required for client meetings, industry conferences, and prospect site visits as needed

The posted base salary for this position is $90,000 with an OTE (On Target Earnings) of $180,000 at 100% of quota. Total compensation will vary based on individual performance against quota. This is the expected range for an employee who is new to the role, to fully proficient in the role. Nice, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Denn bei uns verfolgen wir GENAU ein Ziel:

Wir wollen eine neue Ära einläuten und alteingesessene Industriebetriebe in die digitale Welt begleiten - dafür geben wir jeden Tag 110%.

Falls du ebenfalls auf High-Performance stehst und so schnell wachsen willst, dass nicht mal deine engsten Freunde dich wiedererkennen, dann hast du in unserem A-Player Team deine neue Peergroup gefunden. Solange du Ergebnisse lieferst, hast du volle Freiheit und Vertrauen deinen Alltag so zu gestalten, wie es dir passt.

Aber lass mal Klartext sprechen. Wen suchen wir und welche Aufgaben erwarten dich?

Aufgaben

• Kundenbetreuung auf hohem Niveau: Du führst neue Kunden durch das Onboarding, begleitest sie durch die Zusammenarbeit und bist ihr direkter Ansprechpartner für alle Fragen

• Klare Kommunikation und Struktur: Du sorgst für messbare Fortschritte und hältst alle Beteiligten auf dem neuesten Stand

Qualifikation

• Sicheres Auftreten in Gesprächen mit Geschäftsführern - idealerweise bringst du Agentur- oder Vertriebserfahrung mit

• Stark in Kommunikation: Du kannst erklären, begeistern, aber auch klar Position beziehen wenn nötig

• Verkaufsaffinität: Du erkennst Chancen für Upsells und Verlängerungen und gehst diese proaktiv an

• Strukturierter Arbeitsstil, Eigenverantwortung und ein klarer Anspruch an Qualität

• Fokus auf Lösungen und Ergebnisse: Du denkst mit, erkennst Potenziale und findest auch in kritischen Phasen einen guten Weg

• Drive und der Wunsch, dich und deine Kunden langfristig weiterzuentwickeln

• Wir legen keinen Wert auf bestimmte Ausbildungswege - wichtiger ist uns, dass du bereits erste Erfahrungen in der Kundenbetreuung oder im Vertrieb gesammelt hast

Benefits

• Attraktives Fixgehalt von 3.000 bis 3.500 € plus attraktive Provisionen für erfolgreiche Upsells und Verlängerungen

• Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, 100 % remote zu arbeiten

• 30 Urlaubstage sowie weitere Vorteile wie Prämien, Firmenfeiern, Schulungen und Weiterbildungen

• Strukturiertes Onboarding und Schulung in Kommunikation, Kundenführung und Performance-Analyse

• Moderne Tools und schlanke Prozesse - damit du dich voll auf die Kunden konzentrieren kannst

• Ein dynamisches Team mit schnellen Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in Richtung Projektleitung oder Teamverantwortung

• Ein Produkt, das im Markt einzigartig ist und die Kunden aktuell wirklich brauchen

Passt du zu uns als Kundenberater?

Wenn du ein bisschen nervös bist und du beim Lesen dieser Seite ein Kribbeln in der Bauchregion fühlst, weil du ein echter High-Performer bist, dann ist diese Stelle genau richtig für dich. Wachstum beginnt außerhalb der Komfortzone.

Wie geht es weiter?

Bewirb dich einfach über das kurze Bewerbungsformular hier auf der Seite. Lass uns dann 10 Minuten telefonieren um direkt herauszufinden, ob du ins Team passt und die Möglichkeit die genau richtige für dich ist.

description:
Als Versicherungsmakler der Deutschen Telekom ist die DeTeAssekuranz seit über drei Jahrzehnten erster Ansprechpartner für individuelle und verlässliche Versicherungslösungen. Wir begleiten unsere Kunden mit fachlicher Expertise und bedarfsgerechter Beratung – im gesamten Konzern und für unsere Firmenkunden und deren vielfältige Versicherungsanforderungen.

Bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt. Wir beraten nicht irgendwen – wir unterstützen die Menschen, die unseren Konzern täglich bewegen: unsere eigenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Sie bilden deinen beständigen und vertrauensvollen Kundenstamm, den du mit deiner Expertise aktiv begleitest.

Und über unser Family-& Friends-Programm hilfst du auch den Menschen weiter, die unseren Kolleg*innen besonders wichtig sind.

Kurz gesagt: Deine Beratung trägt dazu bei, Sicherheit zu schaffen – und ist damit ein wertvoller Teil unseres gemeinsamen Erfolges.

Was du bei uns machst:

• Du nimmst eingehende Anfragen (Inbound) entgegen und bist die erste verlässliche Unterstützung, wenn unsere Kolleg*innen Versicherungsfragen haben.
• Du berätst kompetent, verständlich und mit echter Freude daran, Menschen weiterzuhelfen.
• Du begleitest Kolleg*innen und deren Angehörige bei der Wahl der passenden Lösungen – vertriebsstark, aber immer partnerschaftlich.
• Du baust langfristige Beziehungen auf – viele Kolleg*innen kommen immer wieder auf uns zu.
• Du trägst aktiv dazu bei, Sicherheit, Orientierung und Klarheit zu schaffen: ein echter Wertbeitrag im Konzern.
• Du dokumentierst professionell, arbeitest strukturiert und bringst dich mit Ideen aktiv in unser Team ein.

Was du mitbringst:

• Eine Ausbildung im Versicherungswesen (z.B. Kaufmann/-frau für Versicherungen und Finanzen) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
• Idealerweise Erfahrung im telefonischen und digitalen Beratungsumfeld.
• Freude am Vertrieb – im besten Sinne: kundenzentriert, lösungsorientiert, empathisch.
• Lust auf ein Umfeld, in dem Beratung und Service echte Bedeutung haben.
• Offenheit, Neues zu lernen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Warum du diesen Job lieben wirst:

• Du machst den Unterschied: Deine vertriebliche Beratung stärk die Sicherheit, Zufriedenheit und das Vertrauen unserer Kolleg*innen.
• Beständiger Kundenstamm: Du betreust Menschen, die dich wertschätzen.
• Teamkultur, die trägt: Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, lachen miteinander und wachsen zusammen.
• Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und digitale Tools.
• Entwicklung garantiert: Wir fördern dich fachlich und persönlich.

title: Technológiai Gépkezelő
description:
A TAPI-nál nemcsak egy vállalat vagyunk, hanem egy közösség is, amely elkötelezett az egészség fejlesztése iránt. A világ vezető gyógyszerhatóanyag-gyártójaként a világ 50 legnagyobb gyógyszeripari vállalatának 80%-át a partnereink között tudhatjuk. Több mint 80 éves múlttal, több mint 350 termékből álló portfólióval és egyedi CDMO szolgáltatásokkal javítjuk az emberek egészségét világszerte.

Erősségünk egy több mint 4 200 szakemberből álló csapatban, a munkavállalóinkban rejlik, akik 13 gyártóhelyen tevékenykednek Olaszországban, Magyarországon, Csehországban, Horvátországban, Izraelben, Mexikóban és Indiában. Együtt dolgozunk újításokon, oldunk meg problémákat és törekszünk a kiválóságra. Csatlakozz hozzánk, és légy részese egy életeket megváltoztató küldetésnek.

Érdekelnek a modern gyártóberendezések, automatizált rendszerek és technológiai folyamatok? Debreceni gyógyszeripari gyártóegységünkbe keresünk új munkatársat vegyipari, gépészeti vagy egyéb műszaki végzettséggel!

Amit kínálunk

• Versenyképes alapbér mellett kiemelkedő, 65%-os műszakpótlék átalány
• Br. 600.000 Ft-os éves cafetéria keretösszeg
• Éves bónusz
• Önkéntes nyugdíjpénztári hozzájárulás 1 éves munkaviszony után
• Élet-, egészség- és balesetbiztosítás
• Orvosi szolgáltatások a telephelyen
• Munkába járás költségének támogatása a Debrecenen kívülről érkező munkavállalóknak
• Kedvezményes étkezés a saját éttermünkben
• Nyári napközis táborok, dolgozói telefonflotta, banki kedvezmények

Az állás leírása

• Gyógyszeralapanyag-gyártás a termelésirányító és a gyártáskísérő lap utasításai szerint megszakítás nélküli munkarendben (12 órás műszakok, 2 nappal + 2 éjszaka + 4 nap pihenő)
• Gyógyszeralapanyag-gyártás vegyipari műveleti lépéseinek végrehajtása számítógépes folyamatirányító rendszereken
• Gyártáskísérő lapok, egyéb előírt dokumentumok vezetése és a gyártási adatok rögzítése számítógépes rendszerekben
• Üzemi gépek, berendezések, tároló tartályok biztonságos kezelése kezelési utasítások szerint
• Gépek és munkakörnyezet tisztántartása, termékváltásos takarítás utasítás szerinti végrehajtása
• Vegyipari berendezések, egységek üzemeltetési paramétereinek, védelmi rendszereinek ellenőrzése

Elvárások

• Vegyésztechnikus, gépésztechnikus vagy egyéb műszaki végzettség
• Felhasználói szintű számítástechnikai ismeret

Előnyt jelent

• Alap szintű angol nyelvtudás
• Vegyipari/gyógyszeripari tapasztalat
• Munkavédelmi technikusi végzettség
• Targonca vezetői jogosítvány

További információk

Alkoss maradandót a TAPI-ban!

A TAPI-ban dolgozni, több, mint egy munka. Lehetőség arra, hogy maradandót alkoss az egészség fejlesztése terén. Ha készen állsz, hogy vezess, újíts és ösztönözz, örömmel várunk a csapatunkba. Alakítsuk együtt az iparág jövőjét. Várjuk jelentkezésedet, amelyet követően a toborzás-kiválasztási csapatunk hamarosan felveszi veled a kapcsolatot.

title: Gyógyszercsomagoló gépkezelő (Evergreen)
description:
Mylan Hungary Kft.

A Viatris egy globális egészségügyi vállalat, amely egyedülálló helyzetben van arra, hogy áthidalja a hagyományos generikus és márkák közötti szakadékot, kombinálva mindkettő legjobb tulajdonságait, hogy globálisan holisztikusabban kezelje az egészségügyi igényeket. Küldetésünk, hogy világszerte egészségesebben élhessünk az embereket az élet minden szakaszában, széles körű hozzáférést biztosítunk, jelenleg évente körülbelül 1 milliárd betegnek szállítunk magas minőségű gyógyszereket, és az élet minden pillanatát érintjük, a születéstől az élet végéig, az akut állapotokon át a krónikus betegségekig.

Számos díjlistán isszerepeltünk, amelyek bemutatják, milyen hatást érünk el.

Globális portfóliónk kategóriájában legjobb, ismert márkatermékeket, valamint globális kulcsmárkákat tartalmaz; általános gyógyszerek, beleértve az összetett általános gyógyszereket; és egyéb ajánlatokat a terápiás területek széles skáláján. Elkötelezettek vagyunk amellett, hogy oktatással, tájékoztatással és a kezelésekhez való jobb hozzáféréssel segítsünk egészségesebb közösségeket létrehozni világszerte.

Azok számára, akik céltudatosan akarják leélni az életüket, a Viatris segít, illetve az alkalmazottaknak is abban, hogy kiaknázzák a bennük rejlő lehetőségeket azáltal, hogy olyan együttműködési kultúrát hoznak létre, amely elősegíti a bátorságot és a rugalmasságot. A Viatris több, mint egy munkahely. Ez egy olyan hely, ahol változást hozhatunk a világban.

A pozíció és mit fogsz csinálni

A komáromi telephely a vállalat stratégiailag fontos gyógyszer csomagolási központja az Európai Unióban. Közel 120 millió karton csomagolását, felszabadítását és disztribúcióját végezzük. A komáromi telephely a vállalat európai régiós minőségügyi központja, ahol az Európai Unióban értékesített, a helyi üzemben vagy az Európai Unió más országában, illetve harmadik országban csomagolt termékek minőségellenőrzését és felszabadítását végezzük. Az Európai Unióban az egyik legmodernebb és legnagyobb minőségellenőrzési laborral rendelkezünk, éves szinten közel 6000 késztermék analitikai vizsgálata zajlik. Egyben mi vagyunk az európai régió Minőségügyi Kiválóság Központja.

600 főre emelkedett a munkavállalók létszáma, akik képzésére és fejlesztésére nagy figyelmet fordítunk.

Minden nap küzdünk azzal a kihívással, hogy változást hozzunk, és a következőképpen hat a Gyógyszercsomagoló Gépkezelő pozíció:

• Könnyű fizikai munka
• Automata gyógyszercsomagológép üzemeltetése
• Alapanyag felkészítése, késztermék kezelése
• Alapszintű technikai problémák elhárítása
• Megrendeléshez tartozó dokumentáció vezetése
• Minőségellenőrzési feladatok elvégzése

Az Ön készségeiről és tapasztalatairól

Erre a munkakörre olyan jelentkezőt keresünk, aki az alábbi képesítések, készségek és tapasztalatok hatékony kombinációjával rendelkezik:

• Szabálykövető és precíz munkavégzés
• 3 műszakos munkarend vállalása
• Alapszintű számítógép-kezelési gyakorlat
• Gyártó vállalatnál szerzett gépkezelői tapasztalat előny, de nem feltétele a jelentkezésnek
• Csapatjátékos és dinamikus munkát szerető személyiség

Amit kínálunk:

• A pozícióban jelenleg átlagosan elérhető havi bér pótlékokkal bruttó 463.000 HUF
• 50%-os délutáni és 80%-os éjszakai pótlék
• Teljesítmény függő éves béremelés
• A karrierlétra program keretein belül lehetőséget biztosítunk előlépésre, mely további béremelést jelent
• Munkavállaló-barát módon tervezett nyári és karácsonyi szabadság
• Próbaidő sikeres teljesítése után garantált bruttó 100 000 HUF azonnali kifizetés
• Éves bónusz, mely elérheti 1,5 havi fizetés összegét
• 11 elemből válaszható, 520 000 HUF bruttó éves cafeteria, ezen felül mindenkinek napi egy meleg étkezés biztosított (a menü több elemből válaszható)
• Bejárás támogatás: tömegközlekedés esetén 100%-os térítés, gépkocsihasználat esetén 60 HUF/km
• Ingyenes céges buszjáratok folyamatosan bővülő útvonalakon (Magyarország és Szlovákia több pontjáról)
• 100 km-nél távolabbi lakhelyről 35 km-en belülre való költözés esetén albérleti támogatás biztosított, melynek összege havonta nettó maximum 100 000 HUF 1 éven át
• Havi bruttó 7520 HUF sportolási támogatás
• Dolgozói élet- és balesetbiztosítás (melynek érvényessége munkaidőn túlra is kiterjed): kritikus betegségek, gyermek születése, csonttörés, bármely okú műtéti beavatkozás esetén
• Magán szakorvosi és diagnosztikai ellátás privát egészségügyi szolgáltatónál országosan
• Dolgozói ajánlási program, mely egy jelölt sikeres ajánlása esetén minimum bruttó 300 000 HUF
• Ingyenes munkaruha-biztosítás és -tisztítás
• Ingyenes angol nyelvi képzés karrierprogram keretein belül
• Világszínvonalú gépek, tiszta gyógyszeripari környezet
• Folyamatosan fejlődő, biztos jövőt kínáló vállalat, mely az elmúlt 10 év során mind munkatársai számát, mind gyógyszercsomagolási kapacitásait megháromszorozta

A Viatris elkötelezett amellett, hogy valóban sokszínű, befogadó és hiteles munkahelyet építsünk fel, ezért ha érdekel ez a szerep, de korábbi tapasztalatai nem felelnek meg teljesen minden követelménynek, továbbra is bátorítjuk, hogy jelentkezzen. Lehet, hogy Ön a megfelelő jelölt erre vagy más szerepekre.

Miért Viatris?

A Viatris versenyképes fizetéseket, juttatásokat és befogadó környezetet kínál, ahol tapasztalatait, látásmódját és készségeit felhasználhatja mások életére. Lehetősége ess arra is, hogy kiváló karrier-előrelépési lehetőségeket és a munka és a magánélet egyensúlyát célzó kezdeményezéseket kapjon.

Sokszínűség és befogadás a Viatrisnál

A Viatrisnál a sokszínűség és a befogadás elengedhetetlen küldetésünkhöz. Az a sokszínűség, amelyet üzletünk minden területén támogatunk, az egyik legnagyobb erősségünk lehet abban, hogy az egészségügyet nem úgy alakítjuk újra, ahogy van, hanem olyannak, amilyennek lennie kell. Ha többet szeretne megtudni arról, mit jelent számunkra a sokszínűség, a méltányosság és a befogadás, kérjük, látogasson el a https://www.viatris.com/en/Careers/Diversity-and-Inclusion oldalra.

Fenntarthatóság a Viatrisnál

A vállalati társadalmi felelősségvállalás alapvető fontosságú a Viatris küldetésében. Azon dolgozunk, hogy előmozdítsuk a felelős és fenntartható működést, és kollektív szakértelmünket felhasználva lehetővé tegyük az emberek számára, hogy egészségesebben éljenek életük minden szakaszában, felismerve, hogy tetteink hatással vannak az általunk kiszolgált érdekelt felekre és közösségekre. Ha többet szeretne megtudni erőfeszítéseinkről, látogasson el a https://www.viatris.com/en/about-us/corporate-responsibility webhelyre.

Amit a Viatris kínál: versenyképes fizetés, juttatások, illetve egy olyan befogadó környezet, ahol tapasztalataival, elképzeléseivel és készségeivel Ön is hatással lehet mások életére.

title: RECEPTIONIST COMMERCIALE
description:
Acustica Toscana cerca RECEPTIONIST COMMERCIALE (m/f)

Sedi: Pisa, Pontedera, Navacchio

Acustica Toscana è un centro specializzato nella cura dell'udito: ogni giorno aiutiamo le persone a tornare a sentire bene e a vivere meglio. Per rafforzare il nostro team cerchiamo una persona solare, organizzata e con spiccate doti commerciali, che sia il primo volto dell'azienda per i nostri clienti.

Di cosa ti occuperai

• Accogliere i clienti in negozio con cortesia e professionalità, mettendoli subito a proprio agio
• Informare clienti e familiari sull'ipoacusia, sui suoi segnali e sulle soluzioni disponibili
• Gestire l'agenda: prendere e confermare appuntamenti, fare richiami telefonici e organizzare i calendari degli audioprotesisti
• Gestire uno o più punti vendita: apertura e chiusura, cassa, ordine del negozio e piccola amministrazione
• Proporre prodotti, accessori e servizi, contribuendo agli obiettivi commerciali del punto vendita
• Seguire il cliente nel tempo, curando la relazione e la sua soddisfazione

Cosa cerchiamo

• Spiccata attitudine commerciale e orientamento al risultato
• Ottime capacità relazionali, garbo e pazienza, soprattutto con le persone anziane
• Presenza curata e professionale
• Ottime doti organizzative e capacità di gestire più attività insieme
• Buona dimestichezza con PC, gestionali e telefono
• Esperienza in ruoli di vendita, front office o retail (preferibile in ambito sanitario, ottico o farmaceutico)
• Disponibilità a lavorare su più sedi; patente B e auto propria [se richieste]

Cosa offriamo

• Contratto a tempo indeterminato, full time
• Formazione iniziale sull'udito e sui nostri prodotti: non serve esperienza nel settore acustico
• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico, in un'azienda in crescita e radicata sul territorio

Come candidarsi

Tramite mail silvia@acusticatoscana.it

La ricerca è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77 e D.Lgs. 198/2006). I dati saranno trattati ai sensi del Regolamento UE 2016/679 (GDPR).

title: Receptionist - NH Collection Torino Santo Stefano
description:
Se sei appassionato di ospitalità ed eccellenza, unisciti al team di NH Collection e lavora in affascinanti hotel e resort situati in autentici edifici storici nelle principali destinazioni di Europa, America Latina, Medio Oriente, Asia e ora anche nella Grande Cina. Contribuirai alla creazione di un’atmosfera eclettica ed elegante per offrire ai nostri ospiti soggiorni caratterizzati da emozioni straordinarie, prestando grande attenzione ai dettagli per creare momenti memorabili. Trova il tuo posto in NH Collection e scopri la gioia di far sentire unici i nostri ospiti in eleganti spazi e camere da vivere. Fornirai loro un servizio eccezionale e un’attenzione personalizzata. Farai parte di un brand che pone le emozioni straordinarie al centro di tutto ciò che fa.

Quale sarà la tua missione?

Come Receptionist sarai responsabile di soddisfare le esigenze degli ospiti all'arrivo e alla partenza e di fornire un'esperienza eccezionale durante il loro soggiorno, in linea con la visione e i valori dell'hotel in materia di soddisfazione dei clienti.

Cosa dovrai fare?

• Accogliere e completare il processo di check-in per tutti gli ospiti e i gruppi in arrivo in modo tempestivo e professionale, nonché completare il processo di check-out per gli ospiti e i gruppi in partenza.
• Gestire l'assegnazione delle camere in base alle caratteristiche degli ospiti (VIP, abituali, nuovi clienti, ecc.) con il reparto corrispondente.
• Gestire, se necessario, e garantire che il front office e il management siano pienamente informati su richieste, domande, reclami e/o suggerimenti degli ospiti e degli altri reparti.
• Conoscere tutti i prodotti e i servizi dell'hotel, le tariffe, le promozioni e i pacchetti sconto disponibili, nonché gli eventi VIP e speciali.
• Conoscere e comunicare i servizi dell'albergo disponibili (lavanderia, prenotazione di ristoranti) e le informazioni generali sulla sicurezza.
• Massimizzare l'occupazione delle camere alle migliori tariffe (questo include la chiusura delle vendite e delle extranet, se necessario).
• Utilizzare tecniche di up-selling (promuovere il programma di fidelizzazione, altre destinazioni, cibo e bevande, trasporti e strutture alberghiere).
• Gestire le prenotazioni di camere per gli ospiti in arrivo.
• Fornire informazioni agli ospiti sulla struttura e sull'area circostante (musei, monumenti), compresi eventi speciali, attrazioni, ristoranti, attività, ecc. della città.
• Rispondere alle richieste degli ospiti per accordi o servizi speciali (ad esempio, trasporto, prenotazioni, lavanderia) prendendo accordi o identificando i fornitori appropriati.
• Rispettare gli standard del brand.
• Assistere gli altri dipartimenti se necessario.

Cosa stiamo cercando?

• Esperienza di 1 - 2 anni nel reparto Front Office, preferibilmente in un hotel di dimensioni e complessità simili.
• Laurea o diploma in gestione alberghiera o equivalente.
• È richiesta la conoscenza fluente della lingua locale e un alto livello di quella inglese.
• La conoscenza di altre lingue straniere è considerata un plus.
• Conoscenza di vari programmi informatici (Microsoft Office, TMS, ecc.) e dei sistemi di Front Office.
• Orientamento al servizio clienti.
• Flessibilità nel rispondere a una varietà di situazioni lavorative.
• Forti capacità di comunicazione.
• Orientamento alle vendite.
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di un team.

Compensation

Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da € 23,892.26

La retribuzione sarà commisurata al livello e alla seniority del/la candidato/a

Perché scegliere noi?

In Minor Hotels Europe & Americas ci impegniamo a creare carriere entusiasmanti in tutto il mondo ed esperienze interculturali. Il nostro viaggio è alimentato dalla passione e dalla dedizione dei nostri incredibili team, che godono anche di vantaggi stimolanti ed esclusivi quali:

• Esperienza mondiale - diversità di 150 nazionalità diverse.
• Opportunità di sviluppo della carriera ricca di sfide nazionali e internazionali.
• Ampia gamma di programmi di formazione per migliorare le proprie competenze.
• Iniziative di benessere, tra cui condizioni di lavoro flessibili.
• Programmi di riconoscimento per i membri del team, tra cui le date memorabili.
• Possibilità di fare la differenza attraverso il nostro programma di sostenibilità e le iniziative di volontariato.
• Tariffe e promozioni per i membri del team, che offrono tariffe scontate nei nostri hotel in tutto il mondo e vantaggi esclusivi attraverso il nostro programma di fidelizzazione aziendale.

title: Business Consultant Transport
location: Alphen aan Den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description:
Korte omschrijving

Ken jij de transportwereld als je broekzak? En vind je het leuk om ondernemers te helpen hun proces slimmer in te richten? In deze rol combineer je relatiebeheer, consultancy en projectmanagement. Je zorgt dat transportbedrijven het maximale uit hun transportsoftware halen.

Bedrijfsprofiel

FleetGO is de afgelopen jaren sterk gegroeid en telt inmiddels meer dan 250 medewerkers verdeeld over 9 vestigingen in Europa. Vanuit de vestiging in Alphen aan den Rijn ontwikkelt FleetGO software (TMS) waarmee transportbedrijven gespecialiseerd in bulk- en kipper transport hun logistieke processen efficiënter kunnen organiseren. De software helpt bedrijven bij het stroomlijnen van hun planning en administratie en biedt realtime inzicht in hun transportactiviteiten. Inmiddels maken ruim 150+ transportbedrijven door heel Nederland gebruik van deze software.

De lijnen zijn kort: support, development en business zitten dicht op elkaar. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en vertrouwen, en hoeft niet in en uit te klokken. Daar staat tegenover dat je zelf het initiatief neemt en niet afwacht tot iets je wordt aangereikt. Het is een nuchtere, hands-on club waar hard gewerkt wordt en ook genoeg te lachen valt.

Functie omschrijving

Je begeleidt nieuwe klanten bij de implementatie van de transportsoftware. Je brengt hun logistieke processen in kaart: van het verwerken van opdrachten en het plannen van wagens en chauffeurs tot communicatie en facturatie. Op basis daarvan richt je de software in op hun manier van werken. Je zet een projectgroep op en traint medewerkers. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met de developers die de software bouwen.

Na de implementatie blijf je betrokken als vast aanspreekpunt voor ongeveer 150 klanten. Je bezoekt klanten door het hele land en beantwoordt vragen, bespreekt waar klanten tegenaan lopen en verzorgt opnieuw een training als er bijvoorbeeld een nieuwe planner bij je klant start. Wensen en verbeterpunten bespreek je intern met de product owner. Je bewaakt de voortgang totdat deze zijn opgepakt.

Ook bij het aansluiten van nieuwe klanten speel je een rol. Je denkt mee over hun wensen, geeft productdemo’s en adviseert over de mogelijkheden van de software. Aanvragen komen binnen via de website en je werkt hierbij samen met een salescollega. Jouw kracht zit vooral in je inhoudelijke kennis en het vertalen van klantbehoeften naar praktische oplossingen.

Je richt zelf je agenda in. Je werkt vanuit huis, kantoor of bij de klant en krijgt veel vrijheid om je dag in te delen. Naarmate je kennis groeit, krijg je de mogelijkheid door te groeien naar andere projecten, producten en doelgroepen.

Functie eisen

• Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in transport en kent het transportproces van binnenuit
• Je vindt het leuk om onderweg te zijn en klanten door het hele land op locatie te helpen
• Je kunt goed levelen met uiteenlopende stakeholders, van developers tot directieleden bij klanten
• Je hebt geen 9-tot-5-mentaliteit en gaat goed om met veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

• € 4.250 – € 5.500 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
• Pensioenregeling
• Leaseauto
• Laptop en telefoon
• 24 vakantiedagen
• 8% vakantiegeld
• Informele organisatie met korte lijnen en veel vrijheid om je dagen zelf in te delen

Interesse na het lezen van deze vacature? Mail naar s.jouseiph@haystackpeople.nl of bel op +31 6 45262693.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Ben jij een ervaren supply chain professional die graag overzicht houdt, processen optimaliseert en teams in beweging brengt?

Dan is dit jouw kans om impact te maken binnen een groeiende organisatie.

Als Supply Chain Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het aansturen en verder professionaliseren van de volledige supply chain. Je zorgt voor een optimale beschikbaarheid van producten, een efficiënte goederenstroom en een sterke samenwerking tussen planning, productie, inkoop, logistiek en commercie. Met jouw visie, leiderschap en daadkracht lever je een directe bijdrage aan de groei, continuïteit en prestaties van de organisatie.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige keten, van de inkoop van grondstoffen tot het moment waarop onze producten het centrale warehouse verlaten. Daarbij geef je leiding aan twee collega's en werk je nauw samen met verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in internationale groei- en verbeterprojecten.

Jouw impact

• Verantwoordelijk voor de volledige supply chain van grondstof tot uitlevering.
• Eindverantwoordelijk voor S&OP, forecasting, demandplanning en productieplanning.
• Leidinggeven aan een professioneel team en samenwerken met diverse afdelingen.
• Initiëren en realiseren van verbeterprojecten binnen de supply chain.
• Bijdragen aan de internationale groeiambities van de organisatie.

Verantwoordelijkheden

• Eindverantwoordelijk voor S&OP, demandplanning, productieplanning en forecasting.
• Begeleiden van de expeditieafdeling en borgen van een efficiënte in- en outbound goederenstroom.
• Verantwoordelijk voor voorraadbeheer in samenwerking met Verkoop Binnendienst.
• Onderhouden en ontwikkelen van leveranciersrelaties.
• Inkopen van grondstoffen en verpakkingsmaterialen.
• Initiëren en begeleiden van supply chain projecten en procesoptimalisaties.
• Waarborgen van een gestroomlijnde outbound flow inclusief exportdocumentatie en vergunningen.

Wat breng jij mee?

• HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Supply Chain, Logistiek of Technische Bedrijfskunde.
• Meerdere jaren ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol binnen een food- of productieomgeving.
• Ervaring met S&OP-processen, planning en inkoop.
• Ervaring met exportprocessen en internationaal transport.
• Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Frans is een pré.

Waarom werken bij Signature Foods?

Bij Signature Foods zetten we ons dagelijks in om onze klanten de best mogelijke service te bieden, maar ook om het beste in jou naar boven te halen! We hechten veel waarde aan een positieve werksfeer en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Jouw mening en ideeën worden gewaardeerd en je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te laten zien en te groeien binnen ons bedrijf.

Ben jij klaar om de volgende stap in jouw carrière te zetten als Supply Chain Manager?

Solliciteer vandaag nog via de sollicitatieknop of stuur je cv en motivatie naar recruitment@signaturefoods.com.

De vacature wordt gelijktijdig zowel intern als extern uitgezet. Bij gelijke geschiktheid hebben interne kandidaten voorrang. Signature Foods aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor deze vacature. Toegestuurde cv's (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerker van Signature Foods zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van Signature Foods HR worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd.

Baliemedewerker / Magazijnmedewerker | DYKA Eindhoven

Company Description

DYKA Nederland is een toonaangevende productie- en verkooporganisatie van kunststof leidingsystemen (PVC, PE en PP). De productie, centrale distributie, verkoopafdelingen en overige stafdiensten zijn gevestigd op het hoofdkantoor in Steenwijk. Daarnaast zorgen 21 regionale verkoopvestigingen voor servicegerichte verkoop en toelevering aan handelaren, aannemers, installateurs, overheidsinstanties, nutsbedrijven en de industrie. DYKA Nederland is onderdeel van DYKA Group, die op haar beurt deel uitmaakt van Tessenderlo Group. DYKA Group is internationaal vertegenwoordigd in België, Nederland, Frankrijk, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Duitsland, Polen, Tsjechië, Slovenië en Roemenië.

Maar DYKA is meer dan alleen een productie- en verkooporganisatie van kunststof leidingsystemen. Door water, lucht en andere energiebronnen op een betrouwbare, efficiënte en duurzame manier te transporteren, dragen wij elke dag bij aan een betere planeet. Bovendien doen we dit met gerecycleerd of recycleerbare materialen. Wij kunnen dan ook met trots zeggen dat we “Nature’s Network” zijn.

De cultuur van DYKA is 'Every Day, We-GO'. Deze cultuur is gebaseerd op drie waarden die overeenkomen met de W, G en O in We-GO: We Win Together (Samen Winnen), We Go Beyond (Onszelf Overtreffen) en We Own It (Eigenaarschap Tonen).

Job Description

Voor onze vestiging in Eindhoven zijn wij op zoek naar een Balie / Magazijnmedewerker

Als Baliemedewerker / Magazijnmedewerker ben jij hét aanspreekpunt voor klanten en zorg je ervoor dat bestellingen correct worden verwerkt. Je combineert administratieve, logistieke en klantgerichte taken in een veelzijdige rol.

• Je verzamelt en verwerkt bestellingen in het magazijn en de buitenopslag.
• Je helpt klanten aan de balie, geeft advies en zorgt voor een correcte afhandeling van orders.
• Je bundelt en stapelt bestellingen met de heftruck.
• Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het laden en lossen van vrachtwagens.
• Je ontvangt leveranciers en verwerkt inkomende goederen.
• Je verwerkt orders administratief in ons systeem.
• Je bewaakt de orde, netheid en veiligheid op de vestiging.

Profile

Wat breng je mee?

• Affiniteit met techniek, bouw of logistiek.
• Ervaring in magazijnwerk en klantcontact is een pré, maar we leren je ook graag de kneepjes van het vak!
• Je bent handig op de heftruck of bereid om dit te leren.
• Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden en weet klanten op de juiste manier te adviseren.
• Je werkt graag in teamverband en hebt een positieve instelling.
• Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.
• Je woont in de regio Eindhoven

Offer

• Salaris conform CAO KRI en Overeenkomst Aanvullende Afspraken DYKA B.V., schaal E (tot €3233,37 bruto per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring);
• Vakantietoeslag van 8%;
• 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV dagen (op basis van 40 uur per week);
• Secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden als een gratificatie van 3%, collectieve pensioenregeling en mogelijkheid tot deelname aan onze collectieve zorgverzekering;
• Een reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 cent per km tot maximaal € 16,10 per dag (vanaf 10 km);
• Alle persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen die je nodig hebt;
• Opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden;
• Bijdrage (bruto-netto verrekening) aan sportabonnement, fietsplan en computerregeling (bij een vast contract).
• Een uitgebreid inwerktraject zodat je precies weet wat je te doen staat;
• Een fijne werkomgeving met leuke collega’s!

Procedure en solliciteren

Voor vragen over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Roel Broks (Vestigingsmanager) via +31648370061 of roel.broks@dyka.nl. Voor aanvullende vragen over het sollicitatieproces kun je contact opnemen met Vinsent Morsink (Recruiter) via +31647994239 of vinsent.morsink@dyka.nl

Door te solliciteren ga je automatisch akkoord met de bewaartermijn van je persoonsgegevens bij DYKA voor een periode van één jaar.

title: Logistiek medewerker
description:
Wat ga je precies doen

Je start je dag om 7:45 uur met een kop koffie en het verdelen van de eerste orders. Samen met een collega pick je orders, maak je deze gereed en meld je ze bij je teamleider. Klanten kunnen zich tussendoor bij je melden om materialen af te halen. Gedurende de dag laad je orders in trailers voor transport en zorg je ervoor dat alles op tijd klaarstaat.

Naast het verwerken van verkooporders ontvang je ook inkooporders van leveranciers. Deze worden in het magazijn geplaatst en opgenomen in de voorraad. Aan het einde van de dag werk je samen met je team om ervoor te zorgen dat alle orders de deur uit zijn. Je werkt in een hecht team waar samenwerking en een goede sfeer centraal staan.

Wat bieden we jou

Wij bieden een diverse, fulltime functie als logistiek medewerker in een gezond, informeel bedrijf. Je krijgt een tijdelijk contract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband. Daarnaast bieden wij goede arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de CAO Timmerindustrie. Er is veel ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en er zijn diverse doorgroeimogelijkheden. We helpen elkaar wanneer nodig en er is, naast hard werken, zeker ruimte voor een gezellig praatje.

Functie-eisen

We zoeken een logistiek medewerker met een praktische instelling en oog voor detail.

• Je hebt vmbo/mbo-werk- en -denkniveau.
• Je hebt een hands-on mentaliteit.
• Je bent nauwkeurig, flexibel en kritisch.
• Je kunt zelfstandig werken.
• Je hebt een heftruckcertificaat of wilt deze behalen.

Over het bedrijf

Progé is sinds 1997 innovatief op het gebied van productie en toelevering van kant-en-klaar producten voor de bouw. Je kunt hierbij denken aan dagkantaftimmering, vensterbanken, stelkozijnen, leidingkokers, terrasplanken en gevelbekleding. In eigen productie voorzien wij deze producten van een finishfolie, waardoor er op de bouw niet meer getimmerd of geschilderd hoeft te worden en onze klanten veel dure uren van o.a. De schilder wordt bespaard. Dit maken wij met een team van ruim 100 betrokken medewerkers op vier locaties.

title: Logistics Specialist for NA (M/F)
description:
Job description:

Job title: Logistics Specialist for NA

Location: Katowice HUB, hybrid

Type: Fixed Term Contract, full-time

Working hours: 14:00-22:00

Who we are and what we do:

LIPTON Teas & Infusions is the world’s leading tea business, home to iconic, purpose‑driven brands like Lipton, Pukka, Tazo, T2, Lyons and PG Tips.

We craft great teas for every occasion, to bring joy and inspire a healthier lifestyle. Guided by our values of people first, ownership, passion for excellence, and consumer and customer centricity, we create long‑term value for our people, trade partners, suppliers, and the communities where we operate.

If you’re a diverse thinker who takes personal ownership to connect ideas and make impactful things happen, someone who shares our values around humanity and courage and someone who enjoys a good cup of tea (on the house!), then we could be a good match! 🍃✨

Your role:

LIPTON Teas & Infusions produces a significant part of its US volume with external contract manufacturers (copackers). Every production run and outbound shipment from these partners must be accurately recorded in SAP before stock can be deployed to distribution centres and supplier invoices can be paid.

As Logistics Specialist, you will own these SAP inventory transactions end to end, recording finished goods production and outbound shipments accurately and on time.

Your work is an important gate for downstream deployment, transport and invoicing. You’ll work closely with our copackers and North American Supply Chain teams, while also supporting process improvements and the future integration of copackers into planning systems.

This role offers hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, North American supply chain operations and process improvement projects.

Your key responsibilities:

• Post finished goods production to the correct purchase orders in SAP once products are released by Quality.
• Record quantities, batch codes and expiry dates accurately and ensure required Quality approvals are in place.
• Process outbound shipments and post goods issue in SAP, including unit-of-measure corrections, batch splits and picking quantities.
• Ensure stock transfer orders, shipping documentation and SAP postings are aligned.
• Maintain accurate inventory for each copacker site and investigate and correct discrepancies.
• Review copacker invoices, resolve rejections and variances, and follow up on outstanding payments.
• Act as the daily operational contact for copackers, following up on missing releases, shipment information and documentation.
• Work closely with Deployment, Transportation, Supply Planning, Quality, Procurement and Finance to keep shipments on schedule.
• Escalate recurring discrepancies and maintain standard operating procedures for the different copacker operating models.
• Support process automation and the planned integration of copackers into planning systems.

What we are looking for:

You’re someone who combines accuracy and ownership with proactive communication and feels comfortable working in a fast-paced, transactional environment.

You’ll bring:

• High attention to detail and the ability to handle high transaction volumes under time pressure.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken, and confidence working with US and Canadian colleagues and suppliers.
• Availability to work a shifted schedule overlapping with US Eastern Time.
• Experience in logistics or supply chain operations.
• Ideally, hands-on SAP experience with inventory transactions such as goods receipt, outbound deliveries, post goods issue, batch management and stock transfer orders.
• Knowledge of order-to-cash and procure-to-pay processes, three-way matching and invoice handling would be an advantage.
• Experience working with contract manufacturers or copackers in FMCG or food and beverage would be a plus.
• Good Excel skills; experience with Power BI, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Transportation Management or planning tools such as Kinaxis is an advantage.

the community

description:

• Provide specialist tire support to the race team during events, including tire preparation, tire management, tire assembly, balancing, fitting, handling, and monitoring tire condition and performance throughout race weekends.

• Inspect, maintain, and repair tools and equipment to ensure all equipment meets safety and performance standards

• Manage inventory of tools, equipment, and spare parts, ensuring adequate stock levels are maintained; order and restock items as necessary

• Ensure all safety protocols and procedures are followed in the garage; conduct regular safety checks and report any hazards or issues to the Team Logistics Manager or Chief Mechanic

• Maintain accurate records of equipment maintenance, repairs, and inventory; document any issues or incidents that occur during race events

• Support the race team during events by assisting with pit stop operations, troubleshooting tire-related issues, and ensuring all tire equipment is operating effectively and safely

Requirements

What do we need from you?

• Technical certification or diploma in Automotive Technology, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, such as a Level 3 National Vocational Qualification (NVQ)or a BTEC National Certificate/Diploma in Vehicle Technology or Engineering

• Proven experience as a Tire Technician within Formula 1 or another elite-level international motorsport environment

• Demonstrable expertise in tyre preparation, tyre management, wheel and tyre assembly and FIA operational procedures

• Strong technical knowledge of automotive tools and equipment

• Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, particularly in high-pressure trackside environments.

• Exceptional attention to detail, with a commitment to delivering the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and precision in a fast-paced, time-critical environment.

• Strong organisational, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively as part of a high-performing race team.

title: Veterinary Surgeon
description:
A bit about us

Do you want to help create a better world for animals? At the RSPCA, we believe animal welfare is everyone's welfare. Join us in creating a better world for every animal.

We are looking for a new team member as a Vet Surgeon to join us at our Felledge Animal Centre in Chester-le-Street, County Durham. The vet team at the centre consists of one Vet and one Vet Nurse.

• Working hours: 35 hours / Mon - Friday (no overnight, weekend or bank holiday shifts)
• Onsite role: Felledge Animal Centre with some offsite work.
• This is not your average Vet job - so, what's different about it? We focus on animal welfare and can offer great hours (shifts are 8:30am - 4:30pm with an hour for lunch). So, if you are looking for some flexibility to fit in with your home-life this could be the right fit for you.

What a day might look like for you

Here at RSPCA no two days are the same, but, we've added a short summary of what a typical day might look like. For full insight please refer to the attached job description.

Our expert team at Felledge Animal Centre provide life saving veterinary care to animals rescued by RSPCA frontline officers. They also provide vital support to rescued animals being cared for at RSPCA centre.Unlike private veterinary practices, our focus is exclusively on rescued, stray, neglected, and abused animals rather than owned pets.

In this rewarding and varied role, you will oversee the treatment and rehabilitation of injured, ill, and vulnerable animals, demonstrating clinical competence across a broad range of veterinary disciplines. Your responsibilities will include:

• Neutering and other soft tissue surgery
• Shelter medicine
• Some sole charge
• Participating in off site work when required at Private Boarding Establishments in the North East
• Dentistry
• Implementing RSPCA policies in regards to the re-homability of animals including decision making on individual cases
• Welfare support work for the RSPCA Inspectorate

What will help you succeed in this role:

• Membership of the Royal College of Veterinary Surgeons
• Interest or previous experience in shelter medicine
• A pragmatic, welfare oriented approach
• Happy to handle dogs, cats, small furries and possibly bird and wildlife initial triage (although not expected to be an expert on wildlife)
• Excellent time management skills
• Ability to work autonomously and make informed decisions
• Great communication skills
• In line with above you will have the ability to explain complex clinical and welfare decisions in a clear and compassionate way to a variety of non-clinical staff, including the animal centre teams and Inspectorate
• A driver's license is essential for this position due to travel required across the region.

Successful candidates for certain RSPCA roles may need to undergo a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check.

title: Employment Paralegal
description:
The role

We are seeking a motivated and ambitious Paralegal to support our Employment team on a broad range of employment law matters. This role offers excellent development opportunities for an individual looking to build a long term career in employment law within a leading national practice.

The successful candidate will work closely with partners, legal directors, principal associates and associates, providing support on a varied caseload of both advisory and contentious matters.

The Team

Our national Employment team is widely respected for providing pragmatic, commercial and timely employment law advice to a broad range of clients. The team advises primarily employer clients across a variety of sectors, supporting them on both contentious and non-contentious employment matters, including Employment Tribunal litigation, workplace investigations, restructures, redundancies, TUPE transfers, executive departures, discrimination claims, industrial relations issues and day to day HR advisory work. The team also works closely with specialists across advocacy, corporate, immigration and litigation practices to deliver seamless support to clients.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a collaborative and high performing team, gaining exposure to complex employment law matters while working alongside experienced lawyers recognised in the market for their expertise and client service.

Essential

Skills & Experience

• A law degree, GDL, SQE qualification or equivalent legal qualification.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
• A high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong legal research and drafting skills.
• Ability to work effectively as part of a team and independently when required.
• Commercial awareness and an interest in employment law developments.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and legal case management systems.

Desirable

• Previous employment law experience
