Shoosmiths is the law firm clients choose for excellent service, incisive thinking and above all for our ability to focus on what matters. From offices across the UK and Brussels, we support some of the world’s most exciting and ambitious businesses; amazing clients making an impact. The first top 50 law firm to achieve ‘Platinum Standard’ Investors in People, our values and culture are not just words on our website but are the heartbeat of the firm.

We have an outstanding benefits package to complement our competitive remuneration system. In addition to the competitive salaries, great working environment and high-quality work, we believe that all staff should be rewarded for their commitment to the continued success of the firm through a comprehensive and flexible range of benefits.

To discover more about our benefits, please visit: Benefits Package

Shoosmiths is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. Disability Confident is a government scheme designed to encourage employers to recruit and retain disabled people and those with long term conditions.

Equal opportunities

Our approach to our people is underpinned by our approach to diversity, inclusion and well-being. Our ambition is to build a diverse and ambitious workforce that reflects all backgrounds and talents, and a workplace that is supportive and inclusive, recognises and nurtures talent, and has a strong sense of community between colleagues.

title: Finance Director
description:
Cedar is partnering with a global, PE-backed SaaS business to appoint a Finance Director as its number one in finance.

This is a broad leadership role within a scaling international business, combining commercial decision support with ownership of global finance operations. You will build a finance function that supports growth, delivers clear insight and uses technology to improve how the business operates.

Candidates must have worked within a SaaS business in their current or most recent role.

The role

• Lead the global finance function, taking responsibility for financial operations, reporting, FP&A, tax, treasury and payroll.
• Own budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling, translating performance into clear recommendations for senior leadership and PE stakeholders.
• Develop reporting around SaaS metrics, including ARR, recurring revenue growth, churn, retention and customer economics.
• Strengthen cash flow forecasting, working capital management and financial controls across international operations.
• Oversee HR operations and payroll, ensuring effective processes across multiple jurisdictions.
• Lead systems and process improvements, championing AI and automation to increase efficiency, accuracy and visibility.
• Build and develop the finance team as the business scales.

Your background

• A qualified accountant with senior finance leadership experience in an international SaaS business.
• Your current or most recent role must be within SaaS, with a strong understanding of subscription revenue models and their commercial drivers.
• Experience as a Finance Director, Head of Finance or equivalent, with the ability to operate as the most senior finance professional in the business.
• A track record of supporting a scale-up environment, combining strategic thinking with hands-on delivery.
• Strong experience across global finance operations, FP&A, tax, treasury and payroll.
• Confidence working with senior leadership and investors; PE-backed experience would be particularly valuable.
• A practical interest in AI, automation and connected finance systems. Experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Ramp or Rippling would be advantageous.

This is an opportunity to shape the finance function of a global SaaS business and play a central role in its next phase of growth.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Cedar.

title: Strategic Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Strategic Project Manager (Structural & Civil)

Location: HM Naval Base, Portsmouth (HMNBP)

Service Area: Strategy, Asset Management

Hours of Work: 37 hours per week

Contract Type: Permanent

Salary: £60,000

As a Strategic Projects Manager, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Portsmouth Naval Base by delivering a diverse portfolio of strategic projects that inform long-term asset management plans and investment programmes.

This is an exciting opportunity for a proactive and confident Structural Engineering professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, working with a wide range of stakeholders and contributing to the future development of a unique and nationally important site.

What you will be doing:

• Lead strategic projects from inception through to completion, including feasibility studies, surveys, user requirement documents and RIBA Stages 0-2 design activities.
• Work closely with MOD stakeholders, asset owners and wider project teams to understand requirements, develop project briefs and define scopes of work.
• Manage the full tender process, from preparing tender documentation and appointing suppliers to overseeing contract delivery and successful project completion.
• Review and prepare project requirement forms that support programme planning, prioritisation and allocation of funding.
• Track project performance, manage budgets and schedules, and provide clear reporting on progress, risks and outcomes.
• Develop future programme recommendations and cost estimates based on project findings, helping to shape annual and long-term works programmes.
• Build strong relationships through regular face-to-face engagement with clients, stakeholders and project partners.
• Collaborate with a small, experienced team, sharing expertise and supporting colleagues to achieve successful project outcomes.
• Take ownership of a varied workload, spanning everything from fire strategy reviews and infrastructure surveys to early-stage building and engineering designs.
• Occasionally undertake projects outside of trained structures and civils profession.

What you will bring:

• Experience in project and programme management within the construction, engineering or infrastructure sectors.
• A sound understanding of civil and structural engineering principles, with an appreciation of wider construction disciplines.
• The ability to develop clear project briefs, scopes of work and tender documentation.
• Experience managing tender processes, evaluating submissions and supporting supplier appointments.
• Strong commercial awareness, including budget management, cost control and whole-life cost considerations.
• The ability to review and challenge technical proposals and project outputs, balancing innovation, cost, programme requirements and asset longevity.
• Confidence analysing complex reports and technical information to provide clear recommendations that support client decisions and future investment programmes.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across clients, consultants, contractors and internal teams.
• Experience coordinating and managing multidisciplinary technical teams to deliver successful project outcomes.
• The ability to translate complex compliance and engineering requirements into practical, deliverable solutions.
• A proactive mindset, strong sense of accountability and a commitment to continuous improvement.
• Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work independently when required.
• Willingness to diversify technical experience in a flexible approach.

About you:

• Degree Qualified in Civil and structural Engineering/ Management discipline.
• CEng (or working towards) Membership of relevant professional body (e.g., IStructE, IMechE) is desirable
• NEBOSH/IOSH or equivalent H&S qualification (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, SMSTS or CSCS or equivalent is preferred
• Familiarity with multiple mechanical systems, including:
• Saltwater systems including penstocks, dock pumps, and lock gates
• Building systems including HVAC, gas, steam, fresh water, sewage, Combined Heat and Power Plants, Low Temperature Hot Water
• Workshop systems including Local Exhaust Ventilation (LEV), workshop machinery, plant and lifting machinery, High / Low Pressure Air systems
• Experience and good knowledge of the full engineering lifecycle from inception to in-service
• Knowledgeable of building regulations and British standards and relevant regulations.
• Knowledgeable of all engineering, procurement, and construction aspects of delivering major projects.
• Ability to work directly with the client without direct management supervision and instruction

You’ll get:

• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
• Holiday purchase scheme, following successful completion of probation period
• Early finish on a Friday
• Discretionary company bonus scheme
• Enhanced pension scheme – employee contribution 4% and company contribution 6%, or you can increase your contribution to 6% and company contribution will increase to 10%
• Life assurance x 4 (subject to scheme T&C’s)
• Access to our internal benefits and discounts programme for all colleagues
• Cycle to work scheme
• Group income protection
• Flexible parental benefits (if applicable)
• Free parking onsite
• Access to our Internal employee assistance network, giving you the opportunity to reach the heights of success within your new position.
• Continued professional career development
• Kudos reward opportunities (internal achievements scheme)
• Occupational Health & Wellbeing Services
• Discount off entry into the Historic Dockyard

Application process:

Applications are urged to apply prior to the advertising closing date 11th November 2026.

Background checks & security

Please note that due to the nature of the site we are based on and the work carried out, once offered we carry out a number of pre-employment checks which include UKSV clearance applications – you will need to be eligible for this and willing to go through the process. For more information, please speak with the Talent & Recruitment team.

About us:

At KBS Maritime, we're not just another company – we're an exciting and dynamic joint venture between industry leaders BAE Systems and KBR. Our team is dedicated to providing Asset Management, Infrastructure Management, Energy Solutions and Alongside Services at His Majesty's Naval Base Portsmouth (HMNBP), the beating heart of the Royal Navy.

With almost two-thirds of the Royal Navy's surface ships stationed at HMNBP, working with KBS Maritime means being at the forefront of innovation and progress. We operate in a unique and fascinating environment, with a mix of historic dockyards and cutting-edge infrastructure that's unlike any other.

By delivering state of the art solutions to the Royal Navy, KBS Maritime offers the chance to work on projects that make a real difference to the safety, security, and sustainability of the UK's National Defence and Security. But it's not just about the work – at KBS Maritime, we believe in the value of our people. We have the ethos of a small business, which means we value and empower our team members to succeed.

KBS Maritime is committed to building a diverse workforce and fostering an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of every social or cultural background, age, gender, ability, sexual orientation, and belief.

We will make reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process to accommodate any disability. In the first instance, if you require this job advert in an alternative format, or require any assistance, please contact recruitment@kbsmaritime.com

title: Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer V
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Joining our operations team means being at the center of everything – maintaining and evolving critical infrastructure that powers the digital world and delivers real impact for our customers, communities and society. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Senior Data Center Infrastructure Engineer (Electrical or Mechanical)

Keep Critical Infrastructure Running

Are you an experienced Electrical or Mechanical Engineer who enjoys hands-on work, fault finding, and keeping essential equipment operating reliably?

We're looking for a Senior Data Center Infrastructure Engineer to join our team in Slough. You'll work on the systems that keep our facility running safely and efficiently, including electrical distribution, cooling equipment, pumps, generators, fire protection systems, and other building services infrastructure.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving problems, taking ownership, and working as part of a team in a fast-paced operational environment.

Why Equinix?

Equinix is the world's leading digital infrastructure company, operating data centers in more than 70 markets worldwide.

Data centers are the buildings that support the digital services people use every day, from banking and healthcare to streaming, online shopping, AI and cloud services. Our engineers play a key role in keeping these services available by maintaining the infrastructure behind them.

At Equinix, you'll join a stable global business that invests in its people, provides long-term career opportunities, and offers exposure to industry-leading facilities and technology.

What You'll Do

• Carry out planned and reactive maintenance on electrical and mechanical systems.
• Monitor building systems and respond to alarms and equipment issues.
• Troubleshoot faults and carry out repairs safely and effectively.
• Support the operation of critical infrastructure including power, cooling, plumbing, and fire protection systems.
• Complete inspections, maintenance checks, and equipment testing.
• Respond to incidents and help resolve operational issues.
• Work with contractors and service providers to ensure maintenance work is completed safely and to a high standard.
• Review maintenance documentation, permits, and procedures.
• Support infrastructure upgrades and improvement projects.
• Identify potential risks and recommend improvements.
• Help manage spare parts and equipment inventory.
• Share knowledge and support less experienced engineers when needed.

What We're Looking For

• Strong experience in an electrical or mechanical engineering role.
• Experience carrying out maintenance and fault finding on building services or infrastructure systems.
• Ability to diagnose problems and make sound decisions under pressure.
• Experience working safely in an operational environment.
• Good understanding of maintenance procedures and technical documentation.
• Comfortable working with contractors and external suppliers.
• Strong teamwork and communication skills.

Qualifications

• Electrical or Mechanical apprenticeship, trade qualification, City & Guilds, NVQ, HNC/HND, or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in maintenance, facilities, infrastructure, building services, or critical environment operations.

What You'll Get

• Work with complex electrical and mechanical infrastructure.
• Ongoing training and development opportunities.
• Clear career progression within a global organisation.
• A supportive team environment focused on safety and reliability.
• Competitive benefits package, including pension, healthcare and wellbeing support (subject to local policy).

Shift Pattern

4 on, 4 off rotating shift pattern (days and nights).

Interested?

If you're an Electrical or Mechanical Engineer looking for a hands-on role with real responsibility and long-term career opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and join the team helping keep the digital world running.

title: Director of Sales
description:
Position Title: Director of Sales

Reporting To: General Manager

Managing: S&M Department (Reservations Supervisor, Sales Manager and Sales and PR Executive)

Visa Sponsorship: Visa sponsorship may be available for eligible candidates who are currently residing in the UK, subject to meeting UK Skilled Worker visa and immigration requirements.

What will I get?

• Competitive salary based on experience
• Service charge (£9,000–£10,000 per annum, subject to business levels)
• Discretionary bonus of up to 20%, based on achievement of agreed KPIs
• Enhanced pension scheme*
• Enhanced annual leave entitlement, increasing with length of service
• Complimentary meals while on duty
• Private Bupa Health Plan*
• Access to the CODE App, offering exclusive hospitality benefits and discounts*
• A vibrant social calendar and employee engagement programme, including team events and seasonal celebrations
• The opportunity to be part of one of London's most distinctive luxury hospitality projects

What will I be doing as Director of Sales?

We are looking for a passionate, energetic and value-led Director of Sales to lead and oversee the Sales department. You will own and optimise the product (think hospitality, experiences and community) whilst being responsible for wider business strategy as the company fulfils its growth plans, revenue strategies and enters into new locations. You will need a firm grasp of the London market, particularly the fashion, luxury goods, leisure, and entertainment sectors.

Reporting directly into the General Manager and you will work closely with the leadership team, acting as Ambassador, to drive new and existing business.

You will be required to have excellent communication skills and build constructive and supportive relationships with your co-workers. Your support will help design, drive, and implement policies across the Rooms and Food and Beverage Divisions. These will be heavily influenced by the DNA of Hôtel Costes in Paris. Your input will be key to build and develop a culture of constant improvement, challenging the status-quo.

• Directly manage sales for rooms and private dining functions, ensuring targets are consistently met or exceeded.
• Drive sales and set clear, achievable sales goals. Develop and execute a sales plan that aligns with department objectives.
• Prepare and administer the sales budget, executing programs within defined limits as outlined in the budget plan.
• Maintain awareness of current and future competitors' product, pricing and marketing programs to be in a position to proactively respond to market conditions.
• Make sure that all sales functions such as sales, reservations and digital marketing teams, are aligned according to the financial goals & in terms of quality, message and timing.

Sales Responsibility Function

• Direct and coordinate the sales activities needed for the sales, private dining hire, groups, and reservations teams to maximize revenues.
• Allocate sales resources and funds strategically to maximize hotel revenue, based on current market conditions and forecasts.
• Develop a comprehensive sales strategy for rooms and private dining hire.
• Run sales reports regularly and analyse data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
• Build and maintain a database of strategic key accounts across all segments and regions, and establish relationships with them.
• Manage Sales Representation companies for the international markets, according to the need of the property. Brief the companies about company financial goals, competitive analyses, key messages, positioning, marketing & communication programs.
• Prepare room proposals, quotations, group proposals, hotel buyout quotes, and accommodation and catering contracts as needed to support reservations teams.
• Oversee partnerships with OTAs and collaborate closely to activate promotions, manage commission levels as needed, and increase visibility to maximize revenue.
• Support the Digital Marketing Executive in overseeing the performance and strategy of the Digital Marketing Agency, including managing paid campaigns (such as Google Ads), website traffic and ensuring all initiatives are aligned with revenue generation goals.

Budget Control & Owner reporting

• Prepare monthly and yearly sales budget, forecasts and sales plans in conjunction with the General Manager.
• Provide monthly financial and performance updates on the owners' reports, including action plans.

Client Relations and Strategic Partnerships

• Proactively seek out and establish strategic partnerships within luxury travel, luxury high-end brands, corporate, and entertainment segments to drive sales of rooms and food & beverage, enhancing hotel recognition and guest satisfaction.
• Conduct hotel tours for clients and partners to showcase rooms, food & beverage outlets, amenities, and enhance relationship-building.
• Create and manage a comprehensive annual plan for familiarization trips and visits by travel industry partners, ensuring consistent engagement and relationship building.
• Represent the hotel at roadshows, sales calls, and travel shows to promote the hotel's main USPs and highlighting the hotel’s competitive advantages, resulting in relationship and network building and bringing business leads.
• Attend networking events to prospect new business opportunities and establish relationships with new clients and business partners.
• Oversee the maintenance and update of photography assets to ensure they are current and compelling, contributing to enhanced website traffic and visual appeal.

New product launches

• Communicate with clients, business partners, and the travel industry about new menu launches, in-house brand activations, and special offers to drive traffic and revenue.

What are we looking for?

• Minimum 3–5 years' experience in a similar leadership role within a luxury hotel environment
• A proven passion for sales, marketing, and driving commercial performance
• Strong leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills
• French language skills are desirable but not essential
• Full-time position, working 48 hours per week, with flexibility to meet the needs of the business
• Willingness to travel within the UK and internationally as required

Who are we?

We are a 5-star luxury lifestyle boutique hotel located in the heart of Chelsea. Set in a 19th century building next to Sloane Square station and featuring a rooftop restaurant, an intimate cocktail bar, and thirty exceptionally designed bedrooms, the property has been elegantly restored to create unique experiences.

Within one of London’s most stylish interiors, the hotel combines the quintessentially British style of the Cadogan Estate with a unique French touch. Designed as an exceptional and inspiring destination, it highlights the distinguished and historic pedigree of the Sloane Square Conservation Area in a private and intimate setting.

Independently run, the hotel employs passionate, focused individuals with a determination to succeed. To assist us in hosting our wonderful clients, we are on the search for the ambassadors of this truly unique property. They will be given the opportunity to make their own mark while delivering an exceptional service of unparalleled quality.

*Upon successful completion of the probation period

*The service charge range fluctuates based on our forecasted business levels and may vary from month to month.

Permanent

Coventry

You will take the lead on mechanical engineering projects and new product introduction programmes, working closely with customers and internal engineering teams to deliver complex aerospace products from concept through to production.

title: Event Manager
description:
• Location: Remote, UK-wide, with occasional travel to events and team meet-ups
• Salary: Circa £50,000 pa
• Start date: Early 2027

We're looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Events Manager to join one of the fastest-growing and most dynamic membership bodies in the UK.

With our much-loved Events Manager retiring, we're looking for someone to build on their fantastic work and take the lead on delivering the cold chain industry's flagship events.

About the Cold Chain Federation

The cold chain is an essential part of everyday life, keeping food fresh, medicines safe and temperature-sensitive products moving across the UK. From refrigerated transport to temperature-controlled warehouses, the industry plays a vital role in protecting the nation's food supply, supporting public health and keeping businesses moving.

The Cold Chain Federation is the membership body for the UK's temperature-controlled supply chain, representing and supporting the businesses that make it all possible. Through our industry-leading events, we bring together professionals from across the cold chain to share knowledge, build connections, celebrate achievements and shape the future of this essential industry.

We're a small, ambitious and friendly team of eight, based across the UK. We pride ourselves on our supportive, collaborative culture, where everyone's contribution is valued, and we regularly come together at our events and occasional team meet-ups.

About the role

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive, you'll take ownership of the planning, management and delivery of our growing events programme.

Key responsibilities

• Own and manage the full events calendar, from initial concept and planning through to on-the-day delivery, including conferences and exhibitions with up to 500 delegates, awards ceremonies, networking events and webinars.
• Manage all aspects of event logistics, including venue selection, suppliers, catering, agenda, accommodation, staging, production and the attendee experience.
• Develop and manage event budgets, timelines and project plans, ensuring events are delivered on time, within budget and to a high standard.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with venues, suppliers, speakers, sponsors and other key stakeholders.
• Collaborate with the Marketing Manager on event promotion, branding, design and communications.
• Identify opportunities to enhance existing events, develop new concepts and support the continued growth of our events programme.
• Oversee event delivery on the day, ensuring everything runs smoothly and any challenges are resolved effectively.
• Evaluate event performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
• Support the production of our quarterly Cold Chain News magazine, including contributing a regular events column and liaising with the editor and advertisers.

About you

We're looking for an experienced, proactive and highly organised Events Manager who thrives on delivering exceptional events and enjoys working as part of a small, collaborative (and very supportive!) team.

You'll bring:

• At least five years' experience in event management, ideally with a strong background in delivering conferences, exhibitions or large-scale corporate events.
• Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple events and competing priorities.
• Proven experience managing event budgets, suppliers, contractors and external stakeholders.
• Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to engage with senior industry professionals, speakers and sponsors.
• A creative and innovative mindset, with the ability to develop fresh ideas and improve event experiences.
• Excellent attention to detail, alongside the ability to remain calm, adaptable and solutions-focused under pressure.
• Confidence working independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with colleagues.
• Strong digital skills, including proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with CRM and event management/registration platforms.
• A genuine team player who's happy to roll up their sleeves and support colleagues when needed.
• A willingness to travel across the UK and work flexibly during busy event periods.
• Experience within a membership organisation, trade association or B2B events environment would be an advantage, but isn't essential.

What we offer

• Salary circa £50,000 pa.
• Work from anywhere in the UK, with travel to events and occasional team meet-ups. You’ll also have the option to work in our small Reading Office, should you choose to, but this is not a requirement.
• Employer pension contributions matched up to 8%.
• 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays and a Christmas shutdown.
• Join a friendly, collaborative team where everyone is valued, ideas are welcomed, and colleagues genuinely support each other.

We plan to accept applications throughout November, with interviews taking place in December and a start date in early 2027. We may close applications early if we receive enough suitable candidates.

• Control access to high-value moments: presales, drops and VIP experiences
• Activate fandom into measurable, repeatable revenue

We are building the infrastructure for a new entertainment ecosystem, where artists own their audience, fans are rewarded for loyalty, and access is fair.

The Role

We're looking for an Artist Project Manager to own the delivery of fan3 campaigns across a roster of artists, from first brief to final report.

At any one time you'll be running several live campaigns for several artists: a presale for one, a release campaign for another, a VIP drop for a third, each with its own timeline, stakeholders and markets. Your job is to make sure every one of them lands on time, to spec and without surprises.

You'll be the person who holds the plan. You'll know what's due this week across every account, what's blocked, who owns it and what happens next. You'll sit between artists, managers and labels on one side and our product, engineering and creative teams on the other, and keep both moving in step.

This role suits someone who loves the music industry and gets real satisfaction from a complex launch running cleanly. Strategy matters here, but execution is the job.

What You'll OwnMulti-Artist Campaign Delivery

• Run multiple concurrent campaigns across multiple artists, markets and time zones
• Build and own detailed project plans for every campaign: scope, milestones, dependencies, owners and deadlines
• Maintain a single, always-current view of every live and upcoming campaign across your roster
• Prioritise ruthlessly when timelines collide, and flag trade-offs early rather than late
• Run campaign kick-offs, status check-ins and post-campaign reviews

Timelines & Detail

• Work backwards from fixed artist moments (announcements, presale windows, release dates, tour on-sales) to set realistic, locked timelines
• Track every deliverable to completion: assets, copy, approvals, integrations, test sign-offs and go-live checks
• Own pre-launch QA: links, wallet passes, push copy, access rules, regional settings and dates are right before anything reaches a fan
• Spot risks, gaps and inconsistencies before they become problems, and own the fix
• Keep clear, accurate documentation so anyone can see where a campaign stands at a glance.

Artist & Stakeholder Management

• Be the day-to-day lead for artists, managers and label teams on everything fan3 delivers for them
• Understand each artist's release cycles, touring plans and priorities, and map fan3 activity against them
• Set clear expectations on scope, timelines and what you need from them, and hold all parties to it
• Send concise, regular updates so no one is ever chasing you for status

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Brief and coordinate product, engineering and creative teams on every campaign
• Translate artist requirements into clear, actionable briefs and tickets
• Deploy and manage fan3 products: wallet passes, embedded web apps and fan UX, push notification campaigns and DSP integrations
• Manage hand-offs and dependencies so nothing falls between teams
• Feed artist needs and delivery learnings back into the product roadmap

Campaign Types

You'll deliver the full range of fan3 moments, including:

• Presales and ticket access
• VIP access and fan-first experiences
• Exclusive drops
• Pre-save and release campaigns

Performance & Reporting

• Define success metrics for each campaign before it launches
• Track conversion across the fan funnel (sign-up → engagement → purchase) and report results to artists and internally
• Turn fan data into insights and repeatable playbooks that make the next campaign faster and better
• Help reduce leakage, including secondary ticketing

Account Growth

• Build trusted, senior relationships with artists and their teams
• Identify opportunities to deepen platform usage and expand each account
• Act as the internal advocate for your artists, and as an ambassador for fan3 and its fan-first mission across the industry

What We're Looking For

• Proven project management experience, ideally at a music-tech platform, or in label marketing, artist management or a music agency
• A track record of running several projects at once for different clients or artists, with competing deadlines, and delivering all of them on time
• Exceptional attention to detail. You catch the wrong date in the push copy, the broken link and the mismatched presale window before anyone else sees them
• Strong timeline discipline. You build plans backwards from fixed dates, track dependencies and manage slippage before it becomes a missed deadline
• Highly organised, with confidence using project management tools (e.g. Monday, Asana, Notion or similar) to keep work visible
• Confident with fan data, analytics and campaign reporting. You can pull and read campaign performance, explain what it means and turn it into clear recommendations
• A deep understanding of release cycles, touring and fan behaviour
• Calm under pressure when launches are live, timelines move and multiple artists need you at once
• Clear, proactive communication with high-profile artists, managers and internal teams alike
• Commercial awareness: you understand how campaigns drive conversion and revenue, and you measure results
• Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

Nice to Have

• Experience delivering ticketing, presale or D2C fan campaigns
• Experience coordinating with product and engineering teams on technical launches
• Experience running multi-market or global campaigns across time zones
• Interest in emerging technology, especially AI, and the wider fan-engagement landscape

How We Work

We are intentional, ambitious and operate with high trust. We are a globally distributed, remote-first team.

You'll be given autonomy and ownership, and you'll be expected to take responsibility for outcomes. We value clarity, speed and collaboration, and we're building at the frontier of technology and culture.

Why This Role Matters

fan3 is redefining how artists own and monetise their audience. Every campaign we run is a promise to an artist and their fans.

This role makes sure we keep that promise, every time, across every artist on the roster.

title: Senior Commercial Analyst
description:
Who are 118118 Money?

At 118 118 Money, we are dedicated to helping Britain achieve financial fitness. In 2023, we proudly relaunched the iconic 118 118 twins, reaffirming our commitment to improving the financial health of individuals across the nation. Our loans and credit cards are designed specifically for those often overlooked by mainstream lenders, empowering over 800,000 customers on their journey to better financial well-being.

Our vision is to champion financial fitness throughout Britain by offering accessible products, valuable resources, and unwavering support. We are on a mission to provide fair and transparent credit solutions that promote financial well-being for all.

With an impressive 4.8 Trustpilot rating, we take pride in being an approachable lender, ready to provide clear financial support. If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and want to make a real difference in people's lives, keep reading—your next opportunity to contribute to our mission could be just a few clicks away!

What you’ll do:

You will collaborate with a team of industry leading experts to shape the commercial direction of our unsecured loans portfolio. As the analytical engine behind our growth initiatives, you will own the analysis of returns and product performance, assessing where we make money, where we don't and where the next pound of receivables should come from.

A key Commercial team member reporting to the Head of Loans, you will drive insight and change across the function, evaluating pricing, product and segment performance and turning findings into strategies that grow the book while improving customer outcomes.

AI and large language models such as Claude are core to how we work. You will use them throughout your analysis to accelerate your work, scale your reporting and pressure test your thinking, while critically challenging AI outputs and the underlying data to arrive at the right answer.

Key responsibilities and objectives:

• Own the commercial performance view of the loans portfolio, tracking revenue, net interest margin, delinquency, impairment and ROA by segment, product, price point and vintage and quantifying how credit performance flows through to profitability.
• Lead returns analysis on growth initiatives such as new price points, higher loan amounts and new products, sizing the opportunity, modelling the economics and tracking performance against the business case after launch.
• Deliver product analysis across the loans range, understanding how each product performs commercially across customer segments and recommending changes to design, pricing and positioning.
• Support portfolio strategy reviews, assessing the impact of pricing and product changes on both commercial outcomes and customer outcomes.
• Support the annual budget and reforecast cycles, using historic performance to shape the key inputs, including volumes, pricing, margin and loss assumptions and tracking actuals against them through the year.
• Identify and size growth opportunities across the customer lifecycle, including acquisition mix, retention and repeat lending.
• Collaborate with our Partnerships team to support and develop bespoke partnership strategies.
• Build and maintain commercial MI that gives senior stakeholders a reliable, current view of performance, using AI to automate and scale reporting.
• Stay up to date on market, pricing and product trends in near prime lending and identify opportunities to introduce innovative analysis techniques and AI tools to enhance team performance.

What you need:

• 3-4 years of experience working in consumer lending in a commercial, pricing, portfolio management or credit function. Analytics experience in other industries will be considered if strong analytical capability and business acumen can be demonstrated.
• Deep proficiency in SQL for large-scale data extraction and manipulation; experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake or similar) is a strong advantage.
• Proficiency using Excel and other Microsoft software.
• The ability to construct a coherent analytical narrative from complex, multi-dimensional data and present it clearly to a non-technical audience.
• An understanding of how to use AI in combination with the above skill set to deliver timely and accurate results that the business can rely on.
• Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and self-direction is expected.
• An aptitude for getting to the bottom of a particular problem, breaking it apart and understanding it, before designing and implementing a solution
• A proactive and collaborative approach and the ability to operate independently.
• Familiarity with FCA regulatory requirements, Consumer Duty, or IFRS 9 is a meaningful advantage.

What’s in it for you?

• A competitive salary
• Company bonus scheme - if the business does well, you should get rewarded for your hard work
• 25 days' annual leave, (plus bank holidays) increasing to 27 after two years service and 30 after five – your balance stars from day 1 so don’t delay and start planning your time off!
• Company pension scheme – we provide an enhanced pension scheme with generous employer contributions to set you up for the future which includes life cover of 4x your base salary
• Eye test – you can claim a freebie each year, or if your needs change
• Employee Assistance Programme - we offer membership to a recognised scheme to support you and your wellbeing
• A strong ethos of equality, diversity, and inclusion
• Wide business exposure, in terms of business disciplines, projects and stakeholders
• Direct contribution to business transformation and growth
• Huge learning and career progression opportunities
• Being valued as an individual from our team
• Full training, support and mentoring to develop a successful career in financial services

Like what you’ve heard? Great - apply now!

As a candidate, we know the interview process can be daunting and it’s important that you have a great experience with us. We will do all we can to make sure you are fully informed and excited by our story so we get to see the best from you. If you need any adjustments made to help you with the interview process, just let us know and we’ll do our best to accommodate them.

Following your application, we will want to learn more about you, your motivations, experiences, and values. In turn, you get to learn about our business, our culture, the role and what we can offer you.

If you think you’d be great for the role, but don’t necessarily tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, so apply today and take the first step towards an exciting future!

Equal Opportunity Employer

At 118 118 Money we are passionate about equality, diversity, and inclusion. We are committed to being representative of different cultures, background, lifestyles, and groups, where everyone has an equal chance to succeed. It is our policy to treat everyone fairly and to ensure no one is disadvantaged or receives less favourable treatment. We recognise that everyone has different needs and while we can’t accommodate every flexible working request we are more than happy to have a conversation about it

How we handle your data

118 118 Money requires your personal data to process your application for a position within our Company. If your application is successful through to telephone screening/interview, and you are not selected for a role, we may store your personal data for 12 months to enable our HR team to contact you should future roles be advertised.

Where you apply, but are not selected for telephone screening/interview, we will delete your personal data once the position is filled.

118 118 Money does not use automated decisioning or profiling when selecting candidates.

For your rights under GDPR please see our Privacy Policy

Please be aware that should we pursue your application, all our Financial Services employees will be expected to complete background checks to assess suitability for employment, these include; a criminal record, identity, sanctions, adverse finance, fraud prevention and reference checks to comply with our regulatory requirements.

title: Junior Finance Controller - Business Development
description:
Company Description

Publicis Media harnesses the power of modern media through leading agency brands Dysrupt, Infinite Roar, Publicis Collective, Publicis Health Media, Spark Foundry, Starcom and Zenith, as well as global accelerator PMX; immersive experience group PMCI and access to integrated platform-based technologies and offerings from CJ, Epsilon and Influential.

A key business solution of Publicis Groupe, Publicis Media’s digital-first, data-driven global solutions deliver client value and drive growth in a platform-powered world. It is present in over 100 countries with over 23,000 employees worldwide.

Overview

Reporting to: Global Media - Finance Manager

Location: 2 Television Centre 101 Wood Lane, London W12 7FR

The Opportunity

We are looking for a motivated and ambitious Junior Controller to join the Global Media HQ Finance team. Reporting to the Global Media Finance Manager, you will take ownership of a broad international scope combining entity controlling, financial planning, cost and recharge management, and business partnering.

You will support the end-to-end finance activities of Global Media HQ reporting units, with particular exposure to business-development-related costs and initiatives. The role brings together rigorous monthly reporting, forward-looking analysis and close collaboration with finance and operational stakeholders across the organisation.

This is a visible, hands-on opportunity for someone who enjoys turning detailed financial information into clear insight and dependable execution. You will contribute to stronger forecasting, disciplined cost management and practical process improvements while developing a broad foundation across controlling.

Why this role stands out

International exposure across finance, operations and business teams

Meaningful ownership of monthly reporting and forward-looking planning

A strong platform to develop financial controlling and business partnering skills

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Financial Controlling & Month-End

• Prepare monthly management accounts for Global Media HQ reporting units, covering operating costs, recharges and related financial flows.
• Manage month-end activities, including journal entries, account reviews, P&L updates and completion of required reporting schedules.
• Own monthly balance sheet reconciliations and investigate outstanding or unusual items through resolution.
• Partner with HR and Payroll teams on headcount and salary reconciliations, including joiners, leavers, transfers and required cost allocations.
• Monitor purchase orders, invoices and intercompany transactions and support timely, accurate billing and cost recognition.
• Maintain clear supporting documentation and contribute to robust financial controls and audit readiness.

Planning, Forecasting & Groupe Reporting

• Take ownership of the monthly rolling forecast, updating confirmed and pipeline personnel costs, operating expenses and recharge assumptions.
• Support annual budget and periodic forecast cycles, coordinating inputs with stakeholders and uploading approved submissions into HFM.
• Prepare P&L analysis and explain actual-versus-budget and actual-versus-forecast variances with clear commentary and recommended actions.
• Support Groupe reporting requirements, including flash reporting, short-term forecasts and the resolution of reporting mismatches.
• Help improve forecast accuracy, reporting consistency and the quality of management information.

Finance Support to Operations

• Provide financial support for ad-hoc requests from operational stakeholders.
• Partner with business stakeholders to track costs, commitments and financial impacts, ensuring appropriate visibility and timely follow-up.
• Support the allocation and recharge of eligible costs across reporting units or markets, maintaining clear documentation and audit trails.
• Contribute to financial analysis and ad-hoc requests that help the Finance Manager and business teams make informed decisions.

Business Partnering & Process Improvement

• Build effective relationships with finance, HR, Payroll and operational teams across the organisation.
• Communicate financial information clearly, tailoring the level of detail to the audience and highlighting risks, actions and ownership.
• Work proactively and as a key player, with stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and keep deliverables on track.
• Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and strengthen finance processes, reporting and stakeholder communication.

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

Experience

• Previous relevant experience in financial controlling, audit or accounting.
• Hands-on experience in management reporting, forecasting, P&L analysis and closing reconciliation.
• Experience working in a complex, international or multi-stakeholder environment.
• Exposure to intercompany transactions, cost recharges and to various levels of seniority

Technical & Professional Skills

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with detailed financial data.
• Advanced Excel capability, including financial models, reconciliations and variance analysis.
• Good understanding of ERP and financial planning systems such as SAP and Hyperion, or equivalent tools.
• Professional fluency in English, with clear written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines and respond constructively to changing requirements.

How You Work

You combine attention to detail with an understanding of the wider business context.

You take initiative, follow through on commitments and look for practical solutions.

You build trust through accuracy, transparency and constructive stakeholder engagement.

You are curious, adaptable and motivated to improve the way finance operates.

You enjoy collaborating across functions, cultures and levels of seniority.

What We Offer

A visible role within the Global Media HQ Finance organisation, with meaningful ownership from day one.

International exposure and collaboration with finance and operational stakeholders across multiple reporting units.

The opportunity to develop a broad skill set across controlling, operational support and business partnering.

A collaborative environment that values curiosity, continuous improvement and professional development.

Flexible working, with 4 days per week in the London office. Right to work in the UK.

Ready to make an impact?

Join Global Media Finance and help turn financial insight into stronger decisions, disciplined execution and sustainable growth.

Additional Information

Publicis Media offers a wide range of benefits to support our employees. Full details are shared when you join, but highlights include core benefits such as Pension, Life Assurance, and Private Medical cover, alongside enhanced policies like Reflection Days and Shared Parental Leave. You’ll also have access to a range of additional initiatives, including:

📖 Please check out the Publicis Career Page which showcases our Inclusive Benefits and our EAG’s (Employee Action Groups).

Publicis Groupe works primarily from the office or our clients' office four days per week.

At Publicis Media, we are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, disability, age, citizenship, relationship status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic.

We are committed to providing a fair, accessible, and inclusive recruitment process. If you have any access needs - for example, related to disability, neurodivergence, or a health condition - please let us know. We’ll work with you to ensure the process works for you. Sharing this information will never impact your application.

Guided by our values, we listen with empathy, uplift each other, take responsibility, and embrace change - building a culture where everyone feels seen, respected, and genuinely included.

title: Warehouse Operative - Erith
description:
Job Description

Warehouse Operative – Erith | Day and Night Shifts

As a Warehouse Operative with Ocado Logistics, you’ll play a vital role in preparing customer orders in our state-of-the-art fulfilment centre in Erith.

With day and night shifts available across a variety of departments, you can select the shift that best suits you. You’ll receive your work pattern 6 to 13 weeks in advance, giving you plenty of time to plan with family and friends.

Night-shift colleagues will also receive an enhanced premium for hours worked between midnight and 06:00.

What We’re Looking For

New to warehousing? No problem. Skills can be taught. Bring your positive attitude and we’ll support you every step of the way.

You must be 18 or over.

You must be able to handle meat and alcohol.

You must be able to travel to and from the site reliably for your scheduled shifts.

For your safety and the safety of others, you must be able to understand and follow Health & Safety briefings and operational instructions.

Please note that we operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to fulfil customer orders.

Available Roles

Inbound - Receive goods from suppliers and place them into totes ready for our robots and picking teams. You’ll help ensure stock is available and ready for customer orders

Days Inbound – 06:00 to 16:00

4 days per week as per roster

Nights Inbound – 18:00 to 06:00

4 nights per week as per roster.

Pick and pack customer orders into shopping totes with care and accuracy. Our technology and robotics help support the process, making it an exciting and fast-paced environment.

Days Pick – 06:00 to 15:00

4 days per week as per roster

Nights Pick – 18:00 to 06:00

4 nights per week as per roster

Despatch - Load customer totes into delivery frames ready for dispatch and organise returned totes from delivery routes. This is a physical role involving regular lifting and moving of goods, making it a fast-paced and active role.

Days Despatch – 06:00 to 17:00

4 days per week as per roster

Nights Despatch – 19:00 to 06:00

4 nights per week as per roster

What You’ll Receive

Basic rate: £12.93 per hour

Night-shift premium between midnight and 06:00: an additional £2.67 per hour

Overtime paid at 1.25x the basic rate

The opportunity to increase your earnings through our performance-based incentive scheme, where top performers receive additional hourly premiums

Benefits

Alongside a safe and supportive working environment, you’ll have access to a range of benefits, including:

Enhanced digital GP service for you and your dependants

Access to up to 50% of earned pay before payday for four-weekly paid colleagues

High street shopping and restaurant discounts, including 15% off Ocado.com

Up to 7% matched pension contributions after three months of service

Established car-share commuting scheme

Career Progression

If you’re looking to build a long-term career, there are plenty of opportunities to grow with us. In fact, 87% of our salaried roles are filled internally, demonstrating our commitment to developing our colleagues.

How To Apply

Simply complete our online application form. No CV is required.

A member of our friendly recruitment team will then be in touch to discuss the available day and night shifts and the next steps.

About Ocado Logistics

Here at Ocado Logistics, our people, technology and customers work side by side, supporting the amazing communities we serve. We’re all in it together, not afraid to roll up our sleeves, robots included, and get stuck in. Our people are incredibly diverse and come from all walks of life, with different stories and experiences.

We are proud to prioritise inclusivity and equal opportunities for all, ensuring a supportive and accessible workplace for people with disabilities. Whatever your background, experience or story, you’ll find a place to belong at Ocado Logistics.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Be part of our journey...

Location: St Mary's Stadium

What is the role?

We are seeking a Commercial Marketing Executive to take responsibility for the planning and delivery of effective marketing campaigns across three key commercial areas: Football Development, Conference & Events and The Dell Pub.

What will you be doing?

You will plan and deliver integrated marketing campaigns across our key commercial areas, using channels including the Saints app, website, email, organic social media and paid media, while also identifying opportunities to generate earned coverage through local press.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, you will understand their commercial objectives and translate these into engaging campaigns that reach the right audiences. You will develop creative briefs and work with our internal design studio, TURF, to produce engaging online and offline marketing materials. Is this you?

You will play an active role in promoting an inclusive, discrimination-free environment that ensures fair access to opportunities and resources. title: Future Workforce Analyst
description:
Future Workforce Analyst
£37,500 to £45,000 plus great benefits (Work Level 6A)
Manchester City Centre | Hybrid (splitting your time between home and the office as you see fit)

We're looking for a Future Workforce Analyst to join our Talent and Skills team in Manchester. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in shaping how our business understands, manages, and develops the skills needed for the future.

Using a combination of data analysis, colleague engagement, and external research, you'll help identify current and future skills needs across the business. You'll help make sure our skills frameworks remain accurate, relevant, and aligned to these changing needs. Working with colleagues right across Co-op, you'll turn complex data into meaningful insight, support governance processes, and help drive decisions that mean we can build a future-ready workforce.

Why this role matters

The world of work is changing faster than ever. Understanding the skills our colleagues have today, and the skills we'll need tomorrow, is critical to helping Co-op succeed in the future.

What you'll do

• Manage queries and challenges relating to skills mapping, tracking and triaging feedback from colleagues and leaders
• Analyse feedback, trends, and colleague insight to make informed recommendations on skills mapping and framework improvements
• Maintain accurate records of issues, decisions, actions and outcomes from governance forums and meetings
• Make sure all new roles have an approved skills profile that is signed off and established within Oracle
• Maintain the skills library and support ongoing reporting requirements
• Conduct regular reviews of non-catalogued skills and recommend updates where appropriate
• Produce high-quality data packs for governance forums, including insights, trends, risks and recommendations
• Present findings and facilitate discussions to support informed decision-making
• Research emerging skills, industry trends and external frameworks to keep Co-op's skills approach current and future-focused
• Produce clear, evidence-based proposals for governance forums when recommending changes to skills frameworks

What you'll bring

• Experience supporting or managing governance processes and forums
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data into meaningful insights and recommendations
• Experience gathering and interpreting feedback through focus groups, workshops, or other research methods
• Confidence presenting data, insights, and recommendations to colleagues at all levels of seniority
• Experience working with HR or HCM systems (e.g., Oracle)
• Good collaboration, communication, and relationship-building skills

Why Co-op?

At Co-op, we're owned by our members. And because we're owned by you, we can do right by you. So when you join us, you're not just taking a job, you're joining a movement. We're an organisation that puts people and communities first, and we're powered by purpose. We want this to be a place where you can thrive, so you'll also receive:

• An annual bonus scheme (based on personal and business performance)
• 28 days holiday (rising to 32 with service) plus bank holidays
• A pension with up to 10% employer contributions
• 30% discount on Co-op products and 10% off other brands
• Stream - early access to a percentage of your pay as you earn it
• Virtual healthcare including GP appointments, mental health support, nutrition and fitness advice
• 24/7 colleague support service
• Training and support for your development and career progression
• Cycle-to-work scheme

A place you'll belong

We're building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. We welcome applications from everyone, and our support centre is an inclusive environment where all our colleagues can thrive.

If you have a disability, we'll make reasonable adjustments to support you through the recruitment process. We're also proud to be part of the Disability Confident scheme - if you're disabled and you meet the minimum criteria for this job, we'll guarantee you an interview.

Learn more about our recruitment process at https://jobs.coop.co.uk/apply-process

Explore our commitments to diversity, inclusion and wellbeing at https://jobs.coop.co.uk/diversity-inclusion-wellbeing

As part of your application, you'll need to complete an online assessment. This assessment typically takes 15-20 minutes. If you're a current Co-op colleague, this does not need to be completed.

title: Tenancy Support Worker
description:
About The Role

Are you passionate about making a positive difference to people's lives? Do you want to work in a role where every day brings new challenges, opportunities and rewards?

We are looking for a committed and compassionate Tenancy Support Worker to join our Accommodation Service within Housing Solutions at North Northamptonshire Council.

The Accommodation Service plays a vital role in preventing and relieving homelessness across North Northamptonshire. We provide a range of accommodation and support services, including temporary accommodation, supported accommodation projects, rough sleeping services and tenancy sustainment support.

You will be joining a supportive and experienced team managed by the Accommodation Services Manager, alongside a Team Leader, three Senior Officers and a team of dedicated Tenancy Support Workers. Together, we work to help some of the most vulnerable members of our communities achieve stability, independence and positive outcomes.

This is a fantastic opportunity to build a rewarding career in housing, homelessness and support services while making a genuine impact on people's lives.

What will you be doing?

No two days are the same in this varied and rewarding role. You will provide practical, person-centred support to individuals with a history of rough sleeping and complex needs who are living within the Council's supported accommodation and temporary accommodation services.

Key Responsibilities Will Include

• Delivering one-to-one support sessions tailored to individual needs.
• Developing, reviewing and updating support plans and risk assessments.
• Undertaking welfare visits and property inspections.
• Supporting residents to access benefits, healthcare and specialist support services.
• Promoting independent living skills, wellbeing and tenancy sustainment.
• Working closely with partner agencies and attending multi-agency meetings.
• Supporting residents to overcome barriers and progress towards independent living.
• Identifying and responding appropriately to safeguarding concerns.
• Maintaining accurate case records and monitoring outcomes.

This is a role where you will build strong relationships, advocate for residents and help individuals take meaningful steps towards a more positive future.

About You

We are looking for someone who is empathetic, resilient and passionate about supporting people to achieve their goals.

You Will Have

• Experience of working with vulnerable people, ideally within housing, homelessness, support, social care or related services.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build positive relationships and maintain professional boundaries.
• An understanding of the challenges faced by people experiencing homelessness, rough sleeping or complex needs.
• The ability to manage a varied workload and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
• Good organisational and record-keeping skills.
• A commitment to safeguarding, equality, diversity and inclusion.
• A proactive, solution-focused approach and a genuine desire to help people improve their circumstances.

In return, you will gain valuable experience in homelessness prevention, housing support, tenancy sustainment, safeguarding and multi-agency working. We actively support learning and development through training opportunities, professional development and exposure to a broad range of housing services, providing excellent opportunities to progress into specialist, senior or management roles within the service.

If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career where you can make a real difference every day, we'd love to hear from you.

Our benefits

Here at North Northamptonshire Council, we’re transforming for the better, using all our creativity and imagination to create the best life for our local people.

You’ll find that we have a wide range of careers that may be more surprising than you think!

Why choose us?

We provide a range of great benefits such as an Employee Assistance Programme, an Employee Benefits Scheme, wellbeing support, travel rates at HMRC rates, as well as supporting a range of active Employee Network Groups.

title: Credit Modelling Actuary
description:
Job Description

Job Type: Fixed Term Contract (6 months)

Location: This role could be based in our London, Birmingham, Telford or Edinburgh offices with time spent working in the office and from home.

Flexible working: All roles are open to part-time, job-share and other types of flexibility. We will discuss what is important to you and balancing this with business requirements during the recruitment process. You can read more about flexible working here.

Salary and benefits: Up to £95,000 depending upon experience, plus an indicative bonus range of 16% to 32%, private medical cover, 38 days annual leave, excellent pension, 12x salary life assurance, career breaks, income protection, 3x volunteering days and much more.

Who are we?

We’re Standard Life, a retirement specialist focused entirely on retirement savings and income. We champion the belief that everyone’s journey to and through retirement can be better, and for more than 200 years, we’ve been helping our customers plan and prepare for their financial futures.

Life today is increasingly complicated, uncertain and unpredictable. People move through different careers, face unexpected moments and navigate important choices. We offer our colleagues flexibility, trust and benefits that work for whatever life brings. In return we expect curiosity, connection, accountability and high standards. We make room for what matters - so you can bring your best, every day.

The Role

In this role, you will support the Senior Actuary and Head of Credit Modelling in developing the Solvency II Internal Model approach for credit risk. You will work with teams across the business, including Asset Management, Risk and Finance, to identify, develop and implement methodology changes that enhance the capital efficiency of Standard Life’s Internal Model.

• Ensure Standard Life’s credit risk internal model remains compliant with the internal actuarial framework and Solvency regulatory requirements.
• Manage and oversee the annual credit model calibration and validation process, developing calibration proposals, securing governance approval and maintaining documentation to Solvency II standards.
• Promote and embed the use of the credit risk capital model across the business, supporting effective decision-making and risk management
• Collaborate with teams across the organisation to develop and implement capital methodologies for new asset classes and investment strategies, including significant model change initiatives.
• Develop and enhance the calibration and application of credit capital intensity factors for investment and pricing activities, while educating stakeholders and governance committees on key credit risk developments.
• Identify and deliver continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance capital efficiency, responding to emerging regulatory requirements, and owning the roadmap for minor model changes and future methodology developments.

What Are We Looking For

• Qualified actuary with knowledge of credit risk capital models, experience with capital modelling and rating methodology for illiquid assets
• Strong knowledge of SII requirements and Internal Model methodologies
• Knowledge of insurance and investment risk, capital management and their application within a life insurance environment.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts to a range of audiences.
• Ability to work collaboratively across teams to develop practical, commercially focused solutions.
• A proactive approach to problem solving, continuous improvement and delivering business outcomes.

Desirable

• Python, VBA experience

We Want To Hire The Whole Version Of You.

We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels accepted and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If your experience looks different from what we’ve advertised and you believe that you can bring value to the role, we’d love to hear from you.

If you require any adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know so we can help you to be at your best.

We’re reviewing applications as they come in, so apply early to avoid missing out.

title: Fashion and Visual Styling Specialist (Remote | $50–$105/hr)
description:
Fashion and Interior Styling Expert (Remote | $50–$105/hr)

Position: Fashion and Interior Styling Expert

Type: Contractor

Compensation: $50–$105 per hour

Location: Remote

About the Opportunity

micro1 is seeking experienced Fashion and Interior Styling Experts to evaluate fashion looks, wardrobe selections, interior spaces, and styling concepts based on quality, aesthetics, and alignment with specific creative briefs.

In this role, you will review fashion outfits, room setups, styling proposals, and design concepts to assess their suitability, visual appeal, proportions, color combinations, materials, and overall effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

• Evaluate fashion outfits, wardrobe selections, and interior setups against specific creative briefs, seasons, and client requirements.
• Assess proportions, fit, scale, color coordination, textures, and material selections.
• Review styling choices to ensure they are practical, functional, and appropriate for the intended setting.
• Identify unsuitable items, including incorrect sizing, inappropriate fabrics, or furnishings that do not fit the available space.
• Evaluate styling concepts based on budget, client expectations, and project requirements.
• Compare different looks and interior arrangements to determine which best meets the creative brief.
• Prepare and improve styling briefs, mood descriptions, and shopping lists.
• Provide clear written explanations and constructive feedback supporting each evaluation.

Required Qualifications

• Professional experience as a fashion stylist, wardrobe stylist, personal stylist, interior stylist, set stylist, prop stylist, or home stylist.
• Hands-on experience working on real styling projects involving briefs, sourcing, fittings, installations, or client deliveries.
• Strong understanding of fashion trends, interior aesthetics, proportions, colors, fabrics, materials, and spatial arrangements.
• Ability to evaluate styling concepts and explain why one look or space works better than another.
• Excellent written English communication skills.
• Strong attention to detail and creative judgment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with fashion brands, retail companies, editorial publications, production studios, or private clients.
• Background in fashion merchandising, interior design, visual styling, or creative production.
• Experience preparing mood boards, styling concepts, sourcing lists, and creative presentations.
• Understanding of practical styling considerations, including functionality, budget, materials, and client requirements.
• Strong analytical and visual evaluation skills.

Compensation & Engagement

• Hourly Pay: $50–$105 per hour.
• Engagement Type: Independent Contractor.
• Work Arrangement: Fully Remote.
• Availability: 50 openings.
• Location: Worldwide.

Application & Selection Process

• Application: Submit your updated resume and a short professional profile highlighting your relevant styling experience.
• Curation Interview: Complete a short conversation about your professional experience and expertise.
• Experience Review: The team will assess your qualifications and experience against the project's requirements.
• Onboarding: Selected candidates will receive project guidelines and complete an initial task, which will be reviewed before proceeding with further assignments.

• Contribution Pension Scheme

Born of a simple gesture in 1976, L’Occitane en Provence reveals the living power of flora, where the light of the sun meets the richness of the earth. With Trust as our foundation, Curiosity as our compass, Excellence as our standard, we create lasting Impact for the people around us and our planet.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
About the role

Location: Essex / remote-first (hybrid, no fixed office days)

Salary: £28,000 - £35,000 depending on experience

Job type: Full-time, permanent

Reports to: Managing Director

We are looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Executive to own a portfolio of client accounts and the marketing that runs through them.

Better Agency is a full-funnel, multi-channel digital marketing agency working with established B2B businesses across logistics, construction and building materials, legal, property, technology and professional services. We cover SEO and AI search, paid search and paid social, creative and design, website builds, HubSpot and CRM.

This is a client-facing role first. You will be the named owner on your accounts from early on: setting the agenda, running the call, presenting the reporting, logging the actions and chasing them down internally. You will not be sitting behind someone else's account. You will work alongside our Managing Director, Business Development Director and Digital Marketing Manager, who are there to back you up, but the accounts are yours.

The other half of the role is delivery. We want a genuine multi-disciplinary marketer: strong copy, social, email, a working grasp of SEO and content performance, and enough breadth to know what good looks like across channels and when to pull in a specialist.

It suits someone who has worked in-house or in a smaller agency team, is used to wearing several hats and wants a portfolio of their own rather than a slice of someone else's.

What you will be doing

• Owning a portfolio of client accounts as the day-to-day point of contact
• Setting agendas, leading weekly and fortnightly status calls and owning the follow-up actions
• Presenting monthly performance reporting and talking confidently about what the numbers mean
• Planning, writing and editing marketing copy for websites, blogs, social, email and campaign assets
• Building and scheduling email campaigns in HubSpot or Mailchimp
• Supporting on-page SEO and content performance tracking
• Briefing designers, content writers and performance marketers, and keeping work moving to deadline
• Contributing ideas across integrated campaigns and spotting opportunities on your accounts
• Keeping internal trackers and client documentation up to date

About you

• 2 to 5 years' marketing experience, in-house or agency
• Confident and credible on a client call, including when something has gone wrong
• A strong writer with a solid grasp of tone of voice and messaging
• Organised and proactive, comfortable holding several accounts and deadlines at once
• Able to read a performance report and explain it without needing it translated for you first
• Familiar with CMS platforms such as WordPress
• Confident with email tools such as HubSpot, Mailchimp or Klaviyo
• Good foundational SEO knowledge and an understanding of how content drives search performance
• Comfortable using AI tools for ideation and productivity, and knowing when to check the output
• Friendly, approachable and naturally collaborative

Bonus points if you have

• Agency experience
• Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Semrush or HubSpot
• Some exposure to paid social or paid search
• Design or Canva experience
• A portfolio of previous work or campaign examples

What we offer

• Remote-first and hybrid working, with no fixed office days
• 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays and your birthday off
• 9am to 5pm Monday to Thursday, 9am to 3pm Friday after probation
• Genuine development and progression as the agency grows
• Annual summer and Christmas parties with the whole group
• Regular team socials and meet-ups

﻿

Location and working pattern

Essex and remote-first. We work remotely day to day, but we attend client meetings and get the team together, so you need to be close enough to reach us and our clients when it matters. There are no fixed office days.
