group: capital credit union|marketing business development executive
title: Marketing Business Development Executive
description:
This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading and ambitious Credit Union in South Dublin with more 58,000 members and over €300 million in assets.

The Credit Union is looking to hire a dynamic Marketing and Business Development Executive with at least two years’ experience who will work closely with the Marketing Manager to implement the marketing plan and be an ambassador for the Credit Union

FUNCTION

Reporting to the Marketing Manager, the Marketing and Business Development Executive will support the delivery of Capital Credit Union’s marketing and business-development strategy. The role will include digital and traditional campaigns, community initiatives and business partnerships to strengthen brand awareness, member engagement and sustainable growth. The postholder will also assist in monitoring campaign performance, identify improvement opportunities and ensure, together with the Marketing Manager, that marketing activity meets regulatory and internal requirements.

REQUIREMENTS

The successful candidate will be a proactive self-starter with strong personal and interpersonal skills and ideally an understanding of the Credit Union ethos and values.

Essential

• A degree or equivalent qualification in marketing, communications, community or co-operative development, business, or comparable relevant experience.
• At least two years’ relevant marketing experience, including planning and delivering campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
• Excellent communication skills, verbal and written, with the ability to adapt messages for different audiences.
• Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, work independently and meet deadlines while remaining effective under pressure.
• Ability to work co-operatively as part of a team and manage relationships with internal stakeholders, community partners, suppliers and agencies.
• Practical experience with social media, CRM systems, email-marketing platforms, website content-management systems and digital analytics, together with strong Microsoft Office skills.
• Experience using campaign data and key performance indicators to evaluate performance, identify opportunities for innovation and recommend improvements.
• Creative and conceptual thinking, with awareness of current marketing technologies, channels and trends.
• A full clean driving licence and access to transport, as travel within the Credit Union’s catchment area will be required.

Desirable

• Experience in the Credit Union, financial-services or another regulated sector.
• Experience across community engagement disciplines, including events, public meetings, consultation, communications and reputation management.
• Knowledge of data-protection requirements, advertising standards and compliance considerations relevant to financial-services marketing.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

MARKETING

• Support the delivery of marketing and business-development campaigns, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, monitoring results and identifying opportunities to improve performance.
• Assist in the management of digital marketing activity across social media, email campaigns, website content, SEO and digital advertising, creating targeted content with support from external partners.
• Use CRM data, member insights, campaign metrics and market research to strengthen engagement, increase product awareness, support membership growth and recommend compliant, innovative initiatives.

COMMUNITY

• Support youth and community initiatives, including the School Quiz, Higher Education Scholarship and other local programmes.
• Administer sponsorship applications and support the Community Council, volunteers and projects responding to community needs.
• Organise engaging events that strengthen Capital Credit Union’s visibility and positive impact across its catchment areas

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

• Promote Capital Credit Union and its mortgage and business lending products throughout the community while building relationships with local businesses.
• Collaborate with external partners to identify and develop revenue opportunities aligned with the Credit Union’s strategy, values and member focus

The role combines marketing, community engagement and business development responsibilities, with activity across all three areas contributing to stronger member engagement, brand awareness and sustainable growth.

The above summary job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of duties and responsibilities. The post holder may be required to perform other duties as appropriate to the post which may be assigned to them from time to time. The job description may change in line with the evolving needs and objectives of the Company.

SALARY & BENEFITS

Capital Credit Union offers a generous remuneration package, including salary, pension and other benefits commensurate with the role and benchmarked against the market. Salary is negotiable, depending on experience.

CONTRACT & HOURS

This is initially a 12 month fixed term contract, with potential for extension.

The normal working week will be 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Flexibility in working hours will be required to attend meetings and represent the Credit Union at functions and events outside normal working hours. The role involves periodic weekend work and periodic evening work as required.

LOCATION

The role is based in South Dublin.

HYBRID/REMOTE WORKING

The role is considered by the Credit Union as unsuitable for hybrid or remote working. Thus, the requirement is to be on-site at the offices of the Credit Union or representing the credit union in various locations as required.

APPLICATION PROCESS

Please submit your CV and cover letter, outlining your suitability for the role, to recruitment@capitalcu.ie, using “Marketing & Business Development Executive” as the subject line.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview and will be required to provide satisfactory references.

CLOSING DATE

The closing date for applications is 5pm, Monday the 16th November 2026.

Capital Credit Union is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.

title: Core Data Engineer
description:
Flow Traders is looking for a Core Data Engineer to own the end-to-end lifecycle of our most fundamental data products, including our Security Master; our reconciled ETF Compositions; high-resolution historical market data; and records of our trades, orders, quotes, and inquiries. High-quality data is the cornerstone of Flow Traders' strategic direction - beyond reducing complexity and BAU for stakeholders across the organization, quality data is a key requirement for our growth of quantitative trading styles.

Specifically, you will craft and execute the blueprint for these products, leveraging our Data Platform to build and monitor automated pipelines which ensure that users across the organization have reliable data at their fingertips when they need it. Further, you will become an expert in these data sets, leveraging that knowledge to optimize our use of the data we have and explore new sources for additional value. Finally, you will constantly collaborate with teams across the organization to ensure that our in-house systems are designed with data in mind, streamline additional data-related workflows, and work with stakeholders to maximize the value they extract from our data.

As the architect and guardian of our most valuable data, you will have a unique opportunity to make your mark on Flow Traders. You will be accountable for delivering these data products at an exceptional level of quality, ensuring that they are not only timely and pristine, but powerful enough to drive Flow Traders' future growth. Ultimately, your work will not only provide highly visible benefits that every division feels every day, but it will also deliver one of the most important building blocks to the firm's strategic growth for the years to come.

What you will do

• Craft datasets with quants. Take an underspecified research question and turn it into the right dataset: aligned, adjusted, point-in-time correct, documented, and reproducible.
• Develop and own the end-to-end lifecycle of these data products. Build and maintain pipelines, develop quality checks, correct day-to-day operational issues, and systematize/automate manual processing steps
• Own data quality where it matters. Design the checks and alerts that catch the problems that would actually hurt a strategy, and deliberately leave out the ones that are just noise.
• Build shared foundations. Reference data, instrument identifiers, corporate actions and vendor feeds that every researcher and trading desk depends on.
• Keep critical pipelines running. Markets in several regions, and digital asset markets that never close, depend on this data. You will be part of a team that supports it across time zones.

What you need to succeed

Required

• Analytics or data engineering experience, ideally at a startup or scale-up through a growth phase
• Strong data modelling and data quality practice: tests, contracts, lineage, observability in production
• Strong proficiency in Python (ideally familiarity with another statically-typed language)
• Working proficiency with SQL and relational databases, and version control systems
• Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets and familiarity with big data solutions
• You have owned something in production, not only built it
• You enjoy working directly with the people who use your data
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Ability to balance individual stakeholder requirements with data quality, consistency, and broad applicability
• Over 5 years experience working in data engineering

Strongly Preferred

• Experience with financial data: prices, market data, transactions, instruments
• Familiarity with point-in-time data, look-ahead bias and survivorship bias
• Experience with a modern cloud data stack, such as Spark or Databricks, dbt, a cloud warehouse, and orchestration
• Experience with Airflow, Kafka, and GCP (esp. GKE, Dataproc, and Big Query), strongly preferred
• Experience with Polars, Pandas, Spark, Apache Beam, Apache NiFi
• Experience at a trading firm, systematic fund, brokerage, crypto exchange or market data company
• On-call or incident response experience

What We Offer

At Flow Traders, we create the conditions for hard‑working, high‑performing people to do their best work. From a thorough onboarding and ongoing access to Flow Academy, to latest technology and a collaborative, non‑hierarchical culture, we give you the tools, ownership, and support to move fast and drive outcomes. We keep a close‑knit, small‑company feel while offering competitive salary, annual discretionary profit share, and comprehensive benefits, so talent can grow here, and stay here. See our benefits below:

• Flow Academy and opportunities to attend domain-related conferences
• Daily catered lunch, great coffee, and a fully stocked kitchen and snack bar
• In-house Bar and Lounge with arcade, table tennis, billiards, and game consoles
• Company boat
• In-house gym and sessions with our nutritionist or personal trainer
• Bi-weekly massages
• Annual company trip and a variety of events throughout the year, such as the New Years Event
• Global rotations across our offices worldwide
• and more

Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

title: Executive Personal Assistant
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced, professional and proactive Executive Personal Assistant to provide dedicated support to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of an established organisation based in Leicester.

This is a key position of trust, requiring an individual who has extensive experience supporting senior executives or Board-level leaders and is confident handling highly confidential and commercially sensitive information.

The successful candidate will be exceptionally organised, discreet and self-sufficient, with the ability to anticipate the CFO's needs, manage competing priorities and operate effectively within a busy and complex business environment.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have previously supported a CFO, CEO, Finance Director, Partner or other senior executive and understand the demands, responsibilities and discretion required at this level.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide comprehensive, high-level PA and administrative support to the CFO, ensuring the smooth and efficient management of their day-to-day activities.
• Manage a busy and frequently changing diary, coordinating meetings, appointments and commitments while proactively resolving scheduling conflicts.
• Act as a trusted point of contact for the CFO, managing communications and liaising professionally with senior internal and external stakeholders.
• Handle highly confidential, sensitive and commercially important information with absolute discretion and professionalism.
• Organise and coordinate senior management and Board-level meetings, including preparing agendas, collating documentation, taking minutes and following up on actions where required.
• Manage correspondence, emails and enquiries, prioritising matters appropriately and exercising sound judgement when handling sensitive issues.
• Prepare, format and proofread reports, presentations, correspondence and other executive documentation to a consistently high standard.
• Coordinate travel arrangements, accommodation, itineraries and associated logistics where required.
• Proactively anticipate the CFO's requirements, identifying potential issues and taking appropriate action before they arise.
• Monitor deadlines, follow up on outstanding actions and ensure important tasks and commitments are completed efficiently.
• Build and maintain effective working relationships across the organisation, demonstrating professionalism, diplomacy and approachability.
• Take ownership of administrative processes and continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency and executive support.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Significant experience as an Executive PA or senior-level Personal Assistant, ideally supporting a CFO, CEO, Finance Director, Board member, Partner or equivalent senior leader.
• Demonstrable experience working in a position of considerable trust, regularly handling highly confidential and commercially sensitive information.
• Previous experience within a medium to large organisation, ideally employing at least 150–200 people, with an understanding of complex business structures and senior stakeholder relationships.
• Excellent diary management and organisational skills, including experience supporting executives with demanding and frequently changing schedules.
• Strong judgement, discretion and emotional intelligence, with the confidence to handle sensitive situations appropriately.
• A proactive and forward-thinking approach, with the ability to anticipate requirements rather than simply respond to instructions.
• Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and competing demands calmly and effectively.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence engaging with senior executives and external stakeholders.
• A high level of independence, initiative and personal accountability.
• Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• A professional, polished and diplomatic manner, combined with the ability to develop positive working relationships at all levels.

Desirable Experience

• Previous experience supporting a CFO or another senior finance executive.
• Experience within professional services, legal, financial services or a similarly structured corporate environment.
• Exposure to Board meetings, executive leadership teams and senior-level reporting.
• Experience working within a business where confidentiality, governance and commercial sensitivity are particularly important.

title: Validation Analyst
description:
Salary: £42,625.09 - £56,833.45

Closing Date: 18th November

NATS is the UK’s leading air navigation service provider, handling over 2.4 million flights each year. We provide air traffic control services from two control centres and at airports around the UK. We also provide a wide range of commercial products and solutions internationally. Our people are at the heart of our purpose to advance aviation and keep the skies safe.

Purpose of the Role

This role is part of NATS’ Air Traffic Management (ATM) Validation Team, responsible for planning, executing and reporting on assigned tasks in order to provide user-centric validation assurance in support of the delivery of NATS’ Long-Term Investment Plan (LTIP), SESAR led Research & Development and external business.

The role holder will be assigned tasks and activities across several work packages in support of the NATS LTIP and other important programmes (eg SESAR and/or external business), needs to be flexible in approach to work and able to travel to undertake activities at any NATS site along with our partners and supplier locations which may be overseas.

Accountabilities

• The job holder contributes to the provision of independent user-led validation assurance to give confidence that changes will meet the acceptance criteria.
• Lead the planning and delivery of ATM Validation tasks and activities as directed.
• Completes assigned tasks within agreed timescales, to the required level of quality and satisfaction of the relevant task or project manager.
• Helps anticipate and solve routine and non-routine technical problems and suggests appropriate improvements to methods and analysis.
• Contributes to the planning, design, implementation and reporting of complex technical tasks under the supervision of the relevant task manager. Identifies conflicts and escalates concerns and issues as appropriate to the relevant task manager, team leader or project manager.
• Provide management support and technical expertise within the ATM Validation Team to ensure that team and individual capability and performance is maximised; relationships outside the department are developed and strengthened.
• Contributes to continuous improvement, proactively suggesting appropriate improvements to processes and activities, considering a variety of innovative and creative solutions.
• Supports less experienced colleagues. For example, this may be in the form of supervision and guidance of new graduates or industrial placement students, providing on the job training and knowledge transfer.
• Develops and maintains technical and professional expertise and applies this appropriately to tasks.

Qualifications, Professional Knowledge And Skills

• Good honours degree in a numerate subject (which could be scientific or business oriented) or equivalent (e.g. other qualifications or relevant work experience).
• Good understanding of Validation principles and methodologies and the ability to apply these to multiple customer areas.
• Ability to produce well documented, high-quality work, and appreciate when work is of a sufficient standard.
• Good communication and presentation skills with an ability to engage and influence peers and managers.
• Good team working skills with an ability to appreciate different points of view. Can support less experienced colleagues
• An ability to actively contribute in an effective team culture, by showing a willingness to participate, supporting goals and responsibilities of the team.
• A general knowledge of the NATS' organisation and the department’s customers. A basic understanding of the interactions within the organisation and how the department fits into the wider organisation.
• Appreciation of the importance of generating and applying best practice including use of the NATS Business Management System (BMS). An understanding of the need for continuous improvement with a track record of improving process to increase effectiveness and efficiency.
• Effective time management capability with an ability to identify and balance competing priorities.
• Good analytical, financial awareness, problem solving and decision-making skills.

All staff at NATS are subject to UK Security Vetting and Clearance (SC) and must maintain valid clearance throughout employment. We are unable to progress applications where an applicant does not meet eligibility requirements for clearance. For further guidance click here Security Clearance - NATS

title: Event Manager
description:
About The Role

Purpose of the job

To lead the end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of B2B conferences in EMEA. The role covers pre-event planning and supplier management through to onsite delivery, post-event reporting and reconciliation, with every event running on time, within budget and to the standard PEI’s investor audiences expect.

Responsibilities and duties

Event planning and logistics

• Lead end-to-end planning across multiple events at once, keeping each project on schedule and within budget
• Act as primary venue contact, managing floorplans, F&B selections and venue function sheets
• Plan event signage, staff briefings and internal updates, and organise external receptions and ancillary events
• Ensure risk assessments, health and safety requirements and contingency plans are in place for every event

Supplier management

• Source and negotiate with venues, AV, stand contractors and signage suppliers, maximising savings while maintaining service levels
• Oversee third-party suppliers against project deadlines and act as quality control for all delivered work

Onsite delivery

• Lead the team onsite, managing staff and key suppliers and resolving speaker, sponsor and delegate queries
• Be onsite for all event days, nationally and internationally as required

Sponsorship

• Work with the sponsorship and client relations teams to deliver all sponsor entitlements, including branding, exhibition stands and meeting spaces
• Cost any new inventory requirements

Event technology and data

• Build and manage the event app and attendee portal with third-party providers, including delegate lists, agendas and speaker information
• Create and send attendee communications
• Maintain accurate attendee records in the CRM and handle delegate data in line with data protection requirements

Stakeholder collaboration

• Build strong working relationships with Marketing, Content/Production, Delegate Sales and Sponsorship
• Work with Marketing to keep the conference website and event app accurate and up to date
• Give your line manager regular updates on event progress

Financial management

• Manage event budgets $300k+, including forecasting, reforecasting, and pre- and post-event updates
• Reconcile and process invoices promptly so suppliers are paid on time
• Contribute to post-event P&L and to budgeting for future editions

Post-event and continuous improvement

• Deliver post-conference materials to speakers, delegates and sponsors
• Produce post-event reports covering budget performance, delegate feedback and supplier performance
• Champion best-practice processes across the team and cross-functionally

About You

Experience & Skills

Qualifications & Experience:

• At least 3 years’ experience in B2B events as an Event Manager or equivalent, ideally in a conference or exhibition setting
• Proven experience as sole lead on events of 500+ attendees, managing everything from registration, speakers, sponsors and venue through to on-the-day delivery
• Experience delivering multiple events at the same time
• Budget management experience, including forecasting, invoice reconciliation and post-event analysis
• Experience managing third-party contractors such as venues, AV suppliers and stand builders
• Experience building and managing event apps and attendee platforms
• Working knowledge of CRM systems

Personal Attributes:

• Strong onsite leader who stays calm under pressure
• Excellent written and verbal communicator
• Highly organised and able to balance competing deadlines across several projects
• Collaborative, working effectively across multiple teams
• Commercially minded, finding value without compromising quality
• Friendly and approachable, with high personal standards and a drive to keep improving
• Keen to stretch themselves and build a career in a high-growth business

Benefits:

• 25 days of annual leave plus 8 bank holidays, with additional leave for long service and a gifted Christmas break
• 10 days rolling sick leave
• Holiday flex option to buy or sell up to 3 days of leave
• Employee incentive reward program (EIRP) tied to future exit events
• 4 paid volunteer days per year
• On site 24/7 gym with classes and full facilities
• Life insurance (4x basic salary) and 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
• Private medical insurance (post-probation), annual eye tests and DSE eyewear allowance
• Pension scheme with 4.5% matched contributions and enhanced matching over time
• Cycle to work scheme, interest-free travel loan and employee referral bonus

title: Warehouse Team Leader
description:
Who We Are

At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.

Our Global Reach

JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

What We Offer

Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities

Operations & Workflow

Lead, coordinate, and monitor the activities of warehouse staff.

Allocate tasks, set daily priorities, and ensure deadlines are met.

Oversee receiving, picking, packing, replenishment, loading, and dispatch operations.

Ensure accuracy of orders and inventory through regular checks and cycle counts.

Team Leadership & Development

Motivate and guide team members to achieve performance targets.

Train new employees on warehouse procedures, equipment, and safety standards.

Provide feedback, coaching, and participate in performance reviews.

Promote teamwork, communication, and a positive work culture.

Safety & Compliance

Enforce health and safety policies and maintain a clean, hazard-free environment.

Ensure compliance with company SOPs, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

Report and investigate incidents, near misses, or safety concerns.

Administration & Reporting

Assist with shift planning, resource allocation, and attendance tracking.

Monitor KPIs such as accuracy, productivity, and order turnaround times.

Prepare reports on stock levels, workflow performance, and operational issues.

Communicate effectively with supervisors, drivers, and other departments.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Proven experience in a warehouse or logistics role, preferably in a team-leading capacity.

Strong understanding of warehouse operations, inventory processes, and equipment.

Ability to lead, motivate, and develop a team.

Good problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

Proficient with warehouse management systems (WMS) and basic computer tools.

Strong communication and organisational skills.

At JINGDONG Logistics, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: ADHD Nurse Prescriber
description:
Non-Medical Prescriber (NMP) – ADHD Medication Initiation & Titration
Location: Salford, Greater Manchester (Onsite)

Rate:

• £65 per ADHD medication initiation appointment (approximately 45 minutes)
• £40 per ADHD medication titration appointment (30-minute slots)

About the Opportunity
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Non-Medical Prescriber (NMP) specialising in ADHD to join a growing clinical service based onsite in Salford.

The service is seeking a qualified and experienced prescriber who has demonstrable experience working with both children and adults with ADHD, particularly in relation to medication initiation and titration.

This opportunity would suit an experienced ADHD prescriber looking for flexible, session-based work within a specialist clinical environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct ADHD medication initiation appointments for children and adults.
• Undertake medication titration appointments, monitoring patients' responses to prescribed medication.
• Assess patients' suitability for ADHD medication in line with clinical guidelines and prescribing protocols.
• Review medication effectiveness, tolerability and potential side effects.
• Provide appropriate clinical advice and guidance to patients and, where appropriate, their families or carers.

Essential Requirements

• Qualified Non-Medical Prescriber (NMP) with an appropriate prescribing qualification.
• Demonstrable experience prescribing ADHD medication.
• Experience working with both paediatric and adult ADHD patients.
• Experience in ADHD medication initiation and titration.
• Strong clinical assessment, decision-making and prescribing skills.
• Excellent communication and patient engagement skills.
• Ability to work onsite in Salford.

All appointments will be conducted onsite in Salford. Candidates must be able to commute to the clinic.

Interested? If you are an experienced ADHD Non-Medical Prescriber with experience supporting both children and adults, and are interested in flexible session-based work, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV for consideration, highlighting your ADHD prescribing experience and availability.

title: Finance Systems Analyst
description:
Our Story

Hello there. We’re Zopa.

We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com!

We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.

If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

Our Finance Systems team supports the systems and data flows that Finance relies on for reporting and business change. Working across Finance, Technology and Product, the team helps turn changing requirements into practical solutions.

As we invest in a new general ledger and data platform, you’ll help keep existing systems running while contributing to the future of our finance function.

A day in the life

• Monitor finance systems, investigate alerts and help resolve issues affecting data flows and reporting.
• Carry out system administration and month-end controls, documenting access and changes.
• Investigate the root cause of data and reconciliation issues, and propose practical solutions.
• Work with Finance, data and Technology colleagues to understand requirements and agree priorities.
• Contribute to preparation and testing for the new general ledger and wider systems change.
• Support new reporting requirements and product launches, balancing interim fixes with longer-term improvements.
• Explore opportunities to automate processes, with appropriate checks and controls.

About you

• You understand finance, accounting and reporting processes and can apply that knowledge to systems or data problems.
• Enjoy investigating unclear problems and can explain your findings and recommendations.
• Approach system changes carefully, with attention to testing, documentation and controls.
• Organise competing requests and communicate clearly with a range of stakeholders.
• You take ownership, seek support when needed and are keen to learn new systems and ways of working.

Bonus points for

• Experience administering finance systems or supporting SAP.
• Working knowledge of SQL, visualisation or reconciliations across data sources.
• Exposure to financial services, regulated environments or ERP migrations.
• Experience with automation, AI, Snowflake, Python or dbt.

#LI-LK1

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Senior Technical Expert (m/w/d)
description:
WAS DU BEI UNS MACHST

Als Senior Technical Expert bist du unser technischer Experte im Außendienst! Mit deinem Know-how in der Messtechnik und dem Energiemanagement analysierst und validierst du komplexe Liegenschaften. Dabei übernimmst du die Verantwortung für fundierte Diagnosen, lieferst unseren Kunden Top-Beratung und stellst die Einhaltung aller relevanten rechtlichen Vorgaben sicher.

• Du analysierst die messtechnischen Voraussetzungen komplexer Liegenschaften und erstellst fundierte Diagnosen für die korrekte Abrechnung und Anlagentechnik. Gleichzeitig validierst du bestehende Diagnosen direkt vor Ort anhand der tatsächlichen Gegebenheiten im Sinne des Energiemanagements.
• Für Vertrieb, den Innendienst und unsere Kunden bietest du technische Top-Beratung – besonders bei komplexen technischen und abrechnungstechnischen Fragen.
• Du gehst technischen Problemen in Liegenschaften auf den Grund, führst detaillierte Fehleranalysen durch und leitest klare Lösungsmaßnahmen ab.
• Um die Compliance sicher zu stellen, gleichst du die technischen Gegebenheiten mit den Vorgaben der Heizkostenverordnung und allen relevanten rechtlichen Regelungen bei Kundenbeschwerden ab.
• Du bist Meister in der Beurteilung von Einbausituationen, prüfst und berätst zu Montagemängeln und bewertest Schäden– entweder direkt vor Ort oder anhand von Bildmaterial.
• Im Sinne unserer Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie berätst du gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb unsere Kunden zur Umrüstung ihrer Liegenschaften auf energieeffiziente, CO₂-arme Ausstattungen.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Anlagenmechaniker SHK, Mechatroniker/in für Kältetechnik, Klempner, Heizungsbauer, Elektriker für Gebäudetechnik o.ä.) mit Weiterbildung (Techniker, Meister, Studium etc).
• Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der technischen Betreuung komplexer Liegenschaften, in der Messtechnik oder im Energiemanagement.
• Mit der Heizkostenverordnung, einschlägiger Normen und Abrechnungsvorgaben kennst du dich gut aus.
• Du konntest bereits Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt (Beratung, Support, Außendienst) sammeln.
• Deine ausgeprägte Problemlösekompetenz ermöglicht es dir, auch bei komplexen technischen Fragestellungen schnell und effektiv Lösungen zu entwickeln und diese zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln.
• Eine sorgfältige Dokumentation und strukturierte Arbeitsweise runden dein Profil ab.
• Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B und bringst Flexibilität sowie Bereitschaft mit, regionale Vor-Ort-Termine wahrzunehmen.
• Deine Deutschkenntnisse sind in Wort und Schrift sehr gut.

WAS WIR BIETEN

• Firmenwagen mit Privatnutzung.
• Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit viel Raum für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten.
• Effiziente Teamarbeit durch flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und engagierte Kollegen.
• Work-Life-Balance: flexible Arbeitszeiten (Gleitzeit - Starte zwischen 7-9 Uhr) und 30 Tage Urlaub.
• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeber-Zuschuss für deine zusätzliche Absicherung.
• Du bekommst von uns eine zugeschnittene Einarbeitung mit allen notwendigen Trainings und Qualifizierungsmaßnahmen.
• Zahlreiche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten dank eines starken Expansionskurses und einem komplexen Umfeld, in dem sich immer wieder neue Themenfelder ergeben.
• Du arbeitest in modernen Büroräumlichkeiten mit ergonomischen Arbeitsplätzen und bester Hardware von Apple.
• Mitarbeiterrabatte bei über 1200 Anbietern wie Zalando, Adidas, Apple & Co - da ist bestimmt auch für Dich etwas dabei!
• Mitarbeiter werben Mitarbeiter - Prämie (bis 1.500€ brutto)
• Auf Dich warten neben kostenlosem Kaffee und Getränken auch viele weitere Extras (z.B. Firmenevents, Gewinnspiele).
• Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit einem attraktiven Gehalt in einem jungen, stabilen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen.

Hier kannst Du unser Unternehmen kennenlernen: https://www.ista-express.de/videos/

DU HAST NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir beantworten Dir gerne Fragen zum Bewerbungsablauf für die Position als Senior Technical Expert (m/w/d). Melde Dich einfach per Telefon unter +49 341 69700777.

Egal ob Meister, Techniker oder studierter Experte - Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Zum Zwecke der besseren Lesbarkeit verzichten wir bewusst auf das Verwenden von genderspezifischer Sprache. Alle männlichen Formen beziehen sich gleichermaßen auf weiblich, divers, etc.

Über uns

Seit 2020 sind wir als ista Express Service GmbH der professionelle Servicepartner für die zuverlässige Installation und Wartung von Messgeräten wie Heißkostenverteiler, Wasserzähler und Rauchwarnmelder in Privaträumen und Gewerbeanlagen. Unser Ziel ist es, das perfekte Kundenerlebnis für Mieter:innen, Hausverwaltungen und Großkund:innen zu garantieren. Mit aktuell über 20 Standorten in ganz Deutschland (wie z.B. Berlin, Hamburg, Hannover, Leipzig, Mannheim, Osnabrück, Frankfurt, Essen, Stuttgart, Köln, Düsseldorf und Oldenburg) und über 400 Mitarbeiter:innen werden wir unsere Unternehmensgröße auch in Zukunft nachhaltig erweitern.

The Associate will become part of the Global Client Group (GCG), which is Dimensional’s distribution arm comprising of sales channels that target a diverse client set. Reporting to the Head of Client Relationship Group, the role of the Associate is to support Dimensional’s institutional business development in the DACH region Associates across the Global Client Group provide relationship management and analytical analysis in helping to grow the existing client panel and develop new business opportunities for Dimensional.

The individual will be expected to demonstrate their interest in getting to know Dimensional’s client service and business development efforts. In return you will receive best in class on the job training across multiple skills and disciplines and be able to collaborate and contribute to a team-based and inclusive environment.

Responsibilities

• Become an expert on Dimensional’s evidence-based investment approach and its implementation across strategies and vehicle types (including funds, active ETFs and separate accounts).
• Become an integral part of the Client Relationship Group and support the institutional sales team in all client service-related aspects.
• Prepare and manage presentations and client materials on Dimensional’s strategies, research, asset allocation, ESG and other investment topics.
• Oversee and coordinate regular client reporting and answer related questions with support from internal subject matter experts.
• Maintain accurate client records using our advanced CRM system.
• Undertake a range of projects to support sales and client relationship efforts, such as researching market segments or prospective clients.
• Collaborate with colleagues across our Investment, Marketing and Events teams, providing our clients with a true Dimensional 360™ experience.
• Build relationships with colleagues across the Global Client Group and other internal departments, both locally and in our other global offices.
• Over the long term, develop and take over own client relationships.

Requirements

• Native or fluent German language skills, both verbal and written, are essential. Fluency in English is also required.
• Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent, in a relevant discipline is required.
• Robust experience working in the investment or asset management industry or related experience.
• Solid understanding of public equity markets. Knowledge of fixed income markets is a plus.
• Experience with separate accounts and KVGs is a plus.
• Excellent process management skills, handling different tasks in parallel.
• High attention to detail and comfortable working independently.
• Excellent analytical, interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills to articulate investment concepts to a variety of audience types.
• An ability to develop and sustain relationships with internal stakeholders, our clients and senior managers.
• Solid Excel and PowerPoint skills.

Associate, Institutional Sales & Client Services (m/w/d)

Dimensional, ein global tätiger Vermögensverwalter mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von rund 1 Billion US-Dollar, freut sich, einer talentierten Persönlichkeit eine neue Gelegenheit zu bieten, unser dynamisch wachsendes Team im Herzen Münchens zu verstärken.

Der bzw. die Associate wird Teil der Global Client Group (GCG) – Dimensionals Vertriebseinheit, die verschiedene Vertriebskanäle für eine vielfältige Kundschaft umfasst. Indem wir den Kunden in den Mittelpunkt stellen, verfolgen wir das Ziel, die Art und Weise, wie die Welt investiert, grundlegend zu verändern. Unsere Lösungen sind ein Beleg für den Mehrwert, den wir unseren Kunden bieten.

In direkter Berichtslinie an den Head of Client Relationship Group besteht die Aufgabe des bzw. der Associate darin, Dimensionals institutionelle Geschäftsentwicklung in der DACH-Region zu unterstützen. Associates innerhalb der Global Client Group übernehmen das Relationship Management sowie analytische Aufgaben und tragen dazu bei, den bestehenden Kundenstamm auszubauen und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten für Dimensional zu erschließen.

Von dem bzw. der Kandidat/in wird erwartet, ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Dimensionals Kundenservice und Geschäftsentwicklung zu zeigen. Im Gegenzug erhalten Sie eine erstklassige Einarbeitung über verschiedene Fähigkeiten und Fachbereiche hinweg und können in einem teamorientierten und inklusiven Umfeld mitwirken und einen wertvollen Beitrag leisten.

Aufgaben

• Sie werden zum Experten für Dimensionals evidenzbasierten Investmentansatz und dessen Umsetzung über verschiedene Strategien und Anlagevehikel hinweg (einschließlich Fonds, aktiver ETFs und Separate Accounts).
• Sie werden ein integraler Bestandteil der Client Relationship Group und unterstützen das institutionelle Vertriebsteam in allen Belangen des Kundenservice.
• Sie erstellen und verwalten Präsentationen und Kundenunterlagen zu Dimensionals Strategien, Research, Asset Allocation, ESG und weiteren Investmentthemen.
• Sie steuern und koordinieren das regelmäßige Kundenreporting und beantworten – mit Unterstützung interner Fachexperten – damit verbundene Fragen.
• Sie pflegen präzise Kundendaten in unserem modernen CRM-System.
• Sie übernehmen verschiedene Projekte zur Unterstützung der Vertriebs- und Kundenbeziehungsaktivitäten, etwa die Analyse von Marktsegmenten oder potenziellen Kunden.
• Sie arbeiten mit Kollegen aus den Bereichen Investment, Marketing und Events zusammen und bieten unseren Kunden so ein echtes Dimensional 360™-Erlebnis.
• Sie bauen Beziehungen zu Kollegen innerhalb der Global Client Group sowie zu anderen internen Abteilungen auf – sowohl lokal als auch in unseren weiteren globalen Niederlassungen.
• Langfristig entwickeln und übernehmen Sie eigene Kundenbeziehungen.

Anforderungen

• Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich. Fließende Englischkenntnisse werden ebenfalls vorausgesetzt.
• Ein Bachelor-Abschluss oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation in einem relevanten Fachgebiet ist erforderlich.
• Fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Investment- oder Asset-Management-Branche oder in einem verwandten Bereich.
• Solides Verständnis der öffentlichen Aktienmärkte. Kenntnisse der Anleihenmärkte sind von Vorteil.
• Erfahrung mit Separate Accounts und KVGs ist von Vorteil.
• Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten im Prozessmanagement sowie in der parallelen Bearbeitung verschiedener Aufgaben.
• Hohe Sorgfalt und die Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten.
• Ausgezeichnete analytische, zwischenmenschliche sowie mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um Investmentkonzepte gegenüber unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen verständlich zu vermitteln.
• Die Fähigkeit, Beziehungen zu internen Stakeholdern, unseren Kunden und Führungskräften aufzubauen und zu pflegen.
• Solide Excel- und PowerPoint-Kenntnisse.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
About The Company

Excelitas Deutschland GmbH is part of Excelitas, a global technology company focused on developing market-oriented solutions for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and end users. The company’s technologies support customers working in life sciences, advanced industrial markets, next-generation semiconductor manufacturing, and aerospace. Its areas of expertise include sensing, detection, imaging, optics, and specialty light sources.

At Excelitas, technology is shaped around real-world applications and customer needs. Teams contribute to products and solutions that help customers detect, measure, illuminate, and interpret their environments with precision. The company’s work connects scientific and engineering expertise with practical requirements across industries where performance, reliability, and innovation matter. Excelitas invites people who are motivated by technology and collaboration to help create what comes next.

About The Role

This opportunity is suited to professionals who want to contribute to the development, delivery, or support of advanced technology solutions. Depending on the specific position, your work may involve product development, engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations, customer support, or another function that helps turn customer requirements into effective outcomes. You will work with colleagues across relevant teams to support projects, solve problems, and contribute to the company’s objectives.

The exact scope, responsibilities, and qualifications will depend on the specific vacancy. Successful candidates are expected to bring a thoughtful, practical approach to their work, communicate clearly, and take ownership of their contributions. Whether you are applying your experience to an established product or supporting new ideas, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution within a global technology business.

Qualifications

Qualifications will vary according to the position and its level of responsibility. Applicants should review the requirements listed in the full vacancy and provide clear information about how their education, skills, and experience relate to the role. Relevant technical, scientific, operational, commercial, or administrative experience may be valuable, depending on the function.

Excelitas welcomes candidates who demonstrate sound judgment, curiosity, and a commitment to quality. The ability to work collaboratively, manage priorities, and communicate effectively with colleagues or customers can support success across many teams. Familiarity with relevant tools, processes, standards, or industry requirements may also be beneficial where applicable. If you are interested in the opportunity but do not meet every listed qualification, consider applying when your experience is meaningfully aligned with the role.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities will be defined in the specific job posting and may differ by team. Depending on the position, you may contribute to designing, developing, testing, producing, or supporting technologies and products. You may also help assess requirements, document work, analyze information, address technical or operational issues, and coordinate activities with colleagues and stakeholders.

Across functions, employees are expected to follow applicable procedures, maintain a focus on quality and safety, and contribute to reliable outcomes for customers. The role may involve sharing knowledge, identifying opportunities to improve processes, and adapting to changing project or business needs. Clear communication and constructive teamwork are important when working across disciplines and locations.

Benefits

Excelitas offers the opportunity to work in an international technology environment and contribute to solutions used across a range of important industries. Employees can collaborate with colleagues from different disciplines and apply their expertise to customer-focused work. Specific compensation, benefits, development opportunities, and workplace arrangements depend on the position, location, and applicable company policies. Please refer to the full vacancy or discuss these details during the recruitment process.

Equal Opportunity

Excelitas Deutschland GmbH is committed to fair and respectful hiring. Employment decisions are based on role-related qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs. We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives and aim to provide an inclusive recruitment process. Candidates who require an accommodation during the application or interview process are encouraged to contact the recruitment team.

Join us and help shape the future of international commercial excellence through people, leadership, and organizational performance.

Success in this role requires curiosity, commercial acumen, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to build trusted relationships across cultures, functions, and geographies.

Your direct manager will be in Denmark – but you will not be alone. In our Warsaw office You will find colleagues in similar positions, supporting other parts of Demant organization.

What you'll be doing:

• Partner closely with leaders across Sales, Training and Service functions to drive business performance through people and organization initiatives.
• Serve as a trusted advisor on strategic workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, leadership development, and employee engagement.
• Support leadership teams in selected Markets, ensuring alignment between local business priorities and the global people agenda.
• Translate business strategy into actionable people plans that strengthen organizational capability and accelerate business results.
• Lead and support transformation, organizational change, and capability-building initiatives across international markets.
• Collaborate closely with local HR colleagues to ensure globally aligned yet locally relevant HR solutions.
• Build strong relationships across a geographically dispersed organization and create alignment among multiple stakeholders.
• Champion a high-performance culture rooted in collaboration, accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

What we're looking for:

• Significant experience as an HR Business Partner in a global or international organization.
• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect people strategies to commercial outcomes.
• Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing decisions without formal authority.
• Proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and build credibility across cultures and geographies.
• Experience supporting organizational growth, transformation, and change initiatives.
• Strong facilitation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
• Ability to balance strategic thinking with pragmatic execution.
• Fluency in English and confidence working in an international environment.
• Willingness to travel internationally as part of the role.

Why join us?

This is more than an HR Business Partner position.

It is an opportunity to become part of one of Demant's most international and commercially focused organizations, working alongside leaders who are shaping the future of Hearing Aids International Sales.

You will gain exposure to senior stakeholders, complex business challenges, and diverse markets while helping create the conditions for sustainable business success. In return, you will join a company known for its strong values, collaborative culture, and commitment to developing both people and performance.

What we offer:

• A full-time position in a global and purpose-driven organization.
• Extensive learning and development opportunities.
• Hybrid work arrangements with flexibility and autonomy.
• A comprehensive benefits package.

title: Sales Associate Menswear - Selfridges
description:

title: BMS Project Manager
description:
We are currently partnering with a leading facilities and engineering services provider to recruit an experienced BMS Project Manager for their growing London team. Based in London with hybrid working, this role offers up to £80,000 + benefits and the opportunity to deliver high-profile BMS and building controls projects across London.

You’ll take ownership of projects from planning and design through to installation, commissioning and handover, managing programmes, budgets, subcontractors and engineering teams along the way. The role combines strong project management with technical BMS knowledge, making it ideal for an experienced BMS Project Manager, Project Engineer or BMS Engineer looking to progress into project management. You’ll work closely with clients, engineers and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to a high standard, while also supporting future project opportunities and client relationships.

📍 St Paul’s, London – Hybrid

💰 Up to £80,000 + Benefits

What You’ll Be Doing

• Managing the end-to-end delivery of BMS and building controls projects from inception through to completion and handover.
• Developing project programmes, plans and schedules, ensuring key milestones are achieved.
• Managing project budgets, costs, resources and commercial performance.
• Coordinating BMS engineers, subcontractors, suppliers and other project stakeholders.
• Working closely with clients and customers to understand requirements and ensure projects are delivered to specification.

• Strong understanding of BMS, HVAC controls and building services environments.
• Experience managing projects from design/procurement through to installation, commissioning and handover.
• Strong project planning, coordination and organisational skills.
• Experience managing budgets, programmes, subcontractors and project resources.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of health & safety requirements and safe working practices.
• Previous experience within facilities management, critical environments or complex commercial buildings would be beneficial.

What’s on Offer

• Salary of up to £80,000, depending on experience.
• Competitive benefits package.
• Opportunity to work on high-profile BMS and building controls projects.

If you are an experienced BMS Project Manager, BMS Project Engineer or BMS Engineer looking to take the next step into project management, please apply with an updated CV and contact number.

title: Business and HR Administrator
description:
Title - Business and HR Administrator

Reporting to: CEO

Working Hours: Full time / Flexible options

Salary: To be negotiated, based on experience

Location: Nottingham, UK

About Nova Biochem

Nova Biochem is a climate-tech company pioneering the transformation of industrial by-products into high-value, sustainable chemicals. Using our proprietary hydrothermal depolymerisation process, we convert lignin-rich residues from pulping and agriculture into renewable aromatic building blocks used in coatings, plastics, and resins - replacing fossil inputs and cutting emissions at the source.

Our mission is to unlock a circular, low-carbon model for industrial chemistry - creating new value from waste while reducing millions of tonnes of CO₂ emissions. Based in Nottingham, we’re entering a scale-up phase, expanding lab in the UK and pilot operations in Sweden while accelerating towards firs of a kind factory.

This is a pivotal moment to join a small, mission-driven team determined to reshape the chemical industry through practical innovation.

The Role

We are seeking an HR & Business Administrator to professionalise the people operation, take the day-to-day operational and administrative load off the Founder/CEO, and establish structure, clarity, and reliability across our growing organisation. Acting as a central coordinator, you will ensure incoming requests are efficiently routed, deadlines are tracked, and essential business support processes run seamlessly.

This role bridges office management, HR administration, payroll coordination, and executive support. You will oversee general workplace logistics, manage personnel processes, streamline onboarding, and handle routine payroll operations in liaison with our HR advisor and Accountant.

This role suits an experienced administrator who takes initiative, uses sound judgement and follows work through without constant prompting. You should be comfortable learning how the business operates, identifying what needs attention and improving the way administrative work is done.

Key Responsibilities

CEO Support and Action Tracking

• Provide confidential support to the CEO, helping manage priorities, meetings and correspondence, with inbox and calendar support where delegated.
• Maintain a clear record of agreed actions, owners and deadlines; follow up progress and flag delays or decisions requiring the CEO’s attention.
• Research and summarise information, draft routine correspondence and prepare clear documents, spreadsheets and presentations to support the CEO’s work.
• Coordinate management and board meetings, including agendas, meeting papers, notes and follow-up actions, and arrange CEO travel and business visits.

HR Administration & Onboarding

• Prepare and issue standard employment documentation, including offer letters, employment contracts, right-to-work checks, probation and annual reviews.
• Maintain accurate, up-to-date and secure employee records and files in strict confidence.
• Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring seamless induction schedules, access checklists, and exit administration.
• Support recruitment coordination by posting vacancies, screening candidates, scheduling interviews, communicating with candidates, and managing agency relationships.
• Administer employee benefits administration, including pensions, health insurance and policy renewals.

Payroll Coordination & Operations

• Collect, validate, and track monthly payroll changes and updates to ensure accurate, timely processing.
• Liaise directly with external accountants and payroll providers to submit payroll data, handle Benefits-in-Kind (BIK), and resolve HMRC queries.
• Support the internal transition and ongoing management of payroll operations to maintain quality and compliance.

Values

At Nova Biochem, our mission, culture, and individual behaviours are fundamental to our success, guiding how we innovate, collaborate, and scale sustainably.

• Ownership: Take initiative and deliver with excellence. We act like owners, follow through on commitments, and take pride in outcomes.
• Learning: Mistakes are lessons; growth is continuous. We take smart risks, learn fast, and never repeat the same mistake twice.
• Integrity: Honesty and accountability in everything we do. We tell the truth, admit when we’re wrong, and make decisions guided by principle.
• Transparency: Openness builds trust and alignment. We share information freely - from quarterly results to daily challenges.
• Collaboration: Together we achieve more. We ask for help, always offer solutions, and rally around shared goals.
• Balance: Work hard, live well. We push for excellence while respecting time to rest, recharge, and thrive outside work.

Who You Are

You are a practical, highly organised administrative professional with exceptional follow-through, discretion, and sound judgement. You enjoy bringing order to fast-moving start-up environments and take initiative to resolve operational issues before they escalate.

You communicate with clarity, firmness, and tact, feeling comfortable holding colleagues accountable for actions while maintaining a collaborative working relationship. You respect confidentiality, understand the value of protecting executive capacity, and take pride in building scalable administrative systems that support team growth.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Strong experience in business administration, operational coordination or a comparable role involving support to managers and work acoss several business functions.
• A track record of taking ownership, prioritising competing demands and completing work independently with reliable follow-through.
• Strong written and verbal communication, including preparing clear correspondence and documents and dealing professionally with external contacts.
• Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and practical problem-solving ability, with confidence tracking actions and deadlines.
• Discretion, integrity and sound judgement when handling sensitive business, personnel and financial information.
• Strong digital skills, including spreadsheets, document preparation, shared drives, task trackers and modern business software.
• A motivated, adaptable approach and willingness to learn new systems, including appropriate use of AI tools and simple automation to improve productivity.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• Previous HR administration experience or exposure to routine HR tasks in another role, such as recruitment, onboarding, employee records or review coordination.
• Experience working directly with a founder, CEO or senior leadership team.
• Experience in a growing start-up, clean-tech, scientific or manufacturing business.
• Experience coordinating payroll inputs, finance administration or working with external accountants; familiarity with accounting platforms such as Xero.
• Experience supporting board administration or funding reports. A relevant business administration or HR qualification, including CIPD, would be welcome.

Why Join Us?

At Nova Biochem, you’ll join a small, mission-driven team translating breakthrough science into real-world impact. As our HR & Office Manager, your work will directly enable our operational scale-up, protecting founder time and fostering a structured, supportive culture as our team expands.

You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to build administrative frameworks that last, all within an environment that values integrity, curiosity, and balance. If you are driven by purpose, thrive on organisation, and want to see your contribution make a tangible difference, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Educake Marketing Director
description:
Location: Educake Office Oxford / Hybrid

Salary: Dependent on experience

Contract: Permanent

Reports to: Nicola Allen, Educake MD

Hours: 37.5 hours per week minimum, but as required by the position.

Recruiter: Claire Bonnett

Role Overview

Educake is a leading platform for revision, homework, and data-driven insight, trusted by schools across the UK and increasingly by parents at home. We are at an inflection point: a well established B2B school business and a D2C parental subscription opportunity that we are now actively building and scaling.

We're looking for an ambitious, strategic, and hands on Marketing Director to own that consumer growth, from positioning and proposition through to acquisition, activation and retention. This is not a brand building role or a team management role in isolation. It is a growth leadership role: you will be directly accountable for subscriber numbers, unit economics and commercial success.

Key Responsibilities

Consumer Growth Strategy

• Own Educake's D2C marketing strategy end to end: positioning, channel mix, funnel design, pricing architecture, and retention, to translate market and customer insight into a prioritised, phased roadmap.
• Drive subscriber acquisition and revenue growth with direct accountability for CAC, payback period, LTV, and monthly net revenue retention as core operating metrics.
• Lead go to market execution for the MVP launch and subsequent product iterations.
• Define and champion Educake's differentiated positioning, ensuring every channel, campaign and message reflects this.
• Build and continuously optimise acquisition across paid, organic, lifecycle, community and partnership channels.
• Build a needs based marketing programme around key pain points.
• Partner with Product on onboarding, activation, and retention flows, using cohort and behavioural data to identify friction and growth opportunities.

Research, Insight & Positioning

• Commission and interpret primary parent research, including quantitative segmentation surveys, qualitative depth interviews, and exit/cancellation research.
• Develop a deep, evidence-based understanding of the secondary parent audience and define the key ICP segments and translate this into differentiated acquisition and retention strategies per segment.
• Own the ongoing competitive intelligence function, tracking how competitors evolve their propositions and identifying whitespace as it opens.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

• Lead and develop the marketing team, setting clear priorities across brand, content, performance, and lifecycle, and building capability in line with a scaling business.
• Work in close partnership with Product, ensuring marketing insight informs the product roadmap and that GTM sequencing is tightly aligned to development milestones.
• Report regularly to the MD and Board with clear, commercial marketing performance data.

Data, Reporting & Insight

• Establish and own KPI dashboards covering acquisition, CAC, conversion, free trial to paid rate, retention, churn by cohort, and LTV, with a reporting cadence that keeps leadership and the Board in real time.
• Embed a test and learn culture: phased launches, structured A/B testing and rapid iteration.

B2B Channel

• Contribute to Educake's continued growth in B2B, a significant and ongoing area of focus for the business, working closely with the Schools team on partnerships and initiatives.
• Support Sales with enablement materials and messaging that strengthen B2B conversations with schools.

Essential

• Proven track record in a senior B2C marketing or growth leadership role in a subscription business (edtech or consumer subscription experience strongly preferred.)
• Demonstrated experience owning CAC, LTV, and funnel economics end-to-end; able to defend marketing investment at board level with data.
• Direct experience launching a new consumer product or proposition to market.
• Track record building and running research programmes (quantitative and qualitative) to generate audience insight and validate positioning.
• Hands on experience with exam calendar or seasonally driven marketing programmes, with the ability to build and execute campaigns that convert demand spikes into durable subscribers.
• Strong experience with CRM-led acquisition and retention: segmentation, lifecycle sequencing, A/B testing at scale, and warm lead conversion programmes.
• Experience with community, influencer, and organic social channels as performance contributing acquisition channels, not just brand channels.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels, including Board level reporting.
• A collaborative leadership style with proven ability to work closely with Product, Sales and cross-functional teams.

Desirable

• Experience in the education or edtech sector, particularly secondary education or exam-preparation contexts.
• B2B or partnership marketing experience alongside D2C.
• Familiarity with the UK secondary school curriculum, exam board landscape or parent audience.
• Experience building a marketing function in a scaling, resource-constrained business.
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing or related field; MBA a plus, not a requirement.
• Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and CRM/analytics tools.

Our Recruitment ProcessApply with CV and Cover Letter > Screening Call > Online Interview > Task > Interview in our Oxford Office

Sustainability at Bruntwood

Every candidate who reaches this stage will be offered the chance to have a feedback call with our Recruitment Manager to understand why they weren't progressed to the next interview stage, so that you can use this feedback to help with other job applications.

At this stage, you will meet Ash in person, our Head of HR, our L&D Manager and also some of the wider team. We will explore your experince in more detail and also welcome any follow up quesitons you may have. We will also set some tasks so that you can showcase your expertise practically.

Every candidate who reaches this stage will be offered the chance to have a feedback call with our Recruitment Manager to understand why they weren't offered the position, so that you can use this feedback to help with other job applications.

Offer of employment

If you are successful and accept our offer of employment, we will submit your details to our background screening partner, who will conduct a series of background checks. Once these have been completed and we have separately validated your proof of right to work in the UK, a start date can be agreed, and your onboarding schedule can be planned.

Cognizant’s Data & AI Consulting practice partners with government agencies and public sector organizations to modernize data ecosystems, establish trusted data foundations, and accelerate digital transformation through cloud-based data platforms, analytics, and AI solutions. Our teams help clients move beyond fragmented data landscapes by creating scalable, governed, and reusable data capabilities that enable enterprise-wide decision-making.

This role offers an opportunity to shape one of the most significant public sector data modernization programs in the UK, establishing a modern data product ecosystem on a Databricks Lakehouse platform that promotes data democratization, self-service consumption, and enterprise-wide reuse.

About The Role

As a Data Products Architect – Databricks, you will lead the design and architecture of enterprise data products that enable trusted, reusable, and scalable data consumption across the organization. You will define the standards, governance frameworks, and architectural patterns that ensure data products are built once, managed consistently, and shared across multiple business domains.

Working closely with product owners, data engineers, platform architects, governance teams, and business stakeholders, you will help establish a modern data product operating model that supports self-service analytics, data sharing, and enterprise-wide innovation while maintaining strong governance and security standards.

Key Responsibilities

Data Product Architecture & Design

• Lead the architecture and design of enterprise data products built on the Databricks Lakehouse platform
• Define and maintain standards, templates, and reference architectures that ensure data products are scalable, reusable, and interoperable
• Design data products that are discoverable, versioned, self-describing, and aligned with data mesh and product-centric principles
• Establish best practices for product design, schema management, metadata standards, lineage, and lifecycle governance
• Ensure data products are optimized for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency
• Promote consistency across product domains while enabling autonomy for data product teams

Self-Service Data Platform Enablement

• Architect self-service data consumption capabilities that allow users to discover, access, and consume trusted data products independently
• Define data contracts, service-level agreements, and access management frameworks for published data products
• Collaborate with platform teams to ensure the Databricks environment supports scalable self-service consumption patterns
• Champion the adoption of Unity Catalog as the enterprise governance and discovery layer
• Design patterns that support data sharing, product consumption, and cross-domain interoperability
• Enable business and technical teams to leverage governed data assets through a consistent consumer experience

Security, Governance & Compliance

• Ensure all data products comply with enterprise governance standards and public sector regulatory requirements
• Define and implement data classification, access controls, auditability, and security controls across data products
• Collaborate with Cyber Security, Risk, and Data Governance teams to embed security-by-design principles into product delivery
• Ensure compliance with GDPR, Government Security Classifications, and other applicable regulatory frameworks
• Establish governance processes that promote trust, quality, traceability, and effective stewardship of shared data assets

Technical Leadership & Standards

• Establish reusable patterns and accelerators that support faster and more consistent delivery

Stakeholder Management & Advisory

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear business-focused recommendations and architecture artefacts
• Facilitate workshops, governance reviews, and architecture discussions across business and technology teams

• Support strategic roadmap development for the continued evolution of data product capabilities

Domain Expertise
