• Deep understanding of modern data platform architectures, data mesh principles, and product-based operating models
• Experience delivering large-scale data modernization and self-service analytics initiatives
• Knowledge of enterprise data governance, metadata management, and information architecture practices
• Familiarity with public sector data management, governance, and compliance requirements

Functional Skills

• Proven expertise in defining enterprise data product strategies, standards, and governance frameworks
• Strong experience establishing reusable product design patterns and operating models
• Ability to balance business needs with technical, governance, and operational requirements
• Experience designing data contracts, service models, and consumer engagement frameworks
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and consulting skills

Technical Skills

• Deep expertise in Databricks, including Lakehouse Architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Databricks SQL
• Strong understanding of data modelling, schema design, metadata management, and lineage tracking
• Experience implementing self-service data platforms and enterprise data catalog capabilities
• Knowledge of data mesh concepts and their practical implementation within large organizations
• Experience integrating Databricks with AWS services including S3, IAM, VPC, and AWS Glue
• Familiarity with Apache Spark, dbt, data pipelines, and modern analytics architectures
• Understanding of access management, audit frameworks, and enterprise governance controls

Delivery Experience

• Experience leading data product architecture across enterprise-wide data transformation programs
• Proven track record delivering governed, reusable, and scalable data products within complex environments
• Strong collaboration across platform engineering, governance, analytics, and business teams
• Experience supporting data platform modernization, cloud migration, and large-scale transformation programs
• Experience working within UK Public Sector, Government, or other regulated industries preferred

Personal Attributes

• Strategic thinker able to design solutions that support long-term organizational goals

• Collaborative leader capable of driving alignment across multiple stakeholder groups

Contribution to Development of Practice

title: Landscape Apprentice
description:
Location: Uxbridge

Salary: Competitive Apprenticeship Salary

Contract Type: Full-Time, Fixed-Term Apprenticeship

Working Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday (including training time)

Grow your skills. Shape the future. Build a career outdoors.

At Ground Control, we're looking for an enthusiastic Landscape Apprentice to join our team and help create greener, more sustainable environments on a major infrastructure project.

This is an exciting opportunity to earn while you learn, gaining hands-on experience, recognised qualifications and the practical skills needed to build a successful career in landscaping.

Working alongside experienced Landscape Operatives, you'll learn how to plant and care for trees, maintain new green spaces and support projects that make a lasting difference to the environment.

No previous landscaping experience is needed. Just bring a positive attitude, a willingness to learn and a genuine interest in working outdoors.

Why this role?

This is more than just an apprenticeship. It's your opportunity to develop valuable skills, gain a recognised qualification and take your first steps towards a rewarding career in landscaping.

You'll receive practical training, guidance from experienced colleagues and dedicated time to complete your apprenticeship studies, all while earning a salary.

Best of all, you'll see the results of your hard work first-hand, helping create landscapes that support biodiversity and will continue to grow and thrive for generations.

What You'll Do

• Learn how to plant trees, shrubs and whips, helping create new green spaces across a major infrastructure site.
• Assist with preparing planting areas and installing stakes, guards and protective materials.
• Help maintain newly planted landscapes, including watering, weeding, mulching, pruning and grass cutting.
• Learn to use landscaping tools and equipment safely, including strimmer’s, brush cutters and mowers.
• Work alongside experienced colleagues to understand planting plans, quality standards and environmental requirements.
• Learn to read, understand and implement landscape construction drawings and specifications, ensuring planting and landscaping works are carried out accurately and to the required standards.
• Follow site health and safety procedures, keeping yourself and others safe.
• Take part in apprenticeship training, complete practical assessments and maintain your learning portfolio.
• As your confidence and skills develop, you'll gradually take on more responsibility and work towards becoming a fully qualified Landscape Operative.

What We're Looking For

You don't need previous landscaping experience or specialist qualifications to get started. We're looking for someone with the right attitude and enthusiasm to learn.

• A genuine interest in landscaping, plants and the environment.
• A positive attitude and willingness to learn new skills.
• Enjoyment of practical, hands-on work and being outdoors in all weather conditions.
• Good communication skills and the ability to follow instructions and safety guidance.
• Reliable, punctual and able to travel to site for early starts.
• Comfortable carrying out physical work as part of a team.
• Willingness to complete apprenticeship training and assessments.
• Eligibility to work in the UK and enrol on a funded apprenticeship.

A CSCS Apprentice Card will be required before starting work on site, but Ground Control will support you in obtaining this.

Desirable, But Not Essential

• GCSEs or equivalent in English and maths.
• Previous experience of gardening, landscaping, farming or other outdoor activities.
• A full or provisional UK driving licence.

What You'll Gain

As part of your apprenticeship, you'll receive structured training and support to help you develop the skills and confidence needed to succeed.

• A recognised Level 2 qualification – work towards a Horticulture or Landscape Operative apprenticeship.
• Earn while you learn – gain practical experience while receiving a salary.
• Technical skills development – gain experience interpreting landscape construction drawings, planting plans and specifications, building your understanding of how landscaping projects are delivered.
• Fully funded training – with protected time to complete your apprenticeship studies.
• Hands-on experience – learn directly from experienced Landscape Operatives on a major infrastructure project.
• Additional qualifications – opportunities to gain certificates in equipment operation, pesticide application and first aid.
• Dedicated mentoring – regular guidance, feedback and support throughout your apprenticeship.
• Career progression – a clear pathway towards becoming a Landscape Operative, with opportunities for further development.

Why join Ground Control?

At Ground Control, we're passionate about creating and maintaining outdoor spaces that make a positive difference to people and the environment.

We believe in investing in our people, helping them develop new skills, build confidence and achieve their career ambitions.

Benefits

• Competitive salary – aligned with your skills and experience
• Pension scheme – helping you plan for the future
• Recognition schemes – celebrating and rewarding great work
• Online GP service – fast, convenient access to medical support
• Life insurance – providing added peace of mind
• Subsidised gym membership – supporting your health and wellbeing
• Holiday buy scheme – purchase up to 5 additional days of annual leave

Equal Opportunities Statement

At Ground Control, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We believe that diversity drives innovation and success, and we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic as defined in the Equality Act 2010.

We actively support and promote an inclusive culture, ensuring fair and equitable treatment throughout the recruitment process and across all stages of employment, including training, development, promotion, pay, and termination. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for disabled applicants and employees, and to creating a working environment free from discrimination, harassment, bullying, or victimisation.

We expect all colleagues to uphold our values of dignity, respect, and inclusion. We take a zero-tolerance approach to any form of discriminatory behaviour and are committed to continuous improvement through training, inclusive policies, and accountability at all levels. #LDE

title: Conference Organiser
description:
About the BMA

The British Medical Association (BMA) is the trade union and professional body for doctors in the UK. We represent, support and negotiate on behalf of all UK doctors and medical students.

Join the BMA at a crucial time for doctors and the NHS and be part of a team working for better pay and conditions for the profession.

About the role

Our Conference Unit delivers up to 60 events each year, from training courses and seminars to large, multi-faceted conferences. As a Conference Organiser, you’ll take responsibility for a wide portfolio of face-to-face, hybrid and online events, including commercial and branch of practice conferences.

Working with colleagues, members, speakers and suppliers, you’ll coordinate arrangements from planning through to delivery and post-event financial reconciliation, providing excellent customer service throughout.

This role is hybrid and will involve a mix of working from BMA House, event locations across the UK and from home. It will include some early morning starts and later evening finishes.

As a Conference Organiser you will:

• Organise allocated events, including venue selection, audio-visual requirements, catering, speaker liaison, delegate registration and attendee communications.
• Preparing and managing event budgets of up to £30K completing post-event reconciliations and working within agreed approval procedures.
• Negotiate arrangements with venues and suppliers, with contracts subject to management approval.
• Work with communications colleagues to publicise events, prepare conference materials and keep event webpages up to date.
• Keep stakeholders informed throughout the planning process and resolving practical issues calmly during events.
• Support the Conference Assistant with registration processes, payments, event databases and delegate documentation.

As a Conference Organiser you’ll ideally have:

• Experience of organising a variety of events, including face- to -face, hybrid and online events and commercial conferences
• Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage several events at different stages and deliver to deadlines and budgets
• Excellent communication skills
• Experienced in building effective relationships with a wide variety of stakeholders
• Good influencing and negotiation skills when working with planning groups, venues and suppliers
• A calm, practical approach to problem-solving and the confidence to manage events independently when required
• Excellent IT skills, including experience using databases and maintaining web content
• A professional, customer-focused approach and a commitment to working in line with the BMA’s values

Why work for us?

We offer a wide range of benefits including:

• 30 days holiday entitlement plus bank holidays and a BMA company day
• Double matching pension contributions up to 12% of salary
• Additional leave entitlement for volunteering, moving house or wedding leave (after completion of probationary period)
• Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
• Group Income protection & life assurance that is seven times your annual salary
• Annual salary reviews & incremental salary increases from year one to year three
• Onsite gym and subsidised café (at BMA House in London)
• Electric Vehicle and Cycle to work salary sacrifice scheme's (available after completion of probationary period)
• Access to a 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) with free confidential counselling, a helpline and specialist support available
• Long service recognition every 5 years
• Professional subscription cover where membership of a professional institution is required for your role
• BMA Law - discounted rates for employees requiring legal services such as will writing/conveyancing
• Multiple flexible benefits and discounts through our employee benefits platform
• Lots of Learning and Development/training opportunities via our internal learning hub
• Season ticket loan (up to £10,000) (after completion of probationary period)
• Additional annual leave- buy up to 5 additional holiday days per year

Anonymous recruitment

The BMA endeavours to be an inclusive employer, ensuring fairness and consistency to select the best candidate for roles. To support our aims, we use specific software to remove all personal identifying information from CVs and applications. Personal information such as name, date of birth, age and gender are anonymised and will only become visible to hiring managers if you are selected for interview.

To apply please upload an up to date version of your CV and supporting information setting out your suitability for the role.

Whether the role needs you to work at home, in an office or in a hybrid way, we`ll provide all the support you need.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please apply through our website. However, if you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support at any point during the application process, please email recruitment@bma.org.uk.

This vacancy will close for applications at midnight on the closing date.

Diversity & Inclusion Monitoring:

Our ambition is to work together to promote a more inclusive environment, which attracts everybody with the right skills and experience and signals our commitment to celebrate and promote diversity.

BMA is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and does not condone discrimination on the basis of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, or marriage and civil partnership. We want people to bring their unique blend of experiences, backgrounds, perspectives and knowledge as we recognise that diversity makes us stronger.

Please note, we are unable to provide sponsorship under the UK points-based immigration system, as we do not hold a sponsorship licence.

title: Test Centre Administrator (Southgate, UK) (26071)
description:
Our Organisation

Pearson VUE has been a pioneer in the computer-based testing industry for decades, delivering more than 15 million certification and licensure exams annually in every industry from academia and admissions to IT and healthcare. We are the global leaders in developing and delivering high-stakes exams via the world's most comprehensive network of nearly 20,000 Test Centre’s in 180 countries. Our leadership in the assessment industry is a result of our collaborative partnerships with a broad range of clients, from leading technology firms to government and regulatory agencies.

Pearson VUE is a business of Pearson, the world's leading learning company with global-reach and market-leading businesses and listed on both the London and New York Stock Exchanges (UK: PSON; NYSE: PSO). Pearson VUE is featured on The Forbes list of Best Employers and The Stonewall Top 100 Employers list, and we are recognised in the Best Employers for Diversity 2019 awards.

We are proud to offer an exceptional work environment where you can enjoy job satisfaction, and we are now hiring a Test Centre Administrator to join our successful team in Southgate, UK.

Your Opportunity

• You will be required to work a minimum of 8.25 hours/week.

• This is a limited term position for 3 months.

• The pay rate is £14.80 /hour, paid to you at the end of every month.

• Must be available Monday to Saturday and late nights.

When you join us as Test Centre Administrator, you can look forward to working as an important part of our worldwide and life-changing organisation, along with our talented, motivated colleagues who all share our passion for helping customers throughout their learning and assessment journey.

This is a truly exciting opportunity as you’ll be responsible for supporting many different types of interesting and unique test-taking candidates visiting our Pearson VUE Test Centre’s to complete one of our exams/tests. The Test Centre Administrator is responsible for providing secure exam/test delivery whilst offering exceptional customer service in a comfortable, friendly environment.

Your Responsibilities

In this important position, you will be required to:

• Welcome, greet and check-in customers/test-taking candidates.

• Comply with all exams testing security and procedures and follow company policies using careful judgment.

• Verify customer/candidate personal identification documents and explain the exam testing process/rules.

• Proctor / invigilate candidates while they are completing their exam/test.

• Troubleshoot with internal departments, such as our IT department, to fix any technical issues in the Test Centre.

• Some housekeeping duties such as vacuuming floors and sanitizing keyboards/workstations as necessary.

This is a fantastic opportunity for you to gain experience working with our diverse professional teams, ensuring the candidate's experience is a positive one. Our ideal applicant will be a true team player with the availability to work a variety of shifts any day Monday through Sunday. Test Centre’s are open early in the morning, late at night and weekends, therefore we require a colleague who is flexible.

Our Successful Applicant

This is a wonderful opportunity for you to help people during a very important event in their lives whilst protecting our Pearson VUE exams/test process, therefore we are looking for a friendly and professional team-player with school qualifications in English and Math's. It would be an advantage to have some experience of working with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook).

You must be flexible to work different days and times and comfortable in a quiet testing environment, with excellent attention to detail, monitoring for restricted behaviour and notice details from a distance. You should be able to sit for long periods of time and escort candidates to and from the exam/testing room.

Our Recruitment Process

This is an essential role, so please apply now! Complete and submit your application as soon as possible directly to our Pearson Careers website. We are reviewing applications every day, and interviews are scheduled right now; therefore, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Wishing you the very best of success with your application!

Who we are:

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

title: Grid Connection Assessment Manager
description:
The role

Cellnex is seeking an experienced Grid Connections Delivery Manager for a 10m day rate contract to manage the end-to-end delivery of new Low Voltage (LV) and High Voltage (HV) electricity connections, with capacities up to 5MW, across its UK infrastructure portfolio.

The role will take responsibility once an approved site, completed feasibility assessment and DNO quotation have been formally handed over. From that point, the role will own; offer acceptance, procurement and delivery of contestable and non-contestable works, coordination with Independent Connection Providers (ICPs) and Independent Distribution Network Operators (IDNOs), and realisation of associated asset values.

The successful candidate will have strong technical and commercial experience of UK electricity distribution networks, DNO connection processes, contestable works procurement and IDNO asset adoption arrangements.

A key focus will be optimising connection costs, maximising IDNO asset values and ensuring grid infrastructure is delivered efficiently to support Cellnex's site development and build programmes.

This is a hybrid position based at our welcoming offices in Reading or Manchester, with three days in the office and two days working from home.

We welcome applications from everyone. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know—we’re here to support you.

Key Responsibilities

• DNO quotations: Accepted handover pack validated, selected DNO offer committed before expiry, and delivery mobilisation completed.
• Connection strategy: Clear recommendation on DNO delivery versus ICP/IDNO contestable delivery for each site.
• ICP procurement: Competitive tenders completed, evaluated and preferred suppliers appointed.
• IDNO asset values: Competitive asset adoption valuations obtained and commercially optimised.
• Delivery coordination: Effective management of the interface between ICPs, IDNOs, DNOs and Cellnex build partners.
• Programme management: Grid connections progressed to agreed milestones, including energisation.
• Financial management: Connection costs tracked and final IDNO asset values realised and reconciled with Finance.
• Reporting: Accurate portfolio-level reporting covering quotations, costs, milestones, risks and commercial benefits.

Experience

• We are seeking a hands-on grid connections specialist, rather than a general project manager, who can combine technical understanding of electricity distribution networks with strong commercial and supplier management capabilities.
• The ideal candidate will have previously worked for or closely with a DNO, ICP, IDNO or specialist grid connections consultancy and will be comfortable independently managing the full connection lifecycle.
• The individual must be capable of challenging DNO technical proposals, negotiating with ICPs and IDNOs, and identifying the most cost-effective connection solution without requiring extensive technical supervision.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

Cellnex Telecom is a leader in communication, technology and innovation and employs over 2000 people. We want everyone to feel valued by creating a culture of inclusion and belonging. We do this by empowering all our people to be authentic and share their ideas and experiences to ensure we have diversity of perspective. Only by doing this will we be a truly innovative forward-thinking organisation.

Who Are We?

Cellnex is Europe’s and the UK’s largest and fastest-growing independent owner and neutral operator of wireless telecoms infrastructure and is integral to the successful rollout of 5G. With the wireless infrastructure foundation that we deliver across rural and urban areas, Cellnex UK helps to connect everyone, everywhere - reducing digital inequality and supporting socio-economic growth. Our networks and solutions are built to be fit for now and the future so that the UK can prosper. We are a business built on commercial and technical innovation, ambition and sustainable growth.

We provide high-speed connectivity for sports stadia, shopping centres, campuses, railways, ports and even in the air. Whenever you're out in public, and you call a loved one, scroll through social media, watch a funny video or check if your train is running on time, there's a high chance that our infrastructure is enabling your connection.

World's Most Sustainable Companies of 2026

City Centres, connected streets, shared dreams - Connecting the Dots

Authenticity of Assessment

Our recruitment process is designed to assess each candidate's own knowledge, skills, judgement, and experience. Unless explicitly stated otherwise, candidates should not use generative AI tools or third-party assistance to answer interview questions, complete assessments, or produce work submitted as part of the selection process.

If we believe that AI or other external assistance has been used in a way that compromises the integrity of the assessment, we reserve the right to investigate this and, where appropriate, withdraw the application from the recruitment process.

Agency Notice

Please note that agency support is not required for this role, and unsolicited candidate submissions will not be considered. All candidate referrals must be submitted through our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

title: Part Time Retail Assistant (Camden)

title: Admiral Nurse Clinical Lead
description:
ADMIRAL NURSE CLINICAL LEAD | Band 7 | £49,387 - £56,515 per annum (pro rata)

Part Time: Working 30 hours per week over 4 days
Location: Based at our Hospice in Winsley, Wiltshire, with community working across our catchment area.
(Hybrid working available).

WHY THIS ROLE?

Are you an experienced Dementia Specialist Nurse ready to take the next step into clinical leadership and help shape outstanding dementia, frailty, palliative and end-of-life care?

At Dorothy House Hospice Care, we want people affected by dementia and frailty to receive compassionate, expert care that recognises what matters to them and those closest to them. Working in partnership with Dementia UK, you will provide expert dementia nursing practice, support complex clinical decision-making and help colleagues build their confidence and capability in dementia and frailty care.

This is an opportunity to combine direct clinical impact with the chance to lead change, develop others and shape the future of dementia and frailty care within a specialist hospice environment.

ABOUT THE BENEFITS

Dorothy House is an incredible place to work. Some of our benefits include:

• 27 days plus bank holidays, increasing to 29 days and then 33 days with length of service
• Excellent industry leading training with a focus on career development!
• Pension with Life Assurance
• Colleague discount across our 30 retail stores
• 55p per mile for work travel
• Mindful Employer Plus Charter - supporting our colleagues with access to impartial, confidential advice when you need it most

WHAT WILL THE ROLE INVOLVE?

As our Admiral Nurse Clinical Lead, you will combine specialist clinical practice with leadership, education and service development, helping to improve the experience of palliative and end-of-life care for patients and families.

• Providing clinical leadership in evidence-based palliative and end-of-life care for people affected by dementia and frailty
• Delivering specialist biopsychosocial assessments and interventions for people with complex needs
• Supporting advance care planning, complex decision-making, impending loss and end-of-life conversations
• Providing specialist dementia and frailty advice to health and social care professionals
• Developing and delivering education that builds colleagues' confidence and capability
• Leading quality improvement, policy development and evaluation across dementia and frailty care
• Developing integrated pathways with health, social care and voluntary sector partners
• Leading and developing the Admiral Nurse service and using evidence, audit and data to drive improvement

See our full detailed Job Description on our website for more information.

ABOUT YOU

We're looking for an experienced Registered Nurse who combines specialist dementia knowledge with compassionate clinical leadership and the confidence to influence care beyond their own caseload.

Essential requirements:

• Registered Nurse (Adult, Mental Health or Learning Disability) with current NMC registration + significant post-registration experience supporting people with dementia and their families (including complex needs, frailty, palliative care or multiple long-term conditions)
• Experience leading complex assessments, care planning and clinical decision-making
• Experience leading service improvement, quality improvement, practice development or change initiatives
• Experience providing clinical leadership and specialist advice to multidisciplinary teams or partner organisations
• Experience developing and delivering education, coaching or training
• Excellent partnership-working skills with the ability to influence across professional and organisational boundaries
• Evidence of continued professional development in dementia, frailty, palliative care or advanced practice
• Full UK driving licence with access to a vehicle

Desirable requirements:

• Relevant postgraduate qualification (e.g. Dementia care, frailty palliative care, advanced clinical practice)
• Experience leading or managing staff, students, volunteers or clinical placements
• Experience representing services within system, regional or strategic partnership groups
• Independent Prescriber qualification, or willingness to work towards advanced clinical practice development

If this sounds like your ideal job, then we'd love to see your application!

To support your application, we strongly recommend completing the Dementia UK Pre-Admiral Nurse e-learning module. The link is available within the roles job description, found on our careers page.

Please note that our vacancies can close at any time once sufficient applications have been received. We therefore encourage early submission of your application.

INTERVIEWS

Interviews for this role will be aimed to be held early to mid-December.

title: Set Designer (Remote | $50–$105/hr)
description:
Set and Production Design Expert (Remote | $50–$105/hr)

Position: Set and Production Design Expert

Type: Contractor

Compensation: $50–$105 per hour

Location: Fully Remote (Worldwide)

About the Opportunity

micro1 is seeking experienced Set and Production Design Experts to evaluate set designs, production concepts, and spatial arrangements for quality, functionality, and alignment with creative briefs.

In this role, you will review set designs, room setups, and production concepts to assess how effectively they support a story, script, production environment, and camera requirements. You will evaluate design elements such as scale, layout, sightlines, colors, materials, and overall practicality.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in production design, set design, art direction, set decoration, or theatre design who have hands-on experience working on real productions across film, television, theatre, events, commercials, or photography.

• Ensure set designs align with the story, setting, creative direction, and available budget.

Required Qualifications

• Professional experience as a production designer, set designer, art director, set decorator, assistant art director, or theatre designer.

• Experience collaborating with different production departments and creative teams.
• Familiarity with design tools such as SketchUp, AutoCAD, Vectorworks, Rhino, or Photoshop, or strong hand-drafting skills.
• Ability to evaluate design concepts and explain why one approach works better than another.
• Excellent written English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in film, television, theatre, commercial production, live events, or photography set design.
• Background in production art direction, scenic design, interior styling, or set decoration.
• Experience managing production budgets, sourcing materials, and coordinating set construction or installation.
• Understanding of camera angles, visual storytelling, lighting considerations, and practical production constraints.
• Strong analytical thinking, creative judgment, and attention to detail.

Compensation & Engagement

• Hourly Pay: $50–$105 per hour.
• Engagement Type: Independent Contractor.
• Work Arrangement: Fully Remote.
• Location: Worldwide.

Application & Selection Process

description:
Salary: 110 - 140 PLN per hour (B2B)

At Idego, you'll join a ~100-person team of experienced problem solvers building real products across Cloud, Data & AI, and Software Development.

The environment is genuinely AI-oriented - modern tech applied to real business problems, not chasing shiny trends. Modern tech, AI-driven thinking, meaningful projects - and a work culture built around trust, growth, and getting things done properly.

About project:

We're looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our client's team! Our client is a software provider for the automotive industry, helping car dealerships digitise the customer experience – from sales to aftersales.

Our perks:

• Fruit Fridays? Well... we have to admit that we don't organize such events. Seriously. No bananas, apples, tangerines... Instead, we've opted for something more practical: a snack cabinet full of drinks, healthy (and not so healthy) treats...
• From time to time, we prefer to send you a LEGO set or a cozy blanket - just in case you're allergic to citrus fruits.
• Work environment with zero micromanagement - we cherish autonomy
• Remote work, recruitment & onboarding ->People from the Tri-City are welcome to join us for lunch :)
• Experienced team from 4 to 15+ years in commercial projects
• Unique memes & pets channel
• Private medical insurance and Medicover Sport

We want you to join our team. We are neither the agency giving you projects from time to time, nor a huge corporation where you are a "dev XYZ". At Idego - you matter!

Requirements:

• Playwright
• SQL
• REST
• TypeScript

• At least 6 years of experience in test automation for web applications, writing code in TypeScript or JavaScript.
• Strong Playwright skills (or another modern framework), including the Page Object Model.
• Experience in API testing (REST, contract or snapshot tests).
• Strong SQL, including reconciliation and data quality queries on large tables.
• Experience testing data migrations, data pipelines or data warehouses.
• Experience integrating tests into CI/CD (GitLab CI or similar) and reporting results.
• A structured approach to exploratory testing and clear, precise defect reporting.
• Experience with multi-tenant systems and handling personal data (GDPR).
• Professional written and spoken English.

Nice to have

• Snowflake (dynamic tables, query history, EXPLAIN) and PostgreSQL.
• Performance and load testing (k6, Artillery or similar).
• NestJS, Jest, Vitest, React.
• AWS (CloudWatch, AppConfig), feature flags and progressive rollouts.
• Keycloak or other OAuth/OIDC identity providers.
• Experience in the automotive industry or with dealer software.

Nice to have:

• Snowflake
• Nest.js

Daily tasks:

• Build and maintain automated data regression tests for the migration from a legacy Postgres warehouse to Snowflake: query validation, integration tests on real data, scheduled reconciliation (row counts, IDs, checksums, freshness) and monitoring of schema and data changes.
• Analyse production comparison results, classify mismatches and give go / no-go recommendations for each rollout stage.
• Build an API regression suite (contract or snapshot tests) for critical endpoints, running in GitLab CI on every change.
• Take ownership of the existing Playwright framework: stabilise it, remove flaky tests, extend it to critical user journeys and add post-deployment smoke tests.
• Learn the business domain in depth and run structured exploratory and edge-case testing (roles, markets, time zones, large data volumes, browsers).
• Run non-functional tests: performance and load, fallback and rollback, tenant isolation and personal data protection.
• Prepare anonymised test data and test accounts, and coordinate UAT with business stakeholders.
• Report defects in Jira, retest fixes, deliver a quality report every sprint and work shift-left within two-week Scrum sprints.

title: Sous Chef

The Sous Chef is responsible for driving culinary excellence within The Residency, ensuring every dish meets the exceptional standards expected of a Michelin-inspired dining experience.

Working alongside the Chef Manager, you'll lead the kitchen during service, support the development of the brigade and maintain absolute consistency across every plate.

Whilst your primary focus is kitchen leadership, The Residency operates without traditional boundaries between kitchen and front of house. Every chef plays an active role in the guest experience, presenting dishes, sharing the story behind the menu and creating memorable moments throughout service.

This is an opportunity to be part of a unique concept where exceptional cooking and genuine hospitality come together.

Kitchen Leadership

• Lead the brigade during preparation and service, ensuring exceptional standards are maintained at all times.
• Support the Chef Manager in organising daily operations and service delivery.
• Coach, mentor and develop junior chefs, providing guidance and constructive feedback.
• Lead by example, promoting a collaborative, professional and high-performing kitchen culture.

Culinary Excellence

• Prepare and deliver dishes to Michelin-inspired standards with exceptional consistency and precision.
• Ensure every plate meets agreed presentation, quality and flavour standards.
• Support menu development, tastings and seasonal menu changes.
• Monitor quality throughout service and respond quickly to any issues.

Guest Experience

• Present dishes directly to guests with confidence and professionalism.
• Explain ingredients, techniques and the inspiration behind each course.
• Create engaging guest interactions that enhance the overall dining experience.

Operational Excellence

• Support stock control, ordering and inventory management.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Experience leading a team during busy services.

• Passion for delivering world-class food and hospitality.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
Are you a Fullstack developer curious about the world of AI? Wondering how your current skill set could open new doors in one of the fastest-growing tech fields? Here's your chance to dive into applied AI research and development - and actually shape the roadmap of multiple products across the BBM portfolio. It’s a unique opportunity to explore how diverse AI solutions can enrich real-world platforms, not just in theory, but in production - and your role will focus on integrating with AI APIs as part of a typical developer’s journey.

Our projects are always tied to the broadcast and OTT industry (online video). Implementations are based on advanced technological products, modules, or complete end-to-end solutions for companies looking to launch their own streaming platforms (like Netflix) or expand their existing online video offerings.

Why your Fullstack experience is the perfect launchpad for AI?

As someone who's built real software, you already have what it takes to thrive in AI. Here's why:

• AI is powered by data - and you're already skilled at working with databases, APIs, and data processing.
• You're a natural problem solver. That mindset is gold in AI, where experiments and edge cases are part of daily life.
• You know how to code. Your programming experience will translate easily into AI languages, and you’ll be right at home tinkering with models and workflows.
• You understand how systems fit together. Whether it's the front-end, back-end, or cloud, your holistic view is a huge advantage when building AI-powered apps.
• And when it comes to turning models into real-world tools, your experience integrating APIs and deploying cloud-based apps puts you miles ahead.

What you’ll actually be doing?

This isn’t a research lab job buried in theory. You'll be using AI tools and APIs to make real things happen:

• Building simple web apps that integrate BBM products with third-party AI SaaS tools.
• Presenting proof-of-concept results during sprint demos to internal stakeholders.
• Co-defining PoC scope and direction with the product owner.

How your time will be split?

• 60% hands-on R&D work with AI tools and APIs.
• 20% presenting results to the team and stakeholders.
• 20% refining requirements and planning next steps with the PO.

What we’re looking for?

We’re not expecting you to be an AI expert - we’ll grow that part together. But we do need someone who brings:

• At least one backend and one frontend language under your belt - preferably Python and React.
• Comfort working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
• Previous experience working with AI tools, APIs, or ML features.
• Independence, curiosity, and a love for solving complex problems.
• Perfect English - to read/write docs and chat with the team daily.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with .NET 6, OTT/video platforms, or speak some German.

What you’ll get in return:

• salary in the range of 12,500 - 17,500 PLN net + VAT (B2B contract)
• fully remote work with flexible working hours
• one full day per sprint for learning and development
• a choice to join MyBenefit platform (to buy a MultiSport card or other cool services)
• a choice to join our group health insurance
• access the wellbeing platform Mindgram that helps you stay in a good mental shape
• access to the language learning platform Tutlo
• company-wide quarterly meetings (which are special, because you don’t have to work on that day)
• optional (bun fun!) team activities, like joint mountain trekking trips, St. Nicolas Day event for kids, board game nights, and more.
• a welcoming office in the very heart of Poznań, if you prefer to work on-site.

If you're interested in joining our team, please submit your CV below. We’ll be glad to reach out to you!

Recruitment process:

• Chat with People Operations Specialist (30-minute online meeting to get to know each other).
• Recruitment task.
• Interview with the Chapter Leader to discuss the position, the task, and mutual expectations (approx. 1.5 hours)
• Interview with the Manager of the area you’ll be working with.
• Final decision.

description:

Grand Hotel Parker’s: una storia di eccellenza, una visione di futuro

Fondato nel 1870, il Grand Hotel Parker’s è il più antico albergo di Napoli e una delle dimore simbolo dell’ospitalità partenopea. Un hotel cinque stelle lusso in cui il fascino della tradizione, l’eleganza senza tempo e l’attenzione autentica all’ospite si fondono con una costante ricerca dell’eccellenza.

Dimora indipendente gestita dalla famiglia Avallone, il Parker’s custodisce una storia fatta di passione, cultura dell’accoglienza e valorizzazione del talento. Un luogo in cui l’eccellenza non è soltanto uno standard da raggiungere, ma un valore da condividere ogni giorno.

Il prestigio della struttura è riconosciuto a livello internazionale attraverso importanti selezioni e riconoscimenti:

• Chiave MICHELIN 2026 – assegnata dalla Guida MICHELIN all’eccellenza nell’ospitalità; il Grand Hotel Parker’s è il primo hotel di Napoli a ricevere questo riconoscimento.
• Relais & Châteaux – membro dell’esclusiva collezione internazionale che riunisce dimore e ristoranti d’eccellenza, accomunati dalla cultura dell’ospitalità, dall’identità territoriale e dall’arte di vivere.
• Forbes Travel Guide 2026 – Recommended – inserimento nella prestigiosa guida internazionale dedicata all’eccellenza nel settore del lusso.

George Restaurant: l’alta gastronomia nel cuore di Napoli

All’interno del Grand Hotel Parker’s, il George Restaurant è il primo ristorante di Napoli a conquistare due Stelle MICHELIN, confermate anche nella Guida MICHELIN 2026.

Il George propone una cucina gastronomica raffinata, nella quale i profumi e i colori della tradizione campana incontrano la tecnica classica, la sensibilità contemporanea e una costante ricerca creativa.

Il percorso di eccellenza del ristorante è ulteriormente valorizzato da:

• Due Stelle MICHELIN 2026, riconoscimento dell’elevatissimo livello della proposta gastronomica.
• Les Grandes Tables du Monde, prestigiosa associazione internazionale che riunisce ristoranti di alta gastronomia riconosciuti per la qualità della cucina, del servizio e dell’esperienza complessiva.

Descrizione del lavoro

Ricerchiamo uno/a Chef Pâtissier con comprovata esperienza, sensibilità estetica e una forte identità creativa, desideroso di contribuire allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione della proposta di pasticceria del George Restaurant. La figura selezionata sarà responsabile della progettazione, realizzazione dell’offerta di dessert e pasticceria del ristorante George, contribuendo a definire esperienze di gusto capaci di sorprendere, emozionare e lasciare un ricordo distintivo nell’ospite.

Responsabilità principali

• Ideare, sviluppare e realizzare dessert e creazioni di pasticceria coerenti con la filosofia gastronomica del George Restaurant, valorizzando la stagionalità, le eccellenze campane e la qualità delle materie prime.
• Contribuire allo sviluppo creativo del dessert al piatto, assicurando armonia, equilibrio e continuità con la proposta gastronomica dello Chef.
• Curare tutte le fasi della produzione, dalla ricerca e sperimentazione alla preparazione, finitura, decorazione e presentazione finale.
• Sviluppare tecniche, consistenze, temperature e abbinamenti innovativi, coniugando rigore tecnico, gusto e ricerca estetica.
• Garantire elevati standard di qualità, precisione, pulizia, sicurezza alimentare e rispetto delle procedure HACCP.
• Assicurare continuità qualitativa, puntualità e precisione durante il servizio, nel rispetto degli standard richiesti da un ristorante due Stelle MICHELIN.
• Monitorare le evoluzioni della pasticceria internazionale e proporre nuove tecniche, ingredienti e soluzioni creative in linea con l’identità del ristorante.

Qualifiche

• Esperienza comprovata di almeno 2 anni nel ruolo di Sous Chef Pâtissier, preferibilmente maturata in ristoranti stellati.
• Formazione specifica in pasticceria e arte dolciaria, preferibilmente conseguita presso scuole o istituti riconosciuti.
• Solida conoscenza delle tecniche classiche e contemporanee di pasticceria, cioccolateria e lavorazione delle principali preparazioni dolciarie.
• Creatività, sensibilità estetica, precisione tecnica e attenzione meticolosa al dettaglio.
• Capacità di sviluppare dessert identitari, riconoscibili e coerenti con una filosofia gastronomica definita.
• Ottime capacità organizzative, gestione delle priorità e rispetto delle tempistiche di servizio.
• Conoscenza delle procedure HACCP e capacità di gestire approvvigionamenti, scarti e costi.
• Flessibilità, spirito di collaborazione, curiosità professionale e autentica passione per la ricerca gastronomica

Informazioni aggiuntive

Cosa ti offriamo

• Contratto: tempo determinato della durata di 12 mesi, con prospettiva di trasformazione a tempo indeterminato.
• CCNL: Fedeturismo Confindustria ( H05B), inquadramento C1
• Retribuzione annua lorda: da € 36.000 a € 45.000, in funzione dell’esperienza, delle competenze e del profilo professionale.
• Organizzazione del lavoro: 5 giorni lavorativi a settimana, dal martedì al sabato.
• Riposi settimanali: domenica e lunedì, fissi.
• Opportunità di entrare a far parte di una realtà che valorizza la qualità del servizio, l’attenzione ai dettagli e la passione per l’ospitalità
• Formazione specifica criteri valutazione Relais & Chateaux e principali normative vigenti
• Piano inserimento circuito HR Relais & Chateau

All’interno del Grand Hotel Parker’s ogni dipendente si sente parte di una squadra unita da obiettivi comuni e valori condivisi. La cultura aziendale si basa sul rispetto, la trasparenza e la valorizzazione del singolo e l’atmosfera è caratterizzata da continuo scambio di idee in cui ciascuno ha la possibilità di esprimere la propria opinione e contribuire al miglioramento delle attività. Qui le risorse sono innanzitutto persone riconosciute per il loro talento, impegno e passione; infatti, la meritocrazia è il pilastro del Grand Hotel Parker’s dove i risultati vengono premiati non solo con opportunità di crescita professionale ma con riconoscimenti concreti del lavoro svolto.

description:
Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™

Location

This is a fully remote opportunity based out of any of the following with travel as needed: UK, Ireland, Netherlands, Sweden, Estonia.

Who We Are

Become part of the team behind Attribute™. Following our recent acquisition, we're bringing together visionary engineers and go-to-market leaders to disrupt cloud management with real-time, tagless cost visibility across cloud and AI workloads. As an Account Executive focused on Strategic Deals, you'll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers, unlocking high-impact opportunities through top-tier strategic partnerships.

DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.

The Opportunity

As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for Attribute™, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.

Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.

As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. You will drive sales end-to-end with a heavy emphasis on net-new logo acquisition, defining the regional go-to-market strategy and creating the foundational customer success stories that define this category.

You will own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments—prospecting new accounts, running compelling solution pitches, navigating complex technical evaluations alongside engineering partners, and closing strategic partnerships end to end.

You'll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That's the opportunity.

Expect to travel 10–15% of the time to meet customers, engage with hyperscale teams, and show up at industry events that matter.

Responsibilities

• Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to closed deal, consistently hitting and exceeding quota and pipeline targets
• Build a high-volume pipeline and establish the region from scratch with a hunter mindset, driving outbound prospecting and net-new logo acquisition across EMEA
• Build the first wave of reference customers and case studies the rest of the GTM org will run on
• Develop and execute a regional strategy that identifies high-growth opportunities and untapped markets across EMEA
• Build deep, mutually valuable relationships with AWS Sales Leaders and Partner Managers to co-sell and expand market share
• Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solutions Architects to solve the toughest technical challenges prospects face
• Maintain rigorous forecast accuracy in Salesforce and ensure every proposal reflects the quality of what we actually deliver
• Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience
• Feed real customer signal back to product and marketing every week — in a founding team, that loop is the job
• Generate your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, and creative outreach — not just working what's handed to you

Qualifications

• Proven track record of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience with a strong emphasis on net-new logo acquisition and building a regional territory from scratch
• A track record of selling cloud services and understanding how consumption-based models work
• Hunting mentality: demonstrated drive to self-generate pipeline, prospect into target accounts, and close new business independently
• Experience selling to platform engineering / DevOps teams.
• Comfort selling something new — you've sold a product before there was a Gartner quadrant for it, and you preferred it that way
• Technical curiosity: you understand the cloud computing market and can hold your own in conversations about AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure products and architecture
• Genuine interest in FinOps and how engineering organisations actually consume the cloud — you don't need to be a practitioner, but you need to care
• Ability to build influential relationships across matrixed organisations and turn professional networks into real partnerships
• "Roll up your sleeves" attitude that pervades both sales and business development activities
• Prior experience at AWS, ISVs, or in strategic partnerships is a big plus

Are You a Doer?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our Life at DoiT.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor reviews.

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

• Unlimited PTO
• Flexible Working Options
• Health Insurance
• Parental Leave
• Employee Stock Option Plan
• Home Office Allowance
• Professional Development Stipend
• Peer Recognition Program

Many Doers, One Team

DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal — it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

title: Quality Mechanical Technician, Powertrain
description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Powertrain Quality Mechanical Technician supports mechanical Powertrain Quality activities at Lucid Motors. Reporting to the Powertrain Quality Mechanical Engineer, the technician performs standardized inspections, measurements, testing, containment, and verification activities for mechanical Powertrain components and assemblies. The role works closely with Production, Manufacturing, Maintenance, Incoming Quality, and Quality Engineering teams to identify abnormalities, protect the production line, maintain accurate traceability, and support timely corrective actions that meet engineering specifications, Lucid Quality standards, and customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities

• Follow all required safety procedures, including the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, vests, shoes, and gloves.
• Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment in accordance with 6S standards.
• Develop technical expertise in Lucid Powertrain systems, components, and assemblies.
• Perform in-process, control point, and end-of-line Quality inspections for mechanical Powertrain components and assemblies, including motors, drive units, geartrains, housings, shafts, bearings, seals, cooling circuits, and related interfaces.
• Execute inspections and tests according to approved control plans, work instructions, drawings, specifications, sampling plans, reaction plans, and acceptance criteria.
• Use calibrated inspection and test equipment to verify dimensional, torque, runout, backlash, preload, press-fit, leak, cleanliness, sealing, and functional requirements, as applicable.
• Identify, segregate, label, and document nonconforming material and support containment, sorting, re-inspection, controlled rework, and verification activities under the direction of the Powertrain Quality Mechanical Engineer.
• Escalate abnormalities promptly and provide clear evidence, samples, measurements, photographs, and traceability information to support customer protection and rapid decision-making.
• Accurately record inspection, test, repair, audit, and containment results in approved Quality, MES, QMS, and traceability systems.
• Support root cause analysis, corrective action trials, validation builds, and effectiveness checks related to mechanical defects and process variation, including internal Quality failures and Field Quality feedback.
• Conduct visual and workmanship evaluations and support investigations related to fit, sealing, lubrication, noise, vibration, contamination, damage, and assembly concerns.
• Support equipment qualification, gage validation, measurement system analysis, correlation studies, line trials, safe launch activities, launch readiness reviews, and engineering change implementation.
• Participate in layered process audits, product audits, compliance checks, and verification of standardized work and process controls.
• Maintain inspection equipment, fixtures, gages, master samples, and work areas in a controlled and production-ready condition and report calibration or equipment concerns promptly.
• Complete required training and certifications and contribute to continuous improvement, defect prevention, lessons learned, and reduction of repeat issues.

Skills

• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, GD&T, specifications, tolerance requirements, process documentation, control plans, and inspection standards.
• Practical knowledge of calipers, micrometers, height gages, dial indicators, bore gages, torque tools, attribute gages, surface plates, leak-test equipment, and other mechanical inspection tools.
• Working knowledge of precision assembly, machining, castings, gears, bearings, seals, fastening, lubrication, cleanliness, and thermal-management components.
• Basic understanding of automotive Quality tools and methods, including nonconforming material control, MSA, SPC, capability monitoring, layered process audits, and structured problem solving.
• Strong attention to detail, disciplined execution, accurate documentation, and the ability to recognize and escalate abnormal conditions.
• Effective communication and teamwork skills with Quality Engineering, Production, Manufacturing, Maintenance, Incoming Quality, and Supplier Quality teams.
• Hands-on, customer-focused approach with the ability to work safely while prioritizing multiple production and launch activities.
• Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with MES, QMS, digital inspection, and traceability systems.

Minimum Qualifications

• Diploma in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, or a related discipline required. A high school diploma with extensive relevant experience may be considered.
• 2-4 years of experience in mechanical engineering, manufacturing, Quality Operations, or a related environment.
• Ability to use mechanical measurement and inspection equipment and maintain accurate inspection and traceability records.
• Ability to work on the manufacturing floor, support shift operations and production priorities, and follow all applicable safety and high-voltage area requirements.
• Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate technical findings to the Powertrain Quality Mechanical Engineer and cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with mechanical Powertrain components, precision assembly, dimensional inspection, torque verification, leak testing, or functional testing.
• Experience supporting new product launches, greenfield manufacturing, or high-volume production ramp-up.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

To all recruitment agencies: Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

group: moneybox|head of corporate reporting & financial operations
title: Head of Corporate Reporting & Financial Operations
description:
About Moneybox

At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We're guided by our belief that wealth isn't about the money, it's about the means to more - more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind. Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping over one and a half million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they’re saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement.

We are FCA-regulated, look after more than £23 billion of customer assets, and have grown from under £5 billion in three years, with annualised revenue in excess of £150 million. We have done this while growing profitably year on year and building a fortress balance sheet, so our ambitions are funded from a position of strength rather than dependence on the next round. The next phase includes the launch of a financial advice service and expansion into B2B, which means the finance function is scaling in complexity as well as size.

Job Brief

• Accurate financial information is paramount in ensuring Moneybox operates efficiently and profitably. Our Head of Corporate Reporting & Financial Operations will be a leader in their field, possessing exceptional technical knowledge. In addition to being a financial reporting expert they will have a deep understanding of financial operations, with a demonstrable background of delivering and assisting with large transformation projects. Working closely with other functions, they will embed best in class financial controls governance as well as developing financial literacy across the business.

What you'll do

• Being a Head of at Moneybox doesn't just mean you own and manage your function, it means you play a vital role in helping define strategy through steering committees, quarterly planning meetings, and management committees. Moneybox has thrived owing to its strong culture; as a Head of, you are core in helping maintain this culture through living and promoting the Moneybox values. A Head of at Moneybox is a senior leadership grade, equivalent to a Director-level role in most other businesses, with the accountability, visibility and expectations that implies.Scope and scaleYou will lead a team of five, including three qualified accountants, across financial reporting, financial control, financial operations and tax. The role is accountable for all group legal entities and the group consolidation, the statutory audit relationship with PwC, and the finance systems estate, which is evolving towards an AI-native stack that you will help shape. You will be a member of the Finance Senior Leadership Team, present to the Audit Committee, attend management committees, and deputise for the VP Finance where appropriate.As a key member of the Finance Senior Leadership team and a trusted advisor to the VP Finance, this role will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following:Corporate Reporting
• Lead the development and execution of the corporate reporting strategy, ensuring alignment with the overall business objectives
• Oversee the preparation and timely submission of all statutory financial reports, including annual accounts, consolidated financial statements, tax filings, and regulatory returns
• Own the relationship with our external auditors, leading the annual audit and resolving technical judgements
• Prepare and present accounting judgement papers and control-environment reporting to the Audit Committee, and represent Finance at relevant governance forums
• Own the group's legal entity structure from a reporting and tax perspective, ensuring it remains efficient, compliant and fit for the strategy, and advising on structuring for new ventures
• Drive continuous improvement in financial reporting processes, leveraging technology and best practices to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and transparency
• Ensure compliance with IFRS and other relevant accounting standards and regulatory requirements, reviewing changes in accounting standards, regulations and best practice and assessing their impact on the organisation
• Alongside the finance senior leadership team, drive forward our IPO readiness programme, with a focus on reporting and financial controls
• Deputise for the VP Finance as requiredFinance Transformation, Automation & AI
• Own the finance transformation roadmap, with a clear mandate to automate the close, reconciliations and reporting production
• Lead the adoption of AI and automation tooling across the ledger and financial operations, moving the function from manual production towards exception-based review and continuous controls monitoring
• Set the data and systems architecture for finance, ensuring that reporting, control and regulatory outputs are built on a single, well-governed source of truth
• Champion a culture where the team builds and improves its own tooling rather than waiting for itFinancial Operations
• Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all day-to-day financial operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and tax
• Optimise financial operations to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve working capital management
• Oversee the selection, implementation, and management of financial systems and technologies
• Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and controls to ensure the integrity of financial data
• Oversee the implementation and maintenance of a robust internal control framework to mitigate financial risks and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements

Who you are

• Focus on team; providing strong leadership and fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement
• Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with senior management and external stakeholders
• Considered an expert in your field and a leader amongst your team and peers
• Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

Experience and skills

• Chartered accountant (ACA preferred), with a track record of leading a financial reporting and control function in a regulated financial services business; experience across both practice and industry is preferred
• Has personally owned statutory accounts, the external audit and an internal control framework at a scale comparable to Moneybox
• Experience of an IPO, IPO-readiness programme or a listed environment is strongly preferred
• In-depth knowledge of IFRS and UK GAAP and a demonstrated ability to form and defend accounting judgements with auditors and committees
• Evidence of having delivered material automation or systems change in finance, and genuine fluency with how AI changes the operating model of a finance team
• Exceptional project leadership across internal and external stakeholders, and the gravitas to influence at ExCo and Board level

Our Commitment to DE&I:

At Moneybox, we promote, support and celebrate inclusion, diversity and equity for all, so that everyone can bring their full selves to work. We believe that diversity drives innovation, and that if our team is representative of our community of customers, we can better support their needs. To ensure our recruitment processes provide an equal opportunity for all applicants to succeed, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments that we can make. We are open-minded and always willing to go the extra mile to ensure all applicants can present their full self and potential

Working Policy:

We have a hybrid policy that includes 2 days from our London office and 3 from home. If the role states it is either hybrid or remote candidates must be based within the UK.

Visa Sponsorship:

At this time we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role and we cannot consider overseas applications.

Please read before you apply!

Please note if offered a position, the offer is conditional and subject to the receipt of satisfactory pre-employment checks which we will conduct such as criminal record and adverse credit history checks. As a regulated financial business, an adverse financial history could impact your suitability for the role. If you are aware of anything that could affect your suitability for the role, please let us know in advance.

Consequently, we may use your personal data to evaluate your application, to select and shortlist applicants, to set up and conduct interviews and tests, to evaluate and assess the results, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment process generally.We do not share your personal data with unauthorised third parties. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America.

title: Executive Business Partner, EMEA (Strategy)
description:
About the Team

Our Executive Business Partners serve as trusted advisors and collaborators to OpenAI’s executives and leaders, bringing strong communication, sound judgment, and operational excellence to their teams. We elevate leadership impact by anticipating needs, streamlining processes, and providing comprehensive support so our leaders can focus on their highest-impact priorities. Through strong relationships and a deep understanding of business objectives, we help teams navigate complexity, achieve key milestones, and contribute to OpenAI’s growth and success.

Our leadership team reflects OpenAI’s culture and core values and is a mission-driven, kind, and thoughtful group. We take pride in creating a work environment that fosters collaboration, open communication, and authenticity, making OpenAI an excellent place to work for highly accomplished professionals.

OpenAI is expanding its presence across EMEA, building the teams and leadership needed to support our growth across the region.

In this role, you will:

Partner with our GM, UK & Nordics, our EMEA Communications leader, and a future EMEA Marketing leader. These leaders work closely with our Managing Director, EMEA, other regional GMs, and teams across Sales, Policy, Partnerships, and beyond to advance OpenAI’s presence in the region. You’ll help these leaders and their teams operate effectively by creating structure, driving coordination, and strengthening the operating cadence across markets, functions, and time zones. Working across regional business leadership, communications, and marketing, you’ll anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and build connections that support effective collaboration and execution.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

• 5+ years experience in a cross-functional executive assistant role or similar support function.
• Successfully supported multiple leaders in the past.
• Worked in a hard tech startup or similar environment.
• Experience working across EMEA markets and collaborating with U.S.-based HQ teams.
• High cross-cultural EQ and ability to tailor communication styles for diverse stakeholders.
• Strong operational rigor — able to run cadences, track priorities, and maintain alignment across time zones.
• Comfortable supporting complex, rapid travel across international regions.
• Strong communication - being able to tailor a message appropriate to a specific audience (writing an email to a Senator vs. a Customer vs. an Exec).
• Discretion - this role will have exposure to sensitive knowledge so must be rock solid on confidentiality.
• Humility/diplomacy - this role has the potential to accrue power in a unique ways, but we want this person to be decisive and make noncontroversial decisions.
• Very fluent in Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Gmail, etc. and other modern productivity software, and are excited to learn and use new tools.
• Genuine interest in the technology we’re building and the transformative potential of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
