Contract: Permanent, full-time

Working pattern: We offer a fully flexible working environment
Annual leave: 25 days of annual leave per annum, plus 3 additional days over Christmas
Additional Benefits: Comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

The role

We are looking for an experienced Learning Facilitator & Client Consultant to join the Common Purpose team.

This is a role for someone who loves people, ideas and learning, and who can work with a client to understand what they need, help shape the right learning experience, facilitate it brilliantly, and connect what happens in the programme to what needs to change afterwards.

Our programmes are experiential. Participants learn by encountering different people and perspectives, exploring real situations, having conversations that may challenge their assumptions, reflecting and reframing based on what they have experienced, and considering what it means for them and their organisation. You will be involved across that journey: from understanding the client and shaping the design, through to creating the conditions for powerful learning and helping participants and clients translate that learning into practice.

The facilitator is at the heart of making that learning happen. But this is not simply a delivery role.

You will need more than strong presentation or group-management skills. You will need to understand how people learn, how to design meaningful experiences, and how to turn those experiences into insight and action. You will need to be comfortable exploring a client's learning need, contributing to programme design, working with colleagues and clients to shape an experience, and identifying what will make the programme valuable beyond the room.

You will also need to know when to provide structure and when to get out of the way; when to challenge and when to listen; when a group needs energy and when it needs space to think. And you will need to stay curious about what happens after the programme - what participants do differently, what clients need to see change, and how our work can contribute to that.

You will work with an extraordinary range of people — from young professionals to senior leaders and C-suite executives — across different sectors, generations, cultures and contexts. You will need to connect quickly with all of them, while being equally confident in a conversation about a client's needs, a programme design, or the impact we are trying to achieve.

One day you might be helping a client make sense of a complex organisational challenge and shaping an experience around it. The next, you might be facilitating a conversation between people who have never met. Another day might involve an immersive experience outside the classroom, followed by a conversation that helps participants understand what they have seen, what it means for their own practice and what they will do differently as a result.

You will bring the personality to connect with people, the facilitation craft to hold a room, the learning and design expertise to create meaningful experiences, and the client consultancy skills to connect those experiences to real organisational needs and impact.

What you’ll be doing

• Working with clients to understand their learning needs – asking the right questions, challenging assumptions where appropriate and translating organisational needs into meaningful learning experiences
• Contributing to learning design and proposals, helping shape programme journeys, learning objectives, activities and approaches that respond to client needs
• Designing and curating learning experiences – shaping programme journeys and identifying the ideas, perspectives, organisations, places and contributors that will make them distinctive and purposeful
• Sourcing and working with contributors – building relationships with interesting people and organisations, briefing them effectively and drawing out their contribution before, during and after programmes
• Contributing confidently to client pitches - explaining the thinking behind our approach and helping clients understand how experiential learning can address their needs
• Facilitating Common Purpose programmes - both in person and online, taking ownership of the quality of the learning experience
• Creating the conditions for experiential learning – building trust, encouraging participation and creating the right balance of safety, challenge and curiosity
• Bringing learning to life - through questioning, discussion, activities, reflection and interaction with expert subject matter contributors
• Reading and responding to the room - adapting activities, pace, questions and approach according to what the group needs
• Preparing, reviewing and improving delivery – developing facilitation plans and materials, contributing to team briefings and debriefs, and sharing learning and practice with colleagues

What you’ll bring

We are looking for someone who combines excellent facilitation skills with a strong understanding of how people learn.

You will be a confident and experienced facilitator, but you will also be curious about what makes a learning experience work. You will understand that great facilitation is not about delivering content; it is about designing and creating the conditions in which people can learn through experience, reflection, conversation and challenge.

You will bring:

• Strong facilitation experience – ideally five years or more of facilitating groups, learning experiences or programmes
• Understanding of experiential learning and pedagogy – you know how people learn through experience, reflection, dialogue, challenge and application
• Learning design capability – you can see how individual experiences and activities contribute to a wider learning journey and can design with the participant experience in mind
• Learning consultancy skills – you are comfortable exploring a client’s needs, asking probing questions, challenging a brief and helping shape the problem before jumping to a solution
• Client confidence – you are comfortable presenting ideas, contributing to pitches and speaking credibly with clients and senior stakeholders
• Energy, curiosity and external orientation –
you are naturally interested in people, ideas and the world around you, and enjoy discovering perspectives and experiences that bring learning to life
• Strong interpersonal and group skills – you can read a room, listen well, ask powerful questions and bring different voices into the conversation
• Confidence with challenge and complexity – you can facilitate difficult conversations, navigate difference and create productive discomfort without losing trust
• Adaptability and judgement – you can work with a plan while knowing when to change it, improvise or take a conversation somewhere unexpected
• A reflective approach to your own practice – you actively seek feedback, learn from experience and are interested in continually improving how you facilitate, design and consult

All applicants must also

• Have excellent written English, oral communication and interpersonal skills
• Be confident facilitating both in person and online
• Be comfortable working independently while also contributing actively to a collaborative team
• Be able to manage a varied workload, multiple programmes and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Be willing and able to travel within the Uk and globally for programme delivery, including occasional early mornings, evenings and short periods away from home
• Be confident and proficient in the use of Microsoft Office, Zoom and other digital collaboration tools
• Be committed to Common Purpose’s independent and non-aligned approach to programme experiences
• Be able to demonstrate your facilitation experience. This might include examples of programmes you have facilitated, participant or client feedback, testimonials, recordings of your facilitation, qualifications or other evidence of your practice

What we offer

• Purpose – the opportunity to work on programmes designed to create meaningful change for individuals, organisations and communities
• Variety – exposure to different sectors, generations, cultures, organisations and perspectives through your work
• Growth – continual development of your facilitation practice, alongside access to internal learning and development opportunities
• Responsibility – meaningful ownership of programme delivery from the outset
• Flexibility – a remote-first and flexible working environment
• A global network – the opportunity to work with colleagues, participants and partners across different countries and contexts

About Common Purpose

Common Purpose is a global non-profit organisation that develops people to navigate the complexity, influence and competing interests that shape the world around them.

Our work is built around three disciplines:

• Navigating complexity – sensing, interpreting and acting on what is changing in the world.
• Navigating influence – staying accountable to the consequences of the power you hold.
• Navigating legitimacy – having, and granting others, the ground and courage to challenge across boundaries that are not theirs to control.

We bring these disciplines to life through experiential learning. Participants encounter different perspectives, enter unfamiliar environments, engage with people and organisations beyond their usual experience, and work through real questions and situations. Our programmes create the conditions for people to test their assumptions, understand the consequences of their decisions and develop the confidence to act differently.

We bring together people from different sectors, backgrounds, generations and perspectives. Our facilitators play a critical role in creating the experiences and conversations through which this learning happens.

Over 90,000 professionals and nearly 75,000 students worldwide have taken part in Common Purpose programmes.

Next Steps

If you are an experienced facilitator who enjoys working with people, navigating complexity and creating learning experiences that stay with participants long after a programme ends, we would love to hear from you.

Please send us your CV and a cover letter explaining why you are interested in the role and what you would bring to Common Purpose.

We particularly welcome evidence of your facilitation practice, such as participant or client testimonials, examples of programmes you have delivered, relevant qualifications or a recording of you facilitating.

Common Purpose is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds and will consider candidates based on the relevance of their skills, experience and potential.

If you have any access requirements during the recruitment process, please contact us at .

Salary: £38,000 - £43,000 per annum, depending on experience

Job Application for Executive Assistant - Developer Platform at Cloudflare

Executive Assistant - Developer Platform

Apply

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX or New York

About the Role

Cloudflare is looking for a bright, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support three leaders in our Developer GTM organization. We are looking for a dynamic and dedicated candidate who is comfortable with multi-tasking and prioritization in a fast-paced, product-first environment with close attention to detail, accuracy, and timeliness.

Responsibilities

• Calendar & Conflict Management: Proactively manage complex calendars with a strong understanding of business priorities. Independently resolve scheduling conflicts and anticipate meeting requests and logistical needs before they are explicitly stated.
• Travel & Logistics: Manage and coordinate complex international and domestic travel, including visa and passport needs, as well as end-to-end logistical arrangements for executives and teams.
• Executive Support & Business Context: Develop a deeper understanding of the managers' roles, our products, and the broader market and context for Cloudflare. Serve as a trusted gatekeeper who can confidently answer routine questions on behalf of the executives.
• Expenses Meeting Coordination: Prepare and manage expense reports..
• Projects & Process Improvement: Contribute significantly to ad-hoc/special projects. Recognize where operational processes can be improved and actively suggest and implement those process improvements.
• Meetings & Event Planning: Coordinate and assist with large meetings, external stakeholders, and event planning with precision.

Requirements

• 6+ years experience as an Administrative Assistant, in Ops, or equivalent experience.
• Scope & Judgment: A seasoned professional with proven experience handling problems of diverse scope and demonstrating excellent judgment in selecting administrative and operational methods.
• Proactiveness & Autonomy: Strong sense of urgency, proactiveness, and the ability to manage your own time with limited or no supervision.
• Communication & Networking: Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to network and build strong relationships with executives and team members.
• Organizational Skills: Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Mindset: A "no task is too small" attitude combined with the strategic mindset needed to anticipate executive needs.

Drive: Experience working in a tech and AI-native, product-led environment.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.

Estimated Salary for New York: $114,000 - 157,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Facilities Coordinator

Company Description

Netcompany is one of Europe’s leading technology partners, with more than 9,500 colleagues delivering digital solutions for governments, critical industries and businesses across Europe. We take responsibility for the full journey, from strategy and development to daily operations. As Europe’s leader in sovereign AI, we build technology on Europe’s own terms.

Job Description

Netcompany is seeking a proactive and service-minded Facilities Coordinator to support the day-to-day delivery of effective, safe and well-functioning workplace operations. The role coordinates operational activities, suppliers, compliance documentation and financial administration in line with Group Facility Management standards, processes and templates.

You will work closely with the Facility Manager and internal stakeholders to ensure consistent colleague and client experience. The role is hands-on and coordinating in nature; significant operational, compliance, supplier and financial matters are escalated to the Facility Manager.

Key responsibilities

Workplace operations

• Coordinate day-to-day workplace operations and resolve operational issues in a timely and service-oriented manner.
• Coordinate planned and reactive maintenance and follow up on open actions through to completion.
• Liaise with landlords, managing agents, contractors and suppliers on operational matters.
• Support workplace onboarding and office events in cooperation with relevant internal stakeholders.
• Apply Group Facility Management standards, processes, templates and reporting requirements consistently.

Suppliers, service quality and finance

• Coordinate contractors and third-party suppliers and follow up on service delivery, SLAs and KPIs.
• Monitor service issues and corrective actions and escalate significant performance or commercial matters to the Facility Manager.
• Support supplier reviews, procurement activities and contract administration in line with Group Facility Management processes.
• Manage purchase orders, invoice processing and expenditure tracking, ensuring that costs are correctly documented and allocated.
• Support budget follow-up and identify opportunities to improve service quality and value for money.

Health, safety and compliance

• Coordinate day-to-day Health & Safety activities in accordance with local requirements and Group Facility Management standards.
• Coordinate contractor inductions, permits to work, workplace inspections, DSE assessments and risk assessments, where applicable.
• Support incident and near-miss investigations and monitor agreed corrective actions through to completion.
• Review and maintain relevant contractor and compliance documentation, including RAMS and statutory records, where applicable.
• Maintain accurate documentation and evidence to support internal governance, audits and relevant ISO management systems.

Reporting and stakeholders

• Maintain operational records and provide regular reporting on supplier performance, compliance, Health & Safety and expenditure.
• Prepare clear colleague communications relating to workplace operations, maintenance and Health & Safety.
• Build effective working relationships across Facility Management, HR, IT, Finance, Procurement and other business functions.

Qualifications

What we expect from you

• You are service-oriented, structured and proactive, with the ability to maintain an overview while following through on operational details. You thrive in a dynamic environment, take ownership of your tasks and make sound decisions within established processes and escalation routes.
• Relevant experience from Facilities Management, Workplace Operations, Office Management or a similar operational environment.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with a consistent focus on follow-up and completion.
• Experience coordinating contractors and third-party suppliers.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• A proactive, practical and solution-oriented approach to day-to-day issues.
• Experience with purchase orders, invoice processing, expenditure tracking and operational reporting.
• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Fluency in English; relevant local language skills may be required depending on the office location.

Desirable qualifications and experience

• Experience supporting Health & Safety compliance in an office environment.
• Experience with SLAs, KPIs, supplier reviews or contract administration.
• Experience supporting ISO management systems or internal and external audits.
• A relevant Health & Safety qualification, such as IOSH Managing Safely, or willingness to obtain one.

Additional Information

Build on your experience and keep developing

Your development continues through the responsibility you take, the projects you lead and the people you learn from. As part of a structured career model, you’ll build on the experience you already bring, supported by a personal mentor from the leadership group who can help guide your professional development, career direction and personal goals.

Be part of a shared community

Community is built through the way we work together. You’ll join teams where collaboration, trust and support are part of everyday work. We bring together colleagues with different backgrounds, identities, cultures and experiences, ensuring everyone is met with respect and has equal opportunities to develop and thrive.

Driven by responsible digitalisation

We believe digitalisation creates the most value when it is done responsibly. We build solutions that are secure, transparent, and designed to create lasting impact for people, businesses, and society. Responsibility is embedded in how we design, develop, and deliver every solution.

Benefits include

• 25 days’ holiday
• Private Medical Health care via Vitality
• Pension contribution, Life Assurance
• Professional certifications supported as part of learning and development.
• A range of retail discounts to enhance your lifestyle, encompassing restaurants, supermarkets, travel, leisure activities and health and well-being services.
• Access to our Employee Resource Groups, our groups represent diverse backgrounds and provide a platform for colleagues to connect, learn, and support one another.

Company information

At Netcompany, we pride ourselves on our entrepreneurial spirit and our capacity for doing things differently. Our culture is built on fostering low bureaucracy, emphasizing high agility and promoting flexibility, enabling everyone to contribute their best.

Our journey began in the UK with the acquisition of Hunter Macdonald in 2017. As one of Northern Europe's most accomplished IT companies, we have expanded our headcount globally to 7400+ employees and have offices in UK, Denmark, Norway, Poland, Holland and Vietnam.

Netcompany is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process for anyone wishing to apply for a job with us. We operate a Disability Confident Interview Scheme which means that we offer guaranteed interviews to all applicants with a disability who meet the minimum criteria for a role. Applicants are asked to opt in, so please let us know if you wish your application to be considered under this scheme.

If you need any reasonable adjustments or extra support during the recruitment process, please contact us at [email protected].

AI-related roles include roles clearly involving AI, machine learning, data science, generative AI, LLMs, AI automation, AI governance or AI architecture.

Job Description

Help shape the success of a complex data migration by investigating data quality, preparing source data and validating that what moves is complete and faithful. Working across multiple organisations, you'll turn unfamiliar datasets into clear, evidence-based findings that guide migration decisions.

Key Responsibilities

You'll join a data migration programme where your analysis informs mapping, cleansing and acceptance decisions, working alongside data engineers, data owners and client stakeholders.

• Investigate unfamiliar datasets to understand their structure, content, relationships and variation across organisations.
• Identify and explain data quality issues, trace them to source records, mappings or transformations, and quantify their impact on migration.
• Design repeatable comparisons and reconciliation checks to validate that migrated data is complete, consistent and faithful.
• Write reusable SQL and Python scripts for profiling, exception detection and validation, using Azure Databricks, Git and dbt where relevant.
• Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, using Excel and Power BI or Tableau to present evidence and track issues.

Qualifications

You bring a strong analytical background and a careful, evidence-based approach to working with data.

• Experience profiling unfamiliar datasets and tracing data quality issues to their root cause in a migration context.
• Strong SQL skills for complex joins, window functions, anomaly detection and source-to-target reconciliation.
• Working knowledge of Python, Azure Databricks or Spark SQL, and familiarity with Git and dbt.
• Ability to present evidence, scale and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• A responsible approach to data management, ethics and privacy.

Szukamy osoby, która nie tylko rozumie procesy biznesowe w branży ubezpieczeniowej, ale przede wszystkim brała aktywny udział w projektowaniu, budowie lub rozwoju rozwiązań IT wspierających obszar ubezpieczeń na życie.

Będziesz współpracować z zespołami biznesowymi i technologicznymi, analizując wymagania oraz wspierając rozwój systemów i procesów ubezpieczeniowych.

Co oferujemy?

• Długoterminową współpracę w oparciu o kontrakt B2B.
• Możliwość pracy hybrydowej
• Udział w projektach rozwijających rozwiązania IT dla sektora ubezpieczeniowego.
• Współpracę z doświadczonymi zespołami biznesowymi i technologicznymi.
• Realny wpływ na kształt rozwijanych systemów i procesów.
• Prywatną opiekę medyczną Lux Med oraz kartę MultiSport.

Requirements:

• Life Insurance
• Claims Management
• Policy Administration
• Underwriting
• BPMN 
• Jira
• Confluence

• Minimum 3–5 lat doświadczenia w analizie biznesowej, w tym udokumentowanego doświadczenia projektowego w obszarze Life Insurance – warunek konieczny.
• Praktycznego udziału w projektach związanych z budową, wdrażaniem lub rozwojem systemów dla ubezpieczeń na życie.
• Bardzo dobrej znajomości procesów charakterystycznych dla ubezpieczeń na życie, np.:
• obsługa cyklu życia polisy (Policy Administration),
• zawieranie i obsługa umów ubezpieczenia,
• ocena ryzyka (Underwriting),
• obsługa świadczeń (Claims Management),
• naliczanie składek i rozliczenia.

title: Senior Java Backend Engineer (Core Java, Trading Systems)
description:
Join the Java Engineering Team at a top N. American Bank

Are you a Java engineer who enjoys working on large scale and high performance software? Do you love working with smart people on meaningful technology? Want to work in capital markets on financial trading systems? If so, read on.

The Role at a Glance

• Senior Java Backend Engineer
• Fully remote for a top N. American bank (for residents of Poland or Romania)
• Openings on multiple teams in the capital markets division (prime brokerage, platform team)
• Part of the core team - this is not a legacy support role or an outsourced B team

We’re hiring experienced backend engineers (6+ years) to join a major N. American bank — directly supporting the development of financial trading systems. This is not a legacy maintenance or support role — you’ll be part of the core product team, building highly-performant, low-latency systems used across the firm.

Are you a passionate Java developer who thrives on solving complex problems in low-latency, high-throughput trading systems? Join us and work on interesting financial system engineering problems.

Why Join Us?

• Work on a large-scale, low-latency trading system processing millions of daily transactions.
• No Legacy: Join an actively developed system — the engineers who built it originally are still on the team.
• Collaborate with a world-class team of developers across North America and Europe.
• Enjoy the stability of a long-term, fully remote role that only a bank can offer.

A successful candidate will be a very strong programmer with current Java development experience. They must also be curious, open-minded, and desire to learn new things. English proficiency is a must.

This role is for developers who excel at programming core Java from the ground up, not just integrating frameworks or APIs. If you’re fascinated by understanding systems ‘under the hood,’ this role is for you. Successful candidates enjoy geeking out about data structures and debugging application performance issues.

This is a fully remote backend Java development role for a developer in Poland or Romania. You will be working through a Polish company that will provide the support and administrative assistance to make you successful in the role. We are looking for people to join the team long-term.

Different teams have different working hour arrangements. For all roles, to ensure efficient onboarding, you’ll work in sync with the American team during US Eastern business hours for the first two months. Working this way maximizes your time overlap for answering questions, which means you can learn quickly. That means working until 21:00 CET. After that, some teams offer more flexibility your schedule can shift closer to standard Polish business hours.

Only open to residents of Poland or Romania. Citizens and legal residents with permission to work in Poland or Romania are welcome.

What we offer

• Work that matters in the financial domain: Work on a trading system at an established financial institution, processing millions of transactions daily.
• Professional growth: Collaborate with smart, highly capable developers in a supportive and challenging environment.
• Direct collaboration: You will work directly with the client team in North America and in Europe.
• 1st-tier work: This is not a technical support or legacy maintenance role. The system is functional and is actively being built and you will take part in updating it. The people who built the system are still part of the team.
• Long-term commitment: This is not a fixed-scope or fixed-term outsourcing role; we value people who want to grow and contribute long-term.
• Flexibility & remote work: Fully remote position with increasing schedule flexibility post-onboarding.
• Competitive Compensation: Above-average pay and ample time-off options.

Responsibilities

• Design and implement robust software solutions for the bank’s trading systems using core Java (versions vary from team to team, and include 8, 17 and 21).
• Understand, develop, and improve the subsystems used by other teams in the trading platform.
• Create thorough test cases to ensure software stability and reliability.
• Collaborate with operations teams regarding building new features and improving existing functionality.
• Support production issues, including root-cause analysis and diagnosis.

Requirements

Must have

• Strong understanding of programming concepts, including algorithms, complexity, and data structures.
• Good knowledge of the data structures in the Java standard library - both breadth and internals.
• Experience building distributed service-based applications based on message queues.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, to effectively diagnose production performance issues measured in microseconds.
• Open mind, curiosity, and a strong desire to learn new technologies and business domains.
• Ability to clearly explain non-trivial systems and algorithms.
• Ability to follow and understand technical conversations.
• Know when and how to ask questions that speed up learning.
• Ability to align your working schedule to US Eastern business hours.

Nice to have

• Experience with financial markets and trading systems.
• Knowledge of AWS systems.
• Experience with Spring boot (some teams).
• Experience with JVM tuning (some teams).
• Experience working remotely with North American firms.
• A computer science degree from a top school.

The recruitment process

• Submit your CV.
• Answer a few written questions and a short programming exercise which you can do at your own pace.
• Participate in a three-stage interview process:
• Discuss your experience and skills.
• Solve verbal algorithm problems (focus on clarity and understanding).
• Tackle live coding challenges (no trick questions).

No take-home assignments – we respect your time.

Successful candidates will need to pass a standard background check.

title: QA lead
description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About the role

You’ll lead the group-level QA team that supports engineering across all SINGU products, and you’ll stay hands-on. This is a player-coach role: a significant part of your week goes into writing and reviewing test code, while you also own the team’s goals, not just its calendar.

What you’ll do

Hands-on:

• Build and maintain automated tests across multiple products: web and API as the baseline, with depth in performance, accessibility or mobile depending on your strengths
• Write tests in Playwright (TypeScript) and ship them through Jenkins / Bitbucket Pipelines
• Set up new automation projects from scratch and review the team’s test code
• Act as the safety net for ongoing refactoring and migration of a legacy PHP / .NET codebase
• Drive adoption of AI tools and practices in QA workflows, from test generation to analysis

Leading the team:

• Lead a team of QA engineers: priorities, workload, 1:1s, development, hiring
• Take ownership of the team’s goals and report on quality (coverage, escaped defects, automation progress) to engineering leadership
• Define and raise QA standards and practices across the group
• Be the QA counterpart for dev teams and product: you decide what gets tested, how and when
• Coordinate external penetration testing: scope, communication with dev teams, and retests

You’ll thrive here if:

• You’ve shipped production test automation as a Senior QA Engineer and still write code every week
• You’ve led a QA team or been the de facto lead: planning, feedback, accountability for results
• You’re fluent in Playwright or Cypress in TypeScript and comfortable with API testing (REST, HTTP, JSON)
• You know your way around CI/CD (Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines or similar)
• You take ownership and don’t need a fully laid-out playbook
• You use AI tools in your daily work and know where they help, and where they don’t
• You speak fluent Polish and English (B2/C1), both used daily across the group

Nice to have:

• Performance testing (k6, JMeter, Gatling) or accessibility testing
• Experience building a QA function or automation strategy from zero
• Security testing in a QA context (OWASP Top 10, ZAP)

What We Offer:

• Salary range 16 600 – 20 300 gross (UoP) or 20 000 - 24 500 PLN net on B2B + VAT
• The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing international SaaS company shaping the future of real estate operations.
• A role with real ownership and operational impact, where your work directly supports the efficiency of the entire organization.
• A collaborative and international environment, working with teams across multiple countries.
• The chance to improve and build processes in a scaling organization.
• A supportive culture built on adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

title: Senior Data Scientist (Supply Chain)
description:
Job Location

WARSAW - EU SUPPLY NETWORK HUB

Job Description

Within our Demand Planning team, we forecast how much of our everyday essentials (like diapers, laundry detergents, disinfectants, soap or shampoos) our retail customers will order - helping P&G stay ready to meet that demand wherever and whenever it arises. We’re looking for an ambitious Senior Data Scientist who thrives in high-impact environments, builds ML models, transforms them into production-ready pipelines, and understands the balance between technical excellence and business relevance. You’ll be joining a global organization with strong data maturity, where you’ll shape scalable solutions across forecasting, optimization, and applied analytics domains.

What You’ll Do:

• Design, develop, and deploy demand-forecasting models for the full product lifecycle (from product launch through discontinuation)
• Advance our forecasting engines with techniques such as time-series clustering and statistical/ML modeling (scikit-learn, stats models)
• Lead initiatives on feature engineering, model evaluation, and forecast-accuracy monitoring at scale
• Build and maintain robust, config-driven data pipelines using Databricks and PySpark
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams on end-to-end solution delivery — from prototype to production
• Contribute to our internal forecasting library and advocate for clean architecture, modular design, and long-term maintainability
• Lead cross functional teams and support management with a data-driven decision making

Job Qualifications

• Solid Data Science background in areas of: Time Series forecasting, Supervised learning, and ML/statistical algorithms (scikit-learn, statsmodels)
• Strong Python programming skills, with hands-on experience across the scientific stack (pandas, NumPy, SciPy)
• Experience turning models into production-ready, modular pipelines with clean architecture and config-driven design (e.g. Pydantic)
• Proficiency with version control (Git)
• At least 4 years of experience as a Data Scientist or a related position (Data Engineer / Software Engineer / AI Engineer / ML Ops)
• Excellent collaboration skills and working comfortably within a cross-functional team
• Shown success in leadership, problem solving and priority setting
• English proficiency and at least a Bachelor's degree

Nice to have:

• Experience building distributed data pipelines with PySpark on Databricks, and familiarity with SQL and Azure
• Exposure to demand/sales forecasting, product-lifecycle modeling, or forecast-accuracy evaluation
• Prior background knowledge of Supply Chain or FMCG domains

What we offer

• Work in an international Data Science team with global responsibilities (with large part of engineering and product teams located in Warsaw)
• Long-term career with development and growth opportunities
• Competitive salary and benefits program (private health care, life insurance, P&G stock options, saving plans, lunch subsidy, sport cards, in-office fitness center)
• Relevant trainings, certifications, conference participation
• Internal coaching programs & training
• Flexible working arrangements

title: Internal Audit Manager
description:
Job Application for Internal Audit Manager at Cloudflare

Back to jobs

New

Internal Audit Manager

Hybrid

Apply

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX

Role Summary

The Internal Audit Manager will lead risk-based audits from planning through reporting and remediation follow-up, partnering with stakeholders across Finance, Go-to-Market, Legal, and People. The Manager will also contribute to the team’s audit innovation efforts, collaborating with our engineers and data scientists to develop continuous auditing capabilities and repeatable AI-enabled workflows. The ideal candidate is highly motivated, has hands-on experience building AI solutions, and adapts quickly to new business areas in a rapidly evolving environment.

Role Responsibilities

• Conduct risk assessments to identify and prioritize areas for audit focus.
• Lead risk-based audits covering financial, operational, and technology objectives.
• Prepare clear, concise, and high-impact audit reports with actionable recommendations for improvement.
• Communicate audit findings and recommendations to all levels of the company, including senior executives.
• Work with the team's engineers and data scientists to design, build, and improve continuous auditing capabilities and AI-enabled workflows.
• Look for opportunities to apply automation and data analytics in audits to strengthen testing, expand coverage, and improve efficiency.
• Review and validate AI-assisted work to make sure results are accurate, well supported, and meet Internal Audit documentation standards.

Role Requirements

• 6+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, compliance, or a related field, with a solid understanding of control design and testing.
• Strong knowledge and prior experience in applying internal auditing and accounting principles and practices, specifically audit methodologies, risk assessment, testing techniques, audit documentation and report writing.
• A proven track record of building automation or AI-enabled solutions that others have adopted and relied on in their day-to-day work, such as tools, workflows, or applications used by a team or business function.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely.
• Proven ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
• Strong critical thinking and the ability to learn new systems, business processes, and technologies quickly.

Nice-to-Have Skills

• Familiarity with Go-to-Market systems and processes, such as Salesforce.
• Experience with Oracle ERP.
• Experience with SOX compliance or ITGCs.
• Professional certifications such as CIA, CPA, CFE, or CISA.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.

An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Paid Search Manager (B2B)

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer.

Job Description

At Wise, we're on a mission to empower users to make smarter, more transparent financial decisions. We operate as a collective of autonomous teams, trusting and empowering everyone to take ownership and execute on the things that drive the greatest impact for our users.

The landscape of search is rapidly evolving, driven by generative AI, sophisticated machine learning, and a shift toward in-app discovery. We're looking for a highly strategic, data-driven Paid Search Manager to help us acquire net-new customers for Wise Business across multiple platforms, markets and languages. Your focus will be exclusively on B2B acquisition: helping new businesses and business owners discover Wise and sign up for a Wise Business account. You’ll bring at least 4 years of hands-on paid search experience and should be comfortable working with campaign data, identifying opportunities and turning insights into action. Experience in B2B or business-customer acquisition is highly preferred, alongside an understanding of how business needs, decision-making and conversion journeys can differ from those of personal customers. Working closely with other Paid Search specialists and cross-functional partners, you’ll contribute to the growth of Wise Business while developing your skills in managing increasingly complex, global campaigns.

You will own and shape our search strategy, integrating modern AI capabilities, maximising efficiency across all platforms, and empowering the wider team by sharing advanced insights and fostering a culture of shared learning.

What you’ll be doing:

Search Strategy & Execution

• Manage and optimise paid search campaigns focused on acquiring net-new Wise Business customers and driving efficient business account sign-ups.
• Work across large-scale Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts covering multiple markets, languages and business customer segments, with the potential to expand to new engines and video platforms in the future
• Monitor campaign performance, identify trends and recommend practical actions to increase sign-ups and improve acquisition efficiency.
• Support campaign launches and expansion into new markets, business segments and search or discovery channels.
• Contribute to the overall Business strategy within the Paid Media team, from forecasting, to planning, to delivery
• Proactively looking for both tactical and strategic optimisation opportunities, and translating this into campaign delivery

AI and Automation

• Use platform automation and AI-powered features, such as automated bidding, Performance Max and AI Max, to improve B2B campaign performance and operational efficiency.
• Identify opportunities to make recurring campaign-management and reporting processes more efficient through automation, templates or improved ways of working.
• Stay informed about developments in search marketing, generative AI and the ways business customers discover and evaluate financial services.

Testing and the Business Customer Experience

• Support the end-to-end delivery of structured tests across ad copy, assets, targeting, bidding and landing pages.
• Develop clear hypotheses, monitor results and turn findings into actionable recommendations for business customer acquisition.
• Test messaging that responds to the different needs, challenges and motivations of businesses and business owners.
• Use search-term, campaign and customer-behaviour insights to improve the relevance and clarity of Wise Business advertising.
• Work with colleagues across Marketing, Wise Business, Product and Analytics to help prospective business customers find the information and services most relevant to their needs.

Reporting and Analysis

• Maintain and improve campaign reports and dashboards, ensuring B2B acquisition performance is communicated clearly and accurately.
• Analyse campaign data to identify optimisation opportunities, emerging business-customer segments, risks and areas requiring further investigation.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

• Collaboration & Team Empowerment: Act as a key strategic partner and subject matter expert within the team. You will focus on empowering your colleagues by sharing advanced learnings, fostering collaborative problem-solving, and helping to establish strong communication and best-practice processes that elevate the entire team.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead high-impact, cross-channel initiatives and projects - working closely with SEO, Product, Analyst and Paid Marketing teams - to drive holistic user growth and enhance the overall customer journey.

Qualifications

• Have 4+ years of experience running large, direct response search campaigns for a fast-growing business or agency, ideally with a proven track record of scaling across global markets.
• Are actively engaged with the latest developments in Generative AI for Search and excited by the challenge of integrating these technologies into a high-performing marketing function.
• Are a customer-first advocate who believes the core purpose of search marketing is understanding and helping the end user achieve their goals transparently.
• Possess in-depth knowledge of modern tracking, attribution (e.g., server-side), and measurement frameworks.
• Have advanced experience with bid management, automation tools, and a strong history of implementing or amending Google/Microsoft Ads Scripts (or equivalent API solutions).
• Are a proactive, data-driven leader able to prioritise projects based on forecasted impact with a high degree of autonomy.
• Understand the strategic fit of SEM within the broader user journey and its symbiotic relationship with channels like Paid Social, Affiliates, and SEO.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Previous experience with B2B-focused campaigns.
• Experience with YouTube campaigns or Apple Search Ads is a plus.
• Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese or Portuguese.

Additional Information

We cannot offer sponsorship for this role.

Salary - 45k to 55k.

Hybrid working

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Who We Are

Building the Backbone of Distributed Applications.

Orkes is building the platform that powers the next generation of enterprise applications and AI systems. Founded by the creators of the open-source Netflix Conductor orchestration platform, Orkes helps organizations build, deploy, and operate mission-critical workflows and AI agents at massive scale. Our platform combines workflow and agent orchestration, integrations, observability, and resilience into a unified developer experience, enabling teams to build and operate complex deterministic and agentic workflows with confidence. From global enterprises to fast-growing startups, customers rely on Orkes to automate business-critical processes and execute billions of workflow and agent executions with the reliability, visibility, and fault tolerance required for production systems.

We’re solving some of the hardest infrastructure problems: how do you make distributed systems reliable, observable, and scalable – without every team having to reinvent the wheel? We absorb the complexity of distributed systems, letting teams build with confidence.

We’re hiring a Solutions Architect to help us evolve and scale our platform. If you’re passionate about clean, efficient architecture, love solving tough distributed systems challenges, and thrive in an environment where your ideas actually shape the product then we’d love to talk.

And the best part is we’re just getting started.

What You’ll Do

• Become an expert on the Orkes platform to lead customers through training, adopting and implementing best practices for their orchestration journey
• Partner with the sales team to act as a technical advisor during the sales process
• Collaborate with the product team as an advocate of your customers in the field
• Help our customers to achieve tangible data-driven outcomes through the use of the Orkes platform, establishing a clear architectural vision and identifying compelling use cases so as to realize value
• Find solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in orchestration and application development in various business domains including logistics, fintech, cyber security, healthcare and cross vertical use cases like application modernization, performance scaling, and resilience
• Engage with the technical community by leading workshops, seminars and meet-ups

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture and customer-facing roles
• Understanding of business processes across multiple industries, geographies and technical domains
• Understanding of system design patterns, distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native architecture
• Experience with integrations using REST and messaging systems (Kafka, MQ, etc.)
• Language proficiency in Java
• Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for learning new technologies
• A collaborative mindset—we win as a team

Bonus Points

• Experience with orchestration engines or workflow systems (e.g., Conductor, Camunda, Temporal)
• Contributions to open-source projects

Why You’ll Love Working at Orkes

• You’ll be working on real and difficult problems that developers face every day
• You’ll join a team that thinks deeply about the systems we build and the people who rely on them
• We’re a fast-growing team backed by top-tier investors and used by some of the world’s biggest companies
• Remote-friendly, flexible working hours, a global team and a strong culture of trust and ownership
• You’ll have a huge impact on the direction of our technology and our company

Not 100% sure you fit the description? That’s okay.

We care more about your potential and passion than checking every box. If this role excites you, we want to hear from you.

Ready to help shape the future of distributed applications?

Apply now and build something developers will love.

More Details:

The base salary for this role is $80,000-180,000 USD. However, compensation is based on local market rates for your country/region, along with your years of experience and qualifications.

• Start Date: ASAP
• Status: Full time (via EOR vendor)
• Type: Remote daily w/expected travel to clients
• Location: Europe, GMT +1 or within 1-2hrs of that timezone.
• Department: Engineering
• Reports to: Head of Engineering
• Travel: 15-20%

Benefits

• Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision
• Flexible PTO
• Support for personal development

At Orkes, we are committed to building a team that reflects a rich tapestry of perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We believe that diversity is not just a checkbox, but a driving force behind innovation, creativity, and success. By embracing a variety of backgrounds, we cultivate an inclusive environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.

Join us at Orkes and be a part of a team where your unique perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Together we are shaping the future technology by leveraging the strength that comes from embracing diversity in all its forms. Your Journey with us is an opportunity to contribute to something greater and make a lasting impact.

title: Engineering Manager with Networking/Hardware background
description:
Salary: 20000 - 27000 PLN per month (B2B)

Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

• Act to deliver.
• Disrupt to grow.
• Team up to win.

The project and the team

We are looking for an Engineering Manager capable of leading software development, quality assurance, or observability projects.

We are recruiting for two different divisions, and you can join us if your background aligns with either the Networking & Hardware domain or the Observability & QA domain.

You will be working under the supervision of our senior managers alongside a team of fellow EMs/PMs. In this role, you will oversee a diverse portfolio of projects. The nature of these engagements will vary significantly—ranging from straightforward team augmentation setups to complex deliveries that require deep, hands-on project management involvement. The customer may be one of the big vendors or it can be a startup aiming to disrupt the biggest players in the observability business.

What else you should know:

• We keep our project teams consisting of fewer than 10 people.
• We often work using client-supplied hardware and tools.
• Most of our clients are based in the US (often Silicon Valley), so work in the afternoon may sometimes be required.
• We work hybrid or fully remotely

Your role

Note: While you will heavily leverage your technical background to steer teams and discussions, this is a non-coding management role.

Project Delivery & Technical Alignment

• Collaborate with clients to clarify business objectives and technical requirements.
• Facilitate architectural discussions and align engineering decisions with client leads.
• Oversee delivery health, proactively managing risks, scope changes, and project dependencies.
• Empower engineering teams by removing obstacles and ensuring efficient execution.

People Leadership & Growth

• Foster high-performing, engaged teams by applying your leadership style within CodiLime’s culture.
• Actively participate in talent acquisition, onboarding, and continuous engineer mentoring - full employee lifecycle

Client & Business Partnership

• Nurture long-term client trust and spot opportunities to expand ongoing engagements.
• Take part in pre-sales and business development activities
• Travel occasionally for on-site client visits (typically up to twice a year).

More reasons to join us

• Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid
• Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget
• Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start
• A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work
• The ability to change the project you work on

Requirements:

• QA
• Networking
• Linux
• Protocols
• L2
• CI/CD
• Test automation

Do we have a match?

As an Engineering Manager, you must meet the following criteria:

• 7 years of experience in the domain and at least 3 years in a managerial position (Project Manager, Engineering Manager, Technical Delivery Manager, Tech Lead / QA Lead) with dedicated people management responsibilities (we are open to both growing and seasoned managers—the scope will match your seniority).
• Prior hands-on engineering background (e.g., Software Engineering, QA Automation, Systems/Embedded Engineering) — while this is a non-coding role, you must be able to understand low-level concepts and speak the same language as your engineers and client architects.
• Solid grasp of networking & systems fundamentals: strong familiarity with Linux environments and core networking protocols/concepts (L2/L3, network architecture).
• Delivery & test mindset: practical understanding of modern CI/CD practices, test automation strategies, and efficient software delivery lifecycles.
• Proven people leadership skills: guiding career development, conducting impactful 1-on-1s and performance reviews, building trust, and navigating conflict.
• Fluency in English (C1+): confident verbal and written communication, capable of leading technical discussions with international clients and stakeholders.

Nice to have (or what will make you stand out):

• Professional services experience: prior background working in a software house, outsourcing, or consulting environment managing external client expectations.
• Domain familiarity:

Option A: Networking & Hardware Domain:

• Solid grasp of networking & systems fundamentals: Linux environments and core networking protocols/concepts (L2/L3, network architecture).
• Delivery & test mindset: practical understanding of modern CI/CD practices, test automation strategies, and efficient software delivery lifecycles.
• Exposure to networking hardware and low-level software, such as network adapters, SmartNICs, or DPUs/IPUs.
• Network Operating Systems (e.g., SONiC, IOS-XR).
• Hardware bring-up, driver integrations, or porting software to new silicon/hardware targets.

Option B: Observability & Quality Assurance Domain:

• Observability: Experience in at least one of the Observability domains (APM, NPM, Cloud Monitoring, or Infrastructure Monitoring) and familiarity with observability tools and platforms such as Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus, or the ELK Stack.
• Network testing & validation: experience leading teams around network function testing, performance benchmarking, or testbed orchestration (e.g., Spirent, Keysight, PyTest frameworks).
• Broad infrastructure awareness: practical exposure to cloud environments, virtualization, or containerization.

Nice to have:

• Operating system
• Quality assurance
• npm
• Cloud
• Grafana
• Splunk
• Prometheus
• ELK Stack
• Testing

group: canonical|latam enterprise account executive - spanish speaker
title: LATAM Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker
description:
We are looking for enterprise sales people based in LATAM and fluent in Spanish. Colombia is currently the highest priority.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

• Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
• High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
• Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
• Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
• Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.

What your day will look like

• Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
• Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
• Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
• Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
• Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
• Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
• Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers’ business problems
• Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
• Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
• Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers

What we are looking for in you

• Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
• Experience of open source technology and solutions
• Detail oriented with effective follow-up
• Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
• Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
• Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
• Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
• Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional skills of interest

• Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
• Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
• Annual compensation review
• Recognition rewards
• Annual holiday leave
• Maternity and paternity leave
• Employee Assistance Program
• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
