title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic AI
description:
Job Application for Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic AI at PolyAI

Back to jobs

New

Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic AI

United Kingdom

Apply

PolyAI is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. Powered by Raven, a proprietary dialog model trained on more than a billion enterprise conversations, PolyAI agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. PolyAI serves hundreds of enterprises across 75 languages and 25 countries, including Metro Bank, Marriott, PG&E, and UniCredit.

The role

Most AI agents are demos. Ours answer the phone for some of the biggest brands in the world: more than 100 million calls a year, across 2,000+ live deployments. Someone is on the line trying to move a booking, report a fault or pay a bill, and the agent either works or it doesn't.

We looking for a Forward Deployment Engineer who has built and shipped LLM agents in production, including tool use and evals. Forward Deployed Engineers are the people who make it work. You own a customer's agents from the first scoping call through to production and beyond. You design how the agent behaves, write the code that connects it to the customer's systems, put it on their phone lines, measure it and keep making it better.

This is not sales engineering and it is not support. You ship code that runs in production, and you own what happens after it ships.

We want someone who already builds agents because they can't help it, and who wants to do it at the hard end: real-time voice, messy enterprise systems, and callers who notice every mistake.

What you'll do

• Own agents in production, end to end. Scope with the customer; design the conversation, the tools and the guardrails; build in Agent Studio and our ADK; launch; and stay accountable for how it performs.
• You have built and shipped LLM agents in production, including tool use and evals
• Connect agents to the real world. Integrate CRMs, booking engines, payment flows and twenty-year-old APIs in Python. Work across SIP, telephony and contact-centre platforms. Make tool calls fast and reliable in the middle of a live conversation.
• Debug live calls. When a call goes wrong, work out whether it was the speech recognition, the model, the prompt, an integration or the phone line, and fix the right thing.
• Run agents like a scientist. Build eval sets from real calls, run A/B tests and let data decide what ships. Containment, resolution and caller experience are your numbers.
• Close the gap to the platform. When you solve something for one customer, turn it into a reusable tool, template or product change so the next deployment is faster. Work directly with product, research and platform engineering, including the team training Raven, our own LLM built for customer service.
• Be the technical lead the customer trusts. Run sessions with their engineering, operations and executive teams. Explain trade-offs plainly. Say no when no is the right answer.
• Work AI-native. You use coding agents and LLM tooling every day, and you help the people around you do the same.

You'll fit if

• You have shipped LLM-powered agents or conversational systems to real users, and you can show us one.
• You write strong Python and are at home in production code, APIs and integrations, including codebases you didn't write.
• You have several years in a technical, customer-facing engineering role: forward deployed, solutions engineering that ships real code, consulting engineering, or a startup where you were the engineer customers called.
• You own outcomes, not tickets. You have been the person on call when it broke, and you liked it.
• You can explain a latency budget to an engineer and a containment trade-off to a COO in the same afternoon.

Even better

• Voice and telephony: SIP, IVR, CCaaS platforms, real-time audio.
• Evals and experimentation, or an ML background: you have built a test set or run an online experiment.
• Regulated industries such as healthcare, utilities or financial services.
• Go or C++, or high-throughput real-time systems.

Why PolyAI

• Voice is the hard channel, and it's all we do. Real-time, interruptible, noisy, on phone lines built decades ago. Doing it well at enterprise scale is a moat, and you will learn things here you can't learn anywhere else.
• We own the stack that matters. Raven is our own LLM, trained for customer service inside the agent harness. When the model is the problem, the people who can fix it sit down the corridor.
• Real production, real stakes. Your agents go live for brands people have heard of, and you will see the impact in their numbers within weeks.
• Ownership early. Small teams, each engineer owning accounts. The best ideas from the field become the product.
• London HQ. Founded by conversational-AI researchers from Cambridge, with teams in London and North America.

We offer competitive compensation based on experience, expertise, and the level of responsibility. This role also includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business. The listed expectations reflect what we're hiring for, so we encourage you to review the job description carefully.

Benefits

💰 Participation in the company’s employee share options plan

🏝 Tenure-Based PTO: You will receive 25 holidays when you join and will gain an additional 1 day after 2 years of service, then 1 day each year until capped at 32 holidays

🏡 Flexible working from home policy

🌎 Work from outside of the UK for up to 6 months each year

🫂TELUS Health EAP 24/7 - offers you and your chosen family confidential, judgment-free support for any work, health, or life challenge

🧡 Enhanced parental leave

🚲 Bike2Work scheme

📚 Annual learning and development allowance

🏡 We’re all about making WFH work for you - that’s why we offer a one-off WFH allowance when you join. Offering perks like noise-cancelling headphones or a comfortable desk chair to boost your comfort and focus!

👨‍👩‍👧 Company-funded fertility and family-forming programmes

🌸 Menopause care programme with Maven

🏥 Private healthcare and dental cover, discounts on gym members and relaxation apps, and access to a range of mental health programs

🌎 Sabbatical Program: 5-week paid sabbatical available after 5 years of employment

At PolyAI, we take great pride in our values - they guide everything we do. We believe that a strong culture leads to meaningful work and lasting impact.

Our core values are:

Only the best
We expect the best from our people, we hire people that expect the best from themselves, and we nurture this drive for excellence.

Ownership
We care deeply about what we do. We take ownership of our initiatives, decisions and outcomes.

Relentlessly improve
We demand more from ourselves and are always evolving. Continuous, obsessive improvement is the only way we will transform the world of conversational AI.

description:
Wise Executive Assistant | SmartRecruiters

Executive Assistant

• Full-time
• Compensation: GBP 50000 - GBP 62000 - yearly

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer.

Job Description

Location: London (Hybrid – In-office requirement: 4 days/week)

We are looking for an Executive Assistant to support our Legal Team. This role will be based out of our London office and is a unique opportunity to enhance the productivity of our legal leadership by managing complex logistics and communications. You will ensure our leaders are prepared, organised and focused on our mission to save billions for customers globally.

Your ability to anticipate needs and streamline administrative processes will be pivotal to your success in this role.

This is a unique opportunity to work in a fast-paced, global environment, supporting teams in a company that is changing the way money moves around the world.

Your Mission:

• Inbox & Communications Management: Support senior leaders with email inbox management, helping to triage, prioritise, and draft responses. You will maintain a clear and organised communications flow, flagging urgent matters and ensuring timely follow-up on outstanding items.
• Document Accuracy & Quality Control: Review and proofread documents, agendas, minutes, and correspondence before they reach senior leaders or external parties. You take pride in the accuracy and quality of everything that leaves the team, understanding that precision is especially important in a legal environment.
• Calendar & Meeting Management: Independently manage complex diaries across multiple locations and time zones for two senior members of Wise leading the Legal team. You will proactively manage and protect their time, arrange internal/external meeting rooms and register guests with reception as required.
• Strategic Planning & Facilitation: Coordinate Legal Team meetings and events by sourcing relevant topics and speakers. You will lead the quarterly forward-planning sessions, ensuring the team is fully prepared for quarterly planning cycles through coordinated dates.
• Stakeholder Readiness: Ensure senior leaders are fully prepared for all interactions, with pre-reads and documents available ahead of scheduled meetings. You will take minutes when required, collating and helping action next steps, act as a point of contact for the Legal Team, liaising with internal stakeholders and external parties including law firms, government officials and counterparties.

• Travel & Logistics: Research and book comprehensive travel and accommodation for legal leadership, including attendance at external conferences, hearings, and meetings.
• Financial & Document Administration: Process expenses and invoices in compliance with company policies, including the management of external legal counsel invoices.
• Event Coordination: Organise and support team events, offsites, and socials for the Legal Team and participate in Mission Days.
• Ad-hoc Support: Provide ad-hoc administrative support as required for other members of the Legal Team.
• Culture Champion: Positively contribute to making Wise a great place to work.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience:

• Proven experience as a Personal Assistant (PA) or Team Assistant (TA), ideally within a legal, professional services, financial services or high-growth global company.
• A track record of managing complex diaries across multiple time zones.
• Expert in Google Suite (or similar) and collaboration tools like Slack.
• You embrace opportunities to learn and grow, quickly adapting to new procedures and handling unexpected changes with ease.
• You pride yourself on delivering well-organised, accurate work that reflects a high standard of professionalism.

Skills & Abilities:

• Exceptional Organisation: You manage multiple priorities efficiently and deliver high quality work under pressure.
• Proactive Preparedness: You have a knack for identifying logistical challenges before they arise, ensuring leaders have what they need before a meeting starts.
• Communication & Hospitality: Clear and concise communication skills with a professional presence for welcoming guests and interacting with Wisers at all levels, including external legal counsel and government agencies.
• Tech-Savvy & AI Ready: You are comfortable with new technology and are eager to use AI tools to streamline workflows.
• Team Player: You are a Relationship Builder and Cultural Champion who naturally fosters a culture of mutual support. You prioritise the success of the collective by providing active support and cover for other BOSS team members and embracing Wise's mission-driven environment.
• Discretion: Working within a legal function, you handle sensitive, privileged and confidential information with the highest level of integrity at all times.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description:
Hello,
We are called People More because we treat our employees with respect, but also because the projects we work on are for people and should be easy and pleasant to use. We are technological, but we look at the bigger picture :)
The company is made up of people with a huge client base in the country and abroad, for whom we build projects from scratch (UX, UI, frontend, backend, mobile) or in part. We work directly for our clients and also support our partners in their own solutions. This ensures a wide range of projects and the ability to change! We work with clients all over the world.
For the project that we are working on with our partner, we are looking for Staff Backend Engineer.

Your duties will include:

• Designing and evolving backend architecture across multiple teams, ensuring clear domain boundaries, reliable service communication, and scalable system design.
• Establishing architectural principles for distributed systems, including event-driven communication, state management, data consistency, and API integration.
• Leading technical discussions and documenting architectural decisions through ADRs, RFCs, and technical design proposals.
• Assessing technology options and recommending appropriate solutions for databases, cloud infrastructure, messaging systems, and financial data processing.
• Developing and improving AI-powered engineering workflows, including agentic development tools, adoption monitoring, performance measurement, and continuous optimisation.
• Identifying opportunities to improve engineering practices, modernise existing solutions, and introduce common technical standards across teams.
• Collaborating with engineering leaders and product stakeholders to ensure that technical solutions align with business objectives and long-term platform strategy.
• Supporting experienced engineers through architectural reviews, technical mentoring, knowledge sharing, and design discussions.
• Driving cross-team technical initiatives and supporting the implementation of architectural improvements across the organisation.

Requirements that must be met:

• At least 8 years of professional experience in software engineering, including a minimum of 2 years in technical leadership or architecture-related responsibilities across multiple teams.
• Minimum 3 years of experience designing distributed systems in the payments or fintech sector.
• Strong backend engineering expertise and practical experience working with different technology stacks.
• In-depth understanding of distributed systems and architectural patterns such as Event Sourcing, CQRS, Domain Events, and Saga.
• Experience designing state machines and managing the lifecycle of financial entities.
• Strong knowledge of API architecture, including REST APIs, asynchronous communication, and event-driven integration contracts.
• Ability to evaluate database technologies, including relational, document, time-series, and ledger-oriented solutions.
• Experience assessing cloud architecture and services in environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.
• Practical experience designing or improving agentic engineering environments, including instrumentation, adoption tracking, and iterative optimisation.
• Understanding of LLM tool-use patterns, context management, and AI-assisted software development workflows.
• Experience preparing clear technical documentation, including Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), RFCs, and system design documents.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to interface
• Demonstrated ability to excel in a global matrix organization
• Strong leadership skills
• Very good English and Polish

What we offer:

• We are open and honest and we solve problems instead of generating them.
• Maybe it’s obvious, but we really respect our employees and associates. We used to be software developers, too, and we appreciate that job!
• A small team
• An international working environment and international projects
• Private medical care
• Sports card
• Training courses
• Hybrid work - 1 day a week in the office (Cracow or Warsaw)

Why it’s a good idea to work with People More?

• If you are not satisfied with your work or your tasks, we’ll find a way out together!
• If you get bored, we will offer you a new product and new, fascinating tasks
• We will work on your brand together: you will get an opportunity to attend conferences, including as a speaker, and we will help you publish in recognized magazines and online
• We will facilitate your access to challenges that are usually difficult to get
• At any time, you can talk directly to the board of People More—we talk your language because the company’s founders are software developers and designers!

What does the recruitment process look like?

• A friendly remote initial interview
• A remote technical talk
• The decision to work together!

title: Linux Engineer
description:
Job Application for Linux Engineer at Cloudflare

Back to jobs

New

Linux Engineer

Hybrid

Apply

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Linux Engineer

An engineering role at Cloudflare provides an opportunity to address some big challenges, at scale. We believe that with our talented team, we can tackle some of the biggest security, reliability and performance problems facing the Internet.

We are searching for Linux engineers to make our flavour of Linux fast, resilient and reliable across the many use cases that a distribution saving the Internet requires.

Our Engineers come from a variety of technical backgrounds and work across a broad range of environments and codebases. Common qualities across all of our performance-focused engineers include a passion for analysis, optimization, scaling, networking, cross-team collaboration and hard problem solving.

What you would be doing

• Keep Cloudflare Linux platforms secure and up-to-date
• Help with quick and safe deployment and delivery of the Linux kernel and basic operating system to Cloudflare Datacenters in more than 335 cities in over 100 countries
• Continuously monitor and resolve kernel bugs and performance regressions
• Design tools and frameworks for other engineering teams to successfully embrace and enable the latest Linux kernel features and optimizations
• Help porting the Cloudflare software stack to new hardware platforms and architectures
• Research and adopt the latest Linux kernel security features and performance improvements
• Build tools and CI/CD pipelines for safe and automated operating system continuous deployment

Requisite skills:

• Experience with the Linux kernel and Linux software packaging
• CS fundamentals and comfortable working in multiple programming languages and codebases; Comfortable working in Go, Rust, C, Bash, and Python.
• Familiarity with constructing and using eBPF programs.
• Understanding of Linux and POSIX operation systems concepts: processing, files, syscalls, and networking
• Containerization technologies in Linux (e.g Docker, Namespaces, Cgroups)
• Configuration management (e.g Saltstack, Chef) and CI/CD pipelines
• Version control systems (git)

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• Performance analysis and debugging
• Time series databases such as OpenTSDB, Graphite, Prometheus or Grafana
• Key/Value stores
• Network fundamentals DHCP, ARP, subnetting, routing, firewalls, IPv6, BGP
• Experience in a DevOps team structure

Bonus Points

• Experience with programming in C, Rust, Go, or similar languages
• Experience with rapid release engineering
• Upstream community contribution
• Strong tooling and automation development experience

Some tools that we use

• Consul
• Docker
• Grafana
• Kubernetes
• Nginx
• Nomad
• PostgreSQL
• Prometheus
• Salt

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

title: Senior IT Support Specialist
description:
Job Application for Senior IT Support Specialist at Koalafi

Back to jobs

New

Senior IT Support Specialist

Richmond, Virginia

Apply

At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior IT Support Specialist to be the full-time, hands-on owner of day-to-day IT support for our Richmond and Arlington offices. You will be the primary liaison between Koalafi associates and Code Blue, our contracted IT support partner, making sure every teammate has the equipment, access, and help they need to do their best work.

This is a hybrid role based in Richmond, VA, with a minimum of three days per week on-site. You will be the visible, trusted go-to person for anyone with urgent and tier 2 issues. You will also help define how IT support works at Koalafi, including the internal service levels we hold ourselves and our vendor to.

This role is a partner to the business, not only a help desk. Some issues cannot wait for business hours, so you will be a dependable point of contact for high-impact and urgent requests, including occasional off-hours support for company leaders. You must be equally comfortable with troubleshooting a failing conference-room display and managing a vendor relationship, and calm and clear with executives and non-technical colleagues in both. This role may occasionally require on-call support outside of standard business hours. However, on-call responsibilities are minimal and infrequent, with limited after-hours time commitments.

What You'll Do

Be the day-to-day support contact for the business

Serve as Koalafi's primary liaison with our contracted IT support team and tier-2 support point of contact: route and triage requests as needed with Code Blue, follow-up on open tickets, and escalate as needed. Assist with urgent issues and take ownership of keeping associate satisfaction with our contracted support team high.

Support associates directly and be there when it matters.

Be on-site at least three days a week in Richmond to support in-house associates and office technology such as video conferencing, printing, and a small networking stack. Help resolve hardware, software, and access issues when timeliness matters. Act as the point of contact for high-impact and urgent requests, including occasional off-hours support.

Help leadership define and uphold internal support standards.

Partner with leadership to build internal SLAs for response and resolution. Measure performance against them, spot patterns in recurring issues, and drive improvements with both our contracted IT team and our internal teams.

About You

• An experienced IT support professional. You bring 4+ years of progressive IT support experience, ideally including a senior, lead, or sole-IT-contact role at a small to mid-sized company. You are as comfortable doing the work yourself as coordinating others to get it done.
• Technically hands-on across the stack. You have strong skills with Windows and macOS, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, and modern identity, SSO, and MDM tools such as Intune and JumpCloud. You understand networking fundamentals, including Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and switching, and endpoint security basics.
• Experienced with office and meeting room technology. You have supported Zoom Rooms or comparable conference platforms, and you take pride in meeting spaces that work the first time.
• A service-minded, clear communicator. You explain technical topics clearly to non-technical colleagues and executives, set honest expectations, and follow through. You stay calm and organized when something urgent breaks.
• Organized and process-oriented. You keep clean records of assets and procedures. You have supported new-hire onboarding and offboarding, and you naturally document what you build so others can use it.
• Present and dependable. You are able to work on-site in Richmond at least three days a week and are willing to provide occasional off-hours support for urgent, high-impact issues. Able to travel to our Arlington location for project help semi-annually.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, transaction-intensive environment is a plus.
• Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Security+, Microsoft 365 Certified, ITIL Foundation, or HDI-SCA.
• Familiarity with our environment, including Slack, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and common ticketing and service-desk tools. We value strong fundamentals and sound judgment over expertise in any single product.
• Experience documenting processes and reporting service metrics, plus light scripting or automation (PowerShell, Bash) to streamline repeatable work.
• Interest in using AI tools to improve how IT support works, from knowledge base content to ticket triage and onboarding workflows.
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Location: Richmond, VA.

Salary Range: $80,000-$110,000 per year (depending on experience)

Additional Compensation: This position will be eligible to participate in company bonus plan.

The final salary offer will depend on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and geographic location. The actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

Applications will be accepted until position is filled.

Why choose Koalafi: A career at Koalafi means opportunities to tackle exciting challenges every single day. We take pride in a culture of innovation, trust, and ownership. You'll get outside your comfort zone, build meaningful relationships, and most of all, take charge of projects that ultimately help people get the things they need most.

Benefits:

At Koalafi, you will have a direct impact on our products and help shape the company’s success. We offer competitive compensation & benefits packages to keep you at your best:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
• 20 PTO days + 11 paid holidays
• 401(k) retirement with company matching
• Student Loan & Tuition Reimbursement
• Commuter assistance
• Parental leave (maternal + paternal)
• Inclusion and Associate Engagement Programs

Who we are & what we value:

• We focus on what’s most important
• We set clear expectations and deliver
• We embrace challenges to reach our full potential
• We ask, “How can this be better?”
• We move fast together

A "recently separated veteran" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.

An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.

An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

title: Compliance Engineer
description:
About Playson

Playson builds premium casino games and platform solutions for operators worldwide. Our products reach millions of players across regulated markets, and we ship frequently - which means our certification and compliance evidence has to be as well-engineered as the games themselves.

We are hiring a Software Developer, Compliance, to own that engineering: a pipeline that lets us ship faster and safer, and a defence of the platform and the games that holds up in front of a lab, an ISO assessor, and a future SOC 2 auditor.

About the role

You are a software developer sitting inside compliance. You will build and continuously evolve a secure compliance pipeline so we can ship games and platform changes faster and safer - and you will be the technical person who defends what we shipped when an auditor, a certification lab, or a regulator asks.

The scope is not games alone. You will stand in front of game certification labs, and you will also defend the platform: ISO certification of our systems and the evidence work that leads into a future SOC 2 audit. In every case, the job is the same. You produce the proof. You walk the auditor through it. You answer the question that was asked, with the evidence that was requested, and you stop there.

You will own the technical side of game certification. You take a game math package from the review channel to the lab, you produce the evidence the lab needs - build hashes, PAR sheets, configuration snapshots, version manifests - and you answer the lab's technical questions yourself, without a developer sitting next to you. When a certificate comes back, you are the person who confirms every deficiency is closed before the game is allowed past the pre-release gate.

Between lab submissions, you treat the pipeline as a product. Manual evidence collection, one-off screenshots, and tribal knowledge are the things you replace. You automate controls, tighten the audit trail, and shorten the path from "ready to ship" to "ready to show an auditor" without weakening the bar. Faster and safer at the same time is the point of this role - not one at the expense of the other.

What we're looking for

• You are a developer first. 3+ years writing production code, comfortable reading someone else's codebase and forming your own opinion about what it does. You are not a documentation coordinator who learned some technical words
• Strong Node.js and TypeScript. Our game math packages, engine integration, rules and bets migrations, test suites, and compliance automation are all JavaScript-side. You will read game math code and verify that what it does matches what we told the lab it does - and you will write the tooling that makes that check repeatable
• You know what it takes to build certified products. You have worked for an iGaming game provider, a lottery, or another business where products require certification. You understand how that shapes development, testing, and releases, and why the code and supporting evidence need to stay aligned.
• You build pipelines, not checklists. You have taken a manual, high-stakes process and turned it into something engineered: automated evidence, versioned artefacts, gates that fail closed
• You can read data and write queries. SQL against a production analytics store, log investigation, understanding a metrics pipeline well enough to tell a real control failure from a broken dashboard
• Composure in front of an auditor. In a lab session, an ISO assessment, or a future SOC 2 walkthrough, you answer the question that was asked with the evidence that was requested. You communicate with auditors and certification labs precisely and factually. You provide complete evidence for the question or control being assessed, avoid speculation, and escalate regulatory interpretations to the Head of Compliance
• You know where your authority ends. When a question moves from technical fact to regulatory interpretation or commercial consequence, you route it to the Head of Compliance instead of improvising
• You write clearly and permanently. Compliance evidence is read years later by people who were not in the room. Your documentation has to survive that
• You are comfortable saying no. You will be the person telling a squad, under release pressure, that their change does not pass the gate. That conversation needs to be calm, specific, and final
• Precise by temperament. You check the version number rather than remembering it. You are not bored by an audit trail

Nice to have

• Direct dealings with a certification lab (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, iTech Labs, or similar) or a gaming regulator
• Hands-on evidence work for ISO 27001, SOC 2, or an equivalent information-security audit
• Understanding of RNG, RTP mathematics, and how statistical certification evidence is produced
• Familiarity with multi-jurisdiction licensing (UKGC, MGA, and regulated EU and LatAm markets)
• Observability and alerting tooling - Datadog or equivalent, including building automation on top of it rather than just reading dashboards
• Experience with change-management controls, audit trails, and segregation-of-duties models
• Incident response experience, particularly where the incident had a regulatory or audit dimension

What you can expect on this role

• A role with real authority: you hold gate sign-off, and a release does not go past you without it
• Genuine engineering work - you own the compliance pipeline as a product, not a pile of checklists with a technical title
• Direct exposure to certification labs, ISO assessors, and the path to SOC 2 - rare and portable experience
• Close collaboration with math, QA, platform, and SRE across games and the platform
• A compliance function that is being built up deliberately, with room to shape how it works

What we offer

• Unlimited Paid Time Off
• Unlimited Paid Sick Leave
• Remote & Flexible Working
• Private Medical Insurance
• Financial Support for Life Events
• Professional Development Budget
• International Exposure
• Regular Company Events

title: Product Marketing Manager (Cloud, Remote, Ireland)
description:
About the Opportunity

Join our fully customer-funded, engineering-driven team at VictoriaMetrics, the creators of the three open source databases - VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs, VictoriaTraces - that are the foundation of the VictoriaMetrics Observability Stack. Our technology is trusted by leading companies like Grammarly, Spotify, Roblox, and Wix.

We are seeking a creative, collaborative, and strategically-minded Product Marketing Manager to join our team to focus on our enterprise products - in particular our VictoriaMetrics Cloud product. This role will serve as a critical link between Product, Sales, Marketing - and from there our users, ensuring that we deliver the right solution to the right audience with the right message at the right time across our product offering.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Maintain and update the messaging for our VictoriaMetrics Cloud product(s), as well as the core public-facing assets that present our products, such as product webpages, product profiles, etc.
• Develop and promote product marketing resources including case studies, guides, research articles, webinars, white papers, and videos to effectively communicate the value proposition of our products, in conjunction with our Product Marketing Team.
• Plan and help execute cross-channel marketing campaigns utilizing content, email, web, social media, and ads to drive brand awareness, engagement, and conversions.
• Maintain and expand competitive intelligence, including monitoring the marketplace, creation of battle cards, and research of related verticals.
• Facilitate cross-departmental training to ensure messaging consistency and discipline.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with product and sales teams to assist with successful product and feature launches.
• Work with our Digital Marketing Manager on content for our social media channels, content calendar, and monitor performance metrics to optimize results.
• Provide ongoing support to keep product collateral and sales enablement resources up-to-date.
• Support as necessary additional initiatives driven by the Marketing team.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in (product) marketing, communications, or a related field.
• Excellent business writing skills with experience crafting compelling messaging for technical products.
• Familiarity with product marketing principles, techniques, and best practices
• Experience working in B2B marketing.
• Proficiency in marketing automation tools and CRM systems.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in marketing B2B enterprise and specifically SaaS products.
• Experience in monitoring, observability eco-systems is a definite plus.
• Experience and/or knowledge of open-source technologies or open-source technology vendors.

Together we will

Grow our online presence, visibility & user experience

• Work with our Founders, engineers, the marketing team and others on meeting our existing and new users where they are with information that’s relevant to them.

Moreover, we will

• Support your professional and personal growth: You will be working directly with our company founders, our marketing team, design and development teams.
• Support and encourage your individual initiatives.

What We Offer

• Good salary and bonuses, remote work model, and flexible working hours.
• Opportunities for professional growth and development.
• A collaborative and innovative work environment.
• The chance to make a real impact on our technology and user community.

About VictoriaMetrics

We are the company behind the popular open-source, high-performance time-series database and monitoring solution: VictoriaMetrics. We’ve now also known for our open source logs management solution, VictoriaLogs, as well as the new VictoriaTraces.. Fortune 500 companies use our products as their core monitoring & observability solutions. Our services are used by Adidas, WIX, Grammarly, CERN and thousands others. Our open source products have been downloaded 1B+ times to date.

Please note: this position is designed for Independent Contractors with their own registered business entity

title: Senior Payroll Data Migration Specialists
description:
Salary: 36 - 43 EUR per hour (B2B)

Project Description:

We are looking for experienced Payroll Data Migration Specialists to join an international HR & Payroll transformation project.

The role focuses on coordinating and overseeing payroll data migration activities across multiple countries, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with global migration standards.

The engagement is scheduled to begin in January/February 2027 on a full-time basis. The initial duration is a minimum of 6 months, with the possibility of extension.

About Spyrosoft

Spyrosoft is an authentic, cutting-edge software engineering company, established in 2016. In 2021 and 2022, we were among the fastest growing technology companies in Europe, according to the Financial Times. We were founded by a group of tech experts with established backgrounds in software engineering, who created an ‘engineer-to-engineer’ workplace, powered by enthusiasm, fairness and authentic relationships. Having a unique offering, which bridge the gap between technology and business, we specialise in technology solutions for industry 4.0, automotive, geospatial, healthcare & life sciences, employee experience & education and financial services industries.

Requirements:

• Data migration
• Data structures
• Data mapping
• ETL
• Project management
• Security

Required Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with Workday – mandatory.
• Business-fluent English, both written and spoken.
• Proven experience in complex, preferably international, data migration projects.
• Strong understanding of HR and payroll data structures, processes, and dependencies.
• Practical experience with data mapping, data cleansing, data validation, and reconciliation.
• Good understanding of ETL processes and data migration methodologies.
• Experience in stakeholder coordination and project management.
• Ability to work effectively with international teams and country-level stakeholders.
• Understanding of data protection and security principles related to sensitive personnel and payroll data.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a global project environment.

Nice to Have:

• Previous experience in global Workday implementations or payroll transformation programmes.
• Experience coordinating multi-country payroll migrations.
• Familiarity with payroll compliance requirements across different countries.
• Experience with migration readiness assessments, cutover planning, and post-migration validation

Daily tasks:

• Coordinate payroll data migration activities across multiple countries, ensuring alignment with the global migration methodology.
• Ensure migration documentation, deliverables, and supporting evidence are complete, consistent, and traceable.
• Consolidate migration progress, track key milestones, and provide status updates across participating countries.
• Assess migration readiness, identify potential risks, and provide recommendations to the Global Project Manager and Programme Manager.
• Define and oversee data cleansing strategies to ensure data quality and migration readiness.
• Monitor Extraction, Transformation & Loading (ETL) processes from legacy HR/payroll systems into the target environment.
• Establish reconciliation frameworks to validate the accuracy and completeness of migrated data.
• Perform or coordinate payroll data reconciliations, including headcount, salary totals, tax configurations, and other critical payroll elements.
• Collaborate with international stakeholders, local country teams, and technical teams to resolve migration-related issues.
• Ensure compliance with data protection, confidentiality, and security requirements when handling sensitive employee information.

title: WMS Consultant with French
description:
We are looking for an experienced WMS Functional Consultant fluent in French to drive Warehouse Management System (WMS) implementation, rollouts, and functional enhancements. In this role, you will act as the key liaison between operational logistics teams and technical delivery squads, ensuring supply chain processes in manufacturing, distribution, and warehousing are translated into scalable, efficient WMS solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Business Analysis & Gathering Requirements: Lead functional discovery workshops with French-speaking business stakeholders and warehouse operations teams to capture end-to-end supply chain requirements.
• Functional Solution Design: Map and design core warehousing processes (Inbound/Outbound, Putaway, Picking, Packing, Inventory Management, VAS) within the target WMS platform.
• Implementation & Rollouts: Support functional implementation, configuration, deployment, and localized rollout activities for international warehouse sites.
• Testing & Quality Assurance: Design test scenarios, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validate business workflows against target solution architecture.
• Training & Change Management: Prepare functional documentation, user guides, and deliver training sessions to warehouse operational teams and end-users.
• Hypercare & Support: Provide functional expertise, root-cause analysis, and process optimization during post-go-live stabilization phases.

Requirements & Qualifications

• WMS Expertise: Proven experience as a Functional Consultant working with enterprise Warehouse Management Systems (e.g., Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, SAP EWM, Generix, Reflex WMS, or Infor WMS).
• Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of supply chain, logistics, distribution, or manufacturing environment operations.
• Consulting Background: Previous experience in client-facing consulting, system integration, or end-to-end software deployment projects.
• Language Skills: French (B2+/C1 level) with the ability to lead meetings and produce functional documentation in French; professional English for internal coordination.
• Stakeholder Management: Strong communication and facilitation skills to bridge business needs with technical delivery teams.

Nice to Have

• Experience with warehouse automation systems (MHE, WCS/WES integration, RF scanning, voice picking).
• Basic knowledge of integration protocols (EDI, REST APIs, Flat files) between WMS and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Dynamics 365).

Senior Insurance Technology Consultant
description:
We're looking for a Senior Insurance Technology Consultant to join our team in Gdańsk, Katowice, Kraków, Łódź, Poznań, Wrocław, or Warsaw, Poland, in a hybrid working mode.

As part of EPAM's growing Insurance Business Unit, you will work in a high-visibility, client-facing role that drives AI and cloud transformation programs for leading insurance organizations. This position offers the opportunity to influence business outcomes, deliver strategic technology solutions and shape EPAM’s presence in the Polish and European insurance markets. By joining EPAM, you will access a global network of experts, continuous learning resources and career growth opportunities in a collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

• Engage C-level stakeholders to define technology and AI transformation strategies for insurance clients across Europe
• Lead executive workshops, architecture reviews and strategic advisory sessions
• Translate complex technical concepts into clear business-value narratives for diverse audiences
• Validate and shape AI-powered solution strategies on enterprise cloud platforms
• Drive AI transformation initiatives, including adoption of GenAI tooling and developer productivity solutions
• Recommend cloud architecture patterns aligned with regulatory requirements such as GDPR, DORA and Solvency II
• Enable internal AI capabilities, including GenAI enablement programs and ROI measurement frameworks
• Support business development activities and identify new opportunities in European and Polish insurance markets
• Collaborate with EPAM teams on proposals, client interviews and growth strategies

Requirements

• 8+ years of industry or consulting experience, including 5+ years working with major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP)
• Expertise in AI strategy and GenAI/LLM-based solutions, with hands-on understanding of enterprise deployment
• Solid knowledge of cloud-native architecture patterns (microservices, event-driven design, DevSecOps, CI/CD)
• Familiarity with AI lifecycle in SDLC environments, including prompt engineering and governance frameworks
• Strong understanding of the insurance value chain in P&C, Life and Reinsurance, and related regulatory landscapes
• Understanding of EU and Polish compliance frameworks (GDPR, DORA, Solvency II, KNF)
• Proven consulting experience, including RFP support, business case design and executive workshop facilitation
• Excellent communication skills and ability to influence C-level stakeholders
• Fluent English; Polish language is an advantage
• Willingness to travel across Europe (up to 30–40%)

Nice to have

• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (or equivalent AWS/GCP certifications)
• Experience in platform engineering, Team Topologies or Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in an insurance context

We offer

• We gather like-minded people:
• Top tech minds driving innovation in AI, cloud and digital platform modernization
• Supportive team and agile, startup-like culture
• Hybrid by design mode and opportunity to work remotely within Poland
• Chance to work abroad for up to 60 days annually
• Business-driven relocation opportunities
• We provide growth opportunities:
• Career development programs
• Thought leadership, mentoring, soft skills and well-being programs
• Certification (Anthropic, Gemini, GCP, Azure, AWS)
• English classes
• We cover it all:
• Stable pay
• Participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a 15% discount
• Benefits package (health insurance, multisport, shopping vouchers)
• Referral bonuses up to $2,000
• Offices featuring entertainment and relaxation zones, table tennis and football, free snacks, coffee and more
• Corporate, social and well-being events
• Please, note:
• Benefits listed above are available to employees only
• We are open for working with Contractors. Terms of B2B cooperation agreements are agreed individually
• We will reach out to selected candidates exclusively

EPAM is global leader in AI transformation engineering and integrated consulting, serving Forbes Global 2000 companies and ambitious startups. With over thirty years of expertise in custom software, product and platform engineering, we empower our clients to become AI-Native enterprises, driving measurable value from innovation and digital investments.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – Remote (Worldwide)
location: Canada, France, Germany, India, Netherlands, Singapore, United Kingdom, United States
description:
IMPORTANT: after you apply, please check your email. We sendyou a link to complete your application — it is not considered until that laststep is done. If you do not see it, check your spam folder.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands, Singapore.

Pay: $40–$90/hr

Role Title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer

Role Type: Contractor (~15hrs/week)

Location: Remote

We are engaging Senior Mechanical Design Engineers to contribute to a customer's project involving complex CAD assembly exploration and AI advancement. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

• Analyze and dissect multi-part mechanical assemblies to identify critical design decisions, constraints, and potential failure points that challenge expert reasoning.
• Formulate challenging, non-obvious technical questions that test real-world mechanical design judgment, ensuring relevance and difficulty beyond junior-level understanding.
• Validate and document defensible, exact answers directly from CAD models, ensuring clear traceability and accuracy.
• Review AI-generated outputs, pinpoint breakdowns or inaccuracies in mechanical reasoning, and suggest targeted improvements.
• Flag ambiguous, trivial, or unanswerable questions, refining or sharpening them for clarity and precision.
• Thoroughly document edge cases and sources of disagreement within answers to maintain strict verifiability.
• Communicate findings and reasoning in clear, professional written and verbal form to support continuous project improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional experience creating and overseeing multi-part mechanical assemblies from concept, not just from existing drawings.
• Mastery in at least one major parametric CAD tool (SolidWorks, Creo, NX, CATIA, Inventor, Fusion, Onshape, or Solid Edge).
• Demonstrated experience in teaching, mentoring, or leading — whether through formal instruction, leading design reviews, or coaching engineering teams.
• Expertise in design intent, assembly reasoning, mechanism and kinematic analysis, and robust GD&T/tolerance judgment.
• Background in at least one discipline: industrial machinery and automation, robotics, automotive and heavy equipment, aerospace and defense, medical devices, consumer products, or tooling and fixture design.
• Exceptional written English communication skills — your documentation directly influences project deliverables.
• Bonus: Experience with FreeCAD, advanced GD&T/tolerance analysis, or formal design review leadership.

How to apply

Apply here with your profile. We will then email you a link to complete yourapplication on the hiring platform — your application is only considered oncethat final step is done.

title: QA Engineer Python
description:
Wspólnie z naszym Partnerem, amerykańskim producentem sprzętu fitness, poszukujemy osoby do świadczenia usług jako QA Engineer (Python).

Projekt dotyczy budowy zaawansowanej platformy treningowej nowej generacji, integrującej sztuczną inteligencję, dane z urządzeń wearable oraz spersonalizowane plany zdrowotne.

💡 ZAKRES USŁUG:

• Śledzenie i raportowanie metryk jakości (pokrycie, escape rate, flake rate, czas trwania suit) oraz współpraca przy triaż incydentów jakościowych z zespołem QA po stronie klienta.
• Projektowanie podejść testowych dla niedeterministycznych wyników AI, asercje na schematach i kontraktach, sprawdzanie inwariantów oraz ewaluacja na golden setach.
• Logowanie, śledzenie i retestowanie defektów w Jira oraz utrzymywanie przypadków testowych w TestRail z mapowaniem wyników automatycznych.
• Integrowanie suit testowych z pipeline'ami CI/CD jako bramki jakości dla wydań, w tym uruchamianie testów cross-device na iOS i Android.
• Tworzenie i utrzymywanie narzędzi do zarządzania danymi testowymi, inicjowanie, seedowanie i teardown za pomocą helperów API.
• Projektowanie, budowanie i utrzymywanie automatycznych suit testowych obejmujących testy mobilne E2E, API oraz regresję.

🔍 WYMAGANE KOMPETENCJE:

• Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w QA, w tym 1+ rok w automatyzacji testów API na systemach produkcyjnych, z wykorzystaniem Python, pytest i fixtures oraz doświadczenie w tworzeniu i utrzymywaniu kodu testowego.
• Praktyczna znajomość contract testingu z Pact (consumer-driven contracts) oraz testowania bezpieczeństwa API, w tym authorization boundaries, token handling, malformed/hostile input.
• Znajomość HTTP, REST, JSON, statusów, headers i auth tokens, a także praktyczne doświadczenie w testowaniu API z wykorzystaniem Postman i Swagger/OpenAPI.
• Doświadczenie w testowaniu rozwiązań AI/LLM, w tym praca z datasets, golden sets, quality metrics, prompt engineering, ocena regresji, hallucinations i prompt injection oraz definiowanie kryteriów dla niedeterministycznych wyników.
• Znajomość backendu (logi, database queries), Git (branches, pull requests, code reviews) oraz TestRail (test cases, run tracking).
• Doświadczenie w pracy z produktami mobilnymi Android/iOS.
• Bardzo dobra znajomość j. angielskiego (min. C1).

Mile widziane:

• Znajomość Langfuse, LangSmith lub Phoenix, praca z traces i dołączanie ewaluacji.
• Doświadczenie z LangGraph, testowanie agentów jako grafów stanów, zarówno pojedynczych węzłów, jak i pełnych przepływów.
• Znajomość Python z Appium, automatyzacja testów mobilnych jako uzupełnienie testów API.

✨ OFERUJEMY:

• Nowy sposób na aplikowanie z AI Rekruterem (AIR) – w trakcie procesu możesz porozmawiać z wirtualnym rekruterem 24/7, bez czekania na telefon. Finalną decyzję zawsze podejmuje Opiekun Projektu.
• Współpracę w modelu projektowym, z rozliczeniem opartym na etapach i protokołach odbioru poszczególnych deliverables.
• Wsparcie po stronie Connectis w sprawach administracyjnych i rozliczeniowych związanych ze współpracą.
• Uczestnictwo w wydarzeniach branżowych oraz meetupach technologicznych.
• 5 000 PLN za polecenie znajomych do naszych projektów.
• Elastyczna forma współpracy B2B.
• Realizacja usług 100% zdalnie.
• Szybki i zdalny proces.

Dziękujemy za wszystkie zgłoszenia. Pragniemy poinformować, że skontaktujemy się z wybranymi osobami.

• Develop and maintain automation scripts using Python and Bash.
• Build, optimize, and support GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
• Deploy, operate, and maintain applications on Kubernetes (GKE).

• Troubleshoot incidents and perform system upgrades, patching, and release deployments.

• Collaborate with development and operations teams to improve automation and operational processes.

Your profile

• You are fluent in French and English.

• You are proficient in Python and Bash scripting for automation and operational tasks.

• You are familiar with Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, and Docker.
• You have a solid understanding of DevOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and cloud operations.

Capgemini is committed to diversity and inclusion, ensuring fairness in all employment practices. We evaluate individuals based on qualifications and performance, not personal characteristics, striving to create a workplace where everyone can succeed and feel valued.

Do you want to get to know us better? Check our Instagram — @capgeminipl or visit our Facebook profile — Capgemini Polska. You can also find us on YouTube

With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. title: Software Supply Chain Engineer (Go&Java)
description:
Poszukujemy Software Supply Chain Engineer (Go&Java) dla jednego z naszych klientów świadczących usługi audytorskie oraz tworzenia i utrzymania oprogramowania, aż po automatyzację procesów biznesowych dla kluczowych firm z sektora finansowego, publicznego i technologicznego.

Na początek konkrety:

• Możliwa forma współpracy: B2B, UoP
• Stawka: 130-160 PLN/h B2B, 12500-19500 PLN brutto UoP
• Tryb pracy: hybryda (dni do ustalenia) Gdańsk · Katowice · Kraków · Poznań · Rzeszów · Szczecin · Warszawa · Wrocław
• Wymiar pracy: 1FTE

O projekcie:

Projekt koncentruje się na rozwoju i zabezpieczaniu nowoczesnych, enterprise’owych rozwiązań software’owych oraz zwiększaniu bezpieczeństwa całego procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania.
Osoba na tym stanowisku będzie łączyć software engineering, DevSecOps oraz Software Supply Chain Security, rozwijając rozwiązania w Go i Java, projektując skalowalne architektury oraz wdrażając bezpieczne praktyki w całym cyklu SDLC. Kluczowym obszarem będzie również zabezpieczanie zależności, procesów buildowania i deploymentu, w tym wykorzystanie SBOM, dependency management, vulnerability management oraz automatycznych kontroli bezpieczeństwa w CI/CD.

Zakres obowiązków:

• Projektowanie, rozwój i utrzymanie enterprise-grade aplikacji i platform w Go oraz Java
• Tworzenie skalowalnych i bezpiecznych rozwiązań w oparciu o cloud-native architecture
• Projektowanie i rozwój mikroserwisów, API oraz systemów rozproszonych
• Udział w projektowaniu architektury oraz podejmowaniu decyzji technicznych
• Prowadzenie code review oraz dbanie o jakość, bezpieczeństwo i maintainability kodu
• Ocena, dobór i integracja komponentów oraz technologii open source
• Projektowanie i optymalizacja CI/CD pipelines
• Integracja automatycznych mechanizmów bezpieczeństwa, m.in. code scanning, dependency analysis i vulnerability checks
• Automatyzacja procesów build, test i secure deployment
• Implementacja i rozwój mechanizmów Software Supply Chain Security
• Zabezpieczanie zależności, procesów buildowania, artefaktów oraz deploymentu
• Wdrażanie i utrzymanie SBOM oraz dependency management
• Identyfikowanie i ograniczanie ryzyka związanego z podatnościami w komponentach open source
• Współpraca z zespołami Cybersecurity przy zabezpieczaniu software supply chain
• Wspieranie wdrażania Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) w całym procesie tworzenia oprogramowania
• Udział w threat modeling oraz security design reviews
• Wsparcie w analizie i remediacji wykrytych security vulnerabilities
• Promowanie bezpiecznych praktyk wśród zespołów developerskich i DevOps.

Wymagania:

• Min. 5 lat doświadczenia w software engineering w środowisku enterprise
• Bardzo dobra, praktyczna znajomość Go (Golang) i Java
• Doświadczenie w pracy z technologiami i rozwiązaniami open source, w tym ich oceną i integracją
• Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i rozwijaniu distributed systems, microservices oraz API
• Znajomość software design patterns i architektury aplikacji
• Bardzo dobre doświadczenie z CI/CD – np. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins
• Znajomość Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) oraz secure coding
• Praktyczna znajomość Software Supply Chain Security
• Znajomość SBOM (Software Bill of Materials), dependency management oraz vulnerability management
• Doświadczenie w zabezpieczaniu software dependencies, build systems i deployment processes
• Znajomość praktyk DevSecOps i automatyzacji kontroli bezpieczeństwa w procesie CI/CD
• Doświadczenie z Docker i Kubernetes
• Znajomość co najmniej jednej chmury: AWS, Azure lub Google Cloud
• Znajomość Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
• Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne
• Język angielski do swobodnej komunikacji w międzynarodowym środowisku

Mile widziane:

• Doświadczenie w zakresie Software Composition Analysis (SCA)
• Znajomość i praktyczne stosowanie zasad Zero Trust Architecture
• Doświadczenie w podejściu Policy-as-Code
• Mile widziane certyfikaty branżowe z obszaru cyberbezpieczeństwa, takie jak CSSLP, CISSP lub CompTIA Security+

Oferujemy:

• Brak dress code
• Multisport
• Kursy językowe
• Możliwość pracy zdalnej
• Stabilne zatrudnienie
• Możliwość podnoszenia kwalifikacji zawodowych
• Atmosfera otwartości i współpracy w zgranym zespole
• Otwartość na inicjatywy pracowników
• Możliwość realnego wpływu na produkt
• Ubezpieczenie medyczne i zdrowotne

Opis procesu rekrutacji:

• Rozmowa z przedstawicielem 4IT Solutions

title: Senior DevOps Engineer, OpenStack Team
description:
Mirantis Senior DevOps Engineer, OpenStack Team | SmartRecruiters

• Google Chrome
• Microsoft Edge
• Apple Safari
• Mozilla Firefox

Senior DevOps Engineer, OpenStack Team

• Full-time

Company Description

About Mirantis

Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join the MOSK (Mirantis OpenStack for Kubernetes) product team, working at the intersection of OpenStack, Kubernetes, and product engineering. In this role, you will help design, validate, and evolve a cloud-native OpenStack platform that enables customers to build and operate enterprise-grade private clouds at scale.

As a senior engineer, you will act as a technical authority on OpenStack and MOSK behavior, contribute to architectural decisions, support complex customer scenarios, and help ensure stable, high-quality product releases.

Key Responsibilities

Feature Design & Development

• Contribute to Product Roadmap: Actively influence the MOSK roadmap and backlog by providing technical input on feature feasibility, architectural scalability, and long-term maintainability. Evaluate incoming customer requests for specific features by analyzing upstream OpenStack code, specifications, blueprints, and community documentation to assess feature maturity, stability, limitations, and operational caveats.
• Lifecycle Management Engineering: Design, implement, and document lifecycle management for OpenStack on Kubernetes — a core MOSK capability — with emphasis on non-disruptive upgrades, patching, scaling, rollback strategies, and feature compatibility across upgrades.
• Feature Validation & Integration: Drive validation of enabled features by defining test scenarios, validating upstream code behavior in simulated or production-like deployments, and then integrating feature support into MOSK’s lifecycle management.
• Technical Design Reviews: Review and refine product designs, APIs, and implementations to ensure robustness, security, and a high-quality developer experience.
• Engineering Leadership: Lead design discussions, planning sessions, and retrospectives; help the team to uphold high standards for software quality, architectural rigor, and operational readiness.

Product Engineering & Automation

• Frameworks & Tooling Development: Design, implement, and maintain core frameworks, libraries, and internal tools that underpin MOSK development, testing, and lifecycle operations.
• Advanced Automation: Build and evolve automation for deploying and managing complex OpenStack-on-Kubernetes environments used in development, testing, and validation.
• CI/CD Architecture: Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines and integrations with external systems to streamline build, test, validation, upgrade, and release workflows.

Operational Reliability

• Tier-3 Escalation Support: Debug and resolve complex issues in customer production environments involving Kubernetes, OpenStack, networking, storage, and distributed systems.
• Upstream Troubleshooting & Contributions: Investigate issues in OpenStack services, analyze root causes at the code level, and propose or contribute minor fixes upstream to improve product stability and supportability.
• Performance & Scalability Analysis: Identify and analyze performance bottlenecks across hardware and software layers; provide fixes, optimizations, and tuning recommendations.
• Operational Readiness: Manage and improve development, staging, and validation environments that closely mirror customer deployments to ensure release stability.
• Product Knowledge Authority: Act as an authoritative technical source for MOSK and OpenStack behavior, providing accurate, engineering-level input to documentation, field, and enablement teams to ensure correctness and consistency of product documentation and guidance. Participate in technical reviews, demos, and knowledge-sharing sessions to support engineering and other customer-facing teams.

Qualifications

Experience & Education

• At least 5 years of practical administration experience in Linux (CentOS, Ubuntu, RHEL) as a server platform.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
• Experience in software development, Systems Administration, or SRE role.

Technical Skills

• Operating Systems: Deep understanding of the OS, ability to debug and tune underperforming systems, and troubleshoot software and hardware issues.
• Networking: Strong knowledge of networking technologies, including protocols, firewalls, and VPNs. Experience with managing and configuring networking equipment.
• Automation Tools: Practical experience with SaltStack, Puppet, Ansible, or Chef for medium and large environments.
• Infrastructure as Code: Practical experience with Terraform.
• Containerization: Be an expert in Docker and Kubernetes in production environments. Thorough understanding and practical experience with Kubernetes operators and Helm.
• CI/CD: Strong experience with Jenkins and building dependable build/release pipelines.
• Familiarity with code-review systems
• Cloud Platforms: Understanding of principles of working in cloud environments such as OpenStack, AWS, GCP, or Azure.
• Scripting & Programming: Strong scripting skills in Bash, Groovy, and Python (at least one is required). Mid-level experience with Go or C is valuable.

Preferred Qualifications (Will be a plus)

• Deep understanding of OpenStack architecture and experience with running it in production.
• Knowledge and experience with SDN (Software Defined Networking) solutions - Open Virtual Network, Open vSwitch.
• Experience in managing and using Open Search, Grafana, and Prometheus stacks.
• Contribution to open-source projects.

Soft Skills

• English language proficiency at least at an intermediate level (spoken and written).
• Good customer-facing communication skills and a sense of diplomacy.
• Ability to work with geographically distributed international teams in a dynamic environment.
• Analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Additional Information

What does Mirantis offer you?

• Work in a global, collaborative, remote-first culture that rewards initiative and execution.
• Play a pivotal role in shaping the next era of cloud and AI modernisation.
• Manage high-impact enterprise accounts with immediate opportunity for growth.
• Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies.
• Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.
• Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.
• Professional development and training.
• Attend conferences and working groups.
• Customized workstation (macOS, Windows).
• Professional development and training.
• Competitive compensation, performance incentives, and opportunities for advancement.

It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to [email protected]

By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

title: Assistant Site Manager - Events (Bristol)
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Assistant Site Manager - VR Concept Venue

Location: Bristol
Contract: Freelance, September 2026 – March 2027 (potential to extend)
Pay: £16 per hour
Working Pattern: Full-time (job share considered); requires evenings, weekends, and public holiday availability. Shift pattern arranged to overlap with, and to cover for, the Event Manager (Site Manager) as needed.
Reports to: Charlotte Potter, Producer – Fever (day-to-day line management from the Event Manager / Site Manager)
Manages: Front-of-house staff (agency and in-house); full management responsibility for all staff, including cleaners and front-of-house teams, when covering for the Event Manager during periods of leave

Role Overview
We're looking for a proactive and technically confident Assistant Site Manager to support the day-to-day running of our immersive VR experience in a high-footfall Bristol venue. Working closely with the Event Manager, you'll help keep the visitor experience running smoothly, staff well supported, and systems fully
operational.

This role also acts as key holiday and absence cover for the Event Manager (Site Manager), stepping up to take full responsibility for the venue — technical, operational, and people management — whenever they are away. You'll need the confidence to run the site independently at short notice, alongside your regular assistant duties.

Key Responsibilities

🔧 Technical & Operational Delivery
● Support daily setup and shutdown of the VR experience, ensuring all systems, hardware, and software are fully operational.
● Carry out pre-opening checks (hardware calibration, environment readiness, content testing) alongside or in place of the Event Manager.
● Troubleshoot first-line IT and technical issues on-site (VR headsets, PCs, networking, displays), escalating to tech support partners where needed.
● Monitor experience performance throughout the day, resolving disruptions or resets promptly.
● Maintain stock of consumables (e.g., sanitisation wipes, headset liners) and uphold hygiene protocols.
● Assist in keeping technical documentation up to date and support training of team members on troubleshooting procedures.

🏛 Venue Operations (Ground Floor)
● Help ensure the ground floor VR experience space is clean, safe, and visitor-ready at all times.
● Coordinate cleaning and reactive maintenance for the VR zone, including public and back-of-house areas.
● Support queue management, timed entry, and visitor flow, particularly during peak periods.

👥 Team Support & Holiday Cover
● Assist in line managing front-of-house staff, including agency team members, day to day.
● Support daily staff briefings, rota coordination, and shift cover.
● Model high standards of customer service and professionalism for the wider team.
● Help train new team members on VR-specific procedures, safety, and technical protocols.
● Take full ownership of team management, rotas, and briefings during any period covering for the Event Manager, ensuring continuity of standards and cover.

🛡 Health & Safety
● Support daily safety and cleanliness walkarounds of the VR area.
● Act as a trained first aider for the venue, leading incident response (first aid, equipment malfunctions, or guest complaints), including full responsibility for this when covering for the Event Manager.
● Help keep risk assessments for the VR zone up to date and log incidents or near misses.
● Ensure staff are trained in relevant H&S procedures, including emergency evacuations and manual handling (if required).

📣 Customer Experience
● Help maintain a welcoming, engaging, and inclusive atmosphere for all guests.
● Act as a point of escalation for visitor queries or complaints, and the main escalation point when covering for the Event Manager.
● Support customer feedback mechanisms and feed insights back to the Producer and Event Manager.

📝 Communication & Reporting
● Provide handovers to the Event Manager (or, during cover periods, directly to the Producer) covering technical issues, visitor numbers, and operational highlights.
● Maintain accurate logs: staff attendance, incident reports, daily checklists, and maintenance tickets.
● Ensure a clean handover back to the Event Manager after any period of holiday cover, flagging anything requiring follow-up.

Ideal Candidate Profile
● Current, valid First Aid at Work certification is required for this role.
● Experience in live event, visitor attraction, or venue operations — preferably in immersive or tech-driven environments.
● Working knowledge of VR hardware/software and basic IT troubleshooting (e.g., Windows PCs, networks, Wi-Fi, device calibration).
● Experience supporting or managing teams, including casual/agency staff, in high-traffic public settings.
● Comfortable stepping up to run a site independently at short notice, with strong organisational skills and a calm, solutions-focused approach under pressure.
● Confident communicator and team player who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
● Working knowledge of health & safety regulations and customer service best practices.

Additional Info
● Flexibility is essential: early starts, late finishes, and public holidays are part of the standard schedule.
● Some Mondays/Tuesdays may be required for maintenance, special events, or staff training.
● Holiday cover for the Event Manager should be expected on a periodic basis throughout the contract; specific dates to be agreed and scheduled in advance where possible.

A Fiers Mechanika Kft. számos iparágban tevékenykedik, beleértve a gépipart, az egészségügyi ipart, a dohányipart, néhány éve szállít egy jelentős űripari vállalatnak is bonyolult alkatrészeket.
A cégvezetés stratégiájának fontos eleme, hogy minél nagyobb hozzáadott értéket produkáljon gyártási tevékenysége során, és hosszú távú, stabil kapcsolatokat alakítson ki partnereivel.
Idén megindult új csarnoképítés, ami további modernizálásra és gépparkbővítést ad lehetőséget.
