description:
page_title

Back to jobs

tags.new

Business Development Manager - New Verticals

London, United Kingdom

Apply

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Field Based Business Development Manager: New Verticals - London

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

We’re looking for a Field based business development manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us build relationships with new retail grocery partners across the region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Regional UK and Ireland team. The Regional UK and Ireland team drives Deliveroo's performance across local markets, focusing on signing the best grocery retail selection and expanding our footprint within the region.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

• Drive regional grocery retail acquisition: Map, prospect, pitch, and close high-value grocery retail partners across the London region to expand our local market selection.
• Execute strategic business development: Engage with independent retail grocery partners via physical visits, emails, calls, and social platforms to demonstrate the commercial value of Deliveroo’s technology.
• Own the commercial onboarding journey: Oversee the end-to-end partner onboarding process to ensure it is fast, efficient, and seamless for new partners.
• Secure early partner success: Actively support and monitor new retail grocery performance within their first eight weeks on the platform to maximise their long-term growth.
• Act as a local territory expert: Build deep insight into the regional food scene, travelling across London and surrounding areas to identify key brands that local customers crave.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

• Proven new business acquisition: Demonstrated sales experience with a track record of actively targeting new business, hunting out hidden gems, and delivering against demanding targets.
• Commercial negotiation skills: Strong commercial acumen with the ability to handle negotiations, understand marketplace economics, and structure profitable, sustainable deals.
• Effective communication: Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills across face-to-face, telephone, and written channels.
• Autonomy and field-based resilience: A self-motivated, tenacious approach with the ability to work independently and spend significant time out on the road meeting prospects.
• Mobility requirement: Possession of a valid driving licence and access to a personal vehicle to facilitate travel across the region.

Nice to Have

• Industry sector knowledge: Deep interest in hospitality and food delivery, with the ability to demonstrate product and industry insights to prospective clients.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

description:
Leitender Elektriker / Elektroniker (m/w/d) für gewerbliche Photovoltaik & New Energy Systeme - Region Braunschweig, Hannover, Göttingen - 1KOMMA5° Commercial, Industrial & Public Solutions - 4 Tage Woche
Bei 1KOMMA5° bauen wir Europas führende Energie-Software-Plattform Heartbeat AI und schaffen so ein virtuelles Kraftwerk, das Photovoltaik, Stromspeicher, Wärmepumpen und Ladeinfrastruktur intelligent vernetzt. Unser Ziel: Kunden dauerhaft mit günstigem, sauberem und intelligent gesteuertem Strom zu versorgen.
Mit 1KOMMA5° Commercial, Industrial & Public Solutions übertragen wir diese Kompetenz auf Gewerbe-, Industrie- und öffentliche Gebäudeportfolios. Wir entwickeln, bauen und betreiben skalierbare New-Energy-Infrastrukturen — von Photovoltaik über Speicher und Ladeinfrastruktur bis hin zu Energiemanagement und portfolioübergreifender Steuerung.

• Leitung und Aufbau eines eigenen Montageteams von bis zu 4 Personen für die Errichtung und technische Betriebsführung von gewerblichen Energie-Großanlagen in Deutschland
• Fachgerechte Installation und Inbetriebnahme von elektrotechnischen Anlagen unter Einhaltung der VDE 4105/ 4110
• Betreuung und Optimierung von Photovoltaikanlagen, Stromspeichern, Energiemanagement und E-Mobilität, einschließlich der Integration in bestehende Stromnetze
• Überwachung und Wartung von Netzanbindungen sowie Steuerungs- und Regeltechnik
• Mitarbeit an Projekten im Bereich Netzwerktechnik, insbesondere Planung und Installation von Netzwerkkomponenten
• Fehlerdiagnose und Behebung technischer Störungen
• Dokumentation von Arbeitsergebnissen und Erstellen von Reports

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektromeister (m/w/d) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation (z.b. staatlich geprüfter Techniker (m/w/d))
• Fundierte Kenntnisse der VDE4105 und VDE 4110 und in der Planung sowie Installation von elektrischen Anlagen
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Photovoltaikbereich, idealerweise mit der Integration und dem Betrieb von Solaranlagen
• Affinität zu Netzwerktechnik und praktisches Verständnis der Netzwerkstruktur
• Erfahrung in der Softwareprogrammierung und Anwendung von Automatisierungssoftware von Vorteil
• Gerne mit Erfahrungen in dem Aufbau und Führen von Teams
• Selbstständige, verantwortungsbewusste und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
• Teamfähigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke
• Ausgeprägter Hang Aufgaben perfekt abzuschließen
• Führerschein Klasse B mit Reisebereitschaft auf regionaler Basis (+/- 200km)

• Spannende Projekte im Zukunftssektor erneuerbare Energien, Stromspeicher, Energiemanagement und E-Mobilität
• Flache Hierarchien mit direktem Reporting zur Betriebsleitung und ein dynamisches Team
• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Entwicklungsperspektiven
• Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
• Firmenwagen – auch privat nutzbar
• Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass
• Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du die Energie- und Mobilitätswende und gestaltest aktiv den nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Infrastruktur
• Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

title: Associate Project Manager
description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with close to zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Project Management team

The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.

What you’ll be doing

• Run a customer project from kick-off to go-live, keeping budget, timeline and project hygiene on track.
• Be the day-to-day contact for your customer, and tell them early when something is slipping.
• Work with delivery engineers and solution architects in your pod to turn what the customer needs into a plan the team can deliver.
• Use our shared delivery skills and AI tools to cut manual project admin, and flag where they fall short.
• Learn from your delivery lead and bring proposed answers, not just questions.
• Help us improve how we run projects as you learn what works.

What you’ll need to have done

• Delivered something to a deadline with other people depending on you (work, university or a side project), and be able to say exactly what you did.
• Used AI in your work or studies day to day, and be able to explain what it produced and how you checked it.
• Taken feedback and changed how you work, with an example.
• Gone beyond the surface of a problem to find out what was really going on.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

• You’d prefer a long runway of shadowing before taking on real responsibility. You’ll own a customer project early, with coaching alongside you.
• You’re uncomfortable being the person customers turn to when something goes wrong or when there is hard news to deliver.
• You wait for direction rather than forming a view and bringing it to the team.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

• £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.
• 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).
• Company pension scheme via Penfold.
• Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.
• Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.
• Private healthcare insurance through AXA.
• Income protection and Life Insurance.
• Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

• Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).
• Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.
• Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.
• Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

• Initial call with our Talent team - 30 minutes
• Manager Interview - 60 minutes
• Skills presentation - 60 minutes
• Values Interview - 60 minutes
• Meet the CEO - 30 minutes

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer’s are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Senior C# Trading Systems Engineer
company: Vistulo (for a major N. American bank)
description:
Salary: 250 - 280 PLN per hour (B2B)

Want to work on FX electronic trading systems at a top N. American Bank?

This isn’t just another dev role. It’s your chance to engineer the core of global trading.

We’re talking ultra-low-latency architectures, real-time market data, and speedy electronic trading, all in an environment where milliseconds matter, and billions move. You’ll work on building FX (forex) electronic trading systems.

If you thrive on complexity, love solving performance challenges under pressure, and want to collaborate directly with traders and product teams at the sharp edge of financial technology, this is your arena.

The Role at a Glance

• Senior C# .NET Backend Engineer
• Building a trading systems, including high-performance backend services for market data and electronic trading
• Fully remote for a top N. American bank (for residents of Poland or Romania)
• Part of the core team - this is not a legacy support role or an outsourced B team

This role requires experience building trading systems, and an understanding of financial markets. An ideal candidate will have worked on FX trading systems.

If you enjoy working on low-latency, high-throughput trading systems, join us and build the next generation of high-performance capital markets solutions.

Why Join Us?

• Work on a large-scale, low-latency trading system.
• No Legacy: Join an actively developed system. The engineers who built it originally are still on the team.
• Collaborate with a world-class team of developers across North America and Europe.
• Enjoy the stability of a long-term, fully remote role that only a bank can offer.

A successful candidate will be a very strong programmer with current C# development experience. They must also be curious, open-minded, and desire to learn new things. English proficiency is a must. If you’re fascinated by understanding systems ‘under the hood,’ this role is for you. Successful candidates enjoy geeking out about data structures and debugging application performance issues.

This is a fully remote role for a developer in Poland or Romania. You will be working through a Polish company that will provide the support and administrative assistance to make you successful in the role. We are looking for people to join the team long-term.

Only open to residents of Poland and Romania. Citizens and legal residents with permission to work in Poland or Romania are welcome.

What we offer

• Work that matters in the financial domain: You’ll be building a high-performance trading system at an established financial institution.
• Professional growth: Collaborate with smart, highly capable developers in a supportive and challenging environment.
• Direct collaboration: You will work directly with the client team in North America and in Europe.

title: Senior Manager, Paid Social
location: Germany - Berlin; London, England, United Kingdom; Spain - Madrid
description:
Job Application for Senior Manager, Paid Social at Quince

Back to jobs

New

Senior Manager, Paid Social

Germany - Berlin; London, England, United Kingdom; Spain - Madrid

Apply

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
• Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
• Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Manager, Paid Social

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Paid Social to join our growing team.

Paid social is one of the main ways Quince finds new customers, and this role sits at the centre of it. As Senior Manager, Growth Marketing (Paid Social), you will own strategy, execution and optimisation across Meta and other social platforms for a set of Quince departments, turning business goals into efficient media investment and steady, scalable growth.

This is a hands-on, analytical role. You will manage significant media budgets against clear efficiency targets (ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS), work out what is really driving performance, and work closely with creative, merchandising and analytics colleagues so that targeting and creative keep getting better. The role is critical to scaling our paid social acquisition engine.

Responsibilities

Paid social strategy and investment (the main focus of the role)

• Own paid social strategy and delivery for selected Quince departments across Meta, TikTok and emerging social channels.
• Manage and optimise significant paid media budgets to meet customer acquisition and efficiency targets.
• Monitor performance across campaigns, audiences and creative, and act quickly on what you find.
• Run a continuous programme of testing across audience segmentation, creative formats, messaging, bidding and budget allocation.
• Scale the campaigns that work, and deal with underperformance promptly.
• Adjust spend quickly in response to performance signals and changing product priorities.

Performance analysis and optimisation

• Analyse campaign results across different attribution frameworks.
• Identify what drives incremental customer acquisition and revenue growth, and turn those findings into practical campaign and creative decisions.
• Build and maintain dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance analyses.
• Work with our analytics team to improve the accuracy of measurement and attribution.

Creative and testing collaboration

• Work closely with the Creative, Studio and Production teams to shape creative that performs.
• Develop ways of working that make sure creative suits each platform.
• Keep testing volume high enough to support growth targets, with a steady supply of new creative.

Cross-functional collaboration

• Work with Merchandising and Product to agree priority categories and launches.
• Partner with Analytics and Data on attribution and measurement.
• Present performance insights and growth opportunities to leadership.

Growth experimentation and channel development

• Find opportunities to expand into new paid social surfaces and formats.
• Test new growth approaches, including audience expansion, creator-led ads and performance creative formats.
• Keep improving our testing frameworks so we can run more experiments and learn more from each one.

What success looks like

In this role, you will:

• manage and optimise significant paid social spend for your departments against clear targets for ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS;
• drive scalable customer acquisition through testing, experimentation and analysis;
• find new audience, creative and bidding opportunities that unlock incremental growth;
• build a high-performing creative pipeline in partnership with the creative teams;
• use data and attribution models to guide budget allocation and channel strategy; and
• respond quickly, and sensibly, to what the numbers are telling you.

Qualifications Required:

• six or more years of experience in performance marketing or paid social growth;
• deep experience managing Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) at scale, with real ROAS and CPA pressure;
• experience managing TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube and other paid social channels;
• strong analytical skills, with experience of attribution models and performance data;
• a proven record of managing and optimising large paid media budgets;
• experience of running performance creative tests and working closely with creative teams;
• a data-led mindset, together with strong operational discipline; and comfort working in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

description:
Version 1 Delivery Manager - Public Sector | SmartRecruiters

• Google Chrome

Delivery Manager - Public Sector

• Full-time
• Department: Digital, Data and Cloud

Company Description

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

• UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
• 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
• 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
• Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
• Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

Job Description

This is a fantastic opportunity to make a difference on a range of exciting government projects and shape the growing delivery management community.

We are looking for experienced and adaptive Delivery Managers who can apply their agile delivery expertise pragmatically to guide teams to successful project outcomes.

We promote multidisciplinary, ‘T shaped’ skillsets in our people and provide coaching and upskilling through a dedicated coaching model and skills academy.

Responsibilities:

• You’ll apply your agile expertise to lead delivery in one or two workstreams, adapting your agile approach to suit the team and client needs.
• You’ll focus on successful execution of projects, applying a delivery mindset to continuous planning and management of project problems and risks; ensuring the team is on track for success and working to mitigate potential issues and risks before they impact delivery.
• You’ll be a key point of contact for clients, building strong relationships and developing a deep understanding of their needs and desired outcomes, translating asks into feasible delivery plans.
• You’ll focus on optimising team culture, performance, and health, supporting individuals and teams to operate at their peak and finding innovative ways to improve ways-of-working.
• You’ll contribute to building the Farsight delivery management community of practice, including coaching other delivery managers.

Qualifications

• Agile expertise. You have a breadth of experience in agile frameworks and methods, and have applied these in multiple stages of the project lifecycle in service or software delivery. You can apply and adapt these pragmatically and innovatively to meet the needs of a team and client.
• Building and managing relationships. You can build and maintain strong relationships, demonstrating strong emotional intelligence and recognising the different needs of the diverse range of team members and clients we work with. You have experience mediating and mending relationships, and managing expectations of clients and stakeholders.
• Communication. You have strong listening, and verbal and written communication skills, which you can leverage to build relationships and facilitate effectively, asking the right questions to ensure meetings remain focused. You have experience communicating sensitive messages and navigating difficult conversations, steering these towards positive outcomes.
• Planning and project execution. You have experience collaborating with team members and clients to ensure the project roadmap will deliver what’s needed in the desired time-frame. You can assess feasibility of delivery and identify risks and dependencies which may impact success, taking appropriate action before they become issues. You can put plans into practice, keeping planning collaborative and agile and adjusting it as new learning comes to light. You can coordinate a multi-disciplinary team to keep them focused on delivery, ensuring each team member’s contribution feeds into priorities and the critical path.
• Leadership. You role-model positive and supportive servant leadership behaviours. You know how to adjust your leadership approach to meet the needs of a diverse team and create the right environment to keep team members motivated and empowered. You champion ways-of-working and a positive team culture.
• Commercial acumen. You are familiar with a range of contract framework approaches and can apply that knowledge to manage a project budget and identify commercial risk and opportunity.
• Adaptability. You can adjust your delivery management approach, including agile techniques and leadership approach to suit different client context and team needs.
• Nice to have
• Experience of government digital service assessments
• Experience in another discipline, e.g. product management, service design, development

Additional Information

Why Version 1?

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

• Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits

• Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme

• Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance

• Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme

• Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies

• Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat

• Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.

• Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact your recruiter at Version 1. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

title: Senior Rekruter IT
description:
Salary: 8000 - 12000 PLN per month (B2B)

Ideamotive prowadzi kilkanaście rekrutacji naraz dla klientów, którzy budują zespoły IT w Polsce. Szukamy rekrutera, który weźmie procesy i poprowadzi je sam, od briefu od klienta do podpisanej umowy z kandydatem. Bez dzielenia roboty na sourcera i osobę od rozmów, bez czekania na czyjąś zgodę na kolejny krok.
Pracujemy w dwóch modelach i oba są dla nas równie ważne. Rekrutacja stała i bodyleasing. To dwie różne rozmowy z kandydatem i dwie różne matematyki po stronie klienta, więc szukamy kogoś, kto zna obie.
Jesteśmy firmą AI-first bez korporacyjnego teatrzyku. Narzędzia (w tym własne!) do sourcingu, scrapingu i automatyzacji outreachu są tu podstawowym warsztatem, a nie ciekawostką z konferencji. Liczy się wynik i pomysłowość, nie liczba godzin przy biurku.

To oferujemy

• Stawkę 8 000 do 12 000 zł netto miesięcznie na kontrakcie B2B.
• Premię za placementy.
• Dostęp do najlepszych narzędzi AI do sourcingu, scrapingu, rekrutacji i automatyzacji outreachu. Kupujemy i tworzymy to, co realnie skraca pracę.
• Możliwość tworzenia własnych narzędzi i procesów rekrutacyjnych.
• Bardzo dużo rekrutacji naraz, więc doświadczenie rośnie szybko, a wpływ na wynik firmy widać w liczbach.
• Pracę 100% zdalną.
• Zespół, który sam buduje automaty rekrutacyjne i dzieli się tym, co u niego zadziałało.
• Urlop 24 dni w roku.

Benefity

• możliwość pracy zdalnej
• elastyczny czas pracy
• spotkania integracyjne

Jeśli po przeczytaniu tego ogłoszenia masz poczucie, że to rola, w której możesz realnie coś zbudować — bardzo możliwe, że właśnie Ciebie szukamy.

Ideamotive

Czym jest Ideamotive?

• Agile’owa firma świadcząca usługi w zakresie tech team extension IT dla klienta korporacyjnego (głównie w Polsce).
• Nasza firma została uznana przez Forbes 3 lata z rzędu jako jedna z najprężniej rozwijających się organizacji IT w Polsce oraz znalazła się na liście Financial Times 1000.
• Team delivery składa się z 60 osób, core biznesowy z 12 osób i mamy chrapkę na wzrosty, więc podejście “can do” i nastawienie na działanie są tutaj niezbędne.
• Mamy bardzo zgrany, zaangażowany zespół, lubimy to, co robimy.
• Jeżeli taka atmosfera jest zgodna z Twoimi oczekiwaniami, zaaplikuj! Zobaczmy jaką historię możemy razem napisać.

Requirements:

• Recruitment
• Cold calling
• AI

Nasze wymagania

• Minimum 3 lata w rekrutacji IT, w tym praca w agencji, czyli rekrutacja dla klienta zewnętrznego, a nie wyłącznie do własnej firmy. To warunek konieczny.
• Doświadczenie w obu modelach, w rekrutacji stałej i w bodyleasingu. Wiesz, czym różni się rozmowa o etacie od rozmowy o stawce godzinowej i o dostępności konsultanta.
• Zamknięte procesy, o których umiesz opowiedzieć konkretnie. Jaka rola, ile trwała, skąd przyszedł kandydat i co zadecydowało.
• Znajomość rynku IT, czyli ról, stacków, widełek i tego, kogo realnie da się dziś ściągnąć.
• Swoboda w rozmowie z kandydatem technicznym i w rozmowie z klientem.
• Realne używanie AI w codziennej pracy, poparte przykładami. Interesuje nas to, co faktycznie robisz, a nie deklaracja.
• Brak oporu przed telefonem i pełny komfort w cold callach do kandydatów.
• Samodzielność. Dostajesz brief i ruszasz, zamiast czekać na instrukcję.
• Gotowość do współpracy na kontrakcie B2B.

Mile widziane

• Scraping i automatyzacje, na przykład Clay, PhantomBuster, n8n, Apify albo własne skrypty.
• Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi do cold callingu, dialerów i sekwencji outreachu.
• Doświadczenie w agencji o dużym wolumenie procesów albo bodyleasing prowadzony na większą skalę.
• Rekrutacje dla dużych klientów, na przykład bank, ubezpieczyciel, sektor publiczny albo infrastruktura krytyczna.
• Własne portfolio sprytnych zagrywek sourcingowych.

Nice to have:

• Clay
• PhantomBuster
• n8n
• Apify

Daily tasks:

• Prowadzenie własnych rekrutacji od briefu do zatrudnienia, w rekrutacji stałej i w bodyleasingu.
• Rozmowa z klientem o roli, kalibrowanie oczekiwań wobec rynku i obrona rekomendowanego kandydata przed hiring managerem.
• Budowanie listy kandydatów z naszej bazy, z baz zewnętrznych i ze źródeł, do których konkurencja nie zagląda.
• Pierwszy kontakt z kandydatem, telefonem i wiadomością, oraz weryfikacja dostępności, oczekiwań finansowych i dopasowania do roli.
• Prowadzenie rozmów rekrutacyjnych i ocena kompetencji na tyle rzetelna, żeby Twoja rekomendacja była wartościowa dla Klienta.
• Opieka nad kandydatem przez cały proces, aż do oferty i decyzji, razem z rozmową o stawce.
• Praca na narzędziach AI i automatyzacjach, czyli sekwencje outreachu, dialery, scraping, enrichment i własne skrypty. Testujesz nowe i odstawiasz te, które nie dowożą.
• Utrzymywanie prawdziwego stanu procesu w naszym ATS, bo na nim opiera się reszta zespołu.

title: HR & Recruitment Coordinator
description:
HR & Recruitment Coordinator

Start your career in HR and Talent Acquisition with BioPhorum

Are you a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career in HR? Are you naturally organised, curious, proactive and someone who enjoys working with people?

We're looking for an enthusiastic Graduate Resourcer & HR Assistant to join our People team at BioPhorum.

This is a great opportunity for someone at the start of their career who wants to gain hands-on experience across recruitment and HR, develop new skills and make a real contribution to a growing international business.

You don't need previous HR or recruitment experience. What matters most to us is your attitude, willingness to learn and desire to get stuck in.

About BioPhorum

BioPhorum is an international organisation that brings together leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to collaborate, share knowledge and solve some of the industry's biggest challenges.

Our people are at the heart of what we do, and our People team plays an important role in attracting, supporting and developing the talent that helps our business grow.

What will you be doing?

This is a varied role where you'll gain exposure to both recruitment and the wider HR function. You'll work closely with the Talent Partner and wider People team, learning how we attract great people, deliver a positive candidate experience and support employees throughout their time with BioPhorum.

Your responsibilities will include:

Recruitment and Talent Acquisition

• Supporting the recruitment process from initial application through to interview and appointment.
• Reviewing applications and identifying candidates who match our requirements.
• Helping to source and engage potential candidates through different recruitment channels.
• Coordinating interviews, communicating with candidates and keeping everyone updated throughout the process.
• Supporting the preparation of interview materials and recruitment documentation.
• Maintaining accurate candidate information and updating our recruitment systems.
• Helping to ensure candidates have a positive experience when engaging with BioPhorum.

HR and People Support

• Providing general administrative support across the employee lifecycle.
• Supporting onboarding activities for new starters.
• Maintaining accurate employee records and updating our HR system.
• Preparing HR documentation and supporting day-to-day People team activities.
• Helping with wider HR projects and initiatives, including employee engagement and internal communications.

You'll also have the opportunity to get involved in different projects, learn how the People team operates and build your understanding of the wider business.

What we're looking for

We're much more interested in your potential, attitude and approach than how much experience you already have.

You'll ideally be someone who:

• Is a recent graduate, or has equivalent experience, and is keen to build a career in HR or recruitment.
• Is proactive and takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.
• Is naturally organised, able to manage different priorities and has a good eye for detail.
• Has strong communication skills and enjoys interacting with different people.
• Is curious, asks questions and is keen to understand how things work.
• Is confident using technology and comfortable learning new systems.
• Takes responsibility for their work and follows things through.
• Is positive, adaptable and happy to get involved wherever needed.

You don't need to tick every box. If you have the right attitude and are excited about developing a career in HR, we'd love to hear from you.

What will you get out of it?

This isn't just an entry-level administration role. It's an opportunity to build a strong foundation for a career in HR and Talent Acquisition.

You'll gain:

• Hands-on experience across recruitment and the wider employee lifecycle.
• Exposure to different areas of HR and how they support a growing international business.
• The opportunity to work closely with experienced HR and Talent professionals.
• Support, guidance and the chance to develop your skills and confidence.
• Opportunities to contribute to projects and take ownership of your own responsibilities.
• A role where you can make a genuine contribution and see the impact of your work.

Why BioPhorum?

At BioPhorum, we believe in bringing people together, sharing knowledge and making a difference. You'll be joining a collaborative team where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, take initiative and develop.

If you're looking for a role where you can learn, grow, challenge yourself and build a career in HR, this could be the perfect place to start.

Interested?

We'd love to hear from you. You don't need to have your career all figured out – just bring your enthusiasm, curiosity and willingness to learn.

Założona w 1988 roku we Francji Grupa Astek jest światowym partnerem w obszarze doradztwa inżynieryjnego oraz IT. title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Measurement
description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

• Location: Remote.
• Contract: Full-time, permanent.
• Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link -
• Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe.

You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on.

What You'll Do

• Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented.
• Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation.
• Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics.
• Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team.
• Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision.
• Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty.
• Turn test results into investment guidance: estimate marginal returns and saturation by channel and market, and recommend where the next dollar should go and where to pull back.
• Help set and document our causal measurement standards: which method when, what counts as sufficient evidence, and how results calibrate attribution and MMM for budget allocation.
• Defend the framework under challenge from channel owners and leaders, and pressure-test platform claims.
• Guide Growth, Acquisition and Finance from business question to testable hypothesis to budget decision, and build literacy on attributed versus incremental performance.
• Build reusable experiment tooling and templates, work with Analytics Engineering and MarTech on the data experiments needed, and document every test and decision as you build this capability from scratch.

What You'll Bring

• 3+ years of experience in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality or marketing mix modelling), with a track record of analysis that changed real budget decisions.
• Solid grounding in causal inference and experimental design: randomised and quasi-experimental methods such as synthetic control and difference-in-differences, simulation-based power analysis to size and design tests, and knowing when each approach breaks.
• Strong statistical judgement: you can quantify uncertainty, explain it simply, and resist overclaiming.
• Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models and their limits, including reconciling platform-reported results with first-party data.
• Familiarity with how experiments calibrate MMM and attribution, and with marginal-return and budget-optimisation thinking (saturation, diminishing returns).
• Expert SQL and Python, production-quality code, a modern warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Lightdash or Looker.
• Strong data modelling skills: designing clean, tested and documented models (dbt or similar) for marketing spend, attribution and customer data, and working closely with Analytics Engineering.
• Strong core analytics skills: marketing and customer metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, funnel and cohort analysis), dashboards and self-serve BI, and the judgement to prioritise ad-hoc requests alongside the test roadmap.
• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders: you hold a position under challenge, have shaped a roadmap, and say no with a clear rationale.
• Comfortable with ambiguity and with data that is still improving: you're a proactive self-starter who is happy to create a new process or capability in a small, fast-growing team.

If you are interested in this position, please apply via the link.

Why People Join Us

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

title: Welsh Audio Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
Project Overview

We are sourcing independent Audio Evaluation Specialists for an AI benchmark evaluation project assessing advanced agentic audio models. As AI models increasingly handle complex workflows in this domain—specifically real-world customer support scenarios like flight bookings, financial services, and telecommunications—their accuracy relies entirely on robust, expert-crafted training data. The objective of this project is to autonomously produce high-quality evaluation tasks through simulated interactions, audit conversational AI outputs, and generate clean, reliable datasets to optimize model performance.

Project Deliverables & Scope

Operate autonomously to design complex evaluation frameworks and provide structured training data. Expected deliverables include:

• Role-Play Scenario Execution: Creating and executing complex, role-play-based evaluation scenarios that simulate realistic customer service interactions across travel, finance, and technical support domains.
• Model Performance Auditing: Evaluating AI model performance across standardized qualitative and quantitative metrics, focusing strictly on task completion accuracy, conversational naturalness, and audio comprehension.
• Technical Metric Evaluation: Assessing the model's basic computer programming literacy, including its understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and ability to reason about structured data within a support context.
• Representative Dataset Generation: Contributing to the development of diverse, high-quality audio datasets that accurately reflect real customer expectations for clarity, efficiency, and natural conversational flow.

Required Expertise

To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess deep industry knowledge to craft realistic professional scenarios. Core skillset includes:

• Demonstrable professional expertise in complex customer support, technical troubleshooting, or conversational AI evaluation.
• Native or bilingual proficiency in the target language, including fluency across all language skills (reading, listening, writing, and speaking), alongside strong analytical and verbal communication skills to confidently conduct simulated customer support role-plays.
• Basic computer programming literacy, specifically a comfortable understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and simple logic.
• A meticulous, detail-oriented approach to working with structured prompts, complex evaluation rubrics, and technical guidelines.
• Required Equipment: Access to a high-quality microphone to ensure clean, reliable audio input during voice evaluations.

We offer a pay range of $6-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Workplace Type: Remote

Seniority Level: Mid-Senior Level

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to support our CEO as Supabase continues to scale globally. This person will be a trusted partner to the CEO, helping manage time, communication, priorities, travel, follow-through, and key operating rhythms across a fast-moving, remote-first company.

This role must be based in an APJ / APAC timezone to provide strong timezone coverage for our CEO and leadership team. You’ll work closely with founders, executives, internal stakeholders, investors, and external partners, ensuring the CEO is prepared, focused, and able to spend time on the highest-impact work.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments, has strong judgment, and is excited about supporting a developer-focused company building tools that scale to millions.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

In this role, you’ll:

• Own the CEO’s calendar management, prioritization, and day-to-day operating rhythm.
• Manage inbox triage and communications by monitoring emails, drafting responses, and keeping communication flowing across internal and external stakeholders.
• Prepare briefings, agendas, decks, notes, and follow-up materials so the CEO is ready for every meeting.
• Track follow-ups, decisions, and commitments to help projects move forward and keep stakeholders accountable.
• Coordinate seamless domestic and international travel, logistics, scheduling changes, and last-minute adjustments.
• Support investor meetings, board-related preparation, executive meetings, offsites, and company-wide moments.
• Handle sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion, professionalism, and integrity.
• Anticipate needs, identify blockers early, and solve problems proactively before they escalate.
• Partner across the company to create clarity, improve coordination, and help leadership operate effectively in a global, remote-first environment.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

• Have experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive in a startup or scale-up environment.
• Are based in an APJ / APAC timezone and can provide strong coverage for a globally distributed leadership team.
• Communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences, with excellent written and verbal communication.
• Have experience working in async, remote-first, or globally distributed teams.
• Are tech savvy and comfortable using tools like Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, and AI-enabled workflows.
• Bring strong judgment around prioritization, confidentiality, stakeholder management, and executive communication.
• Are energized by organized chaos, fast-moving priorities, and solving problems before they become blockers.
• Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, moving quickly, and staying several steps ahead.

What We Offer

• Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
• ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
• Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
• Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
• Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
• Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
• Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

• ~400 team members
• 60+ countries
• 20+ languages spoken
• Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
• 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Co miesiąc nawiązujemy współpracę z 7 nowymi osobami. Wierzymy, że ludzie z pasją to klucz do naszego wspólnego sukcesu! title: HR ügyintéző
Senior Project Development Counsel
description:
About the Company

In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects.

Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations.

KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.

KoBold is privately held. Investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the Role

This in-house project development attorney will be a key player in shaping and executing the procurement and contracting strategy for our Mingomba mine build and other projects around the world. Their work will directly support a global AI-driven clean-tech company in its mission to invent breakthrough technology, discover billions of dollars of minerals, and stop climate change.

Responsibilities

The Senior Project Development Counsel will:

• Be an integral part of an in-house legal team in a technology, mineral exploration and mine development company growing rapidly around the world
• Provide leverage and support to the CLO and DGC so that they are more effective at advancing the company’s priorities
• Build important parts of the Company’s legal function with a particular responsibility overseeing the legal work for the development and construction of major capital projects for the Company and owning the full range of global supply chain matters related to such projects
• Lead the drafting and negotiation of the entire suite of contracts for the Company’s Mingomba project in Zambia and other capital projects, from EPC/EPCM and major equipment supply to offtake, O&M, and the surrounding infrastructure agreements (power, water, rail, and port), using FIDIC-based and bespoke forms, developing owner-protective positions, and managing English-law and LCIA/ICC provisions.
• Negotiate with counterparties around the world, including global equipment suppliers and contractors, and state-owned utilities, railways, and ports
• Work with engineering, HSE, project management, community engagement and supply chain stakeholders to bring technical annexures, scope, specifications, site information, and project requirements into the contract documents so that the legal terms match the technical deliverables
• Work with the Company’s project finance team and lenders’ counsel on the bankability of EPC and procurement terms, including direct agreements and lender step-in rights
• Keep a pulse on the rapidly-changing context for the Company’s business and engage constantly with people throughout the Company to be able to make good business judgments that enable the Company to accomplish its business objectives
• Have many opportunities to be involved in other areas as the Company and its legal functions grow, including project finance, import-export, broader compliance, and corporate matters
• Work on whatever needs to be done

Qualifications

• 15-20+ years post-qualification, with substantial recent owner-side experience on large capital projects (mining, oil and gas, LNG, power, or heavy infrastructure)
• Law degree and active admission to practice in England; admission to practice in a U.S. state or another common-law jurisdiction may be considered
• Strong desire and ability to provide leverage, support, and partnership to the CLO and DGC
• Strong drafting and negotiation experience across most of the following: EPC / EPCM / lump-sum turnkey (FIDIC Silver/Yellow and bespoke forms), major equipment procurement and supply, O&M agreements, offtake agreements, and infrastructure agreements (PPAs, water supply, rail and port access, concessions)
• Experience working with international counterparties and operations (and agreements in global jurisdictions), including state-owned enterprises
• Interest in working in a company that requires high levels of collaboration and communication among teammates working remotely across many time zones and continents (including ET, London, Perth, and Zambia)
• Strong ability to learn new tools and an optimistic attitude toward work, people, and solving difficult problems of first instance
• Interest in working in a science-based company where most colleagues are scientists and science is the focus of many company meetings and documents
• A high degree of independence and ability to drive processes forward with little supervision
• Ability and desire to travel periodically, including to Zambia and elsewhere as the Mingomba project and other projects require

It is helpful but not required to have:

• Experience in mining or mineral exploration or adjacent energy sector like oil and gas
• Prior work in Zambia, DRC, or the wider Copperbelt; familiarity with the Lobito Atlantic Railway or Dar es Salaam/Walvis Bay logistics corridors
• Project finance lender-side interface experience (direct agreements, lender step-in, bankability of EPC terms)
• Mandarin language skills
• French language skills

This position is full-time.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $250,000-$290,000, plus equity and benefits.

Location: Fully remote. London strongly preferred; U.S. East Coast also possible. Must be authorized to work in the jurisdiction of residence. The manager for this role is located in the U.S. (East Coast).

Travel: Travel to Zambia as the project requires, and interest in engaging with suppliers globally.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

title: Coordinator, Legal Support (Intern)
description:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Coordinator, Legal Support, accountable for providing reliable administrative and general legal support to the Legal team. The position assists with change orders/amendments, work orders/statements of work, document preparation, research, record management, and general legal administration.

The role requires a foundational understanding of commercial law, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work accurately and autonomously in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist with the preparation, processing, tracking, and administration of change orders/amendments and work orders/statements of work. Support the drafting, formatting, review, and organization of routine commercial documents using approved templates and guidance.
• Maintain accurate and organized legal files, records, trackers, and supporting documentation. Coordinate follow-up items and assist with general administrative tasks and ad hoc projects during both busy and quieter periods.
• Assist with routine research and compliance activities, including gathering information, maintaining records, preparing first drafts, and escalating questions or risks to the appropriate Legal team member.
• Manage assigned tasks across the agreed three-day schedule, communicate progress and potential delays, and work collaboratively with internal stakeholders. Use Microsoft 365 tools to prepare documents, track work, and communicate with the team.
• Undertake other duties as reasonably required to support the Legal team and broader business needs

Requirements

• Coursework or studies focused on commercial law.
• Exposure to intellectual property or privacy law.
• Current enrolment in a Bachelor of Laws, Juris Doctor, or equivalent legal qualification; or relevant paralegal/legal studies qualification.
• Previous employment, internship, volunteer, or administrative experience in a professional environment.
• Demonstrated ability to manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines.
• Previous experience in a legal team, law firm, corporate environment, or paralegal role (Desired, but not required).
• Experience supporting commercial contracts, change orders/amendments, or work orders/statements of work.
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
• Ability to prepare, format, organize, and maintain accurate documents and trackers.
• Familiarity with document management systems (Sharepoint), electronic signature tools (Docusign), and contract management platforms (Jira).

Skills, Knowledge and Specialist Expertise

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously in a remote environment while knowing when to seek guidance.
• Reliability, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential information.
• Working arrangements: This is a casual position, with hours generally expected to be approximately 9 hours per week. Hours may vary depending on business requirements and Legal team priorities, but expectation is working hours are to be spread across three business days.
• Interest in commercial law, intellectual property, and data privacy.

What’s In It For You

• Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
• Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the
position.
• Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a variety of learning and development opportunities from internal and external sources focused on leadership, and professional & personal development.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on the company. Privacy Notice for Job Applicants

Cogstate is committed to protecting your personal data. We collect and process your information for recruitment purposes in compliance with applicable laws, including the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs), the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA), Colorado Privacy Act (CPA), and similar laws in other jurisdictions.
