title: IT Support Manager - Microsoft Managed Services
description:
TEKenable is seeking a dynamic Support Manager to lead our managed services support team. The Support Manager is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of an ITIL-aligned Managed Services team, delivering high-quality support across Microsoft cloud-focused solutions including Azure, .NET-based applications, Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.

The role requires proactive ownership of support operations, identifying and addressing service risks, customer concerns, SLA risks, ageing or stalled tickets and potential escalations before intervention is required. The Support Manager is responsible not only for monitoring and reporting service performance, but for analysing trends and underlying issues, identifying risks and improvement opportunities, recommending appropriate actions and driving those actions through to completion. The role will ensure service stability, effective incident and problem management, high customer satisfaction and continuous improvement across service operations.

The role holder can work remotely, but the position is open to applicants in either Ireland or the UK only.

TEKenable is a leader in digital transformation, specialising in Microsoft cloud solutions and recognised for excellence in AI and Data. With a global presence and a remote-first policy, we deliver innovative managed services to clients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

Service Coordination & Delivery

• Act as the operational bridge between the Service Delivery Manager and functional delivery teams.

• Ensure service levels, KPIs, and contractual obligations are consistently met.

• Support the Service Delivery Manager in contractual compliance, reporting, and client satisfaction initiatives.

• Serve as the point of coordination for internal teams, ensuring smooth communication between technical functions and service management.

• Produce regular and ad hoc reports, dashboards, KPI metrics and presentations for internal stakeholders, ensuring data accuracy and clarity.

• Analyse service performance data to identify trends, underlying causes, risks and areas requiring action, providing clear recommendations rather than reporting metrics in isolation.

• Engage with client operational stakeholders on service delivery matters, while the Service Delivery Manager retains responsibility for overall client relationship, governance, and commercial performance.

• Participate in client service reviews, governance meetings, and operational reporting sessions alongside the Service Delivery Manager.

• Provide service performance insights, trend analysis, and improvement recommendations to client stakeholders.

• Build trusted relationships with client operational leads, ensuring alignment between business needs and service delivery.

Operational Ownership

• Own day-to-day ticket operations including prioritisation, assignment, and SLA adherence

• Own operational issues and escalations through to resolution, ensuring actions are clearly assigned, tracked and followed through to completion.

• Proactively identify service risks, SLA risks, ageing or stalled tickets, customer concerns and potential escalations, taking appropriate action before management or customer intervention is required.

• Manage backlog, ageing tickets, and escalation handling

• Coordinate Major Incidents from identification through resolution, ensuring timely internal and customer communication, clear ownership of actions, and appropriate RCA and follow-up activities.

• Ensure Problem Management activities reduce repeat incidents

• Manage service delivery across multiple clients, balancing competing priorities and ensuring effective allocation of shared resources

• Manage prioritisation between BAU support activities and minor enhancements (run vs change)

• Establish and maintain regular ticket quality reviews, ensuring appropriate documentation, customer communication, troubleshooting, categorisation and adherence to agreed support processes.

Operational Excellence

• Monitor incident and request volumes, escalation trends, and service performance.

• Provide input into dashboards, reports, and forecasting models to support proactive service management.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with the Service Delivery Manager and Director of Managed Services.

• Ensure ITIL-aligned processes are embedded and followed across delivery teams.

• Identify gaps in process adherence and recommend improvements.

• Understand, comply with and actively promote adherence to ISO27001 and ISO9001 policies and procedures.

Skills & Experience

• Strong grounding in ITIL v4 practices (Foundation certification required; Intermediate/Managing Professional desirable).

• Proven experience in managed services delivery coordination within enterprise environments.

• Familiarity with incident, problem, change, and request management processes.

• Experience working in multi-location delivery models, ideally with offshore/nearshore coordination.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.

• Analytical mindset with experience in KPI tracking, reporting, and service performance analysis.

• Exposure to Microsoft technology stack (Business Central, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform)

• Previous experience using Delivery Platforms (FreshService, Datadog)

Key Competencies

• Proactive Ownership & Accountability – takes ownership of service operations, identifies risks and issues early, takes appropriate action and drives activities through to completion without requiring continual management intervention.

• Leadership & People Development – able to motivate, coach, and manage diverse teams across geographies.

• Process-driven mindset with attention to compliance and governance.

• Collaborative leadership—able to influence without direct authority.

• Analytical and Data-Driven Thinking – able to interpret service data, identify trends and underlying causes, assess risks and translate findings into meaningful insight and clear recommendations.

• Resilience and adaptability in managing escalations and shifting priorities.

• Continuous improvement orientation—always seeking efficiency and service quality gains.

• Initiative & Tooling for Improvement – proactively identifies opportunities to enhance delivery and leverages automation, dashboards, and service management tooling (e.g., ITSM platforms, monitoring, reporting, and analytics) to drive measurable improvements in performance, transparency, and client value.

• Stakeholder Management & Communication – communicates clearly with customers, technical teams and management, and is comfortable challenging, escalating and influencing where appropriate.

Why apply

• Remote-first flexibility anywhere from Ireland or the UK with global collaboration across Spain, Hungary, and UAE.
• Industry-leading transformation challenges using Microsoft tech in AI, Dynamics, and Data solutions.
• Professional recognition, including Deloitte Fast 50, Microsoft Business Applications Partner of the Year, and more.
• Career growth through coaching, structured development, and international exposure.

Requirements

• Strong grounding in ITIL v4 practices (Foundation certification required; Intermediate/Managing Professional desirable).
• Proven experience in managed service delivery coordination within enterprise environments.
• Familiarity with incident, problem, change, and request management processes.
• Experience working in multi-location delivery models, ideally with offshore/nearshore coordination.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
• Analytical mindset with experience in KPI tracking, reporting, and service performance analysis.
• Exposure to Microsoft technology stack (Business Central, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform)
• Previous experience using ITSM Platform

TEKenable's culture is built upon the values of resilience, heartfelt service, always striving and insatiable curiosity. You can learn more about our values at www.tekenable.ie. Candidates applying for this role need to be able to demonstrate how they have applied these values in other roles and how they'll contribute to them, should they be successful.

At TEKenable we foster a culture of diversity and inclusion as we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, disability, sexual orientation, generation, ethnicity, religion, family or parental status, neurodiversity or belief.

Hiring Process

Once you are successfully selected for interview a dedicated talent acquisition manager will reach out and arrange a short pre-screening call. We want to learn more about you and the experience you can bring to the position. The interview process will have 2-3 stages and we will work around your availability. You will the opportunity to talk with our recruitment team at various points throughout the process. All interview stages will be conducted remotely via video calls and arranged at a time that fits with your schedule. We will close the position once the role is filled.

Benefits

Remote working & sustainability - Experience the flexibility to work from Ireland or the UK, avoiding the stress of being stuck in car jams, saving valuable commute time to an office, while actively contributing to a lower carbon footprint and the fight against climate change.

Equipment - We'll set you up with a laptop and any other equipment you might need to get the job done.

Flexible working hours - Once pre-approved by line management, employees can benefit from flexibility around core business hours Monday to Friday.

Health & life Insurance - We offer a comprehensive health & life insurance to ensure your well-being and peace of mind.

Pension Scheme - A supportive employee pension scheme is offered to help you build a secure and comfortable future

Training & Development Support - We invest in your professional growth through structured learning opportunities, certifications, and career development pathways tailored to your role and ambitions.

Sports & Social Events - Join a vibrant community through regular sports activities, team outings, and social events that bring colleagues together and foster meaningful connections beyond work.

Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - Access confidential support, counselling, and well-being resources through our Employee Assistance Programme ,because your mental and emotional health matter just as much as your professional success.

Állás leírása

Feladatok

Vegyipari és petrolkémiai üzemek mérő- és irányítástechnikai rendszerein dolgozhatsz.
A próbaidő alatt eldöntheted, melyik üzletágban szeretnél szakosodni: az üzemeltetés és karbantartás, vagy a terepi kivitelezés, szerelés területén.

1. Üzemeltetési és karbantartási üzletág
Ebben az üzletágban a már működő technológiai rendszerek megbízható és biztonságos üzemelését segíted.

• Műszerek ellenőrzése és karbantartása: gyártóberendezések és automatizált technológiai rendszerek mérő- és vezérlőeszközeinek helyszíni ellenőrzése, állapotfelmérése és karbantartása.
• Hibakeresés és hibaelhárítás: Irányítástechnikai, vezérlőrendszerek hibáinak felismerése, okaik feltárása és szakszerű javítása.
• Üzemeltetési feladatok támogatása: a működés során felmerülő műszaki problémák megoldása, közreműködés a berendezések üzembiztonságának fenntartásában.
• Karbantartási és fejlesztési projektek: részvétel a meglévő mérő- és irányítástechnikai rendszerek karbantartási és fejlesztési munkáiban.

2. Kivitelezési és szerelési üzletág
Ebben az üzletágban a mérő- és irányítástechnikai rendszerek helyszíni kiépítésében, telepítésében és üzembe helyezésében veszel részt.

• Terepi kivitelezés: mérő- és irányítástechnikai installációk megvalósítása ipari, vegyipari és petrolkémiai környezetben.
• Műszerek és vezérlőeszközök szerelése: új eszközök helyszíni telepítése és beépítése a technológiai rendszerekbe.
• Beállítás és üzembe helyezés: a beépített mérő- és vezérlőeszközök beállítása, üzembe helyezése és a kapcsolódó műszaki támogatás.

Mindkét üzletágban a műszaki és mérnöki csapat támogatása mellett végzed majd a feladataid.

Elvárások

• Legalább középfokú, erősáramú, vagy irányítástechnikai végzettség.
• Műszaki rajzok, kapcsolási rajzok értelmezésének gyakorlata.
• "B" kategóriás jogosítvány.
• Minimum 3 éves iparban eltöltött szakmai tapasztalat.

Előnyt jelent

• Robbanásveszélyes (Ex) térben végzett munka gyakorlata, képzettsége.
• Korábbi karbantartási vagy kivitelezési projektekben való részvétel.
• Egyéb vegyipari, petrolkémiai tapasztalat.

Amit kínálunk

Amit kínálunk

• Bruttó 600–950 ezer Ft havi munkabér. A bérkategóriádat a végzettséged, a szakmai tapasztalatod és a speciális szaktudásod alapján közösen határozzuk meg.
• Teljesítménybónusz az alapbéren felül. A kiemelkedő munkát teljesítményhez kötött bónuszrendszerben ismerjük el.
• Cafeteria és hűségjutalom. A munkabéredet béren kívüli juttatásokkal egészítjük ki, a cégnél eltöltött éveket pedig külön hűségjutalommal ismerjük el.
• Munkarend munkanapokon 7:00–15:20 között. Az alapmunkarend mellett túlóra és készenlét vállalására is van lehetőség, amellyel további keresetre tehetsz szert.
• Személyautó a munkába járáshoz. A napi bejárásodhoz céges személyautót biztosítunk.
• Magáncélú járműhasználat lehetősége. Céges személyautók és teherautók magáncélú igénybevételére is van lehetőség.
• Konkrét szakmai feladatok ipari üzemekben. Vegyipari és petrolkémiai üzemek mérő- és irányítástechnikai rendszereinek telepítésén, karbantartásán és hibáinak elhárításán dolgozhatsz.
• Szakmabeli közvetlen vezetők. Vezetőid a szakmád szakértői.
• Támogatott szakmai képzések. Képzésekkel és továbbképzésekkel segítjük szakmai tudásod bővítését.
• Hosszú távú munkalehetőség. Egy 25 éve működő ipari szolgáltató vállalathoz csatlakozhatsz, ahol hosszú távra tervezünk veled.

Munkahelyi extrák

• Céges étkező
• Céges rendezvények
• Céges busz
• Ingyen kávé, üdítő

Céginformáció

Fejlődj tovább a szakmádban az Ipartechnológiánál!
Szeretnél nagyobb szakmai megbecsülést? Szeretnéd bővíteni a tudásodat az ipari műszerezés és irányítástechnika területén? Nálunk vegyipari és petrolkémiai üzemek rendszerein dolgozhatsz, szakmabeli szakértő vezetők és munkatársak mellett.
Az Ipartechnológia Kft. 25 éve működő, magyar tulajdonú ipari szolgáltató vállalat.
Ipari berendezések kivitelezésével, üzemeltetésével foglalkozunk.
Szolgáltatásaink a technológiai rendszerek karbantartásától és hibaelhárításától az automatizáláson, folyamatirányító rendszerek fejlesztésén, villamos elosztó- és vezérlőszekrények tervezésén, gyártásán át a komplex villamos, gépészeti és irányítástechnikai projektekig terjednek.

Executive Assistant, Biostatistics

• Full-time

Company Description

PSI is a leading Contract Research Organization (CRO) with 30 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. Originated in Switzerland, PSI is a privately owned, full-service CRO with a global reach, supporting clinical trials across multiple countries and continents. Our reputation for being highly selective about the projects we undertake highlights our commitment to delivering high-quality, timely services across a broad spectrum of therapeutic indications.

At PSI, we foster an environment where a diverse range of colleagues feel welcomed and valued. Our inclusive culture is a cornerstone of our success, enabling us to attract and retain top talent globally.

We offer an inspiring story of the company that has grown organically from a handful of countries to global presence. PSI is a mature company with standards and practices, but we do not stand still. Every day, there is a figurative Everest to climb, and you will not get bored here.

Job Description

We are looking for an Executive Assistant to support our Head of Biostatistics and the wider Biostatistics team. This is a trusted and varied role at the heart of the department, combining executive support and global coordination within a clinical research environment

What you’ll be doing:

• Managing calendars, meetings, events, and travel arrangements
• Preparing presentations, reports, correspondence, and meeting minutes
• Coordinating administrative activities across internal and external parties
• Maintaining accurate departmental records and tracking systems
• Supporting departmental performance appraisal activities and data collection
• Handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism

Qualifications

• Previous Executive Assistant or administrative support experience
• Experience supporting senior leaders and/or a department
• Experience working in a global environment is preferred
• Experience in the clinical research industry
• Knowledge of general clinical trial processes
• College or university degree

Additional Information

For someone who enjoys being one step ahead, creating structure, and helping leaders and teams perform at their best, this role provides an opportunity to make a visible and meaningful contribution. You will take ownership of activities that directly contribute to the effectiveness of the department.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET/React) - AI Services
description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

Our client is building the software that hearing clinics run on patient records, bookings, hearing tests and sales. Clinic chains and hospitals use it every day. You join the team that owns the Sales domain: quote, invoice, insurance claim and payment. We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who ships business outcomes, not just tickets. You own features end to end - from why a clinic needs them, through design and build, to checking in production that they worked. AI coding agents are a normal part of every step of your work.

Tech environment:C# / .NET 8.0, Azure Services (Azure SQL, AI Search, Service Bus, App Insights, Data Factory), Entity Framework Core, Docker, Kubernetes, MassTransit, React with TypeScript, plus growing use of Python for AI tooling and experimentation.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

• Design, build and run full-stack features in the Sales domain: .NET services, event-driven integrations and React front end.
• Work with the Product Owner and QA from discovery onwards. Shape the spec and agree acceptance criteria before code is written.
• Find the gaps in a spec before you build. Close the small ones yourself and bring only business questions to the Product Owner.
• Use AI tools across the whole lifecycle: planning, design, build, testing, review and maintenance. Keep the human judgement on correctness, security and data protection.
• Own quality: unit and integration tests, code review, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, observability) as part of the design.
• Follow features into production: watch telemetry and usage, support releases, investigate incidents and close the loop with the product team.
• Contribute to architecture discussions and decision records with the Tech Lead and architects and help pay down tech debt in the sales flows.
• Make the team better at AI: mentor engineers and share the instructions, checks and small tools that work.

Product Mindset

As AI takes on more of the typing, the value of an engineer moves to judgement: knowing what to build, why, and what good looks like for the user. In this role you:

• Start every feature with the business question: who in the clinic uses it, and what problem it solves for them.
• Push back with alternatives when a request is expensive and a simpler solution gives most of the value.
• Explain technical trade-offs in business terms to Product Owners, delivery and customer-facing colleagues.
• Look at usage, support tickets and customer feedback after release, and feed what you learn into the next iteration.

IF YOU ARE

• Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and running production systems. We value practical experience and demonstrated capabilities over years alone.
• Strong hands-on experience with C# and modern .NET, including:
• Core and Web APIs.
• Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core.
• Clean Architecture and maintainable application design.
• Solid frontend development experience using React and TypeScript, particularly for complex business applications.
• Practical experience designing and developing microservices architectures.
• Understanding of asynchronous communication and event-driven systems, ideally using:
• Azure Service Bus.
• MassTransit.
• Similar messaging and event-processing technologies.
• Strong SQL database experience, including relational data modelling and transactional business data.
• Experience with API design, automated testing, debugging, and security fundamentals.
• Hands-on experience using AI coding agents as part of everyday development, such as:
• Ability to demonstrate practical AI-assisted development workflows, including examples of reviewing AI-generated code, identifying mistakes, and understanding when AI should not be used.
• Strong product mindset, with examples of contributing to feature definition, understanding business needs, and influencing technical and product decisions.
• Good command of English (B2 or above), both written and spoken.

NICE TO HAVE

• Python for AI tooling, evaluations and prototypes.
• Features built on LLM APIs: prompting, tool use, and measuring the quality of the results.
• Experience in regulated domains (medical devices, healthcare, finance) or with sensitive personal data.
• AKS / Kubernetes.
• You have built or improved developer tooling, CI/CD or AI agent setups that other engineers use.

AS AN OPINOV8R, YOU WILL HAVE

• Digital-First Approach:Great talent knows no borders! You can work from wherever you are — we hire and collaborate with professionals worldwide.
• Remote Work Model:Balance your professional and personal life with our flexible working conditions, empowering you to deliver your best from anywhere.
• Exciting Projects:Dive into impactful projects across industries that challenge and spark creativity.
• Boost Your Expertise:Grow your career with continuous learning, development opportunities, and hands-on experience.
• Join the Best Team Ever:Collaborate with our diverse and cross-cultural team of passionate technologists and creative thinkers.

HOW’S THE HIRING PROCESS GOING

We strive to make our hiring process smooth and transparent to find the perfect match for both sides. Steps may differ depending on the role, but here’s what to expect:

• Initial Interview: If your background fits the role, we’ll invite you for an interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist.
• Technical Interview:Depending on the position, you may complete a technical assessment or test task.
• Client's Interviews: 2 rounds
• Final Decision:After all steps, we’ll get back to you with the result and next steps.

title: Tower Leader / Service Line Leader – Supply Chain
description:
Everything is possible with the right people

In4ge jest firmą rekrutacyjną, w której wierzymy, że wszystko jest możliwe dzięki odpowiednim ludziom. Naszym celem jest połączenie najbardziej utalentowanych pracowników z odpowiednimi firmami, tworząc synergiczne relacje, które przyczyniają się do wzrostu i sukcesu każdej ze stron. Uważamy, że prawdziwą wartość stanowią ludzie pracujący wspólnie w atmosferze wzajemnego szacunku i zaufania.

Dla naszego Klienta poszukujemy doświadczonej osoby na stanowisko Tower Leader / Service Line Leader.

W tej roli przejmiesz kompleksowe zarządzanie dostarczaniem usług (Application Management i Application Development) dla tzw. planning tower w obszarze Supply Chain, Transportation & Warehousing. Będziesz kluczowym liderem lokalnym (poziom Senior Leadership), odpowiedzialnym za wydajność operacyjną, relacje ze strategicznymi interesariuszami (w tym na poziomie VP) oraz współpracę z globalnymi zespołami (offshore). To rola o wysokiej ekspozycji biznesowej, wymagająca połączenia wiedzy domenowej z doskonałymi umiejętnościami przywódczymi w złożonym, macierzowym środowisku.

Zakres roli:

• Zarządzanie end-to-end usługami AM i AD w ramach linii serwisowej wspierającej planowanie, logistykę i magazynowanie.
• Pełna odpowiedzialność za jakość dostarczanych usług, realizację wskaźników SLA/KPI, koszty, mitygację ryzyk oraz ład operacyjny (governance).
• Pełnienie funkcji głównego punktu eskalacyjnego oraz budowanie partnerskich relacji z interesariuszami wyższego szczebla (Executive/VP).
• Nadzór strategiczny nad złożonym krajobrazem aplikacji wspierających globalne operacje łańcucha dostaw.
• Identyfikowanie szans na ciągłe doskonalenie usług (continuous improvement), optymalizację kosztów oraz rozwój biznesu.
• Wspieranie planowania strategicznego, definiowanie map drogowych dla systemów (roadmaps) oraz nadzór nad inicjatywami transformacyjnymi.
• Zapewnianie przywództwa, mentoringu i wsparcia dla Delivery Leaders, Service Delivery Managers oraz rozproszonych zespołów technicznych.

description:
Jesteśmy firmą technologiczną, która koncentruje się na tworzeniu i wdrażaniu rozwiązań IT opartych na produktach Microsoft. Dostarczamy intuicyjne aplikacje i systemy wspierające zarządzanie procesami biznesowymi, pomagając naszym klientom usprawniać codzienną pracę i rozwijać ich biznes.

Na czym będzie polegać Twoja praca?

Jako Junior Consultant będziesz wspierać realizację projektów wdrożeniowych Dynamics 365 Business Central i stopniowo przejmować odpowiedzialność za własne zadania.

Do Twoich obowiązków będzie należeć:

• interesuje się analizą biznesową, konsultingiem IT i systemami ERP,

• lubi pracę projektową i kontakt z klientem,

Co oferujemy?

Jeżeli chcesz połączyć wiedzę biznesową z technologią i rozwijać się w kierunku konsultanta systemów ERP, zapraszamy do naszego zespołu.

• 15+ years in IT delivery, engineering, or consulting environments
• 5+ years in senior delivery leadership, managing portfolios, leading teams of managers, and working closely with P&L
• Proven track record across large, complex, multi-stream engagements with global clients. Comfortable in a matrixed, multi-stakeholder environment. Makes an impact without needing to own everything. Earns trust through consistency, follow-through, and fronting delivery personally where it matters
• Experience across multiple delivery models: T&M, managed capacity, managed services, fixed price
• Active involvement in presales, solution shaping, and commercial negotiation
• Prior hands-on engineering background is essential. This role requires genuine technology credibility
• Strong grasp of modern software engineering, cloud platforms, and AI-native delivery practices. Sees Poland's scale and EPAM's position at the forefront of AI-native delivery as a genuine opportunity. Motivated by the work itself, not the title. Leads hands-on
• A genuine advocate for AI-led ways of working who champions adoption and leads by example in an AI-first environment
• Fluent English (C1+)

We offer

• We gather like-minded people:
• Engineering community of industry professionals
• Friendly team and enjoyable working environment
• Flexible schedule and opportunity to work remotely within Poland
• Chance to work abroad for up to 60 days annually
• Business-driven relocation opportunities
• We provide growth opportunities:
• Outstanding career roadmap
• Leadership development, career advising, soft skills, and well-being programs
• Certification (GCP, Azure, AWS)
• Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, Get Abstract, Cloud Guru
• English classes
• We cover it all:
• Stable income (Employment Contract or B2B)
• Participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan
• Benefits package (health insurance, multisport, shopping vouchers)
• Strategically located offices featuring entertainment and relaxation zones, table tennis and football, free snacks, fantastic coffee, and more
• Referral bonuses
• Corporate, social and well-being events
• Please, note:
• The set of bonuses might vary based on the role you apply for – specifics will be discussed with our recruiter during the general interview.

EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.

title: Data Scientist (Python / Machine Learning / AWS)
description:
Salary: 24000 - 32000 PLN per month (B2B)

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join a team developing data-driven solutions in the cybersecurity industry.

In this role, you will combine machine learning, data processing, and software engineering to build reliable solutions. You will work with complex datasets and help bring machine learning models into production.

What We Offer

• Work on meaningful, data-driven projects in the cybersecurity space.
• A chance to build ML solutions that go into real production systems.
• Collaboration with an experienced, supportive engineering team.
• Room for professional growth and learning new technologies.
• Flexible work arrangements.

Requirements:

• Python
• AWS
• Machine learning

• Develop, train, and optimize machine learning models, including anomaly detection, using scikit-learn and XGBoost.
• Process and transform large datasets in Python (e.g. Polars, PyArrow) and build feature engineering and data validation workflows.
• Work with AWS data services (S3, Athena, Glue) and write SQL for data access.
• Package and manage models with MLflow, with artifacts stored on S3.
• Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate ML solutions into production systems.

Daily tasks:

•  Professional experience in Data Science or Machine Learning. 
•  Strong Python skills, including data processing libraries. 
•  Hands-on experience with scikit-learn (e.g. Random Forest, Isolation Forest) and XGBoost. 
•  Good knowledge of SQL and experience with structured datasets. 
•  Experience with AWS (S3, Athena, Glue) and MLflow or similar model management tools. 
•  Solid understanding of feature engineering, model evaluation, and data validation. 
•  Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
